tei:div.tei:p: rdzipyadzaྈ/ngapyarir+sha/5bhe/ /phong/rngopyashātswatrī/mophotshetsu/ ngapre8/// /pre lge ngh+ru pho / jamacho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyurakhang gis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang gis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod 〉rtsom sgrig tshogs mi/gtso sgrig pa/ dge gnyen/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ tshe mgon/ bla ma lha/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ hūṃ chen/ gcod pa klu rgyal/tshe ring bkra shis/ phag mo tshe brtan/

dkar chagadakar chagadage gnyen/ rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/ (1)sgrung gtam/che ring don grub/ma cwang / (1)zla ba'i gtam rgyud/ (5)stag 'bum rgyal/mi tshe yi glu tshig (8)bstan pa yar rgyas/lha chu lha shing / (16)pad+ma che brtan/lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/ (26)shog lhe gcig (40)dpal ldan/mgo dkris dmar po/ (47)zon thar rgyal/dur slog mkhan/ (52)dmigs bu/ zhwa mo dmar po/ (62)— 1 —

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/skyabs chen bde grol/ rlung rta'i smre ngag (74)nag po skal bzang /klu 'bum mi rgod/ (85)lhub/ rtsom/ljang bu/ mig shel gyon pa'i khang rtseg (109)stong bsam/ (113)bkra shis dpal ldan/khrom lam du 'phrad pa'i char ba/ (117)a lo rin chen rgyal po/nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/ (121)gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/ (128)dkon mchog rdo rje/gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i skyid sdug (137)pad+ma rig 'dzin/'gyod snang med pa'i dgun ljongs shig (146)khyung bzang /gces phrug ma/ (151)lha byams rgyal/bum chung gi rma kha/ (153)do smyon che ring bkra shis/nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di/ (156)— 2 —

dkar chagamada' btsan po/chu len bu mo/ (158)rmog ru shes rab rdo rje/ bag chags kyis dkrol ba'i rol dbyangs/ (160)'ba' seng smyon/sems gshis kyi rgyang 'bod/ (162)byang skar/64ga zhen/ (165)ldong yon tan rgya mcho/nga la glu zhig len du chugs/ (168)a rdor/brtse ba khrom khrom/ (172)mdzes se gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/ (177)kun thar rgyal/gangs ljongs gzhon nu gsar ba/ (182)sa dkyil che bkra/dran/ (186)pad+ma dbang rgyal/me tog gso mkhan gyi rmi lam/ (188)re rkang gling /las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa'i le'u/ (191)rang gsal/bod pa'i bu phrug (197)— 3 —

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/me lce/nang ma khang dang slob grwa chen mo pa/ (201)a bu/bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/ (207)zhogs dung /'gro ba mi'i rigs ni tshe srog gi gshed ma yin nam/ (224)dge gnyen/‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrags mdangs/ (232)klu 'bum che ring /sems kyi 'khrus gsol/ (257)snyan ngagaljang bu/sems khral zirdogs shig (259)nor bu/ (261)'brong /lham chung dmar po/ (264)gangs 'cho/rje mi la ras pa (265)'ju skal bzang /gsar du rnyed pa'i rgyal khams/ (267)snyan ngag pa'i rgyal khams/ (269)gcan me stagarlung ldang ba'i snga rol/ (271)snyan ngag (274)— 4 —

dkar chagasmreng bu/lam gya ma gyu/ gzhas tha ma thor/ (276)klu tshang smyug rtsen/rkyang thang / (278)pha yul la btang ba'i gzhas/ (279)skyabs chen bde grol/rdzi glu/ bdag gi skom pa sel ba'i rdzi glu/ (280)na zug 'jags thub pa'i phyir du khyod la bos pa/ (282)ri sngon bla ma thar/khyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dus/ (284)'brog bsam gtan/sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gi (286)zhi bde nyi ma/rgyu rkyen mang po mi dgos/ (290)bde skyid sgrol ma/zla tho chu mo dgu mdud/ (292)ge sar/mtshan ces mang po zhig la/ (297)kher skyes/chung ma dran pa/ (299)khri sems dpa'/'grul bzhud ring mo/ (302)mcho bu dga' bde/grong sde chen po/ (309)— 5 —

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gnya' gong lha ste/dus skabs de tsho/ (311)bsgral rdo/kha ba dang po/ (315)zur bkod/zhogs dung /sgal :rdogs/ (318)ljang bu/phebs skyel smre sngags sum sgril/ (321)'bar rde'u/mi bu/ (322)'brong / tshig rkang bdun ma'i snyan ngag gi zhu gsol/ (323)byang skar/snyan ngag pa nam yang bzhud mi srid/ (325)dpal ldan rgya mcho/phul byung ba/ (327)kha sgang bkra shis tshe ring /mi rigs kyi la rgya snying rtse nas 'bar ba'i snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring dus gtan du nga tsho'i sems khong du gnas nges/(329)me lce/ nub bzhud kyi gangs seng (331)—d+ngha 6 —

dkar chagasgrol dkar skyid/phangs pa'i skyel ma zhu/ (333)rta nag zla ba gzhon nu/sems mdangs ri mor bris pa'i snyan tshig (334)mcho bu dga' bde/snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring / (336)dbang drag rgyal/sems kyi mya ngan/ (339)khyung thar rgyal/sems pa'i ri rab nyil song / (340)mdo smad he ru kakha ba'i mi/ (343)mjug byang / (346)

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/da 〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉spel 'go tshugs par zhus pa/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang / tang krung dbyang gis rang re'i rgyal khab kyi gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las rigs la yang dang yang du‘‘nye bcar gsum’’gyi re 'dun te/ ‘‘dngos gnas dang nye bar bcar ba/ 'tsho ba dang nye bar bcar ba/ mang tshogs dang nye bar bcar ba’’bcas bton zhing /sngon bas bzang bar rgyal khab kyi‘‘dpal yon rnam gsum’’gong du spol bar zhabs phyi dgos tshul nan ston gnang phyin/ gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las don tsam gyis ma zad par/ rig gnas las don spyi nas kyang thad kar spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho tshim par bya dgos pa'i re 'dun bton/da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉spel 'go tshugs nas lo ngo55'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshul gyis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ces pa'i mu ldan deb phreng 'di spel ba'i 'go bzung /deb phreng 'di'i khag dang po la deb bzhi 'dus shing / rang re'i tshags par du lo mang po'i ring bkod zin pa'i gsar 'gyur brtsams chos dang rtsom rig brtsams chos dang rtsom rig dpyad mol dang rtsom rig mi sna ngo sprod bcas phyogs kyi rtsom yag shos las tshod 'dzin nges can zhig yod par phyogs sgrig byas yod pa yin/ de yang / 'di ni lo mang po'i yun du rim pa so so'i tang srid dbu khrid dang zhing chen phyi nang gi rgya che'i rig gnas las gnyer pa 1

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis nga tshor rgyab skyor thugs khur gnang bar drin lan ma brjed pa'i sems tsam mtshon pa'i legs skyes su‘‘me tog chung yang lha rdzas’’tshul du phul ba yin/ 〈dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs〉ni sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag sogs kyis grub pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi deb cig yin/ spyir bod yig tu rtsom rig spel ba'i srol rgyun ring yang /srol gsar 'byed pa'i phyogs nas da dung 'bad dgos par gzhigs nas khyad chos nges can ldan pa'i brtsams chos btus nas bsgrigs pa yin la/nang sgos ring thung gi tshad tshags par du 'god 'tsham la sngon gyi srol lam yangs bskyed la phan par dmigs nas lhug rtsom gyis gtso ba bzos yod cing /'di ni srol rgyun ldan pa'i rig khag de phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba'i 'dun pa mtshon tsam lags/ 〈nags klong khu byug 'du gnas〉ni deng rabs bod yig gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs dang len bzhin pa'i rtsom pa po ngo sprod dang khong rnam pa'i 'thus tshab tu rung ba'i rtsom re gnyis ngo sprod tshul du bsgrigs pa yin/ 〈mu tig gling gi dga' ston〉nang du rtsom rig dpyad mol gyi rigs bsgrigs yod/ snga ma bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig lo rgyus 'bri bar mthun rkyen bzos pa yin pas rig khag gsar ba bskrun par gzhigs pa dang / phyi ma bod yig brgyud pa'i rtsom rig dpyad mol da rung zhan pa la skul spel dang / bod du da rung rtsom rig mtha' dpyad(spralhaṅgekhusnyetsho༄spradze+e.ā+oṃkhumi 1)kyi rig khag chags med pa de 'thus tshang yong ched bsgrigs pa yin/ 〈gom stabs dang zhabs rjes〉ni gsar 'gyur gyi rtsom btus te/ bod yig steng nas da rung gsar 'gyur rig pa'i rig khag dar med par gzhigs nas 'di'i lam srol 'byed par mthun rkyen tsam bzos pa yin/2

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/rtsom rig ni dmangs spyi la dbang ba'i khyad chos 'dzin zhing / mi dmangs kyi rlabs po che ba'i spyi tshogs lag len dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba rol stangs dang yid du 'ong ba'i chags sdang rnam 'gyur bcas ni rtsom rig gi brjod don thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin la/ 'di dag gsal lhang brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon pa'i 'gan babs khur 'dug pa ni rtsom rig ljon dbang nyid kyi tshe dpal nyams med ring du 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan du'ang gyur yod/ rtsom rig gi ngo bo nyid ci yin pa la kha tshon gcod sla ba zhig min na yang / rim byon mkhas mchog rnams kyis yang yang dpyad nas bye ma las gser btsags yong ba'i gnad rnyed pa lta na/ rtsom rig ni ngag gi sgyu rtsal la brten nas dngos gnas las lta ba mtho ba dang / dngos gnas las go ba zab pa dang / dngos gnas las 'bur du thon pa dang / dngos gnas las 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa'i tshul du mtshon 'god byung ba na/yong khungs dmangs yin la 'phrod yul yang dmangs yin pa'i nang rkyen gnas phyir/ de ni spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur gyi 'phar rtsa brtag gnas shig dang dmangs kyi 'tsho bar blang dor bslab pa'i gnas shig yin la/ 'gro ba mir ltung shan gyi gshis kyang zhor du ldan pa'i‘‘rnam shes’’de ya rabs dpal yon can gyi phyogs su ngang gis 'dren pa'i yon tan bskyang yong ba yin/srid zhi gnyis las mngon srid spyi tshogs kyi don skyong bar spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod kyi sgyu rtsal thabs lam nas gnas tshul du gnas lugs ston 'gyur ba ni nyid kyi khyad chos lhang nge ba zhig red/ gsar 'gyur la'ang dmangs spyi la dbang ba'i khyad chos yod cing / brjod bya 'dzin stangs kyi cha nas brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon dgos pa'i nges pa med pa dang /spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod dang sgyu 'phrul lta bu'i nyams snang mi bzo ba dang /3

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/dngos gnas las lta ba mtho ba dang go ba zab pa dang 'bur du thon pa dang 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa bcas thad nas rtsom rig las dma' ba tsam las shin tu nye mtshungs yin srid/ deng gi dus 'dir ga 'dra'i yag par snang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i don dag la bsngags skul gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i rin thang ldan zhing gzengs su 'don 'tshal ba'i don dag dar spel gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i ma rabs tha shal gyi don dag la mtshang 'byin lcag gzhus gtong rgyu yod pa/ 'di dag ni gsar 'gyur gyi dmigs bya yin la rtsom rig gi dmigs bya yang yin pas/ 'di gar 'dus pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos dang gsar 'gyur brtsams chos kyang 'di nang bzhin lag bstar byas pa'i grub 'bras lags/‘‘nye bcar gsum’’zer ba'i dmigs gnad de dngos gnas su snang ba'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang 'tsho ba las thon pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang mang tshogs la phrad pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho tshim par byed pa la kha gtad yod pa red/ nye bcar gyi ldog zla rgyang bkyed pa yin nges/ nye bar bcar ba'i dmigs gnad kyi ldog zla'i don ni skabs bab dang thad kar gyi dgos mkhor brtsi 'jog dang len mi byed pa la go / gal te khyed kyis bris pa'i rtsom mam gnyer bzhin pa'i rig gnas gang de dngos gnas dang 'tsho ba dang mang tshogs dang rgyang bkyed cing / skabs su bab pa'i thad kar dgos gtug la brtsi 'jog dang len ma byas tshe/ phan mi thogs pa min pa'i dbang du btang na yang / gos lham phyi nas za 'phrug langs sar 'brad pa dang gnyis su med pas/ gang dang su yis dmigs btsugs nas khyed kyi grub 'bras la mthong chung byas pa min na yang / dngos gnas dang 'tsho ba dang mang tshogs kyis kyang khyed kyi las ka der brtsi 'jog dang len thad nas rgyang 4

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/bkyed srid pa red/ yang na/ ya rabs su snyeg pa ni mi'i rang gshis dang spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo dang sbrags mar gnas pa'i khyad chos shig yin srid mod/'on te de dang 'gal zla gcig gyur gyi tshul du mi'i rigs la da rung ma rabs ltung shan gyi rang gshis dang spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang phyin ci log pa zhig kyang lus dang grib ma ji bzhin yod pas/ rig gnas kyi las ka thams cad po yar 'phel sngon thon gyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i nges pa med/ 'di bzhin du nye bcar gyi rig gnas las ka la'ang lhad skyon mi 'dres pa dang rdzun 'khrul mi 'byung ba zhig ga la yin/ yin na yang bcar nye ba'i dbang du dang len 'thob sla ba dang 'thob pa khyab che ba'i rkyen gyis lhad skyon sel mgyogs pa dang de'i phyir bden rdzun brdar myur ba'i khyad chos 'dzin pas/ yar 'phel sngon thon gyi chos can dang yang bcar nye ba yin srid/ ‘‘lag len ni bden lugs bsher ba'i gzhan bkag tshad gzhi 'ba' zhig yin’’zhes pa'i legs bshad 'di nas kyang / bden pa rnyed dgos na bcar nye min dang lag len dang 'brel dam min bcas la rag las yod pa mngon shugs gnyis nas shes/de yang / rnam pa gang yang rung ba'i rig gnas shig chags zin pa na/ de la 'chun skul gnyis kyi byed nus yod pa yin/ srog gcod mi rung zhes pa'i rig gnas lta ba 'di chags phyin/ mi gsod rta 'ded dam mi shi rta 'gyel lta bu'i nyes dmigs 'gog pa dang / skye khams kyi dngos po kun dang mdza' mthun ngang 'tsho ba rol nas phyi ma'i phyi mar 'tsho rten skyong ba'i thad nas 'chun rkyen du 'gyur srid/ yin na yang / rig gnas de 'dra'i khor yug nas nya las skyong ba dang bshas tshong rgyag pa lta bu'i lag len la tshod 'dzin byed pa myong grub yod pa de bzhin/ 'chun rkyen des phyin log la tshod 'dzin byed pa tsam gyis ma zad par yar 'phel la'ang tshod 'dzin byed srid/ 'on te gtso 5

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/bo phyin log la tshod 'dzin pa red/ skul rkyen des ya rabs la skul 'ded tsam gyis ma zad par ma rabs la'ang skul 'ded byed srid/ 'on te gtso bo ya rabs la skul 'ded byed pa red/ de'i phyir mi dmangs kyi dngos gnas lag len dang 'tsho bar bcar nye ba'i rig gnas spel na/ skul rkyen gyi drang phyogs yon tan ches cher gtong ba dang 'chun rkyen gyi ldog phyogs byed nus las sgrol bar 'gro ba'i phan yon de rgyang bkyed pa'i rig gnas las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba shin tu gsal/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas spel na ni yar 'phel sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang yang thag nye ba red/ nye bcar rig gnas spel ba'i mi la rgyang bkyed rig gnas spel ba'i mi las rig gnas dang lag len byang tshad thad kyi blang bya de bas mtho ba red/ kho tsho rig gnas la mkhas shing rig gnas lag len la 'jon thang ldan dgos pa ma zad/ yig thog gam rigs gzhung tsam gyis mi chog par/spyi tshogs la brtag mkhas shing spyi tshogs lag len nang thad kar zhugs nas skabs bab don bya yag 'khyongs la'ang 'jon thang ldan dgos/ rgyang bkyed rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos de mi sger gyis yun ring las bya'i rnam pa can zhig yin la/ nye bcar rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos ni sde khag gam de bas khyab che ba'i khongs kyi mnyam las la brten 'dug de la khab gsog nas snyung bu dang skung bu gsog nas gri lta bu'i brgyud rim zhig kyang rtag tu snang / de lta na tsag tsig gsog nas ma lag can zhig skyong ba dang /skabs phrad gnyer nas yun ring la phan pa zhig skrun pa/ rags rob gsog nas zhib rgyas can zhig bzo ba'i gnyer rim zhig brgyud kyi yod pa'ang nyid kyi rang bzhin dbang du gyur yod/ da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉bsgrigs pa'ang 'di lugs su lad mo byas pa yin/6

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/nye bcar rig gnas spel rgyu de rig gnas ma lag gsar pa zhig skrun pa'i 'jug sgo gal chen zhig yin srid/ rang don 'khyongs pa'i khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na/ dus srol yul srol dang 'tsham pa'i nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag 'dzoms dgos pa nang bzhin/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs shig gi cha nas bshad kyang / dus rabs dang mthun zhing 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan dag las rang tshugs lcogs pa'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal gyi stobs 'byor zhig cis kyang dgos pa red/ de ltar yin na da gzod dza drag che ba'i spyi tshogs 'gran rtsod nang nas yun brtan pham min gyi go gnas shig 'dzin nges/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyis gral rim 'thab rtsod gnad du bzung ba'i jus chen bsgyur nas dpal 'byor thad kyi 'dzugs skrun lte ba byas te bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi jus chen lag bstar byas tshun/dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal bcas kyi phyogs gang mang nas 'dzam gling yongs kyi mig ldan ha las pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ da lta'i krung go ni 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gong spel dang zhi bde rgyun skyong thad kyi sgul stobs 'byung gnas shig tu gyur yod/ 'on kyang 'phel rgyas su phyin che ba'i rgyal khab dang bsdur na da rung he bag mi chung ba yod pa dang / nang sgos dpal 'byor 'phar snon 'byung stangs dang rang bdag shes bya'i thon dbang gis dpal 'byor dang tshan rtsal la bzo ba'i shugs rkyen thad nas mngon gsal du zhan pa yin phyir/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba lag tu bstar bar do snang byed pa dang / gron chung can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do snang byed pa/ gsar 'byed can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do snang byed pa bcas kyi byed phyogs srid jus rab dang rim par bton zhing lag len byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ rang re'i bod khul dag la mtshon na/ gzhung po ti ga tshod 7

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/ldan pa dang bcu phrag rig gnas kyi gzi brjid gang 'dra yin par 'ud sgrog bskyar zlos tshul gyis yid tshims par 'dug pa'i skabs shig min tshod red/de dag ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / snga thog gi 'thog sgrug dpal 'byor dang gshor rngon dpal 'byor nas rang byung cha rkyen la brten pa'i zhing phyags dpal 'byor(rang byung byo zhe shā5 zhugs skabs meri'i dbon rnam gsam ga32skuthadang/95 khur bsdo da thab /)ngaku dran) / da da wa dbyi da / pa'i sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis snga bzang rgyun skyong dang gzhan bzang dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas gsar 'byed byas par brgyud nas rang rigs la bzhag pa'i nang nom phug nor red/ des na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / rang byung dpal 'byor nas rlangs sgul glog sgul 'phrul chas sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs skabs/ 'u cag gis rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag ci zhig bsrel yod ces pa na/ yid mug mug dang zhe skyo skyo tshul du 'dug pa'am u tshugs can kha shas kyis nged cag la de 'dra ma ldan kyang chog lta bu'i lkug rdzu 'debs pa las brjod kyi mi 'dug ma rtsa ring lugs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams shing / bzo las dpal 'byor nas 'phrin sprod lag rtsal dang ang rtags lag rtsal dang skye dngos lag rtsal sogs lag rtsal mtho gsar gyis mtshon pa'i shes rig dpal 'byor ram phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs kyang zer bar 'jug bzhin pa'i deng rabs/ rang re'i rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag gang ci bzhag cing bsrel yod ces pa na/ phal cher ha las pa'i tshul du 'dug pa las smra sgo 'gag 'gro/ de'i phyir/ bod khul la mtshon na nges mkho rig gnadī dang thun mong rig gnas thad nas spyi tshogs la bu lon steng du skyed ka

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/ brtsegs pa'i chad stong mang drags song / rig gnas rgyun skyong thad nas thabs zhan pa dang / dpe g.yar thad nas lam dog pa/ gsar 'byed thad nas stobs gnyom pa bcas kyi gnas tshul mngon 'dug yin na'ang khag 'di gzhan la 'gel ba dang 'khang ra byas nas ci yang mi 'ong thabs lam 'dems mkhas la gtsigs 'dzin byas nas gzhan las 'bad brtson snying rus che bar mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas bsnyeg dgos na/ thog mar rig khag gsar ba dang gzhogs gtogs yan lag rig tshan gsar pa 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu 'di ni rig gnas spyi'i rgyun skyong dang dpe g.yar dang gsar 'byed bcas kyi rmang gzhi'i gnad dam pa red/skabs bab dgos mkho dang dngos gnas lag len las bton pa'i blang bya ltar na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi spyi tshogs khor yug 'di nas nges par khrims lugs la gtsigs chen byed pa dang / dpal 'byor phan yon la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i bar gyi rton srung la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i spus spyi dang rig gnas tshan rtsal 'jon thang la gtsigs chen byed pa bcas kyi blang bya sngon bas mtho bar gyur yod pas/ rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel de'ang sngon bas kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur yod/des na nga tshos ji ltar gzhal yod rgyu stobs dang mi stobs legs par spyad nas go skabs ma shor bar rig gnas gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas 'byung 'jug pa ni mi rigs spyi'i lo rgyus las 'gan du gyur yod/ de 'dra'i dbang du rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel las don 'di dmangs spyis stobs sgril nas lag rub bya 'tshal ba zhig yin gyi/ rig gnas can nyung shas kyis a gsar rang mtho mtshon pa'i gnas ma yin/'on kyang rig gnas can gyis thad kar tshul gyi zhabs phyi brgyud pa na/ da 9

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/gzod gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa 'don 'gyur ba dang / gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa gang legs shig 'don dgos na/ nges par thad kar gyi zhabs phyi'i nang nas 'khyongs dgos pa myong grub byung yod/ las rigs so sos rang babs lo rgyus las 'gan 'khur phod pa dang 'khur mkhas pa'i gzhi nas/ spyi yongs dang yun ring la bsam blo btang nas phan tshun mthun rkyen bzo ba dang phan tshun ram 'degs byed pa'i phyogs nas las rigs tha dad bar du mnyam las mi 'khyongs pa'i gnad 'gag bsal 'tshal/ dmangs spyi'i smyan byad de gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las khungs kyis smyan byad kyi yon tan de sgo kun nas legs par skyong dgos la skabs don zin 'god kyi sbrags su gzhi rtsa'i rgyal khab skyong jus che shos te/ dpal 'byor spel ba lte bar bzung nas bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang / khrims la brten nas rgyal khab legs skyong yong ba/ tshan rtsal slob gso la brten nas rgyal khab dar rgyas yong ba/ pho mo 'dra mnyam yong ba/ rig gnas la brtsi 'jog dang 'jon ldan la brtsi 'jog yong ba/ 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye rgyun 'khyongs yong ba bcas phyogs nas babs 'gan gang lcogs kyis 'khur ba dang / ched las zhib 'jug las khungs dang ched las mkhas pa bar phan tshun sdongs grogs tshul du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas gnyer ba'i brgyud rim nang nas rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa 'don par blo dang jus kyi bkod pa yod 'tshal snyam/ 〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ni gong gleng ji bzhin lag len byas pa'i grub 'bras las sde dang po tsam yin/‘‘nye bcar gsum’’ni rig gnas gsar pa spel ba'am gzhi de nas sngon thon rig gnas spel ba'i bgrod lam gtso shos shig lags/ nga tshos phyogs 10

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/'di'i gnas lugs snga char ma rtogs pa nas da lta gtsigs 'dzin byed pa dang /sngon du gzhan skul tshul nas da lta rang 'gul tshul du 'gyur bar da rung lag len dang gleng phyogs gnyis kyi cha nas 'bad 'tshal ba red/rig gnas gsar pa de sngon thon gyi thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba rmang gzhir bzung ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs gsar pa'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs nas 'byung ba yin srid/ des spyi tshogs kyi deng byung dgos mkho dang dmangs spyi'i da lta'i khe phan la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i thad nas sngon thon rig gnas kyi rang bzhin dang mthun pa red/ nye bcar rig gnas yin na sngon thon rig gnas kyang yin pa'i nges pa med na yang / sngon thon rig gnas yin na des nye bcar gyi rang mtshan 'dzin pa ni bsnyon du med/ sngon thon rig gnas la deng gi mkho ba tshim la go chod pa/ 'byung 'gyur la'ang phan thogs shing gzhi btsun pa'i khyad chos yod kyang / 'on te des srol rgyun rig gnas dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi khyad chos 'gog pa zhig gtan nas min/dgos mkho che ba dang phan pa che ba la gzhigs nas gna' bzang deng spyod dang gzhan bzang rang spyod dang rnying bsal gsar 'don tshul du rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du sngon thon rig gnas kyis 'das zin lo rgyus las nyar tshags byung ba'i dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun dang / 'gro ba mi'i thun mong du dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun la brtsi 'jog byed pas/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar go chod min dang mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i phan khe dang mthun min 'di rtsa gnad du thug 'duga'adi dang 'gal ba'i rig gnas gang de ma smad ma dgag kyang nyid kyi tshe dpal 'tsho stobs rang shugs su nyams 'gro ba smra ci/ de 'dra'i dbang du spyi khog tsam nas bltas na/ sngon thon rig gnas ni deng gi spyi tshogs kyi dmangs spyi11

nye bcar rtsom mdzod/(nyung shas la min)la mkho che ba dang go chod pa dang phan 'dogs thub pa bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang / gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rgyun skyong dang gzhan bzang rang spyod kyi dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas dus kyi dgos dbang du gsar 'byed bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang /mi rigs kyi nges pa dang thun mong gi nges pa dang rtser son gyi nges pa gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa bcas ni nyams myong las sgrub nus/dus rabs gsar pa la rig gnas gsar pa 'byung ba'i cha rkyen ldan 'dug rig gnas gsar pa'i sa bon ga sa kun tu 'debs bzhin pa la ni bsnyon du med/ bod khul dag tu slob grwa'i slob gso dang rgyang bsten slob gso dang spyi tshogs slob gso bcas kyi sa zhing da rung mu mthud du rgya skyed 'dugacha 'phrin lag rtsal dang gsar 'gyur smyan byad dang rig gnas theg byad gzhan dag la brten nas rig gnas gsar pa'i smyu gu ga sa kun nas 'khrungs bzhin pa'ang bsnyon du med/ bskal bzang 'di'i go skabs ma shor bar 'bad brtson sngon bas che bar btang na/ bzo las spyi tshogs nas phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams pa'i dus 'dir/ rang re'i bod la'ang gzhan gyis yid smon 'chor ba'i rig gnas ljon dbang rgyas 'gyur zhing / de'i smin grol 'bras bzang gis rang rigs la phan pa 'byung ba tsam gyis ma zad par/ yul gru'i khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos de sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang gcig sgril yong yod pa'i cha nas mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khams gzhan la'ang sman par 'gyur nges/ dus rabs gsar pas mngal la rig gnas gsar pa 'dzin bzhin pa 'di la rdzun med pa yin na/ 'byung 'gyur gyi rig gnas gsar pas kyang dus rabs 'di la gzi brjid kyi mngon rtags legs par brgyan yong /12

rig gnas skor gyi gnad don la da dung 'dzam gling khyon nas yang brtag yang dpyad kyi 'du 'dzi mtha' rdzogs dka' ba'i skabs 'dir/ gong du gleng ba dag ni bar skabs 'di'i slob sbyong las thob pa'i ngos zin tsam yin pas/ mkhyen ldan rnam pas dgongs 'char bdud rtsi mngar mo la skom pas re sgug ji bzhin lags/sgrig pa po dge gnyen gyis2006lo'i zla4ba'i ches15nyin zi ling nas/

mā cang / mā cang /tshe ring don grub/'jar pan gyi ngag rgyun ltar na rdo tha bya ba'i gnod byed 'di dang po bdud 'dre zhig gis mi yul du khyer yong zer/ spyir na nga rang 'jar pan mi rigs la phyogs ris lta tshul med mod/ 'jig rten 'di na bdud 'dre zer ba zhig sngar yod ma myong la phyin chad kyang yod mi srid pas na de ni khungs med 'chal gtam zhig las ma 'das so/ 'on kyang mā cang zer ba'i rtsed spyad dam rgyan skug yo byad 'di dang thog dngos gnas srid gzhung gis phyir 'bud byas zin pa'i las byed pa zhig gis rtse gzhung sde bar khyer yong ba ste/ kho nyid thog mar rtse gzhung sde bar slebs dus rkang snam mig 'gro zhig kyang gon rgyu med na'ang phyi ljang nang dkar gyi spos 'gyig gi mā cang so ma zhig khyer yong yod/ kho'i bshad tshul ltar na de ni g.yu dang ba so sbyar nas bzos pa red zer/ des na rtse gzhung sde ba'i mi rnams ni‘‘a ma ma gtogs mi mi shes/thab ka ma gtogs sa mi shes’’zer ba'i dpe ltar mthong rgya chung bas bden par rlom pa dang / phyug po zhig gis‘‘des na 'di ni nor lug mang po'i rin yin rgyu red dam’’zer/‘‘g.yu yi mgul rgyan zhig gi rin gong mdzo g.yag ga tshod red/ ba so'i phreng ba zhig gi rin gong sha bzan ci tsam red/’’ces nga rgyal gyis de ltar —1—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/phyir 'dri byas/‘‘drang mor shod dang / khyod la nor lug ci tsam dgos/ ’’mi phyug pos nan tan gyis de ltar dris/‘‘phangs pa zhig la da rung nga la btsong 'dod med/’’kho rang da lta 'brog pa min la dmag mi'ang min/ las byed pa ni de bas kyang min mod/ 'on kyang rtse gzhung sde ba'i mi rnams kyis da rung gus bkur gyis kho bor‘‘las byed pa’’ru 'bod kyin 'dug la/ kho dang 'dra bar las ka med pa'i gsar bu 'ga' bsdus nas mā cang ji ltar rtsed tshul khrid ston byas pa dang / mtshams lan rer kho tshor shog du rkang re'ang byin pas na 'tsho bar bro ba med pa'i 'brog pa rnams dga' drags te‘‘las byed pa’’dang nyin dkar mnyam za'am mtshan mor mnyam 'dug byas pas ring bo ma song bar mā cang rtsed shes par gyur/ de nas‘‘las byed pas’’slar yang kho tshor rgyan ji ltar skug tshul khrid pa dang gsar bu tsho'i spro sems sngar las bkug skabs de tsam du‘‘las byed pas’’mā cang de rgyan dngul skug pa'i phyogs su khrid de 'brog pa tsho'i lag na yod pa'i sgor mo ngal med du blangs par ma zad tha na rum gyi rwa tse dang rgyab kyi slog pa'ang blangs song / ‘‘las byed pas’’de snga las byed pa ngo ma tshos ji ltar snying rje med par kho rang gcer bur phud nas sgo ru ded pa nam yang brjed mi srid/ de'i phyir khos kyang 'dzem snang med par 'brog pa tsho gcer bur phud par ma zad da rung‘‘skyes pho rabs yod na khyim chung ma rgyan du zhog ya/ 'jog e phod/’’ces kho tshor zhe sdang bslangs/chung ma rgyan du 'jog mkhan ma byung na'ang nor lug rgyan du 'jog 'go brtsams pas 'ga' re sgo nag()tu bzos/ 'ga' re u thug nas zhu ba byas/'ga' re thabs zad nas u tshugs byas par‘‘las byed pas’’sna dgod rgyag —2—

mā cang /zhor‘‘hun/ rgyan mi 'jog rang dbang yod rung rgyan mi ster rang dbang med/rang rgyal khrims lugs nang na rgyan shor nas ma byin na lo du la btson 'jug byed pa khyod tshos e shes/’’zer/rtse gzhung sde ba'i 'brog pa tshos khrims lugs mi shes na'ang khrims la skrag pas chung ma rgyan du mi 'jog ka med byung / des na lo lon bsam shes rnams rtab rtab por gyur te mā cang zer ba'i bdud 'dre 'di tshar gcod nus pa'i rim gro e yod bsams nas a lags 'brong gi mdun du song ba na kho tsho de bas kyang rtab rtab por gyur te phan tshun gyi gdong la lta ba las ci byed cha ma 'tshal bar phyir log rgyu mtshan ni a lags 'brong tshang rig ma 'khor dang bcas pas kyang blo sems rtse gcig gis mā cang rtsed kyin 'dug pas kho tsho mdun du lhags te pus mo sa la btsugs nas yun ring 'gor na'ang ma tshor ba red/‘‘gal te rin po ches kyang rtsed kyin 'dug pas na de bdud 'dre red ces ga la bshad rung /’’‘‘nga tshos nyes pa che ru bsags song /’’‘‘bshad srol med/ bshad srol med/’’rim pa gong ma'i bkod sgrig ltar nga tsho rtse gzhung sde ba'i dud tshang skor zhig sprang por gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen rtsad gcod byed du song dus gang sa gang du bsang khri dang 'dra ba'i sa them gru bzhi dma' mo gang mang brtsigs yod pa mthong ba dang / ma gzhi de ni phyugs rdzi tshos mā cang rtsed gnas sam rgyan skug sa yin pa shes/ yin na'ang de dus rtse gzhung sde bar thog mar mā cang dar du 'jug mkhan‘‘las byed pa’’des thengs shig rtse gzhung sde ba'i rgyu nor khyer nas rdzong mkhar du song ste las byed pa ngo ma tsho dang rgyan skug skabs spyi —3—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bde mi snas 'dzin bzung byas zin/ bshad tshul ltar na‘‘las byed pas’’thengs dang po rtse gzhung sde ba'i rgyu nor khyer te rdzong mkhar du song nas cang ma 'gor bar slar yang grang ltogs kyis mnar bzhin shi ma gson gyis phyir slebs skabs lus steng nas 'doms dkri byed kyi lag phyis rnying hrul zhig las med mod/ 'on kyang lag na‘‘g.yu dang ba so’’sbyar ba'i mā cang cha lnga yod pas de ma thag phyug por gyur/ nga tshos rtse gzhung sde ba'i mā cang yod tshad gzhung bzhes byed skabs rgad po zhig nga'i rkang bar 'jus te smre ngag 'don bzhin‘‘drin chen tsho/ 'di ngas sha bzan brgya byin nas nyos pa yin/ da lta nga la mā cang 'di ma gtogs dngos po rtsa chen zhig med/ snying rje sgom rogs/’’zer ba'i snang tshul de ni mi la snying rje dang skyo snang / khong khro mnyam du slong bar byed pa zhig red/ mchan/red/ mesgo nag ni a mdo'i 'brog skad du khyim tshang la phyugs med par gyur pa'i don

zla ba'i gtam rgyud/ zla ba'i gtam rgyud/tshe ring don grub/‘‘a mes lags/ nga tshor gtam rgyud cig bshad rogs’’ri dwags kyi pags pa phar zhog tha na sdong shun tsam yang gon rgyu med pa'i sa'i go la'i steng gi ches mjug mtha'i byis pa skor zhig gis ha cang nyam nga ba'i tshul gyis bgres song zhig la zhu ba byed kyin 'dug ri thang na me tog bral zhing chu lam na chu phran med par 'jig rten 'di ha cang khu sim zhing yid skyo bar 'dug bslab bya sbyangs rgyu med pa dang rol rtsed rtse rgyu med par byis pa tsho'i 'tsho ba ni de bas kyang snying bo bral zhing bro ba dben/ de'i phyir kho tshos nyin ltar bgres song tsho'i mtha' bskor nas gtam rgyud bshad pa'i zhu ba byed/‘‘ya/ cedrog gi ཿbyeg gi’’‘‘a mes bka' drin che/ bka' drin che ’’byis pa tsho dga' drags nas lag chung thal mo rdeb par byed/‘‘gna' snga mo'i dus su/ sras mo zhig yod pa de bco lnga'i zla ba bzhin mdzes shing ’’‘‘a mes lags/ ‘zla ba’zhes pa de ci zhig red/’’‘‘zla ba edzi o/ zla ba ni dang po tsa na nga tsho'i sa'i go la dang bar thag ches nye ba'i skar ma zhig red/ nyin sum cu re'i rjes kyi sa srod dus su bu mo —5—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ mdzes ma'i smin ma ji bzhin dbang phyogs mkha' dbyings su shar yong zhing /nyin rer je sgor dang je gsal du yong ste nyin bcu lhag gi rjes su dkar zhing sgor la lta na sdug de'i phyir gna' mi tshos nam rgyun bu mo mdzes ma zla ba'i dpe ru 'god/’’‘‘'o na da lta de med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/’’‘‘e—’’bgres song des dbugs ring zhig 'byin rjes‘‘des na ngas khyod tshor zla ba'i gtam rgyud bshad/ nga'i mes po'i dus su/ nga tsho 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal dar rgyas che zhing 'bras bu sna tshogs g.yur du za/ yin na'ang tshan rig pa la las bltas na sa'i go la'i rang byung khor yug btsog cing lho byang gnyis kyi gnam gshis 'gyur ldog che ba'i rgyu mtshan ni sa'i go la'i 'khor lam cung tsam gseg yod pas yin la/ gal te zla ba'i go la de sa'i go la'i lho sne gling la slebs skabs 'bar rdzas kyis gtor bar byas na zla ba'i sa rgyu 'bor chen zhi bde rgya mtsho chen po'i nang la lhung ste sa'i go la'i 'khor lam drang mor snyom thub bsam/’’‘‘skabs der mi'i rigs la sa'i go la'ang thengs bcu lhag la gtor nus pa'i rdul phran mtshon cha mod po yod la/ des na zla ba'i go la de sa'i go la'i bzhi cha'i gcig tsam ma gtogs med pas na de gtor thub min ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/’’‘‘tshan rig pa de tsho mi mang po'i 'gog rgol la ma 'dzem par 'jig rten 'phur gru dang bar snang sa tshigs/ skud 'od sgrig chas/ rdul phran nus pa'i 'bar gas sgrig sbyor/ glog rlabs gnam dpyad rgyang shel/ glog klad chen po/ 'phrul chas mi sogs phyogs so so'i lag rtsal la brten par ma zad ches phul du byung ba'i tshan rtsal mi sna'i khyon yongs kyi ram 'degs 'og tu —6—

zla ba'i gtam rgyud/mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i zla ba de thal ba'i rdul du brlags song /’’‘‘ya nga ba'i snang tshul de mthong rjes tshan rig ha cang dar rgyas che ba'i go la gzhan pa'i mi'i sems la sa'i go la'i steng gi mi 'di tshos rang nyid 'tsho gzhes kyi rten gnas ma yum sa yi go la mi gtsang dri mas sbags te sems can gyi dbugs rgyun chad la khad bzos par ma zad da rung 'dre lag bar snang khams la bsrings te nyi ma'i khyim rgyud nang gi ches mdzes pa'i go la de yang thal ba'i rdul du brlags song / a kha/ da ni gang ltar kho tsho 'di ltar rgya yan du gtong mi rung bsam ste sa'i go la'i steng gi dpal yon yongs rdzogs med par bzos song bas 'gro ba mi'i rigs yang bskyar ya thog gi rnam par lhung bar ma zad sngar las lhag pa'i rang byung gnod 'tshe dang nad yams sna tshogs kyis skye bo dung phyur mang po'i tshe srog 'phrog ste mig snga'i tshad 'di la slebs pa red/’’‘‘a mes lags/ 'di ni khyed ra nga gis btsan sgrig byas pa las gtam rgyud ngo ma zhig ma red/ nga tshor mu mthud du sras mo de'i gtam rgyud bshad rogs/’’byis pa tsho zla ba'i gtam rgyud la dga' bo med de/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tshos‘‘tshan rig lag rtsal’’dang‘‘rdul phran mtshon cha’’‘‘bar snang sa tshigs’’sogs ming tshig 'di dag go ma myong la nang don yang mi shes pas red/bgres song de thabs zad de slar yang dpal yon dus skabs kyi sras mo zhig gis dug rdzas 'then nas mi shi khyim stong du gyur ba'i gtam rgyud cig bshad

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/mi tshe yi glu chigastag 'bum rgyal/gciga.a khu nyi ma lo lon te go khar lhung song /rang lo bdun cu tham par slebs pa'i lo sar gyi snga nub tu/ khos da gzod rang nyid ni srol rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i spyi 'gros shig las 'da' thub med pa rtogs/ kho rang byis pa'i skabs su/ kho'i a phas kho rang khrid de ha cang thag ring ba'i sa la tshong rgyag tu song zhing / lam kha'i zhing kha dag na ngal gso byed bzhin pa'i bud med rnams mthong tshe phan tshun shags rtsed byed cing slar yang lam la zhugs te mu mthud du dal cag ger 'gro dus a phas glu 'di thengs mang blangs myong /‘‘o ye— rta rgyug na 'jig rten 'di nas rgyug /tshe phyi ma'i yul na rta rgyug med/ /sa lag mthil tsam zhig med sa nas/ /rta brgyugs nas 'gro sa gang na yod ’’de 'dra'i skabs su nyi mas g.yag rgan tsho'i brug mdor cer nas yong ba las rta rgan la lcag gis 'brab rgyu'ang brjed 'gro/ glu skad snyan la tshig —8—

mi tshe yi glu tshiga'abru'i sgrig rim ni de 'dra'i mi sems bsgul ba la ang snyam pa'i mos pa rdo la ri mo ji bzhin yid ngor chags/a khu nyi ma gsar rgod yin dus/ kho'i sems la a pha'i ngang tshul de ni rgyun ldan tsam du snang la/ a pha'i glu skad kyi 'gyur khugs kyang spyi 'gros lta bu zhig yin snang shar/yin na yang / lo zla'i 'gros rim ring mo'i rgyun dang 'grogs nas glu tshig des kho'i sems kyang rim bzhin mi bde bar gyur pa dang / skabs 'gar kha mug mug gis glu tshig de bskyar bzlos byas shing / bro myong khyad par ba zhig la blo kha phyogs nas kha brda gzhan mi byed khos lag pa dal gyis yar khyer nas 'dar 'dar ngang skra shad cing gnyer ris brtsegs pa'i klad par byil byil zhig byed dus da gzod lo gsar pa zhig tshes la nye ba de yid la dran/ ‘‘a tsi/ don grub da dung mi yong ba ci yin nam/’’khong mal sa'i nang du lus po 'gul tsam gyis de ltar chig lab cig brgyab cing mdun 'gram gyi dkar yol nang gi ja 'phro hub gang 'thung rjes slar thang la bzhag nas sngon ltar bsdad/dgung mo nub ja 'thung dus/ a khu nyi ma sngon ltar mal sa'i nang du dal khol ler sdod bzhin za ma'ang mi za/ ‘‘ci yin nam/ don grub da dung mi yong’’zhes ldab ldib cig bshad pa ni chig lab rgyag pa'am rgan mo lha mtshor 'dri ba gang yin pa rtogs mi thub/‘‘ci red/ khyod la de ring phu bo rnam rgyal tshang nas mi yong zer ba min nam/’’‘‘o red/ ngas brjed 'dug 'u tshang gi gtor bzlog de nam byed rgyu yin/’’ —9—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ ‘‘khyod kyis tshes lnga la byas na bzang zer ba min nam/’’‘‘in in/’’khos mgo ldem ldem 'ga' byas te dal gyis za 'thung byed/nub ja 'thung tshar rjes sngon ltar lag pa'i nang gi phreng ba nyug tsam nyug tsam gyis dal khol ler ci zhig la 'dang rgyag pa ltar 'dug cing / lan rer kha mug mug gis ci zhig chig lab rgyag pa ltar byed/gnyis/sde ba'i nang gi byis pa rnams skor dang skor byas te ske rags so ma re bcings nas khyim tshang re re'i lo lon rnams kyi gam du 'tshams 'drir 'gro ba dang / pho gsar rnams kyis rta rgod 'brug 'dra ba rer zhon te phar rgyug tshur rgyug gis bang skor byed/‘‘a khu/ khyod kyi lo sar yag gam/’’‘‘'di khyod kyi lo ja'i tshul tsam yin’’zhes legs skyes re kho'i mdun sar bzhag pa na/ a khu nyi ma yar phyogs kyi mal sa'i nang bsdad de gdong la sngar med pa'i mdangs shig shar zhing mgo lcog lcog byas te‘‘yag yag yagatshe ring lo brgya/ gnam gyis srungs’’zhes kha g.yang 'bod gang thub byed/phyi dro/ a khu nyi ma tshang gi sbra nang nas glu skad mtshams mi chad par grags 'ong /‘‘o yed glu len na 'jig rten 'di nas len/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul na glu len med/ /mi mthe bong tsam zhig med sa nas/ /glu blangs nas 'dug sa gang na yod/ /’’—10—

mi tshe yi glu tshigabu don grub kyis glu de ltar blangs pa dang gsar bu tsho dang khyim mi yongs rdzogs 'ur chil ler gyur te bstod pa sna tshogs byed cing / a khu nyi ma de las ldog ste gdong gi 'dzum mdangs rim bzhin bsdus nas glo bur ba'i 'dang rgyag cig gi nang du lhung ste phreng ba 'dren mtshams chad song /dus tshod ring tsam 'gor song / gsar bu la las rtsed mtshar sna tshogs kyis spro ba bsangs pa dang / 'ga' re chang gis bzi nas gom pa 'khyor bzhin 'gro grabs byas song /‘‘a khu/ da nged tsho 'gro rgyu yin/’’‘‘a khu/ da bde mo/’’‘‘nga yang 'gro rgyu/’’‘‘ ’’a khu nyi mas ma tshor ba yin nam mnyam 'jog byed 'dod med pa yin pa mi gsal mod/ kha grags ma byung / kho rang sngar bzhin mal sa'i nang du rnam shes bral ba ltar gzur nas 'dug cing / lan rer kha mug mug byas te ci zhig bskyar zlo byed pa ltar snang /don grub kyis 'grul pa rnams lam la bskyal rjes phyir khyim du 'dzul yong nas zas sder re re phar bzhag rjes gang sar gtor ba'i dkar yol nang gi ja 'phro dag thal 'dabs su phos te nyar tshags byed/‘‘kho tsho bud song ngam/’’yud tsam 'gor rjes a khu nyi mas mal sa'i nang nas de ltar dris byung /don grub kyis mgo dgye tsam gyis rang nyid la 'dri ba rtogs nas‘‘bud thal’’zer/khos mdzub mo'i bar gyi phreng ba 'dren bzhin ma ṇi 'don pa las yang bskyar ci yang ma bshad/—11—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘ci red/ kho tsho yong na khyod de 'dra'i spo(khong khro)zhig langs nas ci byed/’’‘‘ci zer/ nga spo langs myong ngam/’’a khu nyi mas sdang mig cig bgrad de ske gcus nas bsdad/ don grub kyis slar yang yar phugs kyi sgam kha phye ste phyi nyin a zhang tshang gi gras su(bag ma skyel bar)'gro ba'i gyon gos gra sgrig byed bzhin‘‘'o na kho tshos bde mo gtam dus khyod kyis kha ya tsam yang mi byed don ci/ bzang na ngan na khyod la lo sar 'tshams zhu byed du yong ba red/ phyin chad nga yang kho tsho'i gras su mi 'gro zer rgyu ci yod/’’‘‘ ’’gsum/nyi ma ha cang tsha drod che bas a khu nyi ma sbra'i phyi rol gyi nyin khar btsog ste slog pa yang sham byas nas shig 'thu bzhin 'dug cing / skabs rer ma ṇi gyer 'don byed pa'i skad re thos 'ong / khos stod gos gyon med pas brang sha'i skyi gnyer dang lag pa gnyis kyi phyi rgyab sogs nyi mas tshig ste nag nyer rer 'dugalo na drug la son ma thag pa'i tsha bo dbang rgyal gyis a bra gnyis bzung ste ske la skud pa brgyab cing khal g.yag yin khul gyis rtsed zhor du kho'i gam du yong nas‘‘khyod kyis ltos dang’’zhes rang gi 'jon thang ngom pa ltar byas/‘‘de ci yin/ a bra la de ltar byas na tshe phyi ma nas a bras khyod la de ltar byed nges/’’‘‘ci la/’’tsha bos snabs yar 'byin tsam gyis lhad med pa'i mig gnyis ka —12—

mi tshe yi glu tshigacer te kho la bltas/a khu nyi mas mdzub mo ker ker byas te‘‘de zer ram/ mi tshang ma shi rjes tshe phyi mar 'gro dgos pa red/ de dus rang gis ci byas thams cad rang nyid kyis myong dgos pa red/ dpe blangs na khyod kyis da lta a bra la ngan byas na tshe phyi mar song tshe a bras khyod la ngan lan sprod pa red/’’tsha bosanacung skrag pa ltar mdzub mo khar bcug ste mdun gyi a bra gnyis kar cer nas sdod cing slar yang‘‘tshe phyi ma da lta gang na yod pa red’’ces dris/‘‘phal cher nub phyogs su yin nges/’’‘‘thag ring ni e red/’’‘‘tshe 'dir thon sa zhig ma red/’’‘‘nyi ma du la 'gro dgos/’’‘‘thon ni ma red/ da song song / rtsed du song sha’tsha bos mgo yon yon byed bzhin phar la bud song phyi ja ran dus/ a khu nyi ma lag rten la khen te phyir khyim du yong nas bza' mi rnams dang lhan du ja 'thung / khos nam rgyun ltar mal sa'i mtha' khar dkar yol bzhag nas ci zhig la bsam blo gtong ba ltar gzur nas 'dug cing / yud tsam 'gor rjes don grub la lta tsam gyis‘‘de ring tshes pa du red’’zer/‘‘tshes gsum/ khe nyin lo sar ba mi dran nam/’’‘‘o/ ma red ma red/ ’’khos lag pas klad par byil byil zhig byas nas‘‘red ya/ 'u tshang gi gtor bzlog de/’’don grub ya mtshar ba ltar a pha'i gdong la bltas nas‘‘khyod kyis tshes lnga nyin byed ces ma bshad dam’’zer/—13—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘red/ in/ 'o na nangs ka snga dro khyod a lags dar rje tshang gdan 'dren du song /’’ don grub a pha'i nyog gtam dag la yid sun pa'i tshul gyis mgo ldem tsam gyis thab thog gi dkar yol blangs te phu 'debs zhor du ja 'thung / re zhig nas tsha bo dbang rgyal phyi rol nas khyim du 'ong zhor du khe nyin gyi gsar bu tsho'i lad mo byas te glu car cor len khul byed/ a khu nyi mas ja mi 'thung bar‘‘dbang lo/ shog dang ngas khyod la glu khrid’’zer/‘‘gang la song ba yin/ myur mor shog la phyi ja 'thung /’’ don grub cung ma rangs pa'i nyams kyis dbang rgyal la sdang mig bgrad/‘‘nga la glu khrid/ skyid la/’’‘‘len 'dod dam/ khyod kyis slobs’’a khu nyi mas tsha bo gam du 'then nas tshig gcig re bshad de tsha bor bskyar zlo byed du bcug‘‘nga dang ma byis pa yin dus su/ /tshe phyi ma yid la ma dran zig /nang glu chung blangs te g.yeng nas bsdad/ /gcig dran dus lo na rags song zig/sems 'gyod pa skyes rung thabs med red/ /’’ tsha bos thal mo rdeb bzhin sa lding gnam lding byas te‘‘hra gi da dung khrid dang’’zer/mes tsha gnyis kyi tshul des khyim du yod pa'i bza' mi yongs rdzogs ya mtshar bar gyur song / don grub kyis bu dbang rgyal mar 'then nas rang sar 'dug tu bcug rjes‘‘myur mor phyi ja 'thung na mi chog gam’’zer/
bzhi/phyi nyin snga se/ a khu nyi ma glo bur du tshe las 'das song / skabs der stong khams su gsar du chags pa'i rgyu skar zhig gis kyang 'khor bskyod kyi 'go brtsamak+ṣiṃ/srid du

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/lha chu lha shing /bstan pa yar rgyas/grong tsho'i nub kyi ri gsham der kher rkyang du gnas pa'i shug sdong rkang gcig yod pa de'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du gyes pa'i yal ga'i steng du/yul mi tshos dar tshon sna lnga bgrang las 'das pa zhig btags yod pas sdong bo'i yal ga'i skye 'phel la 'gog rkyen bzos yod kyang / rgyang nas bltas na de ni me tog sna lnga rab tu bzhad pa'i sdong bo shin tu che ba zhig dang yang dag mtshungs/ ri lung gang sar shing sna mdzub mo tsam yang med pa'i yul der shug sdong kher rkyang zhig yod pa ni lha yis grong tsho der shing skal sbyin pa yin zhes grags shing / grong tsho'i mi rnams kyis der lha sdong zhes 'bod pa las shug sdong zhes mi 'bod/lha sdong dang bar thag mi ring ba'i sar sgor rgya che ba'i chu mig dwangs shing gtsang ba zhig yod pa'i mtha' ru/ rdo a dkar gyis mtho tshad mi gzugs phyed tsam gyi chu rags brtsigs nas yod pa'i steng du'ang dar lcog mang po btsugs yod/ngag rgyun ltar na/ chu mig de ni pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis phyag sor gyis brkos te bton pa'i lha char grags/ cha'i 'byung khungs shin tu dkon pa'i raX raXgrong tsho de'i mi'i 'thung chu'ang chu mig de las med pa dang / dgun dus —16—

lha chu lha shing /phyugs rigs kyi 'thung chu'ang de las med stabs/ mi rnams kyis chu mig las 'thung chu len pa dang phyugs rigs kyis chu mig las bzhur ba'i chu rnga 'thung gi yod/ chu mig de grong tsho dang bar thag ring stabs grong mi tshos chu thengs re len par ha lam chu tshod phyed ka tsam dgos kyi yod/gnas tshul der gzhigs nas shang krang lha bus gong rim la snyan zhu thengs mang phul te re ba bton mthar/ da thengs gong rim nas khron pa 'dru ba'i lag rtsal jus 'god pa rgan nyi shar grong tsho der btang /khong gis da bar rdzong dang shang mang por sa babs brtag ste khron pa brgya phrag mang po 'dru ba'i jus 'god 'gan khur ba'i nang du las 'dzol thengs gcig byed myong med pas/ lo ngo sum cu lhag gi nang rim pa mtho dman gyi gzengs bstod thengs mang thob myong /khron pa 'dru mkhan rgan nyi shar slebs pas grong tsho'i mi yongs kyis spro sems chen pos khong la bsu ba byas nas sems rtsa 'khol pos sne len byas te/la las mar ja dang lug sha rdog btsos khyer nas 'ongs/ la las zho dang thud khyer nas 'ongs/ la las nas chang dang nor sha skam po khyer nas 'ongs/‘‘rgan lags khyed sngon la sku ngal yag po gso rogs/’’‘‘nga tsho'i grong tshor chu dka' ngal che bas nga tshos khyed kyi bka' drin ma brjed pa byed kyi yin/’’grong mi yongs grong tsho'i rig gnas khang du 'dus te rgan nyi shar gyi mtha' bskor nas khong la ja chang 'dren gyin 'ur long nges bsdad/ 'on kyang a ma lha mo kun dang mi 'dra bar rang khyim gyi thab 'gram du bsdad de‘‘dmyal khams bco brgyad bar drus kyang nga tsho'i lha chu las lhag pa'i chu zhig —17—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/yod mi srid/’’ces kher lab byas/ngal gsos shing za 'thung grub rjes rgan nyi shar gyis‘‘ya/ da nga tsho khyed tsho'i lha chu la blta bar 'gro’’zer/sngar srid na ma grags pa'i rin po che zhig gsar du rnyed pa ltar yul mi phal che ba rgan nyi shar gyi rjes su 'brangs/rgan nyi shar gyis shel dam gyi mthil las mthug pa'i shel mig cig gyon te chu mig de'i chur zhib mor bltas rjes/ mdzub mo chur reg tsam byas nas bro ba myong ba dang / de nas gos khug las chu'i rgyu brtag byed kyi rdzas 'ga' shog bu'i khug nas bton te chu ru sbangs nas bltas pa dang / chu khyor ba gang bcus te btung rjes skad gdangs rnam kun las mtho ba'i sgo nas‘‘dpe red/ dpe red/ ngo ma gter chu yag po zhig 'dug’’ces brjod kyang tshang/mas do snang ma byas/rgan nyi shar gyis chu mig gi mtha' ru brtsigs pa'i rdo a dkar de dag la lag pas byil bzhin du‘‘'di sus brtsigs pa red’’ces dris kyang / der yod kun gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug rgyu las lan 'debs thub mkhan ma byung /sde dpon gyis‘‘phal cher mi las med cig gis nyi ma ma 'khyol bar 'di ltar brtsigs pa min nam’’zer/‘‘ma red/ ma red/’’rgan nyi shar gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug nas‘‘mi yon tan can zhig gis brtsigs pa red’’zer/der yod tshang mas rgan nyi shar gyi skad cha'i don ma rtogs par kha cher gdang nas khong la bltas te bsdad/rgan nyi shar gyis skya phyed sngo phyed du song ba'i mgo skra la byil gyin che mthong shel de gos khug tu bcug rjes nyi 'gog shel mig nag po zhig brgyab —18—

lha chu lha shing /nas‘‘rtsig pa 'di brtsigs mkhan gyi mi des chu 'di'i chu'i rgyu ba legs pa shes te btsog skyon mi phog pa'i ched du brtsigs pa red/ lhag par du dgun dus grong tsho'i mi phyugs yongs la 'thung chu 'di las med pas/ gal srid chu rags lta bu'i rtsig pa 'di brtsigs med na/ mi phyugs gnyis kar 'thung chu gcig rang byung na phyugs nad mi la 'go ba'i nyen kha chen po yod’’ces bshad pas/ chu rags brtsigs mkhan gyi skye bo der tshang ma dad sems skyes/nyin shas kyi rjes su rgan nyi shar gyis sa dpyad legs par brtag ste jus 'god byas pa la mang tshogs nas ngal rtsol nus shugs bton te gting tshad pho 'dom bco lnga yod pa'i khron pa zhig drus pas/ grong tsho yongs la sngar med stabs bde de lta bu bskrun par tshang mas khong la kha btags bsgron/ khyim dud la las sha gzan tshon po 'ga' yang bshas te khong mgron du bos kyang /khong gis‘‘nga la dgos pa ni khyed tsho'i lha chu shel dam gang yin’’zer nas/lha chu shel dam gang khyer nas grong khyer du log song /grong tsho'i mi rnams dus rgyun du chu thengs re len par ha lam chu tshod phyed ka dgos kyang da lta chu thengs re len par skar ma gnyis gsum las mi dgos pas khyim tshang mang po'i na so rgas pa'i khyim 'dzin ma'i lus stod kyi na zug rim gyis 'jags te dbugs rngub gtong yang bde ru phyin/de nyin bu tshe ring gis lcags zom zhig gi nang du chu gang blangs te ja bskol rtsis byas/ a ma lha mos bu khyod kyis khron pas chu blangs sam’’zhes dris/‘‘ yin/ gong rim gyis ched du rang re'i grong tsho'i ’’a ma lha mos bu tshe ring gi skad cha'i mjug 'phrog nas‘‘khron pa drus pa de bka' drin che yang / nged tsho'i lha chu lta bu'i zhim po zhig ga la yod/ chu —19—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/thengs re gnyis len par dka' rgyu ci yod/ song ya/’’zhes bshad zhor du da lta blangs ma thag pa'i chu de chu chas blugs snod du blugs nas lcags zom stong ba de bu tshe ring gi lag la bzhagabu tshe ring ma 'dod pa'i sgo nas lcags zom rgyab tu khur nas song ste a khu sangs rgyas tshang du 'dzul/ a khu sangs rgyas cha sgam gyi 'khris su langs nas rag skyogs chen po zhig bzung ste cha sgam steng gi rag kong nang du yon chab 'bul bzhin du kho'i phyogs su lta tsam byas nas/ ‘‘ya bu khyod chu len par 'gro ba e yin/’’zer/‘‘yin’’a khu sangs rgyas kyis yon chas phul rjes gdan du bsdad de/ da yin na chu'i dka' ngal byung ma song’’zer bzhin sna tha sen mo gang blugs/bu tshe ring gis‘‘nga'i a mas khron pa'i chu 'thung gin mi 'dug’’zer/‘‘khron pa yod bzhin du lha chu len dgos zer ram’’a khu sangs rgyas kyis sna tha 'then rjes‘‘ngas khyod la thabs shig bslab/ khyod kyis lcags zom khur te song nas lha chu len khul gyis lcags zom stong ba tshur khur 'ongs nas de'i nang du khron pa'i chu blangs te lha chu yin khul byas na mo rang gis shes mi srid’’zer/bu tshe ring gis a khu sangs rgyas kyi mdun du 'thad pa'i tshul gyis mgo bo lcog lcog byas kyang don du rang gi a mar mgo skor gtong mi rung snyam nas a khu sangs rgyas kyi‘‘kha ta’’las 'gal te lha chu blangs/ a khu sangs rgyas dang a ye sgrol ma sogs bgres song pho mo mang pos a ma lha mo la dka' las rgyag mi dgos sar lkugs pa u tshugs ma byed/ khron pa'i chu 'di lha chu dang khyad mi 'dug ces kha ta byas kyang / a ma lha mos lag pa 'phred du g.yug nas‘‘ma —20—

lha chu lha shing /red/ ma red/ nga tsho'i lha chu lta bu'i nad rigs kun 'joms kyi chu zhig med’’ces brjod/a ma lha mo ni rang mnyam bgres song pho mo rnams dang mnyam du nyi ma sro bzhin sngar gtam 'chad rgyur shin tu dga' ba'i rgan mo zhig red/de nyin nyi ma lhag par dro bas grong tsho'i rgan 'khogs re zung gis pags gdan khyer te lhas ra'i nang nyi ma sro ba mthong bas/ mo rang lam sang zas bza' 'phro bzhag ste ma ṇi lag skor lag tu bzung nas song / der a khu sangs rgyas dang a myes bzod pa/ a ye sgrol ma sogs la la'i skra mdog skya phyed sngo phyed du song ba dang / la la'i skra mdog tsha nu ltar dkar ba'i bgres song pho mo mang po 'dus nas 'dug a ye sgrol mas‘‘shog dang / lha mo/de ring 'di 'dra 'phyi ba ci red/ a myes bzod pas rnam thar bshad tshar song /’’zer bzhin mo rang phyir nur tsam byas nas phying gdan gyi sne gcig a ma lha mor g.yar/a ma lha mos‘‘a khu bzod pa/ da dung gcig shod dang’’zer/‘‘snang bza'i rnam thar de ring drags pas da mi bshad’’ces a myes bzod pas sun snang gi tshul bstan’’‘‘'o na thung thung shig shod dang /’’‘‘ma red/ mi la ras pa'i sgrung shod dang /’’‘‘'o na 'gro ba bzang mo'i sgrung shod dang /’’‘‘'o na ’’‘‘ ’’byis pa mang po zhig kho tsho'i 'khris su phar rgyug tshur rgyug gis rtsed mo rtsed kyin 'dug—21—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/a ye sgrol mas‘‘phru gu tsho/ thal rdul ma slong dang / khyod tsho lhas ra gzhan zhig gi nang du song’’zer bzhin/ khar thal rdul chags pa'i ja bshos rjes slar yang ja gang blugs te/ ‘‘de 'thung dang’’zhes ja phor a ma lha mor sprad/a ma lha mos ja gtsang mar 'thung rjes phor ba'i khar chags pa'i rdul de mthe bong gis 'byid tsam byas/a khu sangs rgyas kyis‘‘'o red/ deng sang grong khyer nang gi mi 'ga' shas kyis shig nyo bzhin 'dug zer bden pa yin nam/ khyod tshos go myong ngam’’zhes bshad kyin ma ṇi lag skor rum du bcug nas sna ru blangs te rkang mgor lan gsum brdabs/‘‘shig nyo mkhan e yod/ de rdzun yin gyi red’’‘‘de 'dra zer ba ngas go byung’’‘‘shig nyos nas ci phan’’‘‘'ga' shas kyi za yi yod pa min nam’’‘‘de 'dra dpe mi srid/’’ ‘‘shig nyos nas bza' ba las de'i dngul gyis mi zas 'khrul med cig nyos te bzas na yag gi red/’’‘‘a tsha tsha’’a ma lha mos skra gseb nas shig rgyags pa gcig bzung nas‘‘'o na 'dis sgor mo brgya khug gin med dam’’zhes ku re rtsed zhor du/ shig rgan de mthe bong dang gong mdzub kyi sen mo'i bar du bzhag nas bsad de‘‘oṃ ma ṇi pad+ma hūṃ’’zer/‘‘ha ha ha’’tshang ma gad mo shor/a khu sangs rgyas kyis‘‘sgor mo brgya bsad de ci byed’’ces kha mtshar bshad/—22—

lha chu lha shing /‘‘ha ha ha/ sgor mo brgya phar zhog phin gcig kyang khug mi yong’’de ni a ye sgrol ma'i skad cha red/nyin gung bu tshe ring gis ja zhim po zhig bskol nas bsdad/cung tsam phyin rjes a ma lha mo'i mchu tor ja zhag mthug po zhig bsgos te nang du log slebs byung /bus lam seng a ma'i phor ba blangs te ja ldug rtsis byas/‘‘bu/ ja ma ldug ngas kho tsho'i sar ja mang po btung ba yin/ khyod rang gis 'thung dang’’zer bzhin/ cha sgam steng gi rag kong nang du yon chab 'bul rtsis byas/bu tshe ring gis rang gi go nor thebs pa min nam snyam nas rang gi rna bar yid ma ches par‘‘a ma/ khyod kyis kho tsho'i sa nas ja btung ba yin zer ram’’zhes bskyar 'dri byas/‘‘btung ba yin/ mang po btung ba yin’’‘‘ kho tsho'i ja bskol spyad khron pa'i chu red’’a ma lha mo kha gdangs mig bgrad kyis re zhig 'jim gzugs ltar rengs por lus/ cung tsam song rjes‘‘khron pa'i chu de yang zhim po 'dug’’zer/de nas bzung a ma lha mor khron pa'i chu 'thung ba'i gom gshis chags/de nas lo gcig lhag tsam gyi rjes su ar las ru khag cig der 'ongs nas lha chu'i 'gram du khang pa mang po zhig las pa dang / 'phrul chas mang po zhig dbor nas nyin ltar glog sgra 'ur 'ur du grags bzhin 'phrul chas kyis rtsol bar brten te lha chu 'gyig dam dkar po sha stag gi nang du blugs nas‘‘lha chu’’rtags can gyi gter chu zhig khrom ra'i thog brin rgyug byung 'dug—23—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/chu mig der btsog skyon mi yong ched/ da lta sngar gyi rdo dkar gyi chu rag de'i mtha' ru yang ar 'dam las grub pa'i gyang mthon po mi tshad gnyis tsam gyis bskor yod pa ma zad/ mtho zhing brjid chags pa'i 'khor khang dang /gral bstar 'grig cing khams gtsang ba'i las bzo pa'i sdod shag dang /sger gnyer ched las dud khyim gyis btsugs pa'i tsag tsig tshong khang dang ja khang yang yod pa 'ga' shas byung bas/ phyi rol dang 'brel ba nyung ba'i rgan 'khogs rnams kyis bltas na gzhi rgya shin tu che ba'i sngar med kyi grong khyer zhig ri 'dabs su chags pa'i snang ba shar te/ sngar med kyi ltad mo mang po zhig mthong / de snga mkho dngos tsag tsig nyo bar yang rdzong dang sa khul du 'gro mkhan la mngags dgos kyang / da lta‘‘grong khyer’’nang nas nyo bar stabs bde ba'i rgan 'khogs tsho'i rang re'i grong tsho'i bsod nams kyi mthu las byung ba'i lha chu 'di slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' drin las byung ba los yin/ de min na grong khyer chen po 'di lta bu zhig chags mi srid zer/nyin zhig rgan 'khogs khag cig ci grol mol grol gyis gtam gleng byed kyin‘‘grong khyer’’der shig nyo min gyi skad cha 'dri bar 'gro skabs/ a ma lha mos‘‘nga tsho'i lha chu des grong khyer chen po zhig 'dir 'khrid byung / da rjes su nga tsho'i lha shing des nga tsho'i grong tshor dgon pa rgya chen zhig 'khrid 'ong rgyu red/de mi 'dug na ngas bshad pa thams cad rdzun dang zas pa yongs rdzogs rkun rdzas yin’’zer/a myes bzod pas‘‘ngas kyang de 'dra bsam gyin 'dug’’zer/a khu sangs rgyas kyis‘‘phal cher red/ gong rim gyis thog mar 'dir grong khyer chags skabs rang re'i lha chu lta bu'i chu bzang zhig srid na dkon zer nas grong khyer 'di chags song / da yang mi ring bar rang re'i lha sdong 'di —24—

lha chu lha shing /lta bu srid na med zer te dgon pa rgya chen zhig chags rgyu kho thag red/'dzam pa brgya’’zhes mjug tu mna' yang bskyal/‘‘de 'dra byung na skyid pa la’’‘‘de gtan 'khel red’’‘‘ngas kyang de 'dra bsam gyin 'dug’’‘‘ ’’lha sdong sngar bzhin grogs med kher rkyang ngang ri gsham der gnas/de'i yal gar btags pa'i dar lcog sngon ma las ldab cig mang du phyin nas 'dug /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/pad+ma tshe brtan/gcigalug rdzi gzhon nus a pha'i rgas gnyer gyis g.yogs pa'i ngo la cer nas khos ci zhig bsam bzhin pa ma shes/ a ma dang nu bo nu mo gsum pos rgyun mi 'chad par glad sgyings byed zhor gnyid la nye/ mtshan mo'i zla 'od mag mog phyi rol gyi rtswa sa'i steng 'phros shing / phyogs bzhi lhing 'jags su snang /a phas glo bur du yid la ci zhig dran pa'am/ yang na glo bur du don dag cig thag gis bcad pa ltar kha grag byung /‘‘bstan pa yar rgyas/ rjes su khyod lug rdzi la 'gro mi dgos/ dgon par grwa pa byed du song /’’bstan pa yar rgyas ni lug rdzi gzhon nu'i ming yin/ skad cha de thos 'phral/ lug rdzi gzhon nu'i mig lam du lug rdzi bu mo zhig gi yid 'ong gi gzugs brnyan mngon byung / de nas khos lag pas mgo la lan 'gar 'phrugs te 'di ltar bshad/‘‘nga rang chos sgor zhugs nas rab byung bsgrub na chog mod/ yin na yang nga'i skye ba sngon mar sdig pa grangs med bsags pa'i shan pa zhig yin pas ji ltar bya/’’—26—

lug dzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/a ma dang nu bo nu mo gsum po'i rnam rig glo bur du je gsal du gyur nas‘‘ha ha’’zhes hab cha brgyab/ hab cha'i sgra de phyi rol gyi mag mog gi zla 'od khrod bar med du skyom 'gul byed/ de'i 'phror/ a mas kha grag byung /‘‘khyod rang skye ba sngon ma shan pa zhig yin zer na ngas khyod la 'dri/khyod kyis skye ba sngon mar nor lug ci 'dra zhig gi srog bcad/’’lug rdzi gzhon nus 'dang tsam yang ma brgyab par de ma thag lan btab/‘‘ngas nor lnga brgya dang / lug stong gcig gi srog bcad’’ a pha a ma nu bo nu mo rnams hab cha di rer song / hab cha'i sgra de rna bar gzan pa zhig red/ a phas glo bur du dgod mtshams bzhag ste lag pa g.yug g.yug 'ga' byas rjes 'di ltar bshad/‘‘khyod ni khyim 'di'i skyes mgo yin pas/ khyod chos sgor mi zhugs na su zhugs dgos/ khyod kyis nga ngo tshar gtod bsam mam’’lug rdzi gzhon nus mig klad la skor nas bltas bltas rjes bshad don/‘‘nga rang chos sgor zhugs na chog mod/ yin na yang skye ba sngon mar dngos gnas nor lnga brgya dang lug stong gcig gi srog bcad pas ji ltar bya/’’a pha a ma nu bo nu mo rnams yang bskyar hab cha di rer song / rna bar gzan pa'i hab cha'i sgra de kha dbugs khrod 'dar 'dar byed/gnyis/a phas lug rdzi gzhon nu khrid de ri mgo'i dgon par song / dgon pa'i a lags kyis 'dzum bzhin kho gnyis bsu ba byas/ cang ma 'gor bar/a lags kyis lug rdzi gzhon nu'i ngo la sdigs mdzub bstan nas dbugs hal hal gyis skad brgyab byung /—27—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘sdig can khyod chos sgor gtan nas zhugs mi chog khyod kyis skye ba sngon mar nor lnga brgya dang lug stong gcig gi srog bcad/ khyod/ sdig can mi rung ba khyod/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu'i sems la spro ba zhig rgyas shing mig lam du yang bskyar lug rdzi bu mo'i yid 'ong gi gzugs brnyan shar/ kho la 'tshub snang tsam yang med par mgo bo yar dgye ste a phar cer nas 'di ltar bshad/ ‘‘nga'i skye ba sngon ma shan pa zhig yin zhes bshad mod/ khos rnar ma song/’’a phas kyang mgo bo yar dgye ste a lags la lta tsam dang / lug rdzi gzhon nur lta tsam byas rjes a lags la kha gtad de phyag 'tshal ci thub byas/a lags kyi gdong la 'dzum chung zhig rgyas shing dal mor bshad don/‘‘'tshab mi dgos/ 'tshab mi dgos/ kho la dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa 'dis khos skye ba sngon mar dge ba'ang mi nyung ba zhig bsags yod pa bden dpang byed thub/ da nas bzung kho'i ming la khyi phrug thar zer/ 'dis kho'i skye ba sngon ma'i sdig sgrib 'dag par phan yon shin tu che/’’a phas kha nas ldab ldib kyi sgra zhig 'byin bzhin bar med du‘‘lags so/lags so/’’zhes bshad zhor lug rdzi gzhon nu'i gnya' nas mnan ste phyag 'tshal du bcugagasum/khyi phrug thar/ las dbang gi zur zhig nas re zhig thar zin pa'i khyi phrug de yang bskyar g.yang dkar lug gi rdzi bor gyur/nam dkyil/ a pha dang a mas kho rang gam du bos shing / a phas bshad don/—28—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/‘‘khyod la chos sgor zhugs pa'i bsod nams mi ldan na/ da nas bzung sngar bzhin lug khyu 'tsho skyong byos/ nga la da dung bu zhig yod pas 'dang rgyag ci yod’’a pha dang a mas phan tshun la mig brda zhig bstan rjes a mas bshad rgyur/‘‘khyod rang dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs mi thub na cis kyang nga tshor mna' ma zhig blangs te khyim gzhi skyong dgos’’lug rdzi gzhon nu'i sems gting nas dga' spro'i tshor ba zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes shing / mig lam du yang bskyar lug rdzi bu mo'i yid 'ong gi gzugs brnyan shar/ yin yang kho'i sems gting gi spro ba de gnon thabs byas te dal lhod ngang bshad rgyur/‘‘nyin gsum gyi nang du ngas khyod tshor mna' ma zhig 'khrid 'ong /’’bzhi/dpyid ka ni lu gu rtseb pa'i dus tshigs yin pas/ ma mo mang che ba'i rjes su gnam lding sa lding byed bzhin pa'i lu gu re ded yod la/ ma mo lo lon 'di'i rjes su lu gu med pas lu gu khrid pa'i ma mo rnams la smon sems skyes/a phas ma mo lo lon de la shed kyis rdog thos rgyag zhor zhe sdang gis 'di ltar sdig dmod byas/‘‘ma mo tshe zad khyod dngos gnas bsha' ran 'dug’’lug rdzi gzhon nus a phar phud rgyag cig byas shing ma mo lo lon de'i mdun du langs nas bshad rgyur/ —29—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘blun rgan khyod kyis ma mo 'di rang gi drin chen ma'i rnam shes yin pa yang mi shes sam/ mos skye ba sngon mar ri khrod pa zhig la sdig dmod byas pas da gzod skye ba 'dir dud 'gro ru skyes pa red/’’a phas rdog thos rgyag mtshams bzhag ste ma mo lo lon de la bltas nas‘‘ha ha’’zhes gad mo bgad byung / glo bur du/ khos dgod mtshams bzhag ste 'di ltar dris/‘‘nga tshor ming sring gsum yod pas/ ma mo skam pa 'di nga tsho'i ma rgan gyi rnam shes yin srid dam/’’lug rdzi gzhon nus ma mo lo lon de'i rgyab la byil byil byed zhor bshad rgyur/khyod kyi sems la brjed nges kyi rkun po zhugs pa min nam/ ma mo lo lon 'di la'ang sngon chad lu gu spus legs gnyis skyes pa brjed song ngam’’a phas lug rdzi gzhon nu dang ma mo de la bltas bltas rjes glo bur du hab cha zhig brgyab/ de nas khos yang bskyar g.yo sgyu'i ngang bshad don/‘‘de na lu gu spus legs de gnyis ka nga dang nga'i nu bo'i rnam shes yin rgyu red la/ nged gnyis ma shi bar rnam shes dud 'gro ru skyes pa de ya mtshar ba la/ nga la da dung sring mo zhig kyang yod pas de gang du bud song /’’lug rdzi gzhon nu la'ang re zhig lan gdab rgyu ma rnyed pas a phas dgod tsam byas te mu mthud du bshad/‘‘de 'dra mang po bshad nas ci byed/ khyod kyis de ltar bshad na de ring nas bzung ngas kyang ma mo 'di ma rgan gyi rnam shes yin par khas blangs zin/’’a phas de ltar bshad zhor gzan chas sgye mo gang khyer yong nas ma mo lo —30—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/lon de'i mdun la blugs te lug rdzi gzhon nu la 'di ltar bshad/‘‘khyod kyis sems kha bde mo byos/ ngas rang gi ma rgan la bkur bsti yag po bya nges yin/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu kho'i mig lam ṭ+wāṃ /yang yang mngon pa'i lug rdzi bu mo de'i gam la thon/ lug rdzi gzhon nus sems 'gul thebs pa'i ngang lug rdzi bu mo'i lag mgor dam por 'jus te 'di ltar bshad/ ‘‘skye ba da lta 'u gnyis kyis lhan gcig tu 'tsho ba rol chog song /’’ lug rdzi bu mos rang gi lag pa phyir 'then te ya mtshar ba'i ngang bshad rgyur/‘‘khyod kyis de ltar bshad don ci yin nam/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur cing / yang bskyar lug rdzi bu mo'i lag mgor dam por 'jus te bshad don/‘‘'u gnyis kyi las skal sdug pa la'ang / tshe dang por 'u gnyis rang dbang gis mkha' dbyings su 'phur ba'i byi'u 'jol mo gnyis su skyes nas khyo shug byas te snying du sdug pa'i byi'u phrug 'ga' dang mnyam du dga' dga' skyid skyid byas nas yod skabs/ nyin zhig nga rgum bu 'thu ru song rjes sde ba'i nang gi byis pa pra tshags 'gas khyod dang byi'u phrug rnams bzung ste rtsed spyad byas nas bsad de chu khar g.yengs/ nga phyir log nas tshul de mthong bas sems sdug gis ma bzod par chu nang du lcebs nas shi’’lug rdzi bu mos lug rdzi gzhon nu'i thod par reg reg 'ga' byas rjes khong khro'i ngang bshad rgyur/‘‘khyod la tsha brgyab pa ma yin nam’’

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/lug rdzi gzhon nu sngar las 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur cing / lug rdzi bu mo'i lag mgor dam por 'jus te skyo ba'i ngag gis bshad don/‘‘a tsi/ khyod kyis yod tshad brjed song ngam ci/ de dag khyod kyis brjed srid dam/ de'i rjes 'u gnyis stag dang stag mo gnyis su skyes nas khyo shug byas te rgya rdzong nags su gnas bcos shing sha dar khrag dar gyi stag phrug gnyis kyang skyes/ khyod kyis nyin bzhin stag phrug gnyis bsrungs shing / nga rang nyin bzhin ri lung nags tshal 'grims nas kha zas 'tshol du song /yin yang nyin zhig nga rang kha zas 'tshol du song rjes rngon pa 'ga' yong nas khyod ma bu gsum po mdas brgyab nas bsad/ ngas khyod ma bu gsum po'i ro skyin len ched gdug rtsub kyi rngon pa de dag 'tshol du song bas de dag gi g.yo 'og tu tshud de mdas bsad/ de bas yang skyid sked pa nas chad song /’’lug rdzi bu mos dal cag ger nyan nas bsdad yod/ mo la rang shugs kyi sems 'gul zhig thebs te mig zung gis lug rdzi gzhon nu'i gdong la 'bur tshugs su cer te ngag 'jam pos 'di ltar dris/‘‘snying nye lags/ bden nam/ da bar du khyod kyis nga la de dag mi gleng ba ci yin/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu'i sems la rang shugs kyis dga' spro zhig skyes shing /gdong la 'dzum chung zhig rgyas te bshad rgyur/‘‘ngas khyod kyis yod tshad brjed med 'dod/ de dag ji ltar brjed srid/’’lug rdzi bu mo'i ngo la nan tan gyi mdangs shig mngon zhing / ha cang nyan 'dod pa'i nyams shig bstan nas bshad don/‘‘khyod kyis mu mthud du shod dang / nga la nyan 'dod shin tu che/’’—32—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/lug rdzi gzhon nus lug rdzi bu mo'i ngo la lta tsam byas shing / ha cang nan tan gyi sgo nas bshad rgyur/‘‘de'i rjes su 'u gnyis 'jig rten mi yul du skye ba blangs/ khyod zhing pa zhig gi khyim du skyes shing nga tshong pa zhig gi khyim du skyes/ khyim gnyis kyi bar thag ring rgyu med pas 'u gnyis rgyun du ngo thug thub la chung dus nas 'dris shing mthun par gyur/ nga rang pho lo lnga gsum bco lngar son pa'i lo der/ nga'i a phas khyed tshang la gnyen bslangs te lo gcig gi rjes su khyod rang bag mar bsu rgyu'i gros byas/ yin yang lo gcig ma 'gor bar/nga'i a pha nged tshang gi gnyer ba g.yo can de dang a ma gnyis kyis dug blud de bsad/ de bas nga rang glo bur du phyug po'i bu zhig nas srang mdor 'khyams pa'i sprang bo zhig tu gyur/ lo gcig gi rjes su/ nga rang khyod tshang la song nas khyod bag mar bsu rgyu'i re ba bton mod/ yin na yang khyod kyi a phas don de 'dra zhig gtan nas med zer nas khas ma blangs shing nga rang khyi rkun bzhin sgor bskrad/ yun ring ma 'gor bar khyod kyi a phas khyod btsan gyis rgyang ring gi khyim tshang phyug po zhig tu gnas la byin/ ngas mig rig rig gis khyod gnas la 'gro bar bltas 'dug pa las thabs bkod gzhan med/nga'i sems skya mo thang la lhung zhing sngar bzhin srang mdor 'khyams nas 'khyag grang ltogs skom gyi sprang bo'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i dus/ byang sems can gyi shan pa zhig gis thugs khur mdzad pas da gzod 'tsho thabs tsam byung /khos nga'i lo rgyus thos pa'i snying rje tshad med skyes shing nor lug bshas te sha btsongs nas sgor mo btsal ba'i man ngag ma lus bstsal/ 'tsho ba'i ched du/ngas kyang sems can gyi srog gcod pa'i las de dang len mi byed thabs med byung / ngas 'dang brgyab kyin brgyab kyin sems la 'jigs skrag gis —33—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/khengs shing mtshan mo'i gnyid kyang mi bde bar gyur/ de bas nga'i sems la rjes su sdig pa grangs med bsags srid pas sdig bshags kyang 'os 'tshams shig byed dgos snyam nas nor lug re'i srog bcad na dgon par mchod me re dbul rgyu dang ltung bshags tshar gcig re 'don rgyu byas/ skye ba sngon mar ngas nor lug stong gcig dang lnga brgya'i srog bcad pas dgon par mchod me stong gcig dang lnga brgya phul zhing ltung bshags stong gcig dang lnga brgya bton nas sdig bshags byas/ nga rang pho lo bzhi bcu'i steng du khyod sems sdug gis ma bzod par snga mo nas phyi ma'i yul du chas zin pa thos pas nga'i sems la'ang skyo bas khengs te khyod kyi rjes 'brangs nas phyi ma'i yul du phyin/mchod me stong gcig dang lnga brgya'am ltung bshags tshar stong gcig dang lnga brgya'i tshogs bsags sam gang yin mi shes mod/ skye ba 'dir nga la yang bskyar dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu dang lug rdzi bu mo gnyis kar sems 'gul chen po thebs te phan tshun gyi lag zung dam por 'jus shing dga' spro'i mchi ma bton/lug rdzi gzhon nu'i brtse ba'i mig mdangs kyis lug rdzi bu mo'i mig zung la 'bur tshugs su cer te mu mthud du bshad rgyur/ ‘‘a kha/ 'u gnyis kyi las skal sdug pa la ang / gang ltar kyang skye ba da lta cis kyang 'u gnyis kha mi 'bral/ sang nyin nyi shar gyi rtse mor/ ngas khyod bag mar bsu rgyu yin/’’lug rdzi bu mo'i gdong gi dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs de de ma thag gar song cha med du gyur cing lug rdzi gzhon nu'i lag nas thar thabs byas te lag rgyab kyis mig chu 'byid zhor 'di ltar bshad/‘‘snying nye lags/ nga khyod dang 'bral mi 'dod mod/ yin yang a —34—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/phas kha sang nga gnas la byin zin pas skye ba 'dir 'u gnyis kyis lhan du 'tsho ba rol ba'i skal ba ma ldan thal/ a phas nga chung dus nas gnyor nas lag chags pas kho la rgyab 'gal byed ga la srid/ snying nye lags/ do dgong khyod shog dang / ngas khyod la sgug nas 'dug khyod cis kyang yong dgos/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu'i ngo mdog glo bur du thal skya ltar gyur nas lcug phran bzhin 'dar 'dar byed/ lug rdzi bu mo de kho'i mig lam du cha med cig tu gyur/ lug rdzi gzhon nus ci yin 'di yin med par‘‘ha ha’’zhes gad mo bgad byung /lug rdzi bu mos 'gyod gdung gi mig mdangs kyis lug rdzi gzhon nu'i skya mdog gi ngo la bltas bltas rjes mgo bo lan 'gar g.yugs te kho'i lag mgor 'jus nas 'di ltar dris/‘‘snying nye lags/ khyod grang ngam/’’lug rdzi gzhon nu tshor snang med par yar la langs shing / ‘‘ha ha’’zhes hab cha rgyag zhor bshad rgyur/‘‘ngas khyod ngo mi shes/ ngas khyod ngo mi shes/’’rjes su/ khos lus po sngun la sgur tsam byas te shugs kyis mdun phyogs su brgyugs song / nye 'khor gyi lug rnams 'drogs te gang sar bros/sgron 'od shin tu gsal ba'i gusdo kāng zhig tu/ ma mo lo lon de 'dzum dmul dmul gyis gral mgo du bzhugs yod la/ lug rdzi gzhon nu dang a pha a ma nu bo nu mo rnams gral rnga ru gus gus ngang tsog pur bsdad 'dugaskabs shig la/ a pha yar langs nas ma mo lo lon la bltas te gus pa'i —35—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/tshul gyis bshad don/‘‘drin can gyi ma yum lags/ de ring ni khyed kyi brgyad cu gya ston gyi nyin mo yin pas/ khyim mi yongs kyis khyed la tshe ring lo brgya dang bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel zhu ba yin/’’de ltar bshad rjes tshang mas ma mo lo lon la gus phyag 'tshal/a pha a ma nu bo nu mo rnams kyi gus pa'i tshul de mthong bas lug rdzi gzhon nu'i sems la dga' tshor zhig 'gog med du skyes shing mig mthar dga' spro'i mchi ma 'khor/ljid tig tig gi gom sgra zhig gis lug rdzi gzhon nu gnyid las sad du bcug ma gzhi khos rmi lam zhig rmis pa red/ khos skad cig nyid la de ni a pha'i gom sgra yin pa tshor/ kho'i don snying nyig nyig tu lding zhing myur mor mal chas kyis lus po yongs su btums/ gom sgra de nye sar thon pas kho'i lus kyi mal chas kyang glo bur du bshus/ khos 'jigs skrag ngang mig zung phye ma thag a pha'i rgas gnyer gyis g.yogs pa'i ngo gdong kho'i mig lam du lhang nger mngon byung / de ma thag kho'i sems la skug snang zhig skyes shing dbugs kyang len mi thub pa lta bu zhig tu gyur/a phas dmar por gyur pa'i mdzo mig zung che cher bgrad de skad sbom pos 'di ltar bshad/‘‘ma mo lo lon de shos la thongs/ do dgong 'grul ba yod/’’lug rdzi gzhon nus skad cha de thos 'phral/ 'jigs skug ngang phyi nur byed zhor bar med du zhu ba byas/‘‘min/ min/ ma mo lo lon de ni khyod kyi ma rgan gyi rnam shes yin pas de ltar byed mi 'os/’’—36—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/a phas kho la sdang mig cig bgrad de gdug tsub kyis bshad rgyur/‘‘'chal gtam de dag sus rnar 'gro/ khyod kyis myur du ma mo lo lon de shos thongs/’’glo bur du/ na bun lta bu zhig gis kho'i mthong lam bsgribs te yod tshad rab rib du gyur/ khos ma mo lo lon de la lta tsam byas rjes/ shes med tshor med kyis tha gu nag pos ma mo lo lon de'i kha bsdams/ ma mo lo lon des yun ring la sdug bsngal gyis 'phag 'tshag byas byas mthar 'gul rgyu med par gyur/ khos nu bo'i lag nas 'od yug yug gi rno gri blangs te snang med kyis pags pa bshu 'go brtsams/ yun ring zhig 'gor rjes/ pags pa bshus tshar la/ dkar log log gi ma mo lo lon de'i lus por da dung sha 'gul rgyag bzhin yod/ khos dbugs hal hal gyis ma mo lo lon de'i brang blangs shing brang khong gi khrag dron dkar yol gang re gang re byas nas nu mo'i lag gi lcags sder nang la blugs/ kho'i ngo gdong dang lag pa/ da dung nye 'gram gyi rtswa sa'i steng la khrag gis sbags te ya mtshar ba'i ri mo 'ga' grub 'dug khos ma mo lo lon de'i khog nas rgyu ma phyir phud dus glo bur du dngos po nar nar zhig mthong / de ma thag kho'i mig zung 'gul tsam yang mi byed la/ mig lam du khyad mtshar gyi mdangs shig mngon byung / khos shugs kyis phan tshun sbrel ba'i rgyu nyog dag phar ded de lag zung gis dngos po nar nar po de yar bkyags nas zhib lta byas/ de ni rtseb la nye ba'i lu gu zhig red/ de ngos zin rjes/ kho'i lus po rdo sku zhig dang 'dra bar 'gul rgyu med par gyur/ cung 'gor rjes/ kho'i ngo gdong glo bur du 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu gyur cing de dang dus mnyam du ma mo lo lon de'i dkar log log gi lus po'ang kho'i mig lam du mngon/ ma mo lo lon de'i mig zung che —37—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/cher bgrad cing / skyo shas kyi mdangs tsam las 'jigs skrag gi nyams ni tog tsam yang mi 'dug de dag mthong rjes/ kho'i ngo mdog skya bor gyur te lus po 'dar 'dar byed/ de'i 'phror khos 'od yug yug gi rno gri dang /nye 'gram gyi rtswa sa'i steng gi ya mtshar ba'i khrag gi ri mo/ rang gi khrag gis sbags pa'i lag zung sogs mthong bas 'jigs skrag ngang yar langs nas ki ring zhig btab ste rang gi sbra nang du 'dzul/ skabs 'dir/ mtshan mo'i yol ras dal gyis 'then byung / grang rlung 'ur 'ur du ldang zhing gnam sa'i bar mtshams su mag mog tu snang /bdun/lug rdzi gzhon nu la tsha 'khrul byung ste ldab ldib ngang gang 'dod du ci zhig lab bzhin pa'i dus su/ byis pa gnyis kyis mnyam du bos byung /‘‘phu bo lags/ yar longs dang sha za ru 'gro/’ ’skad cha de thos pas lug rdzi gzhon nu'i rig pa je gsal du gyur cing zhe gting nas zhen pa log khos kha sha lhab lhub tu 'gul nas ci zhig bshad 'dod mod/ yin yang yun ring zhig la ngag ma 'khrol/ mjug mthar/khos dbugs bsgrims te shugs kyis 'di ltar bshad/‘‘mar song / mar song /’’'tshab 'tshub kyi gom sgra 'ga' sbra nang nas bstud mar yal rjes/ sbra nang du yang bskyar dal cag ger gyur/ lug rdzi gzhon nu la yang bskyar tsha rgyas te rig pa rab rib tu gyur cing lus po lcug phran bzhin 'dar 'dar byed/nam dkyil tsam la/ lug rdzi gzhon nu'i rna lam du chang 'thung 'ga'i‘‘ha ha'i’’dgod sgra dang / rna bar gzan pa'i khyi'i zug skad/ da dung 'ur —38—

lug rdzi gzhon nu zhig gi 'das rkyen/'ur du ldang ba'i grang rlung gi sgra sogs bstud mar grags 'ong /rjes su nam langs zin/ yin yang gnam ngo rub 'dug nyi ma mi mthong / cang ma 'gor bar/ nam mkha' ru lhab lhub ngang ngang ba'i gshog sgro lta bu'i kha ba babs byung / skad cig tsam la/ kha ba'i 'dab mas sa gzhi yongs su dkar por bsgyur/lug rdzi gzhon nu'i nu bo dang nu mo gnyis dbugs hal hal gyis a pha'i sbra nang du 'dzul nas a pha gnyid las bslangs te 'tshab 'tshub kyis bshad don/‘‘phu bo shi song /’’a pha yar tsog ste lag pas mig zung phur phur 'ga' byas shing / had nas cung tsam bsdad rjes 'di ltar dris/‘‘ci zer/ shi song1’’nu bo dang nu mos a pha'i tshugs ka de mthong bas sems la dgod rgyu zhig langs rung gzab nan gyis 'di ltar lan btab/‘‘red lags/ shi song /’’a phas dmar por gyur pa'i mdzo mig zung che cher bgrad de dal mor bshad rgyur/‘‘ho/ dkon mchog gsum po/’’skyi g.ya' ba'i skad cha de kha bas g.yogs pa'i rtswa thang steng bar med du lding skor rgyag gin 'dug /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ zhog d+dha gcigapad+ma tshe brtan/nyi ma sngon po zhig shar ri'i phrag nas phyed tsam mngon byung / kho'i sems la nyi ma sngon po de shar ri'i phrag nas dal gyis yar 'phags yong bsam mod/ bsam yul las 'das par de ma thag mar 'grib song / kho'i sems la dogs pa zhig skyes te gom pa yang mor spo zhor gser 'od lam lam du 'phro ba'i pho brang zhig tu thon/ pho brang de'i nang gi bzo bkod ni khos nam rgyun gtan nas mthong ma myong ba tag tag red/ khos ya mtshar ba'i mig mdangs kyis pho brang nang gi dngos po de dag la cer 'dug mjug mthar/ kho'i mig mdangs gyang ngo'i lo tho mthug po zhig gi thog la gtad/kho rang 'jig rten mi yul du yong nas mi lo sum cur son yang 'di 'dra'i lo tho mthug po zhig gtan nas mthong ma myong / lo tho de'i steng gi lo zla tshes ni2000lo'i zla12pa'i tshes32red/ de mthong bas kho rang kha gdangs mig cer nas had par gyur/ khos yang bskyar thengs gcig bltas mod/'chugs mi 'dug lo tho de'i ngos su2000lo'i zla12pa'i tshes32zhes gsal bor bkod 'dug kho rang de ru had nas ci yin cha ma 'tshal ba'i dus su/ mi zhig kho'i gam du yong nas kho la cer 'dug khos mi de'i brtse mdangs bral ba'i ngo la lta bzhin khog 'dar zhig brgyab/ mi des gyang ngo'i —40—

shog lho gcigalo tho la gcig bltas rjes 'di ltar bshad/‘‘khyod kyis nga tsho'i lo tho la bltas nas ya mtshar skye bzhin yod dam/’’khos dbang med du mgo lcog ldem ldem 'ga' byas/mi des mu mthud du bshad rgyur/‘‘o/ khyod ya mtshar mi dgos/ khyod kyis nga'i skad char nyon/ nga tsho ni de ring gi nyin mo'i mgo brtsams dus go la 'di'i steng la yong ba yin/da nangs/ byed po zhig gis nga tsho gsar bzo byas/ byed po des nga dang nga 'dra'i mi brgya tham pa gsar bzo byas/’’de ltar bshad zhor mi des pho brang gi gru zur zhig la mdzub gus bstan/khos mi des mdzub gus bstan pa'i phyogs su blta dus/ de ru dngos gnas mi mang po zhig rub 'dug mi de dag gis phan tshun gleng mol byed bzhin yod la/ tshugs ka mi 'di dang phal cher 'dra/ khos da so ma ci'i phyir mi de dag ma mthong bar dogs pa skyes/mi des mu mthud du bshad rgyur/‘‘byed po des nga tsho gsar bzo byas rjes go la gzhan du song / ngas nga tsho mi brgya tham pa 'di'i 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i las dbang shes/ nga tsho go la 'di'i steng du lo brgya ma gtogs 'tsho mi thub/ da nas bzung ste lo gcig 'gor na mi gcig shi 'gro/ de ltar lo rer mi gcig je nyung du 'gro zhing /mjug mthar 'chi ba ni nga yin/’’skabs 'dir/ khos spobs pa bskyed te mi de la 'di ltar dris/‘‘khyod kyis rang gi tshe tshad shes na sems na sdug bsngal med dam/’’‘‘med/ de las ldog ste ngas de yag po 'dug snyam/’’‘‘de ni ci'i phyir/’’

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘'di ni nga tsho'i brtse dung gi rnam pas gtan 'khel byas pa yin/khyod tsho mi'i rigs kyis de la go ba len mi thub/’’‘‘khyod tsho mi'i rigs zhes na khyod tsho ni rigs gang la gtogs sam/’’‘‘ngas kyang nga tsho rigs gang du gtogs pa mi shes/ gang ltar kyang nga tsho la khyod tsho mi'i rigs ltar skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal med par skye ba nas 'chi ba'i bar da lta ltar phyi tshul la 'gyur sdog ci yang med/’’mi des ci zhig la bsam blo gtong bzhin kho la cer nas mu mthud du bshad rgyur/‘‘nga ni shes bya brgya phrag khong du chud pa'i mi zhig yin/ yin yang nga la skyon zhig yod pa ni ngas mgo nas brtsams te grangs ka brtsi mi shes/ ngas gzhan gyi brtsi 'phro der rgyun skyong nas brtsi ba las thabs med/ da nangs/nga rang sa'i go la'i steng du 'grul bzhud la song dus/ khyod tsho mi'i rigs kyi lo grangs brtsi tshad spyi lo2000lo'i zla12pa'i tshes31la thon yod pas de'i rgyun bskyangs nas lo grangs brtsis pa yin/ de ring ni nga tsho'i go la 'di'i nyin dang po yin pas khyod kyis mthong ba de spyi lo2000lo'i zla12pa'i tshes32red/khyod la da dung ya mtshar skyes sam/’’mi des bshad mtshams bzhag ste kho la blta tsam byas pas khos kyang ci zhig rtogs pa bzhin mgo lcog ldem ldem 'ga' byas/ rjes su/ mi des yang bskyar kha grag byung /‘‘nga tsho 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i lo brgya'i nang / nga tsho'i lo tho'i steng gi lo dang zla ni nam yang spyi lo2000lo'i zla12yin la/ tshes grangs nyin re bzhin yar la 'phar bzhin yod/ de ltar lo brgya 'gyangs rjes/ nga tsho dang nga tsho'i go la'i tshe tshad kyang thon pa red/’’—42—
