dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/phar g.yugs pa dang / lag mthil la mchil ma zhig btab nas lcags gri lag la bzung rjes/ ‘‘ha ha/ bdag gi lcags gri 'di'i so kha nas/ lha thugs rje chen po phebs kyang skyob thabs med/ khas ma ṇi bton kyang thar lam med’’zer zhing klu 'bum gyi lus stod g.yas 'dzur zhig byas pa dang /lcags gris tshag sgra dang bcas kho'i ltag rgyab na yod pa'i rdo pha bong zhig gi steng nas rdo lug mgo tsam zhig bcad de sar 'phangs rjes dug sbrul gyis dug lce bskums pa nang bzhin slar yang bsam 'phel glang bo'i lag la 'phrod/de nas lcags gri de skar cha tsam la glog dmar 'khyug 'khyug dang me stag mched mched byas nas klu 'bum gyi brang dong dang lte mtshams/ brla rtsa/ rgya tshigs la gtad de lan bzhi bsnun tsa na/ nam mkhar lag rnyab byas pa dang 'ja' tshon la mtshon gyis bsnun pa ltar reg sa thug sa med par gyur/skabs der nywa la khug tis kyang tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs dge 'phel ri la slebs ran yod pa mthong ste bsam 'phel glang bo la‘‘mi tshe zad 'di rem par ma bsgral na tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs bar 'byol la slebs byung’’zhes bshad pa dang bsam 'phel glang bos klu 'bum gri 'og la mi zin pa ni thad rgyag byas pas lan pa red snyam nas‘‘khyod kyis skyag gzan der thur la lag pas skor gzhus dang / gyen la rkang bas skor rgyag byas te glags rnyed skabs da gzod lcags gris snun cig’’ces gdams/bsam 'phel glang bo ni drang mo drang rkyang g.yag sna khu tshur byed mkhan zhig yin pas/ de ma thag tu‘‘skye bdun ril bu slebs rag la/ a pha'i skye ba zad du 'jug’’ces klu 'bum la thur la lag pas skor rgyag dang / gyen la rkang bas skor gzhus shig byas rjes lcags gri sngo lam me lan gsum 'phangs pa na/ klu 'bum ni kho'i mgo thog nas gyi li gsum 'khor te kho'i ltag rgyab na —98—

rte klu'abumamirgod/langs 'dugabasam 'phel glang bos klu 'bum gyis tshur rgol mi byed pa ni rang nyid kyi rtsal dang stobs la 'jigs pa red snyam ste glang smyon ji bzhin mig rtsa dmar log ger klu 'bum gyi steng la brgyugs tsa na/ klu 'bum ni gom pa bcu tham pa'i khor yug gi nang du phar 'dzur tshur 'dzur byed pa las tshur rgol ni spu tsam yang ma byas so/ /nywa la khug tis gcig nas g.yas g.yon gyi grwa rgod 'gas tshogs chen zhal ngo mthong ste bros song ba dang / gnyis nas bsam 'phel glang bos klu 'bum la lag mi zhog pa mthong ste‘‘ya skyag gzan/ khyod drag drag’’zer zhing ral gris klu 'bum la gtsags rgyag drug gsum bco brgyad byas so/ /skabs der tshogs chen zhal ngo dang dge g.yog 'ga'/ bsam blo 'bum thongs sogs dge 'phel ri rtser slebs/ tshogs chen zhal ngo ni se 'bras dge gsum na chos kyi rtsa ba rtogs pa dang / byams snying rje ha cang che ba'i bgres po dgung lo bdun cu can zhig yin na'ang / ri rtser slebs kyang dbugs mi 'tshang ba dang gdong mi 'gyur bar nywa la khug ti dang bsam 'phel glang bo la‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen/ klu 'bum ni tshogs gral la zhugs nas cang ma 'gor ba'i grwa pa zhig yin pas/ khyod gnyis kyis sa la 'og 'dir khrid 'ongs te gsod rtsis yin nam’’zhes bshad pa ni skad mgo mtho rgyu med kyang brjid shugs che ba zhig red/nywa la khug tis ji mi snyam pa'i tshul du lag pa je mgyogs la btang ste klu 'bum ni sa rdul dang gri 'od kyis btum byung / bsam 'phel glang bos lag pa je dal la btang ste tshogs chen zhal ngo la‘‘khyed la 'gal na dgon pa yongs la 'gal ba yin pas/ khyed kyis kha mi len na su zhig gi kha len/ yin —99—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/na'ang pha spun gsod pa'i dme bo 'di ma bsad na bdag gis shi bo shi mo rnams kyi ngo la ji ltar blta’’zer ba la bltas na bsam 'phel glang bo ni dud 'gro glang bo las bsam blo gtong shes pa de mngon 'dugaklu 'bum gyis phu nu 'di gnyi ga ma bsgral na bdag dang shi 'thab ro 'thab cig byed kho thag yin la/ gal te 'di gnyi ga bsgral na bdag la mtshon na sdig pa'i steng la sdig pa brtsegs par ma zad/ 'bras spungs dgon pa nas kyang chags mi srid/ da gang ltar kyang bya ma dkrogs par sgo nga len thabs shig btsal dgos snyam ste nywa la khug ti'i rgya tshigs la gtad de g.yas rkang gis gzhus khul zhig byas pa na/ nywa la khug ti bar snang la lding ste gri rtse klu 'bum gyi brang dong la gtad de gtsags rgyag cig byed pa dang mnyam du bsam 'phel glang bos lcags gri klu 'bum gyi gnya' ltag la gtad de 'phangs byung / dngos gnas glog dmar 'khyug thengs tsam dang mig rdeb dbang tsam gyi dus la klu 'bum ni me stag mched mched byas te bkyed lding zhig byas pa tsam gyis tshogs chen zhal ngo'i gam na langs 'dug ag skad tsam sgrog pa dang khrag char tsam gtor ba'i mod la der yod thams cad kyi mig lam du mngon pa ni nywa la khug tis gri ring de bsam 'phel glang bo'i ya chung nang la brdabs shing / bsam 'phel glang bos lcags gri 'phen tshod ma zin par nywa la khug ti'i ske la phog ste nywa la khug ti'i mgo bo ni tsog ril ler sa la g.yugs byung / phu nu de gnyi ga dal gyis sa la 'gyel bar bltas na rang nyid kyi tshe srog dang 'jig rten 'di la ji 'dra'i zhe thogs kyin yod pa la ang /bsam blo 'bum thongs kyis kha ngo thams cad skya thal le gyur pa'i klu 'bum bskyor te‘‘khyod la rmas skyon 'dra ma byung ngam’’zhes dris/ klu 'bum gyis sna lam du khrag dri zhig 'thul yong ba la zhe mer nas skum tsog byas te skyug —100—

klu 'bum mi rgod/byung /tshogs chen zhal ngo ni klu 'bum gyi rtsal shugs la ngo mtshar te‘‘klu 'bum lags/ khyod rang bkyid tshad cig la bkyed byung / de min phyin phu nu 'di gnyis kyi lag nas thar dka' rgyu red’’ces bsam 'phel glang bo phu nu gnyis la bltas te‘‘mgo thog na gnam yod ces pa de ci ma bden/ sdig thog la sdig brtsegs te rgyu 'bras mi brtsi na mgo thog la babs pa 'di red’’zer zhing /der yod grwa rgod 'ga' la bsam 'phel glang bo phu nu gnyis kyi bem po sa 'og la 'jug tu bcuganyi ma de nas bzung klu 'bum gyi rtsal shugs dang bsam 'phel glang bo phu nu gnyis kyi shi brda ni 'brug stong ldir ldir dang bser bu g.yug g.yug byas te se 'bras dge gsum la khyab par ma zad/ klu 'bum ni tshogs chen zhal ngo'i dge g.yogs la bskos so/ /spyir do bsdo zhig yin phyir dgon pa'i bca' yig la 'jigs te kho rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i grwa rgod la rtsal shugs 'gran pa dang thub tshod byed pa ma gtogs/ dpe cha pa zhig la thub tshod dang brnyas bcos gtan nas mi byed pas na/ bsam blo 'bum thongs kyis chos la 'bad de yon tan ni yar ngo'i zla ba ji bzhin 'phel la/ klu 'bum ni do bsdo ste grwa rgod rnams kyi yar lta byed sa zhig tu gyur te a rogs zer mkhan zhig kyang med par bsdad do/ /dka' thub rtsid bus klu 'bum dang bsam blo 'bum thongs kyis kho rang khrel med la g.yugs pa red snyam ste gar 'gro gar sdod med par lha sa'i khrom la song /dka' thub rtsid bu nam slebs 'di slebs ma shes par lha sa'i jo khang gi sgo drung la slebs/ phyug po rnams kyis jo sku la gser zhal 'bul ba dang /—101—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/dad ldan rnams kyis jo sku la brkyangs phyag 'tshal bzhin 'dug bsang du sna lam du 'thul ba dang ma dbyangs(ma ṇi 'don pa'i dbyangs)rna la rgyu ba na/su yin yang nub phyogs bde ba can ni 'di los yin snyam pa'i snang ba zhig ster ba red/ skabs der phyug po zhig gis rtsam pa snye mo 'ga' bkal nas yong ste sprang tshogs la sbyin pa gtong mgo brtsams/ sprang tshogs ni skad cig nyid la rtsam par rub pa'i mod la/ sprang po rkang gyol zhig gis lag pas skam gyi sog pa gnyis brdungs te thag sgra grag tu 'jug pa dang / kha yis ma ṇi zlo bzhin slebs pa la sprang tshogs ni dmag tshogs kyis dmag dpon mthong ba ji bzhin dal 'jags se phreng bsgrigs/ sbyin bdag gis kyang‘‘gral gdong slebs byung / rtsam pa gral gdong la ster du chugs’’zhes rtsam pa sprang po gral gdong zer ba der sprad/ sprang po gral gdong gis sprang po re re la rtsam pa rtsam khog lnga re byin rjes 'phro lhag gi rtsam pa sgye mo do sprang po gnyis la 'khur du bcug ste grabs rgyags dang bcas phyir log go /'jig rten na sprang po la rigs gnyis yod/ rigs gcig ni sprang nag ste rgyab na gos dang kha la zas med par ngo tsha zer ba de phar la g.yugs nas zas gos slong ba de yin/ sprang nag la mtshon na zas gang zhim dang gos gang yag gon mi thub na'ang / ltogs sdug dang grang sdug gtan nas myang mi dgos/ sprang dkar ni zas gos med par rgyab grang ste chab rom blugs 'dra gsus pa ltogs te me 'bar bzhin yod na'ang‘‘mi la ngo tsha med na khyi dang /khyi la rnga ma med na 'dre yin’’zhes ngo tsha la 'dzems te zas gos slong mi phod pa de yin/ dka' thub rtsid bu la mtshon na gsus pa ltogs te tsha lang gin yod kyang sprang nag ltar ngo tsha ltag rgyab la 'phangs te slong mo byed ma phod par da ni yar jo bo rin po che la phyag gsum btsal rjes ci byed de dus blta snyam nas ska —102—

klu 'bum mi rgod/rags grol ba dang / lag pa'i pad+mo thod par bkod de brkyangs phyag gcig btsal ba na/ bu mo mig zung la 'od snang ldan pa/ kha ngo bkrus med na'ang yag mo sgo shugs nas mngon pa/ lus skyes gzugs kyi phra sbom dang ring thung ran pa/ skad snyan mo rna dbang 'phrog pa'i bu mo zhig brgyugs nas yong ste yar blta mar blta zhig byas rjes dka' thub rtsid bu mthong byung / de nas kho mo dka' thub rtsid bu'i gam la yong ste brel ma dngangs shig byas nas‘‘stag shar gzhon nu lags/ bdag bu mo mgon med skyabs med cig skyabs rogs’’zhes zhu ba byed skabs rnyi las thar ba'i ri dwags shig dang kun nas mtshungs so/ /dka' thub rtsid bus gar 'ongs 'di 'ongs med pa'i bu mo zhig gis skyabs re ba la khong dgod cig langs te/ 'jig rten khams 'di kham kham zhig yin zer ba la bden zhad yod 'dug de min phyin bdag lta bu'i kha la zas dang rgyab la gos med pa zhig la zhu ba byed mi zhig yod mi srid/ da gang ltar kyang mi zhig gi srog bskyabs pa las dge rtsa zhig bsgrub rgyu gang na yod snyam ste‘‘bu mo lags/ bdag lta bu zhig gis khyod rang ji ltar bskyabs’’zhes dris pa dang / bu mo des bsam dbang dran dbang med par dka' thub rtsid bu'i thu ba yar bkyags te dka' thub rtsid bu'i ltag rgyab la 'dzul/dka' thub rtsid bu la 'phrug rgyu cig langs pa dang kha phyir 'khor te‘‘khyod 'dis ci byed kyin 'dug’’zer ba na/ bu mo de'ang kho'i ltag rgyab la 'byar zhing / lag yas kyis kho'i kha bcad de‘‘khyod kyi kha de kha rog ger sdod dang’’zer skabs/ lus la khrab rmog gyon zhing lag la mdung ring thogs pa'i sde ba gzhung gi dmag mi bcu phrag 'ga' slebs te mi tshogs kyi khrod nas yar btsal mar btsal byed pa dang / ‘‘thams cad kyis nyon dang / rkun mo —103—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/zhig ma rig gam’’zhes dris/ thams cad kyis mgo bo g.yug g.yug dang /‘‘ma rig ma go’’zhes bshad/ don dngos thog bshad na'ang der yod thams cad kyis dad pa rtse gcig sgos rdo gcal gyi steng na jo bo rin po che la phyag 'tshal bzhin yod pas/ bu mo zhig dka' thub rtsid bu'i rgyab gos kyi 'og la 'dzul ba ni ya yid la'ang gang na 'ong /sde ba gzhung gi dmag mi gcig gis kho la 'jigs te phur tshugs su lta bzhin pa'i dka' thub rtsid bu'i rgyab gzhung la mdung yus gzhus tsam byas te/‘‘gcin phrug 'dis ska rags grol te phyag kyang mi btsal bar bdag la blta don ci yin/ khyod kyis 'dre mo mthong ba min nam/’’zhes gshe gshe 'ga' btang ste phar song / dka' thub rtsid bus lag pas mgo bo bskyor ba dang /kha nas‘‘a yo’’zhes rkang ba g.yas phyogs su spo tsam byas pa na/ bu mo des kyang rkang ba g.yas phyogs su spo tsam byas byung / 'jigs dngangs kyis mid thag khar btags pa'i snying rdog khu tshur 'dra ba de bu mo de'i gtos shing mnyen pa'i myos bum dang / drod 'jam ldan pa'i gzhon sha/ dri bsung 'thul ba'i kha rlangs sogs kyis slar yang ya chung nang la 'bab tu bcug na'ang /'khyag sib ber gyur pa'i rngul chu yis kho'i lus la za 'phrug cig bslangs byung /khos bu mo der‘‘bdag gcin gtong du 'gro dgos’’zhes gyang phag cig la dal gyis song ba na/ bu mo de'ang kho'i rum rgyab nas lus dang grib ma ji bzhin 'grogs te song ngo / /mi med sa zhig la slebs rjes/ dka' thub rtsid bus bu mo de rum rgyab nas phyir bskrad de‘‘gdon mo ma khyod kyis bdag la 'jigs dngangs bskur byung’’zhes bu mo de'i steng la mig zung bgrad pa dang lag sgying byas/bu mo des hab cha sang sang zhig brgyab ste‘‘bdag la nyen kha de 'dra zhig —104—

klu 'bum mi rgod/byung med phyirna/ khyod lta bu'i gsar bu kha ser zhig gi rum rgyab la 'dzul na dkon mchog gsum’’zer ba dang / rgyang ring na yong gin yod pa'i sde ba gzhung gi dmag mi gnyis la bltas te‘‘spyang rgan gan tsho thon byung’’zhes gla lding lding dang sha rgyug rgyug byas te bros song /dka' thub rtsid bu la'ang skug dnganyangs smra mi shes pa zhig langs te bu mo de'i rjes bsnyegs te bros/ lha sa'i srang lam ni g.yas dkyogs g.yon dkyogs dung dkar 'khyil 'dra zhig yin pas/ rkang mgyogs spyod sa ni mi 'gro/ dka' thub rtsid bus bu mo de'i rjes su bsnyegs te brgyugs pa na/sde ba gzhung gi dmag mi'i lag nas thar song na'ang / bu mo de ni mig lam du rgyu ba'i skar mda' ji bzhin mi snang bar gyur/ de nas mun yang khad khad kyis rub byung /dka' thub rtsid bu ni klad pa med pa'i rtswa mi shing mi ji bzhin srang lam dang srang lam brgyud de 'gro skabs khyi 'gas rgyang nas zug pa ma gtogs mi zer ba zhig gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug dus de ni zla mjug yin pas mun ni ha cang gnag dka' thub rtsid bus ltogs bsran byas te sgo khung zhig tu bsgongs nas bsdad cing / yid la rang nyid kyi byis dus nas phu bo dang mnyam du a lnga mthe drug btsal te ro skyin len du song tshul dang / klu 'bum gyis kho rang bskyabs tshul/ klu 'bum dge rgan la bsten tshul/ de nas lha sar slebs tshul sogs dran pa dang mnyam du klu 'bum dang bsam blo 'bum thongs/ dbyangs can khro mo sogs kyi gzugs brnyan mig lam du re re bzhin mngon byung / de'i 'phror mi gzugs nag lang ba zhig mig lam du brgyud pa na khos mgo bo 'dar g.yug cig byas te zhib tu bltas tshe/ mi zhig lkog 'jab byas te khang ba sum thog lhas ra dang ldan pa zhig gi gyang kha nas —105—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/nang la lding / khos 'di ni rkun ma zhig min nam snyam ste mtshar snang dang bcas gyang kha de nas lhas ra'i nang lding / lhas ra de ha cang che la thog khang ni gcan gzan rngam brjid can zhig dang mtshungs par nag lang nge 'gying 'dugakhos grags 'gul ci yang med par yar lta mar lta zhig byas te thog khang gi sgo drung la 'jab pa tsa na/ kho rang glo bur du gar yong 'di yong mi shes pa'i mi tshogs dpal 'bar thogs pa mang pos bskor 'dug dka' thub rtsid bus zhib tu bltas tshe mi tshogs de ni sprang tshogs khyu zhig yin la/ rgyab gos chad po gyon cing kha ngo bkrus med par ma zad/ la la ni long ba dang la la ni gyol bo sogs mi rnam pa sna tshogs 'dus 'dugasprang tshogs kyi khrod na ska rags yan na mtho gang dang / ska rags man na mtho gang las med pa'i mi'u thung gyol po zhig dka' thub rtsid bu'i gam la gom pa gsum spos rjes/ ‘‘ya skyag gzan/ khyod sde ba gzhung nas mngags pa yin nam ci zhig yin/ 'chi bdag rgyal po zer na nged cag yin/ gshin rje chos rgyal zer na nged cag yin/ gshin rje las mkhan zer na nged cag yin/ khyed kyis rdzun gyi 'khor lo bskor tsam byas na/ nged cag gis khyod kyi lus steng gi shun lpags rim pa dgu mi bshu na dkon mchog gsum’’zhes bshad pa dang / der yod thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu‘‘shun lpags rim pa dgu mi bshu na dkon mchog gsum’’zhes bshad do/ /dka' thub rtsid bus gcig na mi ma bsad/ gnyis na jag ma byas/gsum na brkus ma byas pas skrag don ci yod snyam ste/ stod nyi ma lha sar mjal du yong rogs/ stod nyi ma lha sar mjal du yong don/ stod nyi ma lha sa ru rang nyid mi rkyang rta rkyang du lus tshul sogs gcig gcig gnyis gnyis —106—

klu 'bum mi rgod/byas te bsnyad pa na/ thams cad hab cha di re bgad byung /mi'u thung des mig zung sgor sgor dang sma ra gzeng gzeng byas te‘‘ya skyag gzan kha mkhas/ khyod kyis bshad pa mtha' dag lha sgrung kho na yin pa la bltas na/ khyod ni bshad shes te bya pho'i g.yod ldug mkhan dang / bshad ma shes grod pu phyir slog mkhan zhig red/ da brgya bshad stong bshad stong ba yin/ phyi 'khor rnams gang na yod’’ces bos pa na/ sprang tshogs kyi khyu nas sprang po dbyug thogs brgyad kyis dka' thub rtsid bu sgor sgor a long 'dra ba zhig byas nas bskor byung /dka' thub rtsid bus de ring bdag ni lam kha'i shing dang sa mtha'i mi zer ba ji bzhin tha na sprang tshogs kyi brnyas bcos byed yul du gyur yod na'ang / gcig na rang nyid ni stag shar ba zhig yin pa dang / gnyis na rang nyid ni klu 'bum gyi dngos slob yin pas/ la rgya 'chor du 'jug mi rung snyam ste‘‘khyod cag ni gzhog gin gzhog gin je sbom dang / bshad kyin bshad kyin je thu yin na gdong la bud dang / dpa' med kyang sar rgyag rdor rgyag dang skad med kyang ra 'ba' lug 'ba' zhig los byed’’ces phu dung ltag rgyab nas mdud pa zhig brgyab pa dang / thu ba g.yas brdze dang g.yon brdze zhig byed skabs sprang po phyi 'khor brgyad ni dbugs thengs skad cig la rub byung /skad cig tsam la dpal 'bar gyi 'od snang gi 'og na sprang dbyug sbrul zhags 'phen 'phen dang / khu tshur tho ba 'phyar 'phyar/ cal sgra dang skag sgra mtshams mi chad par yod skabs/ sa rdul gyi khrod nas dka' thub rtsid bus klu 'bum gyis bslabs pa ltar rkang lag mnyam bkol byas pa las khu tshur gyis sprang po zhig tsog ril ler gom pa gsum gyi mtshams la g.yugs pa dang /—107—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rkang bas sprang po zhig thal 'tshub ber gom pa gsum gyis mtshams la g.yugs pa na/ dbyug pa drug gis bsam dbang dran dbang med par dka' thub rtsid bu'i rgyab gzhung la gzhus te sa la bsgyel pa dang / thag nag cig gis skad cig nyid la dka' thub rtsid bu gru gu 'dra ba zhig bkyigs byung /sprang po mi'u thung des lag sgying zhig byas te‘‘gral gdong gi sku mdun la khrid cig’’ces bshad pa dang / sprang tshogs kyis dka' thub rtsid bu ni g.yas drud g.yon drud byas te thog khang de'i nang la khrid/ snum sgron mang po dus gcig la bkar byung / dka' thub rtsid bus khang ba'i nang la zhib lta byas tshe/ de ni dkyil ka yod pa'i khang ba gyan bzhi can zhig yin la/ ban shing dang mthil shing ldan pa'i khang ba'i gral mgo na cog tse tshon ris ma zhig yod pa dang / cog tse dang ban shing bar gyi ra stan steng na sprang rgan ral ba 'phyings shing sma ra gzengs pa zhig gis mgo bo sprang dbyug cig la sngas yod pa dang / lag pas chang rdzi'u zhig la 'jus nas sngur ba 'brug sgra ldir ldir byed bzhin nyal 'dugadaka' thub rtsid bus sprang tshogs kyis sprang rgan de'i gnyid dkyogs par dogs nas sdod pa la bltas na sa dmar gyis las pa'i sku brnyan khyu gcig las blta rgyu mi 'dug da gang ltar kyang bdag gis kha ma grags na gcig gis kyang kha grag mi srid snyam ste/ glo lu 'ga' byas nas mgrin pa zhig bsal rjes‘‘bya lam la 'gro gi med dus gcin btang ba brla sgang ngo red zer ba de ci ma bden/ sa mdo smad nas yong ba'i stag sha ra zhig stod nyi ma lha sa ru sprang tshogs kyi lag la lhung rgyu red zer na su zhig gi rna la 'gro/ da gang ltar kyang khyod tshos bdag gi shun lpags bshus na a khu klu 'bum gyis kyang khyod tsho kha rog ger mi bskyur kho thag yin’’zhes skad mgo je mthor btang nas bshad do/—108—

mig shel gyon pa'i khang rtsegamig shel gyon pa'i khang rtsegaljang bu/mi/ snyan ngag gi don snying gis gzhis chags pa/—('jan man3hes te ker/'gro ba mi'i rigs 'di rtswa chu 'tshol snyegs kyi 'brog las nas khang gzhis su gtan sdod byung ba ni mdun skyod thengs shig gi mtshon byed yin par sus kyang the tshom 'dzin mi srid la/ khang gzhis dang khang gzhis tshogs pa la brten nas grong dang grong khyer gyi kho lag 'di byung ba yang mdun skyod thengs shig los yin/ gna' bo'i 'jeb kyi gtor dbyibs mchod rten nam rom gyi glu gar tshoms khang / de bzhin rdo rje gdan gyi 'dzugs skrun dang rgya nag lcags ri ring bo'i gzi dpal/ 'dzugs skrun gyi deb ther la rim pa ba zhin bstar ba'i sa rdo yi phung bo 'di dag mi rnams spobs pa skye thub pa'i rgyab rtsa btsan po yin la/ mi'i rigs rang ngos kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'grogs pa'i blo gros dang ngal rtsol gyis bden dpang yang yin/gna' bo'i dus kyi mi rnams rang byung khams kyi sa rdo ri brag gtsang chu nags tshal dang ha cang nye bas na/ 'dzugs skrun gyi rgyu cha'ang drod 'jam dang ldan la/ mi gshis kyi bab dang bstun pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ bed spyod kyi rin thang dang mdzes dasnyod kyi rin thang de rang byung khams kyi ngo bor —109—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/thim pa zhig yin pas/ 'dzugs skrun ni mi dang rang byung khams bar gyi 'brel zam lta bur chags shing / khang rtseg re re dang mkhar gyang dum pa tshang ma mi dang mi'i bar gyi zol bral bab chags kyi dung sems bcos min ji bzhin/mnyes gshin dang bde drod/ 'jam bag ma bcos pa bcas kyi rnam pa'i ngang gnas thub yod/ gna' bo'i 'dzugs skrun tha dag gi mdun du/bdag la rang yul du log 'ong ba'i snang ba zhig ster la/ mkhar gyang dang pho brang gi mdun du ngas mi'i rigs kyi byis pa'i dus la byung ba'i sems 'gyu tha dag la 'tham 'khyud bya thub/lag rtsal gyi rkyen gyis/ e sha ya'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi 'di thal ba'i tha gu ji bzhin rlung gis spur la/ ‘‘gsar ba’’thams cad da lta mi rnams kyi ltar snang gi blo ngos su‘‘rnying bar’’gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa ma zad/ rigs rgyud du ma'i skad ngag gi ngo bo 'gyur dus 'dir/ kho bo grong khyer chen po'i rno lcags dang ar 'dam/ 'gyig sob/ glog skud/ 'phrul 'khor gyi klong du rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med las chung ba'i tshul gyis thim dus/ mig shel gyon pa'i khang rtseg tshar du dngar ba'i ngo mtshar ltas 'di mthong /drang mor bshad na/ kho bos kha byang gi gsham du drangs yod pa'i 'jar man pa hes te ker gyi gsung dum de'i don snying la yang bskyar bsam blo mi gtong ga med byung / mi tshogs chen po'i khrod nas mi tshogs chung bar bsnyegs shing / mi tshogs chung ba nas‘‘grogs po’’zhes pa'i tshogs pa zhig snyeg skabs/ slob grogs/ las grogs/ mdza' grogs/ dga' grogs/bza' grogs sogs‘‘grogs’’'di dag gi tshogs pa'i khrod/ rgan gzhon/mdzangs blun/ pho mo/ nye ring gi tshogs pa zhig de las kyang lus ni grong khyer na gnas kyang sems pa 'brog thang zhing kha ru lus pa'i spun zla tsho/—110—

mig shel gyon pa'i khang rtsegagadong la bar thag 'byed byed lta bu'i skag rtsi dang thal dkar byugs kyang sen bar nas nag dreg mngon pa'i spun zla mo tsho/ lus sems ngag gsum grong khyer sribs la mkha' dbugs bzhin thim bzhin pa'i spun zla bu dang bu mo tsho/ngag nas‘‘a khu’’dang‘‘a ne’’‘‘zhe zhe’’(thugs rje che)zer mkhan gyi ngo gdong skyer skya dag smyo ham gyi grong khyer 'di'i lus stobs ches che ba ni khang rtseg mtho shos dag yin la/ de ni stobs shugs dang nga rgyal/ blo gros dang lag rtsal gyi mtshon byed kyang yin/ khang rtseg 'di dag brtse sems bral ba'i mi gsod lag dmar (nga tshos glog brnyan las mthong ba'i lag dmar) ji bzhin/mig shel ja mdog gam gnam mdog re gyon nas khro gtum dang khrel med kyi rnam pas tshogs pa dang tshogs pa sbrel ba'i mi rnams la lta rtog byed kyin 'dugamig shel chen po de'i 'geb srung 'og tu mig zung chung chung khri ma 'bum gyis kyang khyod la lkog lta byed kyin 'dug khyod kyi kha zas dang skyid sdug khyod kyi bde thang dang 'gro sdod la gzigs skyong gnang mkhan de khyod rang nyid las su/ rang byung khams kyi sprin pa dang ri brag gtsang chab dang nags tshal/spang ljongs dang me tog gang la'ang 'brel ba med pa'i gru bzhi nar mo'i ngo gdong 'di tsho ma gzhi su yi ngo gdong yin/ brtse bral khrel 'das/ thod gnyer gyi mdud pa mkhregs pa'i rtseg rim re re'i 'og tu mig shel gru bzhi gyon pa'i khang rtseg 'di dag gi sbubs su/ khyim mtshes phan tshun rus ming yang mi shes pa'i bza' zla gnyis te/ bza' zla gnyis dang bu phrug gcig re/yang na rgas 'khog rabs chad cig gcig mang du phyin/ gzhan zhig nyung du 'gro ba'i 'khor skyod/ res mos/ 'khor lo ltar/ zo chun gyi 'khor lo bzhin skyod pa'i las 'bras sam dge sdig re snyeg dang yid chad —111—

nga rang sdod myong ba'i sbra gur de dang a ma'i slog ral/ thag ring gi spyang tshogs dang lug khyu/ gangs ri dang mtshe'u 'gram gyi me tog sna brgya/ar 'dam gyi gzhung lam ngos nas bzhur gyin nga rang la dngangs skrag skyes pa 'di su la zhu/ nga dang 'dra ba'i mi rnams las grub pa'i tshogs pa 'di/khang rtseg gi mig shel mdun dang rgyab tu/ rang gis rang la mchod pa'i mar me bzhin zhi bar gyur/ med par gyur/ dus tshod bzhin shul med du gyur/

stong bsam/stong bsam/ljang bu/rmi rnams kyis rtag par phugs bsam dang stong bsam gyi dbye ba gsal kha thon pa zhig khyod la 'grel bshad bya thabs med de/ rgyu mtshan ni kho rang tshos 'tshol snyeg byed kyin pa'ang yang snying rigs gang du gtogs pa rtogs thabs bral/gal te khyod rang las skal gyi bdag po'i dbang du gyur ba zhig la rlom tshe/tshe rabs du ma'i sngon nam yang na khyod rang 'jig rten 'dir slebs pa'i nyin de nas bzung 'byung 'gyur gyi mdun lam gtan 'khel byas tshar la/ gal te khyod rang rang gi blo gros dang nus par rlom thub pa zhig yin tshe phugs bsam dang stong bsam res mos ngang khyod kyi mi tshe'i bshul gyi lam tshad rdo ring du 'gyur srid/phran gyi rtsom yig dang po ni lo bcu bdun du son dus tshags par steng du bkod myong la/ skabs der rtsom pa po zhig gis/ ‘‘ci nus kyis snyan grags kyi phyir du rtsom yig 'bri dgos’’zhes snying nye ba'i ngang skul 'ded kyang byas pas/ phran gyis 'byung 'gyur gyi rang nyid ni‘‘snyan grags ldan pa'i rtsom rig pa’’zhig yin pa'i stong bsam 'chang myong / stong bsam gyi me lce je cher mched pa dang bstun nas nga rang go med tshor med ngang lhug rtsom chung chung zhig —113—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/legs skyes la brdzus te rtsom rig ces pa'i pho brang gi sgo 'gram du slebs/skabs der/ phran gyi go ba len stangs la rtsom rig pa ni nyams myong dang 'jig rten gyi shes byas phyug pa'i rgan po zhig dang 'dra bar/ kun gyis dga' bsu dang dang len/ gus bkur bcas byed la/ de ni lam ston gyi sgron me dang kun mkhyen gyi slob dpon bzhin/ gzhan la slob gso dang bslab bya gtong mkhan te/ de'i smyug 'og nas‘‘legs bshad’’kyi me tog dgod cing / de'i tshig sgros las mun sel gyi nyi 'od 'tsher thub snyam/lo bcu dgu nas bzung / phran gyis‘‘rigs su gyur pa phyogs su chad pa'i’’mos mthun 'ga' dang mnyam du snum par dus deb rigs gnyis bton myong la/ stong bsam de mthar thug gi dad par bzung nas/ sems su rang nyid ni skyo gdung gi bla srog kun gyi mgon skyabs dang / bde skyid skye bo kun gyi gnyen bshes su sgom nas/ ‘‘rgya che ba'i 'gro don mdzad mkhan’’gyi skye bo'i bzhugs gral du rang la yang sdod gnas yod snyam pa'i spobs pa ya mtshan zhig gis brang kha gtams song / da lta phyir 'dang brgyab na spobs pa ya mtshan de ni stong bsam gyi wu ba las ma 'das/tag tag stong bsam des phran slob 'bring gi dge rgan tshad thub cig byed pa'i gdams gses de bcom la/ lto 'dun can la kha zas zhim po dang chang 'dun can la bdud rtsi bsil ma bshams pa lta bu'i stong bsam gyi bslu brid des/ nga rang‘‘gang la thon na yul dang / chu khar thon na ja’’yin pa'i yul gyar pa zhig tu bzos shing / ‘‘lag pa rum dang ca ni mchan’’gyi sprang po zhig tu bsgyur/sos dal ngang mjal skor du 'gro zhing / lhod g.yeng sgos ja khang du sdod pa/ da rung bag phebs kyi glu gar la rol ba'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis nga'i —114—

stong bsam/stong bsam gyi yol gor don snying snon thub ched dam/ yang na/ sngo bsangs kyi nam mkha' dang gangs dkar gyi gzi byin/ spang ljongs kyi rgya khyon sogs kyis nga'i stong bsam gyi sgron mer mar khu tsam snon thub pa'i ched du de/ nga rang yun ring la dmigs med du 'khyam la/ tha na/ glo bur spro ba 'phel ba'i rang snang rang bzi'i sems 'gyu zhig la brten nas mi tshe 'di 'grul skyod kyi 'phyo 'gul la bcol ba'i 'char gzhi'ang bzos myong /nga rang spyi sger gang rung gi mthun rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ chol kha gsum gyi dkyil snying du gyur pa'i sa khongs phal cher gyi mgron por gyur myong la/ dpe sgam gyi nang du zin tho'i 'bri deb brgyad dgu zhig nyar yod na'ang /rang rlom dang blun rmongs/ rgyan cha dang dbul phongs/ glu gar dang sdug bsngal sogs re re bzhin ngo mtshar zhing yi mug pa'i kha sprod du langs pa'i sa gzhi 'di'i mdzes sdug ldan pa'i snod bcud kyi 'gal 'du sems thengs rer/stong bsam de yang nyi 'od 'og gi kha ba bzhin ga le ga ler smug sprin rab rib dang rlangs pa ban bun du 'gyur gyin 'dugastong bsam de'i drin la/ nga rang sngar ltar tshe srog gi bgrod lam steng skyod thub pa byung la/ gsal bor bshad na/ stong bsam gyi phyogs ston 'khor lo de'i rkyen gyis/ da lta'i bar du nga la thang chad cing sems ngal ba'i tshor ba ma byung /'on kyang / da lta ngas gzhi nas shes pa ni/ stong bsam ni nam yang stong bsam yin la/ stong bsam de mngon 'gyur 'byung ba'i nyin mo ni tshe yi 'du byed stong ba'i skad cig ma de la rang la nongs 'gyod mi skye ba de red/stong bsam de 'od snang bzhin yal gyin pa'i rkyen gyis/ nga'i rtsom rig gi pho brang de yang nyil zin la/ da lta ngas rang gi las ka ste rtsom rig —115—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ces par bsam blo gtong thengs rer/ lag rtsal mi dman pa'i shing bzo dang mgar ba'am/ spo lo dang mig mangs rtsed par mkhas pa'i lus rtsal pa/yang na so nam dang gso skyong la byang ba'i zhing pa dang rdzi bo sogs dran gyin 'dug pas/ shog dkar gyi sa zhing ngam spang ljongs la yig 'bru'i sa bon gtor zhing lug khyi 'tsho ba'i rtsom pa po'ang‘‘srid pa rgan po’’min la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'ang ma yin pa rtogs byung /nga'i rgyu nor 'ba' zhig ni shog smyug dang lag rtsal phran bu/ bsam blo nyag nyog cig yin la/ stong bsam gyis da bar du nga la bzhag pa'ang de tsam yin/ /

khrom lam du 'phrad pa'i char ba/khrom lam du 'phrad pa'i char ba/bkra shis dpal ldan/chu zangs byur bur gang nas lud pa ltar gyi char ba chen po zhig glo bur du babs pa dang nyi mas tsha bor gyur ba'i sa bkrag gzhung lam steng nas rlangs pa dang sbrags drod mog mog gi dri smra mi shes pa zhig sna lam du 'dzul 'ongs/'ar sgrag 'ur sgra dang zang zing lang long gi khrom lam hril bo rgya je cher song ba dang phar bzhud tshur bzhud byed mkhan de dag ha lam char chu dang mnyam du 'od thing thing gi gzhung lam nas 'dred de sa 'og dong lam nang 'dzul ba bzhin je nyung du song nas rim bzhin stong sang sang du gyur bas char ba 'bab sgra rna bar gsal du gsal du song / dbyar kha'i mkha' thog gi glo bur 'jab rgol thad mi mang che bar gra sgrig med pas g.yas g.yon gyi tshong khang dang bza' khang du char g.yol byed mkhan gyis yongs su khengs pa dang mgo bo rub rub kyis gzhung lam phyogs su bltas nas sdod tshul ni ci zhig gis mi tsho'i yid dbang 'phrog pa dang 'dra zhing / char bas rlon pa chags nas rjes su 'dzul yong mkhan tshos mgo dang gyon gos steng gi chu rdeb rdeb byed bzhin nam mkhar 'khang ra byed pa dang char g.yol byed mkhan mang po zhig gi 'dren byed las kyang sgug mi bzod pa'i snang ba ston pas don dngos thog lam bar glo bur du 'phrad pa'i char ba der mi mang po zhig gis ma mos pa'i bzo lta ston bzhin —117—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'dugachar ba ni zhib la phra ba'i mu tig gi yol ba dang 'dra bas 'khris kyi mthong lam yang sgrib grabs byed pa dang char chu 'khyil ba'i sa bkrag gzhung lam steng du 'bab tshul ni me mda' sbag sbag gi mde'u rgyun mi chad par dmigs 'ben thog tu babs pa'ang phye leb grangs las 'das pas de gar bro gar 'khrab pa dang mtshungs/khor yug gi sgra yod tshad char ba'i har sgra dang 'og chu'i shag sgras bkab pa dang / tha na rlangs 'khor rgyug pa'i sgra yang char ba 'bab pa'i sgra dang 'dres nas har sgrar gyur/lus la snam bu nag po'i phyu ba phu med dang rkang bar lham zon gyon zhing mgo ras nyeb gyon brgyab pa'i bud med dar yol zhig gis‘‘char ba yag po zhig babs song / bdag tsho zhing pa'i khul la char ba ma babs na gang yang yong gi ma red/ lha sar babs tshe bdag tsho'i lung par yang babs yod kyi red/ babs yod kyi red’’ces chig lab kyi tshul du smras pa thos skabs skom pas gdung ba'i lo tog gis char gyi bdud rtsi ngoms par 'thung ba'i ngang tshul lhang lhang du 'char/ 'khor gsum rkang 'khor gtong mkhan kha shas 'gyig shog chen po re gyon te 'khor lo stong par phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed bzhin yod pa dang / nyi gdugs phub pa'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis ni gom pa dal mos skyod bzhin pa'i ngang tshul la bltas na yul ljongs yid du 'ongs pa zhig tu sos dal gyi 'cham 'cham la zhugs pa ltar snang /gzhung lam steng du rlangs 'khor nyung du song na'ang de dag char la g.yol mi dgos pas bdal gtong 'jib chung dang bzo bkod mdzes la —118—

khrom lam du 'phrad pa'i char ba/gnas thang che ba'i 'jib chung mang po zhig sngar bzhin char dkyil du har sgra dang bcas rgyug bzhin pa ni char g.yol byed mkhan g.yas g.yon gyi mi rnams la ngom 'phyar byed pa dang 'dra zhing / bdal gtong 'jib chung gla pa rgyug mkhan yin na'ang bzo bkod mjos pa'i 'jib chung gzhan dag nang sdod pa ni longs spyod yin pas skabs der smon sems sngar las lhag pa skyes/rkang 'khor bzhon pa'i skyes pa zhig gi phru gu chung chung zhig rgyab tu bskyon nas char ba'i khrod du skyod bzhin 'dug cing / kho gnyis la char gos gcig rang las med pa de phru gur g.yogs yod pas skyes pa de'i gyon chas cha tshang rlon rkyang chags pa ma zad mgo bo nas bzhur ba'i chu og ma'i 'og nas bzhur bzhin yod pa dang / phal cher slob grwa'am bu bcol khang grol nas phru gu bsu bar song ba dang da dung nang du brel ba che ba'i las ka zhig yod kyi red/bzo lta mdzes la skyid snang dod pa'i 'jib chung zhig kho'i 'khris nas har sgra dang bcas bzhud pa dang lam steng du 'khyil ba'i chu 'thor tshul ni brnyan 'phrin thog rlangs 'khor rgyug shugs 'gran pa'i ltad mo'i nang grags can rlangs 'khor de rigs chu'i nang rgyug tshul ltar ha cang mdzes pa dang kho'i lus thog tu'ang byin 'bebs byung zhing / skabs der kho'i ngos nas bshad na lus yongs rlon par gyur zin pas rlangs 'khor gyis chu gtor bas phan gnod med mod/ kho ma bzod par de'i rjes la mchi zhags shig 'phangs na'ang rlangs 'khor de snga sa nas thag ring du bzhud tshar bas kho'i mchil ma char ba'i khrod du mi mngon par gyur/chung dus ba phyugs 'tsho skabs char gos dang nyi gdugs med na'ang snam bu'i phyu ba'am snam bu'i char khebs nges par du 'khyer dgos pa dang /char ba 'bab skabs gad 'og gam pha bong 'og tu gab sa ma rnyed tshe snam gos —119—

4 dribazangathul ba'i sman ljongs/mgo la gyon nas rang sar sdod dgos pas na rna bar thos pa ni ko ba ltar rengs por 'gyur bzhin pa'i snam gos steng char ba 'bab bzhin pa'i khrob khrob kyi sgra dang ba phyugs kyis zil rtswa ngoms par za bzhin pa'i hrob sgra las ci yang thos rgyu med pas gcig pur ljid tig tig gi char khebs 'og gnyid lcog rgyags grabs byed/ glo bur du ri byi'u khyu zhig cir cir zhes skyo skad lhang lhang 'don bzhin phar lding tshur lding bya tshul la bltas na de dag la'ang char g.yol byed sa zhig ma rnyed pa yin gyi red/mi mang po zhig char bas sbangs na cham pa rgyag gi red ces skrag snang byed na'ang kho bo ni de la yid ches kyi med/ char ba 'bab pa ni dbyar kha'i gnam gshis kyi chos nyid yin pa dang char ba ma chad par char g.yol byas nas bsdad tshe char ba ga dus chad min tshod mi thig pas bkag byad dam po med pa'i lcags rta de bzhon nas char dkyil du song bas yud tsam las ma 'gor bar gyon gos rlon rkyang chags nas sha chu 'phrod pa dang mgo nas bzhur ba'i chu og ma'i 'og nas 'bab bzhin 'dug mod/ khyim du slebs skabs char ba da dung 'bab bzhin yod pa dang char thag chod skabs mun pa rub tshar song /—120—

nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/a lo rin chen rgyal po/gcigayod tshad nyi ma dang 'grogs nas bzhud par gyis dang / 'od gsal la 'gros gdangs de mnga' bas rkang sne gcig 'od la reg kyang srid/ skya rengs khrod kyi gom sgra nyi ma dang sbrel dus/ ngas lu gu'i 'ba' skad de btsal cing a sngon gyi sprin phung dang g.yang dkar gyi khyu tshogs rnams re re dbyangs su gyer myong / skabs de la bsam gzhig gi bsil chu spang thang la thor zhing nyi 'od 'og gi gtam rgyud yod tshad 'od chem chem gyi 'jig rten zhig la gtogs kyang srid/ ngas rdzi lcag gi stobs la brten nas spang thang gi rlung 'ur dang klu sgra/ kha ba dang me tog gi dri bsung yod tshad gzi 'od kyi phyogs la ded mod/dmar mdog gi dbang gis yod tshad 'khyag rom bzhin du zhu zhing mar khu bzhin du 'bar bar gyur/ 'bar bar gyur ba'i rtswa thang ya/ zhi bar 'gyur ba'i gangs ri ya/ thog ma nas sbar bar gyis la thog ma nas zhi bar gyis dang khyod la bzhin gsar gyi zhal ras dang ljang mdog gi rmi lam zhig yod nges/ kye/ nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i bdag gi glu sgra/ skad gseng gi ram 'degs mdzod dang / gzi 'od kyang glu ru gyur nas mes po tsho'i mig chu de bsregs par 'gro ya/

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ gnyis/nyi 'od ri rtse nas thon zhing nga rang sbra sgo nas chas/ nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i nga rang dpe khug gis drod khugs pa'i nang nas mtshar sdug gi lam sne bsrings te mdun nas mdun gyi lam ga 'gros la tshad/ rngul chu dang 'dres pa'i dpe klog gi nyin mor/ ngas rang la dri tshig gi thog ma drangs shing dran tshor la tshon mdangs kyi me tog btus myong / nyi 'od sngar ltar 'tsher zhing drod gsum 'khor nas slebs zin/ mdzub mos bris pa'i sa steng gi ka mad sum cus nga la 'dzum brda gtong zhing skyor klog gi 'jig rten chung chung sgo lam gyi mdun na mdzes shing yid du 'ongs/ mgo 'phang mtho ru btegs nas skad gseng che ru sgrogs dang / nga rang la sbar chog pa'i sems khong gi me ri yod de 'bar sla ba'i bar snang gi rang dbang yod/ ngas mig chu lag mthil la blangs nas stobs shugs kyi 'byung khungs ring du btsal/ ka mad sum cu'i bstar phreng khrod du/ shes rab kyi sbrel thag dam du 'khyud nas mdun phyogs kyi dmigs pa gsar du 'tshol bzhin 'od gsal la bstod glu shur shur len/ ngas rang gi kha phyogs la glu sgra rnyed cing rang gi snying chung la 'phar sgra mtho ba thos/ dus de nas ngas rang nyid kyis khur ba'i dpe khug de re ba yod tshad kyi yod tshad yin pa tshor/ nga rang la mtshon na nyi ma ri rtse nas slebs pa'i dpe klog gi rol dbyangs des ci nas kyang chog go /gsum/sbra 'dabs kyi lci ba 'thu bzhin 'bri mo tsho'i g.yang thag 'then thub pa nas/ nga la nyi ma dang 'dra ba'i zil shugs yod kyang srid de/ lo zla gang rung zhig la a mas gnang ba'i gna' gtam yod tshad nar son pa'i be'u —122—

nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/bzhin du rtswa thang gi pang la thor/ ngas me tog snyim pa gang btus nas rang gi lus la mdzes sdug gi bkrags mdangs bsnan yang mes po tsho'i 'dzum zhal gyi nang du nga rang la me tog lta bu'i mtshar sdug bkra/ ngas dbyangs su gyer ba'i rdzi glu la zhim mngar gyi mar dri bro ba'am nga'i mdun gyi spang thang la nyi 'od kyi rlangs sprin 'phyur bas yin/ nga rang nyi 'od kyi dmar zhing tsha ba'i zer khu la thims nas skad cig skad cig la yar nas yar la 'phags shing che nas che ru bgrod/ ngas bgrod stangs yod tshad las bdams gses byas shing 'gro lam yod tshad las bgrod stangs btsal/ nga tshos sbra nag dang lug khyu thag ring nas bskyur zhing nyi 'od kyi stobs las byung ba'i phun tshogs gsar du rnyed/dus de nas ngas rtsam dri dang 'o zho gleng bzhin pha yul la bzhud pa'i sprin dkar la dmar mdog gi mig chu btang myong / nga rang gdod ma nas phyogs med du rgyu ba'i sprin phung zhig lags pas nam zhig la 'tshol snyegs kyi mtha' la slebs shing nam zhig la nyi 'od de rum nas 'gro/ kye/ yar nas yar la 'phags pa'i 'od gsal dang che nas che ru 'gro ba'i gangs ljongs/ bdag gi brang khog gshags par gyis la bdag gi khrag rgyun gtor bar gyis/ drod khol sum 'dzoms kyi dus shig la ngas tshe srog gi mchod pa yod tshad khyed kyi phyir du phul nas khyod dang lhan du 'chi srid/bzhi/gal te nyi 'od la bar chad med na/ gal te nyi 'od la dngangs skrag med na/ bye ba stong phrag gi re smon bar snang nas 'tsher zhing snang ba 'bum ldan gyi 'byor phyug gangs thang la spro nges/ dus de ni 'od kyi 'byung khungs rnyed pa'i 'char ka dang / dus de ni rgyal khams gzi la thims pa'i ngo mtshar —123—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/yin/ nga la mtshon na nyi 'od 'og gi sbra gur dang 'o zho'i bcud kyi mar lo/da dung 'brog thab kyi zur zhig na sgron pa'i mtshan mo'i 'od 'phros pa'i mchod me/ rna lam nas yal bar dka' ba'i a ma'i‘‘sgrol bstod’’kyi glu dbyangs rnams/ nga'i bsam gzhig gi thog ma nas mtha' ma'i bar bsrings shing nga'i yid sems kyi gting shig na rtag brtan gyi rgyud du chags yod/ kye bdag dang 'grogs pa'i klu sgra/ bdag dang 'grogs pa'i nyi 'od/ da dung ga tshod zhig nas rmi lam gsar du bsgrigs shing bar snang 'doms tshad de bzhud dgos ang / nga la bang 'gros kyi stobs shugs dang mdun skyod kyi spobs pa stsol rogs/ nga tshos 'od zer spyi bor btegs nas ma 'ongs pa'i mun pa bcom nas 'gro/ nga tshos nyi rma 'i la rgya bstod bzhin 'jig rten drod kyis gso/ nga tshos ljang mdog gi khrod nas 'od zer gyi bzhud lam bsnyegs nas 'gro/ kye/ glu zhig longs dang / pha yul gyi phyir du dpung ba gshib nas 'od zer glu ru len ya/ lnga/snga phyi gang la bltas kyang 'od zer la nye ring med/ shar nub gang la bzhud kyang nyi 'od la bri gang med/ gtsang bo dang gangs ri/ pho brang dang rdo ring / yod tshad nyi 'od 'og gi lo rgyus gson po ste/ spre'u dang brag srin 'du ba'i rtsed thang gi gtam rgyud nas 'dzam gling sa yi dkyil 'khor la dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'thab rnga de dag rul du ma gyur ba'i khrag dron nang gi pha rgyud kyi deb ther la brkos nas/ nyi 'od kyi mtho rlabs 'phyur ba'i dus tshigs kyi dga' ston la gtan du rol srid/ ngas mi rgyud kyi tho 'god la mig chus bstod bzhin sems khong khrag gis bkrus pa grangs med kyang sha dang rus —124—

nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/pa'i brtse drod las yang nas yang du gsos pa nyi 'od dang 'dra ba'i dmar mdog gi snying chung 'di lags te/ mes po'i sbra gur las bud de rgyang ring gi sa mthar nyul na'ang ngo mtshar dang gsar gtod kyi phyir du lding ba ma rgyud kyi lte khrag bor sa nas rnyed pa'i snying gson po 'di las ci zhig yod/ bdag gi bsam gzhig khri stong la lang tsho yi dpung shed rgyas/ bdag gi bdams gses re re la mngon 'gyur gyi spobs pa mtho/ bdag ni nyi 'od 'og gi ljang gzhon kher rkyang zhig dang nyi 'od kyis bskyed pa'i mtsho dbus kyi me ri gtum po zhig ste/ ngas mtha' yas pa'i spang thang la ljang mdog gi rmi lam bsu ba'am deng rabs kyi ngo mtshar rgya mtsho bzhin 'phel ba'i phun tshogs kyi rlabs brgal re'i khrod na kher rkyang du lus pa'i gangs kyi gling phran nas rngam mthug pa'i nyen 'gag la me dpung gi tha tshig sgrog srid/drugayod tshad nyi 'od dang 'grogs nas bzhud par gyis dang / ngas rang gi 'od zer gyi phyir du 'jig rten glu ru 'bri/ ‘‘jo mo glang mas phyag zung ring du brkyangs nas nyi zla mtho ru btegs shing rma 'bri'i rlabs kyis rgyal khams gas mar gshags te rgya mtsho zhabs kyis mnan yod/ 'jig rten gyi rtse mo na nga tsho stobs kyis 'tsho zhing tshogs pa'i ru dpung bsgrengs yod/’’glu sgra 'di'ang 'tsho ba'i phyir du 'tshos pa'i nor lug dang 'chi ba'i phyir du bton pa'i ma ṇi dang 'dra ste/ yul dus gang rung na dmigs pa gcig gi dar rgyas kyi phyir du spel ba'i snyan ngag yin/

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bdun/'dun ma gsar ba'i 'bod sgrog gcig gis nga tshos sbra gur gyi lo rgyus la mjug byang 'god pa'i dngangs skrag 'dor bzhin khang brtsegs kyi dpal yon la gsar du bstod pa'i mnyam len 'ur 'ur len/ yin na'ang sngar nas rnyed pa'i bgrod stangs des de ring gi tshab byed mi rung la/ gsar du rnyed pa kho na yis ma 'ongs pa'i yod tshad ga nas 'grub/ nga tshos bskyar bzlos kyi ngal rtsol de la 'khang ra cis mi byed/ nga tshos nyi 'od 'og rang nyid la khrus gtsang zhig bya ste/ nyi 'od kyis nga tsho la rang dbang sprad/ nyi 'od 'og zhi bde la drod snang spro/ nyi 'od dang 'grogs pa'i nga tshos rang gi zungs dang khrag la ba tshwa'i brlan dri rgyas pa'i kha sang gi rnyog pa 'di nas 'dor ya/mdor na/ nyi 'od ni tshe srog gi phyir du dmar zhing tsha ba dang / rang dbang gi phyir du bar snang brtol nas 'gro/ ngas nyi ma'i 'byung khungs kyi zer rdul 'thu bzhin rang gi bar snang la skad gseng mtho ru bsgrags pa glu sgra kho na de'i phyir du min la/ gnyid du yur ba'i rtswa thang dang gtsang bo/ pho brang gi gser tog dang sbra gur gyi rmi lam/ da dung kha ba 'bab thang gi lha tshogs dang 'brong g.yag gangs seng dang gangs rin po cher stobs shugs gsar ba'i dpung 'jug thengs shig byas pa yin/ nga tsho nyi 'od dang 'grogs nas mdun nas mdun du skyod cing nyi 'od la brten nas mtshar sdug gsar du 'tshol/ mun nag gi klong las thar ba'i gom 'gros de dmigs pa tshad ldan gyi bgrod lam na skyod cing / rnying zhen dang u tshugs la gzhus pa'i khu tshur yang ka mad sum cu'i gdangs dbyangs kyi khrod na mtho ru bsgrengs/ da lta'i las dbang gi sgo 'phar rdung bzhin 'jig rten gsar ba'i sngon skyod la gom —126—

nyi ma dang 'grogs pa'i glu/stabs chen pos bskyod/ kye/ nga'i mgo steng gi nyi ma/ nga rang gzi 'od kyi phyogs la khrid nas skyid kyi dpung rogs mdzod ya/brgyad/ngas bde drod 'bar ba'i sems kyi dmigs pa re re rtswa thang nas 'thus te 'ur zing mtho ba'i grong khyer gyi gzhung la zhugs/ ngas kha phyir 'khor nas‘‘rkang lam phra mo'i’’snang tshul la zhib tu brtag tshe/ ‘‘rgyal khams rig pas bskor ba’’rang yul gyi phyir dang‘‘snying chung drag tu lding ba’’'tsho thabs kyi phyir te/ nga la mtshon na lo 'gros sum cu'i rang zhal de slar yang rnyed pa'i nga rgyal gsar du mtho/ da ni lang tsho'i rngams kha la brten nas gtan tu 'tshol bsnyegs bya/ bgrod stangs gang zhig dang thob shor ci zhig yin yang nga rang sbra sgo nas thon pas kha phyogs la 'gyur ba med/ rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho nyi ma dang 'grogs nas thon pas nam yang mun nag gi go skabs dben/ da nas 'di ru bsu ba mtshar sdug dang 'od zer yin la/ da nas 'di ru sgrog pa nyi ma dang klu sgra yin/ yod tshad nyi ma dang 'grogs nas bzhud par gyis dang /nga tsho'i dpung shugs la gtan du 'od zer 'phro/ las skal gyi gnyid las bslangs pa'i gangs ljongs ya/ khyod kyi phyir du nga tshos 'od gsal glong /khyod kyi phyir du nyi 'od la snying gtam zhus shing nyi ma la 'bod sgrog bya/ ci nas kyang nga tsho nyi ma dang 'grogs nas thon zhing nyi ma dang lhan du 'gro/ kye/bdag gi glu sgra ye/ mi yul gyi mtho sa nas rang gi dpung tshogs bstod cing rang gi phugs bsam bskrun/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/a lo rin chen rgyal po/ci gcigagana' snga mo zhig nas 'di ni gsang ba 'bum phrag gi 'jig rten khyad du 'phags pas 'di ru ngo mtshar ba'i phun tshogs dang skyi g.ya' ba'i gtam rgyud kyi le tshan bsgrigs yod/ rgyang ring nas bsam na gangs ri ni sems khong gi rten sa dang nye sa nas mjal na gangs ri ni yid sems kyi brtse dung mthon po 'dra/ ngas sems pa dkar po'i rlung rta re re khyod kyi dbu 'phang bstod pa'i bar snang la bskyon zhing kha ba babs 'dra'i mdzes sdug gi gtam rgyud yod tshad zhwa mo phad thengs re'i dab thod la bsdus nas khyod la gus 'dud kyi ngo so yar ni bye dming la bstod/ rgya che ba'i dus tshigs kyi dar rgud sna tshogs 'di ru 'bab pa'i chab rgyun gyi rlabs la brten nas mu med mtha' 'khob kyi g.yang sa brgyud de 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'i bcud du babs pa khyod kyi gtum drag gi tshogs pa la nyi 'od kyi gzi mdangs spras pa'i 'khyag rom gyi mngar kha zhus/ yin yang ngas khyod kyi rgyun gtsang hub gang 'thung ba'i dus de nas a ma'i nu zho la mngar kha ldan pa'ang gsar du rtogs pa'i thog ma'i tshor 'du kho na ste/ lus kyi 'byung rtsa re re la'ang zhim mngar gyi dungs zhen brtan por rgyas shing dmar mdog gis myong ba'i snying khong gi gangs ri'i tshogs pa nam yang gson por 'phyo zhing —128—

gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/yar nas yar la 'phags te yul khams 'di'i la rgya'i bang rim yang khyod kyi dbu 'phang bsnyegs nas nyi zla'i phyogs la stobs kyis bzhud nas 'gro/dus de nas ngas rnyed pa gtam rgyud kyi nyam chag re re/ ngas tshor ba lo rgyus kyi rma kha re re/ da dung grang ngar dang bu yug/ la bcangs pa'i khyed kyi bla srog gi brtse dungs yod tshad/ sham bha la'i smyo ham dang mdzes sdug gi phyogs la ci nas kyang snyeg par brtsams mod/ nga yis brtse dungs rma kha can gyi zug gzer 'di nyid da nas bzod cing dang du len pa'i 'dun pa ye nas dben/gnyis/bde ldan zhing sa 'tshol bzhin dad sgom gyi re smon 'thor myong ba'i yul dus shig na khyod kyi rnam shes gnyid du chas pa'i nyam thag gi sgrub phug kher rkyang la ngo gdong rnying ral can gyi glegs bam gter du sbas shing gsang sgrub kyi bde stong rnyed pa'i nga rgyal ngom yang 'di nas dgung du gshegs pa'i 'od gsal gyi grib brnyan sna tshogs da dung khyod kyi la thod la dkris pa'i sprin tshom gyi lhag ma 'dra ste/ gangs ri'i zhing sa na gtibs pa'i na bun gyi tshogs pas 'brong g.yag gi ngar skad dang zhabs rjes rgyang ring la bskyal mod ban sngags bon gsum 'du ba'i mnga' 'bangs kyi ru dpung gtam rgyud rnying ma'i skyo thang nas slar yang bcom brlag gi g.yul sar chas shing / khrag thigs dang dmar mchod bshams pa'i 'thab jus kyi du dar sna tshogs khyod kyi tshogs pa la mos nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha g.yang mthon por bsgrags te da dung rdul phung khrod kyi deb ther du rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa 'di ru ha cang gsal/ khyod kyi gsang chen 'bum phrag gi bab brling brjid po'i mdun du nga tshos dus rabs du ma'i sdom tshig gi 'grel chen la mya ngan dang bstod glu mnyam du —129—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/brtsams te sbra gur gyi lhing 'jags dang zhing grong gi 'ur zing khrod du rigs rus kyi tshogs pa bskyar du bskyangs shing khyod la mos pa'i ru dar gyi brtse dung dang sha khrag gi gtam rgyud bskyar du 'bri/ mes po tsho'i rgyang skyod kyi spobs pa re re khyed kyi lhad med pa'i mdangs las bzhus te yar klung dang rma 'bri 'bab pa'i tshe srog yod tshad kyi rgyun bzang khyed kyi lte khrag las bzhur ba'i 'o ma'i bcud len nyid de/ mdangs kyis brgyan pa'i yul khams la rigs drug gi 'dab ma bzhad pa'i snying bo'i gsos su smin la mu mjed kyi khams chen la phyi nang bkod pa'i mdzes sdug gi lhun chags bskrun pa'i gdod ma'icem ma lags/shis pa brgya phrag la mi shis pa stong phrag 'du ba'i lkog gyur gyi gsang rgya zhig gis pha mes kyi gsol bstod la 'od snang bkra bar byas shing dungs zhen la pham nyes byung ba'i ngang sgug gi khrod du lha sgrung 'bab pa'i kha ba'i phung bo yun gyis che ru brtsigs shing mda' mdung gri gsum gyi rdzu 'phrul 'gyed pa'i snang srid mtha' dag khyed kyi byin mthu 'bar ba'i rgyal pham gyi klong chen re re nas bzhur te mu tig dang 'dam rdzab/ byu ru dang gser bye/ da dung chu srin dang dngangs skrag 'du ba'i rlabs brgal gyi rgyal khab bskrun pa'i stobs shugs bla med cig gi gshis ka khyad du 'phags/ dus de nas mes po tshos khyed la gter chos kyi tho 'god bris shing khyed la dpang bstod dang skyabs 'jug gi gdangs dbyangs spras te mu med blo gtad dang brjod med rgyal sras kyi mnga' dbang khyed la phul/kye/ rgyal sras kyi tshogs pa ya/ lha sgrung gis phab pa'i thob shor gyi rmog chen ring bar dor dang / ches mdun sa dang ches rgyang ring gi dpung 'jug chen mor khyod kyi stong phrag 'bar ba'i mthu chen gyi gzi byin dang 'od stong dgos ya/—130—

gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/gsum/mi tshogs kyi 'chi gson res mos su 'khor ba'i lo zla mthug po kha ba sra mkhregs can gyi phung bo la 'dres shing nyi zla zlum po'i drod bsil gyi 'khor skyod 'og tu rnam shes dang dad smon la rab tu dkar ba'i kha dog gi spobs pa rgyas te khyed la brten pa'i zhing khams kyi dbugs rgyu yod tshad mu mtha' dben pa'i rtswa thang dang zhing grong gi bar snang nas 'phur te mgrin pa mthon pos 'brong g.yag dang sa sgang dbyangs su gler ba khyed kyis mnga' 'bangs la bstsal ba'i khe dbang zhig lags na/ de kho na nyid kyis kyang rigs rgyud kyi rus rkang la brkos pa'i‘‘oṃ’’dang‘‘hūṃ’’gyi bde tshor shin tu che/ mi sems lha la bcol ba'i byin chen gyi bden pa du ma dus gang zhig nas mes po 'tsho sdod kyi rmang sar babs pa khyod la thob pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung bor grub cing bsam gzhig la blo gros rgyas pa'i lha sgrung gi dbang thang 'bar ba mnga' 'bangs kyis phyir khyed la bstsal ba'i rlabs chen gyi ye shes shig ste/ de'i phyir du khyod kyi rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs shing khyed kyi mthu stobs la tshe dang srog gi mchod pa 'bul ba yul khams 'di'i rgya che'i srol du dar/ mdor na/ khyod ni stobs shugs kyis 'phags pa kho na min zhing rigs rgyud kyi bla srog dang shes rab/dpal yon dar rgud kyi 'byung gzhir grub pas dus nam kun tu'ang khyod kyi phyir du bla srog la khrag rgyun bzhur zhing 'tsho thabs la pham nyes byung yang thob shor sna tshogs kyi chag grum bsgrigs nas 'chi yang khyed la dad pa'i las skal gyi khas len da dung gtan du mtho/ nyi ma ni tsha zhing zla ba ni bsil bsil du rgyu ba'ang rang byung gi snang tshul phal ba zhig min zhing 'od sna tshogs kyi 'gros stabs re la'ang byed nus phun sum tshogs pa'i rang rang gi gzi dpal 'bar —131—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ba dngos te/ gna' nas da lta'i bar gyi shes rig gi sgrub byed bskrun pa'i mi'i blo gros kyi snang ba khyod kyi rtse mo nas stong gsum gyi bang rim la 'phags zhes gna' sgrung gi brjod gzhi ru gyur yod/‘‘nyi ma'i lha’’dang‘‘zla ba'i lha mo'i’’gtam rgyud kyi gru ga re re na ngo mtshar bla na 'phags pa'i 'jig rten gyi byung ba phun sum tshogs shing rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol dang tshur rol gyi lha sgrung mtha' dag 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi ches mtho sa nas dma' sar dar zhing de re re la'ang mi'i rigs kyi byis blo'i ngang tshul mngon pa'i phugs bstan gyi bsam blo'i dmigs pa rab tu mtho la dmigs pa mtha' dag gis 'jig rten gyi lkog gyur dang mngon sum yod tshad dmar rjen du 'don sprod byas yod/ nga tshos khyed la bzhag pa'i brtse dung ci tsam zab na khyed la bskrun pa'i lha sgrung de ltar ring zhing khyed kyi sgrung las mched pa'i tshe srog gi lta ba yod tshad mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pa'i khrag rgyun dang 'dres nas khyed dang nga tsho la yul dus gang zhig tu'ang bar gyang yod re skan/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tsho'i mi tshe dang 'chi gson gyi pir smyug bar snang nas bskyangs te dkar zhing gtsang ba'i khyod kyi ngo gdong la stobs shugs 'bum phrag gi snying gtam ring du bris shing gsar du rnyed pa'i 'tsho thabs kyi bla srog khyed la phul nas dung sems kyi snying khrag dron mos dmar zhing tsha ba'i mchod pa rgya cher 'bul bzhin mig chus brlan pa'i gdung sems kyi phyag gsum khyod la sgur ya/bzhi/kye/ gangs ri lags/ bdag gi snyan ngag gi dungs sems ni khyod la brten cing bdag gi blo gros kyi 'tshol snyeg kyang khyed kyis bstsal ba ste/khyod kyi 'bod pa stong phrag gis bris pa'i tshon mdangs sna tshogs las nga tsho'i —132—

gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/rgyal pham gyi dga' skyo rab tu lci yang dka' ngal la rngul chu 'thor zhing bde skyid la 'bras bu rnyed pa'i thog ma de nas nga tshos gzi brjid khrod shor ba'i pham kha mtha' dag bskyar du bklags shing de las rnyed pa'i shes rab kyi dbu 'phang mtho ru btegs te/ khyod kyi zhing khams hril bo'i las dbang la g.yul 'thab gsar du bshams nas mda' mdung gri gsum gyis rgyang ring du bskyal ba'i rma gzer yod tshad la mjug byang bkod pa'i lha sgrung gsar du sgrig bzhin lam la chas pa'i dpung chen gyi ru dar 'di nas mtho ru bsgrengs/dpung bskyod de'i dbang gis nga tsho'i byang sems kyi bsam gzhig la'ang blang dor gyi zin bris gsar du bkod cing mchong skyod byed thengs re rer pha rgyud kyi dpa' ngar dang ma rgyud kyi shes rab las 'gongs pa'i gsar byung nyen kha dang ngo mtshar nyis 'dzoms su bsus te rang sde'i rgyud kyi nag nog gi bsam blo la dag sel gyi dus ston 'di nas bsgrigs/dus 'di ni ches gal 'gangs che ba'i rlabs chen gyi dus shig yin pas nga tsho skya rengs dang 'grogs nas mun pa dor zhing 'gro la nga tsho nyi 'od dang 'grogs nas 'od zer snyeg cing 'gro/ skya rengs dang nyi 'od kyis gangs ri bstod pa'am nga tshos 'jig rten la go 'byed pa'i 'od snang rnyed pa gang zhig yin rung gsal thag chod pa'i dmigs pa thun mong ba zhig gis nga tsho la 'byor phyug dang rmongs sel/ dag snang dang bde skyid kyi phyag brda btang zhing rtag brtan gyi 'tsho rten 'cha' ba'i pha sa dang ma sa la gsar gtod kyi jus 'god rgya cher 'bri ba khyod kyi bu phrug gi tshogs pa'i spyi gshis su grub cing khyod kyi rigs rgyud kyi dpung shugs gsar ba ru grub 'dugakhyod ni sems rten gyi rtsa ba dang stobs shugs kyi gter chen zhig lags pas/ khyed la dungs pa'i sems rgyud gtsang zhing dag la khyed la 'khor ba'i —133—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/brtse dungs zab cing brlings/ de'ang khyed kyi rang gshis la rdul phung gi dri ma dag cing byams brtse yi rgyun bzang 'bab pa des min la khyed kyi mnga' 'bangs la‘‘gzhan gces’’kyi bla srog dang‘‘bde stong’’gi bsam gzhig 'bar bas te/ rgyal pham gang zhig gi khrod du'ang‘‘las dbang’’gi gu yangs gnam sa'i bar khyab pas phug ron gyi tshogs kyang 'di nasatsho'aphur ba'i bde lam yangs pa ste/ mdor na kha ba dang phug ron gyi tshogs rnams dkar po dkar rkyang gis babs pas khyed la bzhag pa'i dkar phyogs kyi bden pa rab tu mtho la khyed kyis skyong bzhin pa'i nga tshos kyang re don dang dam bca'/ phugs 'dun dang zhi bde glu ru len/ gangs ri ya/ bdag la snyan ngag gi ram 'degs mdzod dang / ngas khyed kyi gu yangs dang skyo sdug rgyal pham dang ngo mtshar khrag gis 'bri bzhin mdun gyi 'tsho thabs la glu tshig gsar du rtsom bzhin mchis/lnga/ri rab 'bum phrag 'gying ba'i tshogs dbus su khyod la shel gyi mu 'khyud brtsegs pa'i rin chen gyi phung bo rnam par mtho ste/ dkar zhing gtsang ba'i mdangs kyi bang rim las gangs can pa'i skyo sdug dang bde skyid mtha' dag gzugs brnyan du 'char zhing dus nam zhig tu'ang khyed la zhum med kyi spobs pa dang 'gyur med kyi rang gshis de mnga' bas nga tsho la'ang khyed kyi stobs shugs kyi 'byung rtsa re re nas thob pa'i dga' ba dang sdug bsngal rab tu mod/khyod kyi dbu 'phang mtho ba bar snang hril bo'i la rgya zhig ste/ 'di lta bu'i rngam brjid kyi bang rim bstar ba las khyod kyi mnga' 'bangs kyi tshogs pa'ang 'jig rten gyi yang rtse nas 'grengs shing sa sgang zhabs mthil du mnan pa'i nga —134—

gangs ri dang nye ba'i rang gtam/rgyal gyi dbang gis ches mtho ba'i 'tsho gnas shig nas ches ring ba'i phugs 'dun zhig gleng bzhin bgrod stangs thun mong min pa zhig la rab btags kyi sgrub byed 'bum phrag brtsams te bskal ba nas smon pa'i‘‘sham+bhala'i’’rgyang skyod la dpung 'jug grangs med byas pa khyed kyis kyang bgrangs bar dka' zhing rgyang skyod de'i dbang gis mnar ba'i skyo sdug gi mig chu khyod las 'bab pa'i yar klung dang rma 'bri/ da dung skyid chu dang dgu chu gang la'ang 'gran du gzod de/ de dag gis bskrun pa'i dpal yon ni de bas kyang phugs bsam gyi gzhi ru grub pas ngu bro ba'i lo rgyus kyi brjod bya'i na gzer re re chal chil du 'bab pa'i klung chen de dag gis kyang bzod par dka'o/ /bde sdug gang zhig la 'phrad kyang khyed la bstod pa'i stobs shugs kyi bla srog ma nyams shing khyed la bcol ba'i gdung sems kyi zhen chags bor ba dka' ste/ khyed kyi phyir du nga tsho bde sdug la dungs shing brtse dung de'i dbang gis khyod ni nyams pa med pa'i ru dpung gi dbu 'phang mthon po dngos te/nga tsho'i mdun skyod kyi ru dar yang khyed la mnga' ba'i gzi brjid kyi dan rtags re re lags/ gangs ri lags/ brtse dung kho na tsam gyis khyod la bstod rin med pa dang nyam chag tsha bo zhig gis khyed la smad rin ga la yod/ rgyu mtshan ni khyed nyid rngam pas 'gying ba nga tsho'i bde skyid kyis yin la khyed nyid zhu nas nyil ba'ang nga tsho'i nyam chag gis yin pas khyed dang nga tsho la srog gi gzhi gcig las yod min te/ tshe srog de la gtogs pa'i rin thang yod tshad dus nam kun tu 'od stong phyogs bcur 'agled pa'i phung bo zhig tu grub pas ngas rang snying gi khrag khu snyim pa gang btegs nas khyed la gtogs pa'i rgyal pham gyi brjod gzhi yod tshad rtsom 'gro/ mdor na/ khyod ni a ma'i brtse dung dang a pha'i byang sems 'dus nas grub pa'i sha khrag gi phung bo'ang yin du —135—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/srid de/ nga tsho la yod pa'i don lnga snod drug gi 'du ba mtha' dag khyod kyi dbang shes kyi zungs su grub pas khyed kyang nga tsho'i phyir du 'jig rten gyi rtse mo na 'gyings shing nga tsho'ang khyed kyi phyir du‘‘rnam shes’’bsrings nas bem lus ci tsam zhig bskyur ba khyed kyis kyang mkhyen dka' lags/gangs ri ya gangs ri/ ngas snyan ngag gi snang ba 'bum phrag la blo gros stong phrag tu bkra bar byas kyang mtha' gcig tu bsdoms na nga'i tshad yod pa'i 'tshol snyeg yod tshad khyed kyi tshad med pa'i bsam gzhig gi gter du thim pas khyed kyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na rtag brtan du 'tsho ba ni nga dang 'dra ba'i ru 'bangs kyi tshogs pa kho na ste/ sdug bsngal gyis khyed la dngangs skrag skyes dben pa dang bde skyid kyis khyed la g.yo 'gul thebs dka'/ bab brling de'i dbang gis ngas khyed la 'chi gson gyi snying gtam zhu bzhin gus 'dud kyi phyag gsum gtan du sgur lags/ / —136—

gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i skyid sdugagangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i byud sdugadakon mchog rdo rje/dus kyi 'khor lo ni skad cig ma'i cha dang 'grogs nas yud tsam gyis bgrang bya'i phreng ba mang dag cig drangs zin/ 'das zin pa'i dus kyi mi tshe'i skyid sdug dang ya mtshan pa'i gtam rgyud mang po zhig da lta brjed zin/'on te/ gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa dang de'i skor gyi bde sdug mang po zhig ngas dus nam yang brjed mi thub pa ma zad/ snying khong rus pa'i steng du je bkra dang je gsal du gyur/da dung zla ba kha shas phar yol tshe/ ma yum slob grwa btsugs nas bgrang bya nyi shu 'khor ba'i dus ston shar rgyu red/ slob grwa de'i thad nas bshad na/bgrang bya nyi shu ni dka' sdug dang rngul chus bskrun pa'i thun min gyi lo nyi shu dang / re ba dang 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i lo nyi shu zhig kyang yin/ bgrang bya dha shu'i sngon gyi de ring la ka kha'i 'bri klog gzhi nas sbyong bzhin pa'i gangs phrug tsho gangs dkar gyi 'dab ma rgyab tu gyon/ gangs 'khyag gi dar yug gdan du bting / gangs chu bsil mas skom pa sel thabs byed bzhin gangs can gyi bcu phrag rig gnas la 'bad 'bungs hur thag byas pas bgrang bya nyi shu'i rjes su gangs phrug de tsho shes rig gi rtsal lag rdzogs nas rgyal khab phyi nang gi slob grwa chen mo'i 'chad stegs thog langs nas bod kyi rig —137—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gnas de yangs pa'i khyon kun tu dar spel gtong ba'i las la brel/ de dang chabs cig gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa de'ang bde sdug gi lam bu mang po zhig brgyud rjes snyan grags kyang 'brug sgra ltar phyogs kyi mtha' gru kun tu khyab par gyur/deng gi bod yig slob grwa'i mtho la brjid pa'i thog brtsegs dang mdzes shing gtsang ba'i khor yug la phyi mig lta dus bgrang bya nyi shu'i sngon gyi gangs 'khyag steng du cog tse dang rkub stegs tsam yang med pa'i sbra gur gyi slob grwa de dran byung / deng gi khod snyom pa'i lus rtsal thang chen du tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i glog bzhu'i 'og gi mnyam spro'i dgong tshogs de mthong dus bgrang bya nyi shu'i sngon du glog sgron tsam yang med par sa snum gyi 'od la brten nas mtshan mo'i chu tshod gsum bzhi tsam la'ang rang sbyong bya bzhin pa'i ngang tshul de yid la 'khor byung / deng gi gtsang la gral 'grig pa'i za khang nang nas dge slob tshos rang rang ci dga'i za ma sna tshogs 'dem nyo byed bzhin pa'i gnas tshul de mthong dus bgrang bya nyi shu'i sngon du slob grwa grol ma thag thad kar rang rang gi gur nang du brgyugs nas lcags thab nang du me sbar rjes mar med pa'i rtsam pa zhig ja nag phor gang gi ram 'degs 'og za bzhin da dung sum cu pa'i rtsa ba blo la 'dzin bzhin pa'i snang tshul de yid la wa ler shar yong /gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa ru thog mar slebs skabs/nga rang sa cha mang por song myong rung thengs dang po pha yul dang kha bral nas gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i nang song ba'i gnas tshul de ni nga'i mi tshe gcig gi ches dmigs bsal dang ches lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa zhig yin pas gtan nas brjed rgyu mi 'dug—138—

gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i skyid sdug1982lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i nyin zhig la nga rang pha yul sde dge'i 'khor lo mdo dang kha bral nas zhang po a nya'i skyel rogs 'og rdzogs chen bod yig slob grwa ru rta kha bsgyur/ de ni nga rang chung a ma'i khog nas skyes nas bzung gces pa'i pha yul dang brtse ba'i pha ma rgyab tu bskyur nas thengs dang por thag ring du 'gro ba zhig yin la mi tshe'i lam bu ru gom stabs thengs dang por spo ba zhig kyang yin/ /rta la zhon nas nyin gnyis song rjes gzhi nas rdzogs chen la bslebs/ngas chung dus nas rdzogs chen zhes pa'i ming de thengs mang thos myong zhing /de ni grong khyer chen po zhig dang yang na lha sgrung nang gi sa cha lta bu ha cang skyid po zhig yin snang 'char myong / 'on te/ de ring nga'i mig mdun gyi rdzogs chen ni mtho gangs ri nas dma' spang thang bar dar dkar po yug gcig gis bkab pa ltar ri lung thams cad dkar sang sang dang stong 'jags se gnas/sngon gyi dgon pa'i gyang ra'i 'gram du gangs dkar dang dbye 'byed dka' ba'i gur chung kha shas las du ba sngo lhog lhog 'phyur ba las gzhan pa'i ya mtshan pa'i ltad mo ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug nga rang sbra gur dang thag cung nye sar bslebs dus glo bur du dgon khyi khyu gcig 'ur zug rgyag bzhin nga bsu bar chas pa ltar brgyugs byung / nga'i rtsar bslebs dus kho tshos nga rang ngo shes pa bzhin skor ba rgyag pa las rmug mi 'dug‘‘a ro/ nang du mi e yod’’ces ras gur chung chung zhig gi sgo nas nang la bos pas ngo gdong sngo la slog pa mthug po gyon pa'i 'brog rgan zhig phyir bud nas nga rang slob ma yin pa shes pa bzhin‘‘o/ khyed slob ma yin nam/ da lta slob ma re 'ga' las 'dzoms med pas slob 'go tshugs pa'i sngon du sdod gnas sogs rang rang so sos btsal dgos pa red’’zer/ ngas —139—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ras gur dang snod chas tsam yang khur med pa dang 'di na ngo shes mkhan yang med pas ci dgos rgyu red snyam nas sems la brel 'tshub chen po zhig shar byung /‘‘'u 'u’’zhes dgon khyi rnams yang phar phyogs su 'ur zug byed bzhin brgyugs song / ngas khyi rgyug sa'i phyogs su lta skabs phar phyogs nas skya mi gnyis slebs yong ba mthong / phal cher slob ma yin pa 'dra 'dug o/khong gnyis ni sde dge'i dpal spungs kyi kun dga' 'jam dbyangs dang khong gi phu bo red/ stabs legs pa zhig la kho tshos gur dang snod chas phran bu khur 'dug nga tsho'ang pha yul gcig pa yin pas de nub mnyam du gur chung de'i nang du bsdad/phyi nyin nga tsho skyel mkhan gnyis phyir log song / kha ba mu mthud 'bab bzhin 'dug ngas snod chas khur nas chu len sar song bas kha sang gi chu lam de kha bas mnan nas gsal por mthong dka'/ ma tshad mdang dgong yang grang lhags che rkyen chu'i dar khung rub nas chu mthong mi thub/ skabs der ngas nga tsho skyel mkhan gyi skya mi gnyis kyi rjes su bltas nas dro zhing skyid pa'i khyim dang byams shing brtse ba'i pha ma dran bzhin rang dbang med par mig zung mchi mas bskor byung / nga rang bya zhig tu sprul nas khu sim pa'i ri lung 'di nas pha yul du 'phur thub rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig kyang skyes byung /nyin shas kyi rjes su slob ma phal cher 'dzoms pas slob grwas nga tsho mi lnga re la ras gur re dang lcags thab re/ da dung snod chas dang rtswa stan sogs g.yar byung ba dang yun mi ring bar slob 'go'ang tshugs so/ /—140—

gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i skyid sdugakhri rkun gyis nga tsho'i mar brkus song /de ring / gnam gshis ha cang grang bas nga tsho snga mo nas slob grwa grol song / ‘‘sus ras gur sgo brgyab pa red/ sgo rgyag stangs thabs chag pa la/nga'i mar khyi rkun tshos brkus song 'dug’’ces nga tsho slob grwa grol nas phyir khyim du log dus slob grogs kun dga' 'jam dbyangs kyis bshad kyin 'dug‘‘ras gur chad po 'di'i sgo ci 'dra yag po brgyab rung khyi rkun de tsho 'gog mi thub pa 'dra’’zhes slob grogs lhag dgas 'grel bshad byed bzhin 'duga'abri shi ba'i steng du mar rkyal brgya dang med thog med bzhag ces pa ltar nga tsho spyir btang 'tsho ba'i thad dka' ngal che thog khyi rkun tshos kyang rgyun du brkus nas nga tsho zla shas ring mar za rgyu med par gyur/ thengs shig slob grogs kun dga' lags kyi phu bo dang thub bstan gyi pha rgan gnyis ched du rdzogs chen la yong nas sha mar dang / thud gro sogs zas rigs phun sum tshogs pa khur byung / nga tsho tshang mas zas rigs de dag za ma bra bar yun ring bsri tshags byas/ nyin zhig slob grwa grol nas khyim du log dus zas rigs tshang ma khyi rkun tsho'i kha zas su gyur zin pa mthong dus nga tsho tshang ma khyi rkun de tsho la zhe sdang chen po langs pa dang / zas rigs de dag sngon nas ci la zos ma bzhag ces 'gyod sems chen po skyes/yang thengs shig la/ thub bstan phun tshogs kyis‘‘de ring khyi rkun tsho rku la ci 'dra mkhas rung nga'i mar rku rgyu mi lon sha stag yin/ khyed tshos mar nyar tshags yag po ma byas na khyi'i kha zas su 'gyur rgyu red’’zer bzhin kho rang gi mar de sgam chung zhig gi nang du bcug nas sngas 'og tu sbas/ slob grwa 'tshogs bzhin pa'i sgang la mi zhig gis khyi rkun gyis mar rkus song zhes 'bod —141—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/pa thos nga tsho slob grwa grol ma thag ras gur nang yong nas rang rang gi mar bor yod med lta skabs/ thub bstan gyis‘‘shi dgos pa'i khyi rkun de tshos nga la brnyas bcos tshad med byas pa ma yin nam/ yang tag tag nga'i mar brkus song’’zhes khyi la gshe gshe gtong skabs ras gur nang du tshang ma'i dgod sgras khyab song /dge rgan gyi sprun chab/nga tsho'i ras gur nang gi slob grogs rnams dus tshod lnga pa'i thog yar langs nas sa snum gyi sgron me 'og tu yi ge cung bltas rjes/ shar phyogs nas skya rengs shar byung bas rang rang gis bdams pa'i chu'i pha rol gyi pha bong chen po de dag gi rgyab tu dpe cha blta ru song /dus tshod ci tsam 'gor yod pa mi shes mod kha ba che ru babs byung bas/nga tsho tshang mas phan tshun phyir gur nang du 'gro rgyu'i brda btang nas ras gur gyi sgor slebs dus dge rgan blo chos de gar 'greng 'dug khong gi dbu skra dkar po'i steng kha ba'i 'dab ma lhung 'dug pas je dkar du gyur pa dang phyag zung gis kha rlangs kyi drod la brten nas 'phur 'phur byed bzhin pa dang zhabs zung yang gnas gcig tu rgyun mi chad par 'gul bzhin 'dug khong gi sku lus 'og tu kha ba chags med par bltas na khong 'dir yun ring bzhengs yod pa shes thub/ khong gis nga tsho tshur slebs pa mthong dus cung thugs khros pa'i ngang nas‘‘khyed tsho la rang gi lus po mi mkho ba yin nam/ nyin ltar 'di 'dra'i nangs snga langs dang nub 'phyi nyal kho nas slob sbyong la 'bad na gzugs pos nus sam/ de ring kha ba de 'dra chen po babs shing grang ngar —142—

gangs khrod kyi sbra gur slob grwa'i skyid sduga'adi 'dra che rung ras gur du mi sdod par gang du song / phru gu glen pa tsho’’zhes gsung bzhin nga tsho mi re rer mgo nas mjug bar zhib mor gzigs rjes spyan zung las mchi ma thon byung / nga tsho tshang mar sems 'gul chen po thebs nas gangs las grub pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin 'gul tsam byed rgyu med par khong la cer nas lus song /mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug/ bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /ces pa ltar nga tsho rkyang pa min par slob grwa'i slob grogs tshang mas slob sbyong la 'bad pa byed bzhin yod/ dge rgan tshos slob ma'i sbyangs 'bras la thugs khur de 'dra byed mi dgos kyang slob ma'i gzugs po la tshang mas thugs khur chen po gnang dgos kyin yod/bsam yul 'das pa'i las bgos/zla ba bdun pa'i mtho sgang ni lha yul las mdzes shing rtsi shing me tog gi bkrag mdangs rnam par rgyas shing / dkar 'o zho'i rgya mtsho 'phyur la/las rlung rta yar zla ltar dar ba'i rdzogs ldan gyi dus ston zhig yin pas tshang mas dus ston der re zhing dus ston der yid smon 'chor/bkra shis pa'i dus ston de'i nang shes rig gi gshog rtsal rgyas pa'i rgod phrug khyu gcig yangs pa'i rtswa thang 'di nas mtha' mi mngon pa'i mkha' dbyings su 'phur nas rang rang gi dpa' rtsal dang spyang grung ngoms rgyu red/1986lo'i zla ba7pa'i nyin zhig la slob ma rnams slob grwa'i ra ba'i nang 'dzoms nas phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis gcig gis gcig la lta tsam byed bzhin yang mgo bo thur du gug nas rang rang gi las skal der sgug nas 'dug—143—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/dge rgan rdo lo lags kyis slob ma'i ming dang las khungs mang po'i ming bkod pa'i 'bri deb cig lag tu bzung nas‘‘thub bstan phun tshogs/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa ru bgo rgyu/ bsod rgyal pe cin mi rigs rig gnas pho brang du bgo rgyu/ pad+ma tshe ring dang bkra shis gnyis si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang du bgo rgyu’’zhes sogs klog bzhin 'dug ngas da nga rang gang zhig tu bgo'am/ phal cher rang gi re ba ltar pha yul du bgo rgyu red snyam bzhin pa'i skabs su‘‘dkon mchog rdo rje dkar mdzes gsar 'gyur khang du bgo rgyu’’zhes thos 'phral sems dga' skyo gang yin mi shes la ci dran 'di dran yang med pa ltar gyur song /las bgos kyi ming tho bklags zin dus tshang ma'i gdong la ngu ma dgod kyi rnam 'gyur re mngon par bltas na phal cher rang rang gi 'dod blo ma 'grub cing da lta'i las bgos ni nga nang bzhin bsam yul las 'das pa zhig yin pa shes thub/ spyir bod yig slob grwa'i thengs dang po'i slob ma mthar phyin grabs la nye skabs slob grwa'i gzhung las khang du pe cin dang khrin tu'u/ rang skyong khul dang rdzong bcas kyi las khungs mang po'i yi ge 'byor zhing yi ge'i nang don ni don gcig kho na ste/ ‘‘nga tsho'i las khungs la khyed slob grwa'i slob ma kha shas bgo rogs’’zer mkhan sha stag gi grangs ka de slob mi'i grangs ka las ha lam ldab gcig mang ba red/ 'on te/ slob ma tsho'i re ba dang po dang gnyis pa/ gsum pa tshang ma rang gi pha yul du bgo rogs zer mkhan las pe cin dang khrin tu'u sogs su 'gro 'dod mkhan ha lam med pa red/ nga rang yang dge rgan dang mgo khrid tshos thengs mang pe cin dang yang na khrin tu'u sogs su 'gro dgos pa'i slob gso btang rung ngas pha ma dang khyim tshang gi re ba ltar pha yul du mngags rogs kho na bshad pa dang slob thon byung skabs slob —144—

gangs khrod kyi spra gur slob grwa'i skyid sdugam rnams rgya nang gi sa gnas kha shas su lta skor la khrid skabs kyang nga rang rgya yul du bgo rgyur dogs nas rgya yul du tsha ba na rgyu red ces kha g.yar nas lta skor du yang ma song / rjes su dge rgan dang mgo khrid pas slob ma'i sbyangs 'bras dang 'jon thang la dmigs nas btsan thabs kyis las bgos mi byed thabs med gyur/ bgrang bya nyi shu'i rjes su gnas tshul de dag dran dus skabs 'gar ngu shor ba dang skabs 'gar dgod bro ba lta bur gyur 'dug /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'gyod snang med pa'i dgun ljongs shigapad+ma rig 'dzin/thog ma'i bzhur rgyan/ dgun ljongs 'dir lo gnyis can gyi byis pa zhig gi bgrod stangs dang 'dzum tshul las mi lo nyer bzhi yar sngon gyi rang nyid rnyed cing rmi lam lta bu'i lo zla der yid smon shor/nga rang rmi lam lta bu'i lo zla der ha cang mos/ lo zla de'i brang gzhung nas rang gi 'dod blo tshang ma gtsang bo bzhin bzhur chog la/ rang la mkho ba yod tshad nu zho ltar bslang chog da dung pha 'dzoms ma 'dzoms kyi khyim gzhis dron mo de'i yon tan mngon bzhin glu a la ngag nas chu bo bzhin bzhur zhing rta 'do ba'i bang rtsal bsil rlung la 'gran/a a/ rmi lam lta bu'i lo zla de nam yang 'bor dka' zhing rtag tu nga'i dran gdung gi ljon pa'i steng nas lhung rgyu med pa'i mthing mdog gi lo ma de yin na ci ma rung /bab chags pa'i bsam gzhigari mang po zhig gi zhal ras btsal zhing chu mod po zhig gi dro ba myangs nas mi lo nyer bzhi'i dgun ljongs 'dir thon byung / 'di'i yar sngon du brtson pas nyin mtshan gyi go rim brjes myong la/ le los pha rgan gyi gnam sa —146—

'gyod snang med pa'i dgun ljongs shigakha sbubs pa lta bu'i 'gram lcag de'i zab tshad kyang myangs myong / nam rgyun phugs ring ba'i mi tshe'i lam sne rdog pas gnon dus mdun du yod pa ni dpung mtho ba'i ri rab cig gi mtho tshad yin pa'ang gsal bor shes/bden lags/ 'di'i yar sngon du ngas rang nyid ngo ma de btsal ma myong yang phugs bsam rlabs chen zhig gi ched du 'grul bzhud yang dag cig gi 'go gzhi nas brtsams zin/ da dung mi tshe'i las bya re re'i mjug tu yid tshim pa'i sdom tshig re re 'god ma thub pa la'ang dus rgyun du bsam gzhig gi me lce drag tu sbar bzhin yod lags/zhe mthun pa'i 'gro 'ong /ma gzhi mi tshe ni 'grul bzhud dang 'grul bzhud las 'go brtsams shing grogs mang po zhig gi brtse sems kyi 'o ma dang snying gtam gyi bdud rtsi'ang 'grul bzhud kyi tshigs mal re nas 'thung ba gor ma chag de bas zhe mthun pa'i 'gro 'ong las me tog gi 'dzum mdangs bzhad cing dga' spro yi khu byug 'phur ba'i tshogs pa re grub pa ma yin nam/da dung dgun ljongs 'dir ngas grogs mang po zhig gdan drangs la nga yang grogs po re re'i khyim nyul nas zhe mthun pa'i smra ba rlung rta bzhin spur/skabs der ngas 'jig rten mi yul gyi brtse ba tshor ba ma zad/ zhe mthun pa'i 'gro 'ong re la bkra shis pa'i smon tshig gang mang bskyon/'od 'cher ba'i phyir dran/grogs po lags/ da lta nga dus rabs nyi shu pa'i ches mtha' mjug gi dgun ljongs dang / ches mtha' mjug gi nyin mo/ ches mtha' mjug gi —147—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/dus tshod nyer gsum dang skar ma sum cu'i sa srod na yod/skabs 'dir ngas rlabs che ba'i dus rabs shig 'di ltar mjug rdzogs par rjes dran zhig byed 'dod nas re zhig la rang nyid gcig pu khang mig tu 'dzul/ ngo ma rlabs che ba'i dus rabs 'di'i khong gseng du bod mi mang po zhig gis zhabs rjes bzhag yod la/ dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs ga ge mo'i nang du spun zla mang po zhig sa mthar 'khyams song /yin na yang / dus rabs 'di'i nang bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog tu ming du grags pa'i ljongs rgyu pa zhig byung la/ kho'i ming la dge 'dun chos 'phel zer/ khos nga tshor bzhag pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rig gnas yin la/khos nga tshor sbyin pa 'od stong 'bar ba'i mdun lam lags/da dung don grub rgyal zer ba'i rgod po zhig byung nas bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'phel mtshams gnas mal gsar ba zhig tu gtad byung bas/ tshang mas kho gleng bzhin yod la/ tshang mas khor dpal don grub rgyal zhes pa'i ming gi do shal phul bar byas/ngo ma dus rabs 'di rlabs che ba'i dus rabs shigadus rabs 'di snying du sdug pa'i nor bu zhig ang /'o/ khyod tshos brjed mi dpe/ zla ba'i steng na chu yod par smra ba'i tshan rig pa de'ang bod mi zhig red/ gzhan sgyu rtsal pa blo bzang yang mkha' dbyings su skar ma bzhin rtsen rjes rgyang ring la skar mda' bzhin bzhud song /da dung nga tsho'i sems khong gi zla ba dus rabs 'di'i mkha' dbyings nas gangs can kha ba ri ba'i bgo skal du byon zhing de nas yar bskyar rlabs che ba'i dus rabs nyi shu/ khyed kyis nga tshor mang bo zhig sprad kyang sprad la/ byings nas nga tshor 'thob 'os /pa mang po zhig kyang khyer song /—148—

'gyod snang med pa'i dgun ljongs shig1904lor/ rgyal rtse'i mkha' dbyings kyi sprin dkar me skyogs kyis gtor dus/ bod mi tshos zhe sdang gis 'ur mthil bzhag pa'i 'dod blo re re dgun ljongs 'di'i skar 'od bzhin 'tsher na ci ma rung /dgun ljongs 'di'i yon tan/dgun ljongs 'di dus rabs nyi shu pa'i ches mtha' mjug gi mdzes ljongs yin pas nga glu pa zhig yin pa'i tshul gyis 'gram pa yang yang bskyor te ri tshogs kyi rna bar 'o brgyal gang mang bzos/ngas snang ngor dgun ljongs 'di'i rtswa rtsi shing dang la lung ba/ tha na kha ba'i zegs ma re re la'ang ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud re mchis pas nga tshos nam yang phyir dran byed 'os pa zhig yin par ma zad/ byings nas 'dra par len rgyur mi dga' ba'i ngas kyang skyes stobs kyi lang tsho rgod pa'i rtsi shing gi tshogs dang mnyam du tshon mdog gi 'dra par zhig bskyon/cis kyang 'thob 'os pa'i 'bras mngar/dgun ljongs 'di'i rjes nas skyes stobs kyi lang tsho 'bar ba'i dpyid ka bsleb srid pas/ de dus‘‘bod mi res zhing re rmo’’dgos la/ nga tshos‘‘skra gseb kyi 'jig rten’’gyis gsang ba'ang cis kyang rtogs dgos/ da dung dpyid rlung de'i rjes su ston ka bsleb tshe ngas bod mi re la mdzod re yod pa'i smon 'dun zhu zhu/ngo ma dgun ljongs 'di/ 'khyod snang med pa'i dgun ljongs shig red ang / ngas dgun ljongs 'dir bsam tshul mang po zhig gi gshog zung rnyed cing grogs po gang mang zhig gi yid sems kyi 'jig rten mthong ste/ 'dzum —149—

mdangs kyi me tog ngo ma de rnyed/ gzhan bab chags pa'i bsam gzhig cig la brten nas bgrod dka' ba'i lam phran zhig gi bar snang yang ngang gis mthong rkyen/ ngas nam yang dgun ljongs 'dir rang nyid ji bzhin phyir dran byed nges lags/ /

gces phrug ma/gces phrug ma/khyung bzang /gces phrug ma/ a ma dang mnyam du rgyang thag ring ba'i zhing grong na yod/ da lta ston mjug yin pas/ sil tog re za bzhin a pha gleng gin yod srid la/ ri mo bkra ba'i mig zung chung chung des a pha phyir log pa'i lam sne srung yod nges/gces phrug ma/ dbyar kha re re bzhin grogs po tsho dang mnyam du sde 'dabs kyi rka chu'i 'gram nas rtse zhing / ston mjug ha cang yangs pa'i g.yul kha nas shog bu'i rlung 'khor bskor te 'thung dgos pa'i gung ja yang brjed 'gro/ phyi dror ngo gdong skya ther re log dus/ pho ba ltogs drags pa'i lu gu bzhin a mar go re slong zhing / rang 'gul gyis chu 'khyag phor gang blugs te rngam 'thung byed/gces phrug ma/ zhing grong gi byis pa gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar slob lo ran dus/ rmo mos bzos pa'i dpe khug chung chung de khur slob grwar 'gro dgos zhes thol gyis langs nas lwa ba gyon/ gal te/ su zhig gis dus der bkag 'gog byas tshe de mur skad ngan byung nas ngu srid/gces phrug ma/ de ltar brel 'tshub kyis nangs ja rten 'brel tsam 'thung rjes dpe khug khur nas rgyug 'gro la/ phyi dror khyim la log dus/ sa —151—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rdul gyis g.yogs pa'i ngo gdong 'dzum gyis g.yogs te/ ka gcig pu shes pa'i nga rgyal gyis‘‘a pha ngas yi ge shes’’zhes yang yang sgrogagaces phrug ma/ dgun kha thon rjes/ mal khang dron po nas sngur ba chung chung re 'then bzhin gnyid la rol/ de dus/ bslangs kyang myur mor mi sad la/ sgul sgul nas sad rjes kyang nga rang slob grwar mi 'gro zhes kha g.yas phyogs su gcus 'gro/ a mas byed thabs kyi mdzub mo yang yang sgreng na da gzod 'thad la mi 'thad kyis langs yong mod/yang bskyar ngas kha lag mi bkru zhes gces g.yer yang yang slong / spo bos skad log re byas tshe drang lam la bud pa'i bong bu bzhin a ma'i ci gsungs dang len byed/gces phrug ma/ da lta yang mtshan mo re re bzhin a ma'i gna' gtam la nyan gyin yod srid la/ sngon chad dang 'dra bar‘‘de la ci zhig byung ba red dam yang na mi de da lta gang na yod’’sogs gna' gtam dang 'brel ba'i 'dri tshig glo bur ba re yang mda' mo bzhin 'phen gyin yod nges/ da dung dge rgan gyis bslabs pa'i〈'jig rten steng du a ma kho na bzang〉zhes pa'i glu dbyangs de yang cha le chol le re len gyin yod srid/gces phrug ma/ a ma dang mnyam du rgyang thag ring ba'i zhing grong na yod/ snying rje ba'i ral ba thung thung / ser tig gi snye rlabs dang lhan du ldem gyin yod nges la/ nag krig krig gi mig 'bras/ skar tshogs dang lhan du 'dzum gyin yod srid/ grong khyer gyi mi tshogs kyi 'tshang kha'i khrod/rlangs 'khor gyi 'ur sgra'i khrod/ ngas mo rang ha cang dran/ nam rgyun dgod kha slong mkhas kyi nga'i gces phrug ma/ / —152—
