bum chung gi rma kha/bum chung gi rma kha/lha byams rgyal/bum chung ni de'u las cung zad che ba'i ri phran zhig gi ming yin/ bod yul gyi ri grong chung chung zhig gi rgyab rir bzhugs yod cing / grong tsho de ni tag tag nga'i lte khrag 'pho sa'i pha yul yin/ thag ring nas bltas na bum chung ni dngos gnas bum pa chung chung zhig dang shin tu mtshungs/ ri de'i 'dabs ni khod yangs shing ri sked 'bur du thon yod la ri mgul nang du skum yod pa'i rtse mor ljon shing gi yal 'dab dang dar tshon sna tshogs kyis bstad yod pa'i la btsas phon po zhig kyang yod/de ni bum pa'i kha rgyan du me tog btsugs pa dang mtshungs/ bum chung ri phran ni spang ri zhig yin/ dpyid kyi bu mo'i gom sgra nye bar lhags thengs rer/khos 'bol zhing 'jam la ljang zhing nim pa'i spang gos mnabs srid cing /de dus yul mi tshos lug khyu ri la bkram pa'i tshe gos rgyan ljang gu'i thog tu dkar nag gi ri mo phab pa ji bzhin lta na sdug nga'i bsam pa'i brtse zhen gyi yol ngor bum chung ni gangs ri ltar 'khyag shur shur zhig dang g.ya' ri ltar gcer grang grang / nags ri ltar zing long long zhig ma yin par/ zhi zhing dul la bag phebs shing brtse zhen gyis khengs pa'i mdzes ma zhig dang mtshungs/mdzes ma des mi rabs nas mi rabs bar nga tsho'i grong tsho chung chung de pang du —153—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rum nas gces skyong byas pas/ grong mi rnams kyis kyang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi grangs su bgrang ba'i bum par rtsis mthong byed pa bzhin ri phran 'dir bstod cing bkur ba red/yin na yang / 'di lta bu'i spang ri yid du 'ong pa zhig la'ang lo rgyus skyom 'gul gyi rba rlabs khrod du mi rnams kyis gdug tsub sbar bgrad byas te rma kha zab mo bzos myong / rgyang nas bltas na/ bum chung gi lto ba dang 'dabs gsham du gru bzhi bre dang 'dra ba'i rjes shul gang mang phab 'dug pa de dag ni snum bcud shor ba'i ngo mdangs sam skya gor babs pa'i bzhin ras ltar bltas ma thag mig la gsal ba zhig red/ grong tsho'i nang gi bgres song tshos lab pa ltar na/ de ni‘‘mchong skyod chen po'i’’las 'gul khrod bzhag pa zhig red zer/ de dus‘‘mi la snying stobs ga 'dra yod na/ sa la thon skyed de 'dra yod’’zer ba'i 'ur sgra gang sar sgrog cing / mthon po ri yi spang bkog nas lo tog btab/ dma' mo thang gi nags bcad nas lo tog btab/ gang sar lo tog btab pa'i mjug tu lo dang por khe bzang nyung tsam reg nas spro ba skyes kyang lo gnyis pa nas bzung 'bru rdog thar thor srin mo'i mig chu tsam las bsdu rgyu ma byung pas/ yul mi rnams yid chad de‘‘sa zhing’’de dag sa rgod du mi bskyur ka med byung / da lta bltas na rang byung khams kyi chos nyid dang mi bstun par rang snang gang shar byed pa'i mi de rnams kyis skabs der ji ltar bsam pa yin nam ljang mdog spang gi gyon gos gcer bur bshus pa'i‘‘bum chung’’de snying re rje/ ri phran der mtshon na shul rjes de dag ni sos thabs dka' ba'i rma kha zab mo zhig ma yin nam/'das zin pa ni chu rgyun las snang ba'i wu ba dang gnyis su ma mchis par snga mo nas yal tshar/ 'on kyang yid skyo ba ni bum chung la nye char yul mi tshos —154—

bum chung gi rma kha/yang bskyar rma kha zab cing rgya che ba zhig bzos 'dug dgun gnang skabs su nga rang pha yul du log dus/ tag tag 'bab zhod che ba'i kha ba thengs shig gis yod tshad mnan 'dug mgo bo dgyes te bum chung la lta dus/a kha/ bum chung thog kha ba chags pa'i gzhi ru dra mig mang ba'i ri mo zhig bkod 'dug cing / de ni bum chung gis dar gos dkar po dra mig ma zhig gyon pa dang mtshungs/ ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar grong mi zhig la dris par skyo gdung dang bcas‘‘bum chung thog tu nags bskrun dgos pa'i bka' babs pas/ da lta khyod kyis mthong ba ni brkos yod pa'i sdong 'obs red’’zer/nga'i yid du dar cig la phangs sems kyis khengs shing zug rngu drag po zhig skyes song / ‘‘spang ri ni nam yang spang ri red/ spang ri nags rir bsgyur dgos don ci red ’’ngas 'di ltar bshad dus/ grong mi des dngan pa ring po zhig 'then nas‘‘de gong rim gyi bka' yin pas ’’zhes mgo bo g.yug bzhin bud song /los yin/ gong rim gyi bka' yin pas nga tshor bya thabs ci zhig yod/gsar skrun nam gsar spel zhes pa'i bya 'gul la smon 'dun yag po zhig yod srid kyang / ri phran bum chung gi sa bab khor yug la brtags na spang ri nags ri la bsgyur thub min ni dogs pa'i gnas shig ste/ gal srid de ltar ma gyur na/ bum chung gi rma kha je mang je zab tu song ba tsam zhig tu ma zad par/ nga tshos phyi rabs pa rnams la ngo gnong dgos pa'i glen rtags shig bzos 'gro ba'i som nyi yod/ gang ltar kyang bum chung gi rma kha de nga'i sems la thebs pa ji bzhin ring du yal ma thub/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di/do smyon tshe ring bkra shis/ mi yul la char thigs tsam gyi slad du/ sprin pa tshos sngar nas mtha' med pa'i bar snang bdams zin la/ ri bo grangs med kyi pha rol nas rlung bu'i sems gshin gyi gleng mol shab shub/ pha yi zol med dang ma yi byams sems bzhin mya ngam gyi sems steng du babs byung /rno ngar gyi yig 'bru re re mun khrod du zug dus/ srang lam du gad snyigs 'thu ba'i sprang po tsho'i gzugs brnyan/ je mtho nas je mthor 'phags te bdag gi rnam shes mnan 'ongs/ skabs der/ dpe cha za mkhan dang yig 'bru 'gam mkhan tsho srang lam du chang dri 'thul ba'i ku co 'don mkhan yin/ mun pa lhung lhung bzhur bas rang gi dbugs rgyun yang mthong thabs bral/lug sha tshon po bzhes bzhin skad cha tshon po bshad la/ chung ma tshon po rum bzhin rmi lam tshon por rol ba'i mi de tsho/ ‘‘mdza' mo’’nang bzhin nga tsho'i sems gting du 'jab 'ongs pas/ dus kyi brang gzhung nas zol gyis bslangs pa'i dar lcog gi glu sgra lhang lhang mched/bdag gi 'dzum chung ldang ba'i tshe srog la/ nags tshal gyi grib mas brlan byung / gzhon nu ma'i zo khar 'phyo ba'i nyi 'od kyi mgrin glu snyan mo/rgyang bzhud kyi gom chung la 'khrul nas chas song / nga tshos nyi gzhon gleng —156—

nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di/drags pas mchu sgros la'ang ji 'dra'i tsha drod 'bar ang /byis pa tsho skom gdung gis bzi bas/ mig mdangs kyang rnyid par gyur/ar 'dam dbu 'phang dgung du btegs pas sbra nag gi na tshod rim gyis rgas shing / na chung ma dang 'o zo/ dbyangs gsal gyi grib 'og tu 'dus te jus gzhi gsar pa 'then dgos byung / da dung 'phrul 'khor dang glog klad/ su zhig gi bslu brid bzhin nga tsho'i phugs bsam gyi mnga' thang 'phrog song /ston rlung gis bdas pa'i lo 'dab re re'i mig kong du yibs pa'i me ltar dmar pa'i blo mos/ dus mtha'i brag ldebs su brkos pa'i snying nye ba'i yig 'bru'i rgyal khams su 'phyo la/ pham kha zhig cis kyang bsu nges na/ nga tshos kyang pha gzhis la dag sgrig cig bya 'os/'di ltar/ nga tshos‘‘ya nga ba'i bsam gzhig’’mang po g.yor dar bzhin mi bsgrengs ga med du gyur/dar lcog ni nam yang mtho sar btsugs pas/ nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di byis pa bzhin 'tshar longs 'byung 'os/'byor phyug la khen drags pas nga tsho yang bskyar dbul phongs su gyur/nga tshos kyang char rlung khrod kyi sbra nag la ar 'dam gyi ka ba dang rno skud kyi chon thag bskrun cing / rgya mtsho chen po'i phang bar 'phrul zam 'phangs te 'o zo las‘‘ti si kho'i’’dbyangs snyan mched du 'jug 'os/ da dung / gangs ri la gshag bcos kyis ngo mtshar gyi bden pa 'byed 'os/ nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di/ 'di ltar 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin yod la/ yod tshad skyes stobs kyis 'bar nges/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/chu len bu mo/mda' btsan po/chu ngogs nas me tog ser chen 'thu ba'i lug rdzi bu mo de khyed yin/khyed ni nga'i yid du 'ong ba'i brtse dung gi me ri'am ri skyes me tog de yin/sems pa bzhin dmar ba'i sdong lo rgyang la 'phur dus/ mig chu brtse dung bzhin babs pa kha ba'i me tog dkar po/ bdag gi 'bri deb kyi bar gseng la brlan gyis sim byung / chu len bu mo/ gtsang bo'i pha rol na ngu ba khyed rang yin la/ ri bo'i tshur rol na skyo ba nga rang yin/ nga'i rmi lam na dka' tshegs kyis rgya ba'i chu len bu mo/gyes bral gyi nyin mo de nas bzung / bdag gi lus sems rdo dang chu yin/ chu la sems pa zhig med na rdo la drod khol zhig ci la yod/ bdag gi re sgug rdo dang chu yin/ chu la 'dzad rgyu zhig med na rdo la zad rgyu zhig ci la yod/rgyang ring / ngang sgug ltar ring ba'i rgyang ring gi re bzhag ma/gnas yul na khyed la rang dbang gis bsgrigs pa'i bza' zla med/ khrims dang mthun pa'i gnyen yig med/ rgyang ring gi nga'i re bzhag ma/ mdza' brtse drod kyis khyab pa'i nga'i khang mig la shog brtse 'dang phyi thag ring ba'i nga'i khang mig la shog khang mig chung chung gis khyed la drod khol dang 'od —158—

snang stsol nges/nam zhig la/ khyed kyi skad ngag bdag gi khang mig nas dgod srid/nam zhig la khyed kyi bzhin bzang bdag gi khang mig nas 'dzum thub/ de dus khang mig chung chung bde skyid dang spro snang gis khyab nges/ bsil char/nyi zer/ mtshams sprin sogs bdag gi sngas na bkal ba'i snyan tshig de yin nam/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bag chags kyis dgrol ba'i rol dbyangs/rmog ru shes rab rdo rje/nam yang brjed par dka' ba ni nam yang rtogs thabs bral ba'i khyod kyi 'dzum mdangs red/nga'i sems khong na mdzes sdug gi rang byung khams chen mo dang sgyu rtsal gyis bskrun pa'i 'phrul ljongs kyi mu khyud yod la/ snyan ngag dang snyan ngag bkram pa'i bkrag mdangs yod/ de las gzhan/ da dung snying nye ba'i shes rab sgrol ma'am kho mo'i 'dzum mdangs dang snying gtam/ khyad 'phags kyi gshis ka dang ma 'ongs pa yod/ lus rten gyi lcags mkhar dmar po'i nang rol gyi yid 'ong gi skyed tshal hril bo'i bdag mo ste/ khyod la nga'i dbang bo mtha' dag gi pho brang rmeg med du gtong ba'i nus mthu mnga'/ khyod la nga'i snyan ngag dang smyug rtse bslu ba'i gar stabs dang shes rab ldan/ don du khyod ni nga'i tshe srog gi snying bo dang mi tshe'i skyid sdug yin/brtse dung zhes pa'i me lce de'i tsha drod dang 'od zer/ zab tshad dam ljid tshad sogs gsal bor rtogs rjes nga'i sha rus kyi gseng nas khol ba'i glu gzhas yod tshad khyod kho na'i longs spyod du 'bul bzhin yod/ de'i phyir/ngas nam yang khyod kyi me tog srung yod/ rki—160—

bag chags kyis dkrol ba'i rol dbyangs/bdag gi kher rkyang gi bdag mo/ skyo gdung dang rma khas rab tu brgyan pa'i na zug dang len byas shing dor ma myong ba'i dwangs gsal gyi 'dod 'dun lag pas bskyor te khyod kyi 'gram ngogs bsnyeg pa'i nga rang / dus rlung grang mo'i rno srog gdug tsub dang ral gri mang bo'i so kha nas skyob par 'bad kyin yod/ 'khyud 'khyud 'dra ba'i 'u gnyis kyi lag gdang dam dam pa don dngos yin tshe/ dus gtan du 'bor ma myong ba'i dga' dgod kyi rlabs phreng ngam mnyam gcig gi gom 'gros dang 'gul skyod re re'ang 'u gnyis kyi las 'phro yin nges/ khyod rang ngo bstod dang tshul 'chos la dungs mi srid na/khyod rang dbang thang dang sgor mo la dga' mi srid/ ngas 'char nub gang yang ma bsam par 'byor phyug gi dbul phongs la dga' mgus rol bzhin su zhig la bsgugs yod pa khyod la mi gsal su la gsal/ khyod rang thob 'dod kyi ham sems rgod pos/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma'i gseb nas kyang ngas khyod la rang nyid kyis brtsegs shing srung ba'i brtse dung ston srid/ngo ma/ ngas bsam na nga'i dga' ba dang dungs pa ma lus nga rang 'jig rten du ma slebs pa'i sngon nas khyod kyi btson 'og tu tshud yod par snyam pas/ ngo gdong khrag tshos kyis brgyan te ji ltar mjug bsdu tshul zhig nam yang ma gsungs rogs/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sems gshis kyi rgyang 'bod/'ba' seng smyon/zhing grong gi gtam rgyud/zhing grong / sa rdul gyi smug long khrod smin zhing / zhing pa tsho/lcags khem gyi rtsol shugs la 'byar 'duganyi zla dang 'grogs pa'i lo ngo khri stong gi ring la/ zhing pa tshos/dbyar gyi tsha gdug khrod nas mdzad rjes kyi rngul chu zas su brjes shing /dgun gyi grang ngar khrod med dpung bzhin dro ba'i sems pa rum ste phyi rol gyi mkha' dbugs rngub kyin mi tshe yi lam rgyags 'tshol bar brel/zhing grong / khyod kyi nam mkha' stong sang sang / khyod kyi sa gzhi skya thang thang / khyod kyi yul ljongs la rmongs zhen gyi mun pa je stug nas je stugakhyod kyi pang nas grang shur shur gyi gtam rgyud je mang nas je mang / nga rang pho lo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis la son te phugs bsam kyi gnas tshang phyi rol la g.yar ba nas bzung / khyod rang ljan ljin gyi rdol dbyangs bzhin nga'i blo ngo nas yal ma myong / ma yum bzhin sems khong nas dor ma myong / nga rang brag thog gi gla bo dang thod dkar gyi 'bri mo bzhin/ 'grul bzhud kyi 'bab tshigs re re nas phyi mig gis 'khreng sems khyod la gtad cing / brtse dung gi glu chung khyod la blangs na'ang / khyod rang rmi lam stug po'i lhing 'jags khrod —162—

sems gshis kyi rgyang 'bod/gnyid la/ ri rab brtan po'i byang sems rum zhing kun gsal yangs pa'i snying rje sgom nas ci zhig la sgug ang /gzhan yul gyi 'gyur ldog gis gnam sa bsgul byung / gzhan yul gyi 'phel rgyas kyis 'jig rten gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs song / yin na'ang khyod la ci zhig yod myong / ci yang med pa'i khyod kyis/ sa rdul gyi phung bo dkrugs nas rnyed pa'i rin chen gyi gter kha ci/ rdo ba yi tsha drod gleng nas brtsigs pa'i pho brang gang / 'jor dang lcags khem 'byar nas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gang yin/ nam rgyun bsam gzhig 'di dag gi klong nas 'khyams thengs rer/ nga khyod kyi sgal gzhung na bzi ba'i chang 'thung de yin song /nga'i sems khur gyi ri rab dang na zug gi tsher ma khyod/ nar son pa'i dus tshigs nam zhig la nga bya ltar 'phur nas khyod la bar snang yangs mo zhig bzo 'dod/ nga me ltar 'bar nas khyod kyi yul ljongs la gtam rgyud gsar pa zhig bskrun 'dod/rtswa thang gi zlos gar/rtswa thang / lug khyu dang sprin dkar gyi lding cha g.yo ba'i spang thang chen po/'brog pa tsho/ mi tshe yi nyin srib gangs khrod nas 'jal ba'i rnam shes khyu gcigalo zla'i 'khor 'gros rta pho'i bang ltar mgyogs/ dus kyi gom kha skyi bser rlung ltar myur/ khyod kyi yul na/ gnag phyugs las rdzi bo mang zhing /sbra khebs rlung gis 'khur tshul dang sbra nag rlung gis zos tshul gyi gtam rgyud mod/ khyod kyis gang zhig 'tsho ba'i mgon du bkur cing / gang gis khyod —163—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/la sems pa bstan myong /'phur nas go lar bskyod pa than ltas kyi dpe ru 'dzin cing / rkang thang gis dbus lam snyeg pa ngo mtshar du bgrang / dus tshigs kyi char chu lang tsho ru 'dzin la/ grong khyer gyi glog bzhu 'jigs dngangs su blta/ kye/sbra nag gi kha tshub yangs por phyes dang / nam mkhar lcags bya 'phur gyin yod la/ sa gzhir rlangs 'khor gyi 'du 'dzi 'khrigs/ khyod da dung bag phebs ngang 'dar gyin pa yi re mug ang /go thos la/ rtswa thang la 'od stong 'bar ba'i kha sang zhig yod myong zer/da ni mi lo khri stong ring gi rmi lam las yar la longs/ gzi 'od 'phro ba'i sang nyin de rang shugs kyis 'debs dgos pa las/ skyabs bcol dang re 'bod kho nas ci la phan ang /sems khong gi glu'akhyag sib sib kyi gtam rgyud dag kha sang byung bar brdzus na/ de ring ljid tig tig gi rmi lam de las sad par gyis dang / 'od lam lam gyi sang nyin de'i slad du 'bad par rigs/ nga dus rabs 'di'i mi rigs kyi mgrin tshab par 'greng nas/ rang nyid kyi smra brjod gnam sa'i bar snang nas brdol ba'i glu chung 'di pha yul du drangs so/ /

log zhen/log zhen/byang skar/de sngon ston ka zhig la/ nged nang mi tsho chung ma'i pha yul du khams gseng la song ba yin/ nyin zhig nga tshos bya 'dab 'og tu ja 'thung mur gleng mo byed 'dug skabs/ byis pa tshos smin zin pa'i nyi ma 'khor zhig btogs 'ongs te mnyam du bza' zer bar/ mo'i pha rgan cung ma rangs pa'i tshul gyis/ ‘‘rgyal po glang dar bdud kyi sprul pa yin pas/ mi rnams la ma ṇi 'don du mi 'jug ched/ tshang mar nyi ma 'khor gyi 'bru gu 'cha' ru bcug pa red’’zer/'u dum btsan po'i mgo na rwa skyes med pa dang / srong btsan sgam po la'ang dbu gnyis med pa ha lam dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis thog mar rtogs pa 'dra/ khong nyid sku gshegs nas dus de ring bar phal cher dus rabs phyed tsam 'das song rung / bod pa ni bod pa rang red de/ khong gi yang dag pa'i gtam rgyud rna rgyab tu g.yugs nas sngar ltar khri dar ma'i mgo na rwa co yod khar zas su mi sha za ba'i bdud sdig to can du ngos 'dzin zhing /srong btsan gyi gtsug na a mi de ba'i dbu yod la rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa'i spyan ras gzigs su ngos 'dzin gyin 'dugagazhes ning lor/ grogs zhogs dung gi〈'phag 'tshag gi nga ro〉zhes —165—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/pa'i rtsom yig tshags par du spel par/ mdo dang khams kyi skye bo lce ldan dang lce med mi nyung bas dkrog gtam sna tshogs bzo bzhin pa'i skabs shig la/zi ling gi bod kyi las khungs shig tu zer rgyu 'di 'dra zhig byung ba red/las byed pa zhig gis‘‘zhogs dung zer ba des bod la cang med tshul mug tshul dang pha mes yang mes tshos cang ma 'grub ma 'khyongs rabs kho na lab 'dugades na gtsug lag khang mang po yod pa ci red/ po ta la ci red’’ces par/kho'i las grogs shig gis‘‘de pha mes yang mes tsho'i phyag rjes ga la yin/ lha rnams kyis bzhengs pa min nam’’zhes ku re rtses pa na/ khos bsam blo bag tsam btang rjes/ ‘‘tag tag red/ des de tsam yang shes mi 'dug’’ces gdeng tshod dang bcas lan btab zer/sa sgang 'di zlum po dang nyi ma'i 'char nub ni sa'i go la'i rang 'gros las byung ba lta bu'i rgyun shes tsam yang rtogs med pa'i las byed pa de ni/mi rigs slob gling ga ge mos dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu par skyed sring byas pa'i slob chen pa 'khrul med cig yin rabs 'dug pas na/ rgya khyab rong 'brog pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/a ri'i srid 'dzin khi lin thin gyis srid dbang bzhes ring bod pa ser skya ris med kyis khong ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam sprul yin tshul zhig lab kyin 'dug don dag de dang lo ngo lnga bcu lhag gi yar sngon du/ 'u tshos dbyin ji'i rgyal mo big ṭo ri ya rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul par ngos bzung bduganyis bsdur tshe/ bod mi'i bsam blo ci tsam nar son 'dug pa ngang gis shes 'gro'o/ /des kyang mi tshad de/ 'u tshos rgya nag bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi gong ma rnams 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa dang rgyal mo tshi zhi ni sgrol ma'i sprul pa/—166—

log zhen/sog po'i khi hin dag gsung bdag gi sprul par ngos bzung bar kho pa tsho dgod bro yang / ‘‘bod mi gcam bu rnams’’(dge chos kyi tshig)kyis gang de dngos don du 'dzin gi yod do/ / gang ltar kyang de ni mi ngo ma zhig mi las lhag pa'i lha lta bur ngos bzung ba red/ de bas/ mig btsums nas che ba brjod par go ba blangs tshe blo khog tu mi shong rgyu med/ 'on kyang dus da lta de las kyang thal te/ tha na ge sar sgrung du rtog bzo byas pa'i mi sna grags can dag kyang bod yul la mngon sum du byon 'dug pa red/ mgo log tu gling gi dpa' rtul tsho'i yang srid btsal 'dug skad/dar ma mi ma red zer ba skur 'debs red la srong btsan lha red zer ba sgro 'dogs red/ 'di ni mngon sum dang rjes dpag gis grub pa'i don dag la rgol 'dug pas/ tshad ma'i 'jug pa las ches cher 'das na'ang /'u tsho bod kyi bsam gzhig byed stangs ngo mad 'di red/ /mchan/rjodage 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom deb gnyis pa'i shog ngos160pa/

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/nga la glu zhig len du chugs/ldong yon tan rgya mtsho/nga ni nga ste shākya'i dge sbyong zhig de'i phyir/ glu gar dang rtsed 'jo'i 'jig rten gyi pha rol nas mig zung rkang rtse'i me tog la gtad de 'gro dgos pa shin tu bden/ 'on kyang / nga'i mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis po sgom stobs kyis ma grol yang sbyangs stobs kyis lhod song ba'i spro dga' bsam na/ skad gseng mthon pos glu re blangs na 'dod/nga'i khor yug dang nga'i 'jig rten gyi tshogs/ nga la glu zhig len du chugs/gnam sa ga'u kha sbyor gyi gur khang yangs por phye zhig bdag gi mgrin par bzhi lhag drug cu'i 'gyur khugs mi tshang rung / srid pa chags pa'i glu/ lha klu mchod pa'i mgur/ sprel srin mthun pa'i gzhas/ yod tshad mtsho ldan ma'i rgyud drug pi wang gi ldem 'khyug dang 'grogs te‘‘zhang ya re lo’’yi ngag rtsal zhig ngom na dga' ba brgya ldan gyi yang rtse yin/'do rig rta bo'i 'tsher skad/ thul dkar 'bri mo'i ngur dbyangs/'tsher mo lug gi 'ba' sgra/ mtho sgang gi dbyangs rta brgya phrag mnyam du bsdebs te/ mgo nag bod pa tshang gi slad ma 'dres pa'i 'tsho ba dwangs mo lhang lhang glu ru blangs na ji 'dra'i snyan/ glu zhig len du chugs dang / nga‘‘glu gar rgya mtsho'i pha sa’’nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i khu byug sngon mo yin 95ba/bsdo/—168—

nga la glu zhig len du chugs/sa sgang ril mo chung nas chung du 'gro ba'i dus rabs gsar ba'i nyams snang khrod/ dmigs bya zhig gi ched du sus kyang 'thob 'os pa mang po skra lo bzhin ltag rgyab tu 'phangs te gcig las gcig mgyogs kyi 'gran rtsod la tshe srog phra mo'i mchod pa'ang 'bul phod pa ltar/ ngas kyang rang la dbang nges pa'i gter mdzod du ma snang med du bskyur te/ kha lce mnyen mo skam rag bar du/ mgrin pa yangs mo 'gag rag bar du/ a yig srog tu 'phos pa'i rdzi glu 'di'i rgyab ljongs btsal nas rnyed byu/nga / ma gzhi nas sems pa yod tshad kha dog mi gcig pa'i rlung skad re re yin nges pas/ bya rgyal khyung gi 'phur stangs la'ang char sdod bye'u yan chod kyis gleng brjod mi 'dra ba re yod srid mod/ ngas khrom pa'i 'du sgo glu yis phye nyin nas/ spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo kun bzod sgeg mo'i rgyan du 'god dgos byung / zhum pa dang nongs 'gyod kyi mig chu snga mo nas bskams zin/nga la glu zhig len du chugs/ gna' bo'i cong sgra dang dung sgras nga'i glu sgo ma 'gog gsar dar rol mo dang glu rta than thun gyis nga'i glu gdangs ma bslad/ nga la nga yi glu skad dang glu tshig yod dgos la yod kyang srid/ngas lung rtogs chos sgra snyan mo'i ro bcud myong bzhin li khri'i chu gter gyi 'jings su rtsen yun ring bas/ nga a ce mtsho ldan mas sgeg 'dzum gyis bslus te lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs btsal stangs mtshar bas/ dpa' bo rdo rje'i dgyes glu/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang glu/ zag med longs spyod kyi tshogs glu/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang dpal tshogs drug rang grol gyi nyams klu/ bstod pa'i glu/ bskul ba'i glu/ a la la/ la la ho/ dben pa'i lhing 'jags dkrogs pa'i‘‘glu ba stong rgyal 'bum thub’’de su zhig red 'dug—169—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ngur smrig gsar ba'i 'jig rten 'di nas ma mtha' yang dmangs glu mgo snga tshang mo re'ang len ma thub na/ bzhud zin pa'i mes po dag gi lang tsho'i zhabs rjes ji ltar 'tshol/ gces srog gi mchod pa snyim rtser btegs pa'i kha pho mthon po re sgrog gin yod pa min nam/ ngas bsam gyin bsam gyin glu re blangs na 'dod/ mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te blangs na 'dod/ zhen chags kyis blangs na 'dod/ sdang sems kyis blangs na 'dod/ glu skad nam mkha'i mtha' ru khyab cing rgya mtsho'i gting du sim rjes kyang shugs drag gis len nges/khyed tshos gson dang ngas glu zhig len/ glu tshig 'di rgas sla ba'i glu ba zhig las brkus pa min/ glu skad 'di rang tshugs med pa'i glu ba 'khyam po zhig la g.yar ba'ang min/ thog mtha' mi rnyed pa'i 'khor ba'i klong nas tshig bsgrigs shing smra bsam brjod 'das kyi zhing khams nas gdangs brtsams pa'i glu gzhas snyan mo/ chu bzhi sgang drug gi nam mkhar lhang lhang grags dus/dga' ba'i thal mo rdobs dang rang nyid kyang dbyangs ldan ma'i glu ba blor 'bab cig tu mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa med/nga'i glu la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud shin tu mang / zas su sil tog brten cing gos su shing lo gyon pa'i gdod ma'i dus shig la/ blo col dma' ba'i spra mi tshos rang byung khor yug las rnyed pa'i zhed snang mang po'i yid 'gyur gnon ma tshugs par/ ming tshig gi rang skya mi thub pa'i dbyangs 'gros rkyang rkyang zhig gi sa bon btab pa snyan mo glu 'di'i mgo khungs yin/ blon chen gnyal ba snang grags la blo rig gsal ba'i sku sras de 'khrungs rjes gangs ri'i glu yis rlung rta yar 'phur zhig gi gshog sne zin te/ dbyangs gsal so bzhi glu ru blangs pas rang skya mi thub pa'i dbyangs 'gros de la'ang blos mi dpog —170—

nga la glu zhig len du chugs/pa'i rang dbang thob/ skabs shig la stod rgya gar nas thon pa'i chu shel dwangs mo'i me long zhig gi mdzad 'phrin dpal sa skya'i yul nas chu gter brdol ba bzhin 'phyur te klu la glu yi gzhung lugs chags/ bgrang bya du ma'i rjes shig la〈mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro'i〉klu sgra thog ma bod rang sa nas rlung la bskur bas glu ba glu mas sā la'i sman ljongs 'di yang dog por bsgrubs myong zer/ gtam rgyud 'di ltar ring bas nga nam yang glu ba gtsang ma yin/sgyu rtsal gyi stangs stabs re rer mi sems sgul shes pa'i gsang ba yod na/glu la'ang glu yi sgyu rtsal yod nges te/ ngo mtshar tshig gi mtshon thabs gsal ba/spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan mngon pa/ tshig gi sdeb sbyor la dga' skyo chags sdang gi nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa/ dbyangs 'gros dang sems khams kyi 'degs 'jog mnyam pa sogs so/ / nga la glu zhig len du chugs dang /sgyu rtsal gyi gsang ba re re mtho ru 'degs na 'dod/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/brtse ba khrom khrom/a rdor/gcigabartse ba khrom khrom du bzhur bas/ smyug khar gshin po nus med cig gi rnam shes thogs byung / kho'i yal bar nye ba'i bla srog gi ngang tshul mthong dus/snyan ngag dum bu re dngos grub kyi tshul du gnangs shing / rid cing skam pa'i lus phung yang phye leb cig gi mchu sgros ltar 'gul bar byed/ bdag gis kyang yang dang yang du de la bltas te/ snyoms shig snyoms shig khyod kyang nga ltar lus dang 'dres/ sems dang 'dres/ de las kyang mdza' brtse dang 'dres med na/ rang nyid la thebs pa'i mnar gcod de 'tsho bcud du brtsis nas ci zhig byed ces bshad tshe/ khos rang nyid kyi lham kog g.yugs nas grong rdal chung chung zhig 'tshol bar phyin/gnyis/ma brag las skyes pha lha las byon tshul ni bod pa tsho'i mtshan snyan gyi rgyab rten du bzhugs la/ gdod ma'i dpa' bo zhig gis ral gri btab shul kyang kho tsho'i khyim rgyud kyi nar bur gyur/ de'i phyir/ nga tsho su'i gzi rngam la brten nas 'tsho ba las/ rang nyid la dpung gnyen dang rtags mtshan gang yang med pas/ skyi pags las 'phyur ba'i don snying gi khengs gtam yang snga —172—

brtse ba khrom khrom/mo nas thor zin pa min nam/ 'di dag bshad dus/ bdag gis da gzod tsho khag cig gi la rgya dang rus pa zhig gi sra mkhregs la rmongs nas tshig tshogs kyi g.yul bkye mi 'dod cing / de las kyang dngos po'i skye 'jig dang gnas lugs kyi bang rim la had nas bslab bya dang skul ma gang yang gtong 'dod med/gsum/kho bo'i ngag la/ 'jam tsub kyi dbye ba bral la/ bde sdug gi tshor ba bral/ kho bo'i ngag kyang / bdag gi rang bzhin dang 'dra bar shog dpar gyi tsher ma'i gseb tu u tshugs kyis 'thams shing / re ba dang bsam 'dun lhugs por bkram nas yun ring 'das/ don dngos su rang nyid kyi sems khams hril bor gsang nyul thengs shig byas pa las ci yang med zer na'ang chogabazhi/mchod rten gyi rtse mo nyi zla'i snying la zug kha ba'i rang mdog zhing khams 'dir mngon tshe/ g.yer dril gyi sgra dbyangs kyang gas gtor byung zhing / rang byung gi bkod pa'ang phyogs phyogs su grol song / de dus chu rnams zhi dul gyis bzhur/ nags tshal kyang 'jam thing thing gis 'tsho stabs/ bdag gis rang byung gi bag 'khum gyi snying rtsa de rlung gis skul te/nga tsho la'ang tshe srog gi theg tshad dang ran pa'i khe dbang yod par sngar nas bshad myong / sred pa che ba'i lha mo'i tshogs/ bdag gi 'tsho bcud kyi rkang mar dag bzhus te 'od gsal ba'i tshe 'bar gyi mchod me gsos na/ dur —173—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/khrod du sha la rngam pa'i bya rgod kyang yid skyo bas gshog rtse smad srid cing /bdag gi smra bar dka' ba'i reg bya dag gis kyang brang gzhung nas 'dod rtse la rol srid/sprul chen zhi khul gyi mal las 'alngang/sa dus/ rang nyid kyi smra lce la'ang sman gyi kha dog 'dug cing / rang lus kyi dbang bo la'ang dus las 'gongs pa'i sems gshis 'dug pa shes byung / yin na'ang / khong nyid gcig pu gnas mal du log cing rang nyid kha zas su rol ba'i khrom pa'i 'gram du mya ngan dang 'dra ba'i gsom sdong dag skyes pa'ang brjed zin/ dus tshod kyi smra lce la'ang zhe sdang gi g.yu ral dang sdug bsngal gyi ljon pa gang rung zhig skyes med na/ 'jig rten du mi chen gyi ngo so bldag pa'i lhung bzed/ da dung /gshed ma'i gri dngo lta bu'i lag pa dag yod pa ma yin nam/drugakhyod tshe srog la rmongs zhen che bas/ pha sa zer sa'i dbang rtsa rnams nyams kyang srid la/ lha sku'i ngo gdong du byugs pa'i so dkar gyi rdzi bag dag rang sa ru 'thor song tshe/ g.yu mtsho'i 'gram gyi a ma'i byams brtse yang rten yul dang chags sa gang yang med par 'jig kyang srid/ gang ltar/ nga tshor brtse bas phyug pa'i mig dang / sha khrag gi dbyangs rta 'phyur ba'i brtse ba yod pas/ lha mo zer sa'i sring mo zhig bskyar tu bzhengs nas ci byed/—174—

brtse ba khrom khrom/bdun/dbyangs ha cang mdzes/ brtse ba yang de las mdzes/ de ltar khang brtsegs mthon po mdzes pas bzhengs shing / mdzes pa des mig zung gi khu ba yang dkrugs pa tshor bas/ 'dod yon gyi tshab tu rgya mtsho drag tu 'phyur/'dod yon gyi tshab tu snyan ngag srog la brtad/ nga tsho'i rjod kyin pa dag kyang yig 'bru re re dang 'grogs nas bud med kyi mchu sgros su 'thims tshar bas/snyan ngag pa'i brtse dung ni rkang mthil brtol nas sa gzhi la khyab pa sus kyang shes/ mgrin pa bkyag nas sge'u khung gi 'od snang la nyon dang / nga ni dbang rten re rer g.yo thabs kyis 'tsho zhing dran 'dzin re rer lung bstan re mdzad pa'i ston pa yin phyir/ ze'u 'bru dang dri ma dag gis kun nas sbags pa'i bzhin byad kyang / g.ya' dag pa'i me long du lan mang btso rogs/snang ba sab sib cig je gsal nas je gsal du phyin dus/ yab mes kyi ngo gdong da dung drod dang rlangs pas byugs stangs mthong thub la/ bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi dngul phor kyang bgres po tsho'i smra sgo ltar su la'ang gzed 'dug pa mthong byung /brgyad/gtsang bo'i brang khar zla ba'i ngo gdong brlan zhing / skar tshogs kyi brtse ba'ang rlabs la 'thims tshar bas/ da ni sa srod kyi spro snang 'di kha btags ltar gang la 'then/ o/ rgyun du glu dbyangs dang snying grogs dran pa'i kher rkyang pa/ khyod la khyod kyi mdza' bo dran pa'i thugs dgongs dang /khyod la bsam gzhig sgom pa'i snying stobs mchis pas/ rang byung gi bkod —175—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/pa 'dis khyod la ngu ngag 'dres mas le 'ded byed ga la srid/ o/ nga dang brtse ba khrom khrom du bzhur byung / o/ nga dang brtse ba khrom khrom du bzhur byung /dgu/ bdag gi 'dag thabs bral ba'i sems pa ye/ khyod kyi skra lo'ang glang rwa ltar skyes 'dug ces bdag la grogs po zhig gis nan tan gyis bshad/'on kyang / khyod kyi ngo bo/ chu ltar mi 'khyug me ltar mi tsha ba'i yum chen gyi mnga' dang 'brel don yang / nga'i gdos bcas kyi phung bo'i don du min par/ skyon dang dri ma bral ba'i 'du shes dag gi ched du yin pa su yis bsnyon/ ltos dang / su zhig gis‘‘rang nyid’’ces tshos gzhi 'di gang du'ang mi rku bar rdul ltar zag na 'dod/ su zhig gis phyi lus kyi spyad bya mtha' dag tsher sdong du brngos nas dbang shes kyi 'jug pa yod tshad ral gris bcad na 'dod/ de ltar bsam dus/ ngas bya dngos kyi go rim dang chags tshul sogs rim gyis brtsis te/ 'gro stangs dang sdod lugs sogs sems chung gis nyar ba'ang gnas lugs shig yin 'os/ /

gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/ gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/mdzes se/gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du chags pa'i rmog ru sde ba/phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'dus 'ongs pa'i 'dod rngam gyis tshal bur gshags pa'i rmog ru sde bar/ ngas skyo glu zhig dang mtshungs pa'i mtsho sngon po'i rlabs phreng sngas su byas nas/ ston gyi mkha' dbyings su 'phur bzhin pa'i mjug mtha'i khrung khrung khyu de la nyan/dus yun ring bo zhig la/ char ba 'di 'dra'i chen po zhig babs ma myong / da lta/ su zhig gis lho bzhud kyi khrung khrung la skyel ma byed kyin nam/shag shag gi 'bab rgyun/ mtshan mo gcig la ma gzim/de ring gi mtsho 'gram rtswa thang / rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i kha sang min te/bu phrug byes yul 'grims kha la'ang / khyim gzhi chen po 'dir rlung 'tshub las gzhan legs skyes rtsa chen zhig 'bul rgyu med pa ngas shes/bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi lag pa khob tos/ rtsig mthug po'i shog dngul tshur blangs shing / rang gi gnas gzhi de chog mi shes pa'i sre mong la sprad pa mthong dus/je mang nas je mang yin pa'i ngo gdong cha med dag gis/ gri gug —177—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'phyar nas rtswa sa'i brang khog gshags shing / ljang mdog gi pags pa gson por bshus pa mthong dus/gzugs gtos che ba'i zhing las 'phrul chas kyis nga ro sgrog cing /skam rid kyi nor lug dang mnyam du bang rtsal 'gran pa mthong dus/'u cag gi ma ma ste/ mtsho mo khri shor rgyal mo yang bskyar thengs shig ngus byung / /gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/ btul thang ni phyi dror bslebs 'dugaston ka thon la nye dus/ byang phyogs kyi khrung khrung gis 'phrin btang yong nas/ nga la chab cha'i nub phyogs kyi lam bde min dris byung ste/mtha' med 'brog stong du shu sgra 'byin pa'i rlung rgyun de las gnas las mar babs yod dam/ ngang thung gi bye ma rnams da dung sngar ltar rang gshis gyong bor gnas pa e yin zer/ btul thang gi dbyings su/ snyan ngag dang 'dra ba'i khrung khrung gi gshog 'gyur dngangs 'drog dang bral phyir/ nga rang ge sar rgyal bos khol mo bor ba'i gnas der lam rgyus len par chas/gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/ btul thang ni phyi dror bslebs 'dug la/ gdong mdog skya bo'i rab rgan sde ba ni/ bu lon skra yi nyag ma las mang ba'i rgyan po zhig ltar/ thang rgod kyi dkyil na grags 'gul med par 'khums shing / dbugs kyi rgyu ba drag pa'i nam mkha' yang bye rdul gang dgar rgyu ba'i spyi gling du gyur nas yod/ char dus kyi btul thang gi phyi dro/chu mig cig rab rgan sde ba dang le dbar26yod pa'i sar 'tsher snang gis skung 'dug la/ tshe srog gi 'byung khungs 'dren pa'i lag skyor 'phrul 'khor —178—

gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du/gyi sgra zhig bye sgang gi pha rol nas nyin gcig gogagling bu zhig 'brog khyim gyi nag por gyur pa'i rtsig ldebs su lcebs nas yun ring song ste/ sgo khar rkang rdab byed kyin pa'i rta rgan la zhon pa'i skal ba shin tu phra/nor lug gi khyu yis/ mkha' mtha'i sprin dkar gyi 'dab ma der re zhing sgug 'on kyang char ba ni yid kyi mdza' bos springs pa'i 'phrin bzhin nam yang 'byor rgyu mi 'dugardzi bo zhig dang kho'i bu mo chung ba mdzes se gnyis/ dur sa ltar rang gi khang rgyab dang je nye yin pa'i bye 'bur gyi mgor 'grengs mod/ mdangs nyams pa'i mig zung las dbyar kha'i brjod bya ci yang mi mthong /kha nang bye mas khengs pa'i 'brog khyi snying re rje/ a sngon na rgya mtsho chen po rmi lam du rmis shing 'phur gyin pa'i nyi ma la dmod pa mtshams mi 'jogabatul thang gi phyi dro der/ nga'i sems su/ gal te skye 'chi la rang dbang mnga' na/ phyi mar nga rang chu phran zhig tu gyur nas nyin bzhin bye thang 'di'i rma kha brgyud de bzhur zhing / rab rgan sde bar khrung khrung slar yang rang gi mgo thog nas bag phebs kyis 'phur ba mthong du 'jug na 'dod/ /chab cha/ gangs thig gi 'dabs rol du bzhur ba'i chu bo gnyis/chab cha ni chu bo gnyis zhes pa'i don yin gsungs/ sa 'dir/yang snying chu bo gnyis sngon la byung ba yin nam yang na don dang mi mthun pa'i ming 'di sngon du byung ba yin pa ngas mi shes/ gang ltar kyang / chab cha ru gal te chu bo gnyis yod par gyur tshe/ de ni ci 'dra'i bsod nams chen po zhig red ang / bzhud zin pa'i kha sang / chab cha ni 'od kyi rlabs phreng —179—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ 'tsher ba'i lha dar ring mo cha gcig dang mtshungs par/ gangs thig yan du 'gying nger bzhengs pa'i gnas ri blon po gser chen gyi 'dzum mdangs las mnyen 'jam gyis dal bur bskyod de/ mtho sgang gi sems pa can la bkrag mdangs dang skyes stobs gnangs la/ 'gram gnyis kyi rdzi klu ni lo legs thob pa'i dus tshigs su sems pa rab tu myos/ dwangs bsil gyi chu bos/mya ngam thang chen brgal nas thon pa'i ngal zhing dub pa'i gnas mjal ba dag gi skom gdung sel zhing / me tog gi dus chen dang 'dab chags kyi bro dbyangs kyis/ kho tshor rang nyid su zhig yin pa'ang brjed du bcug da dung / dpyid ni nya mo'i ngang tshul gyis ches snga mar smad nas rkyal yong la/ston ni glang chen gyi brtul zhugs ngoms shing ches rjes mar stod nas babs 'ongs chab cha/ blon po gser chen gyis bstsal ba'i ming sring chu bo/ ma yum lta bu'i byams brtse'i 'o bcud kyis/ pha mes ci tsam gyi rmi lam ra bzi bar byas myong ba sus shes sam/dus tshod la gshog pa ma thogs mod/ khyu dang bral ba'i gshog ldan bzhin mkha' rlung khrod nas skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'phur/ nam zhig gi tshe/ blon po gser chen gyi gces phrug tsho rang gi sngas 'gram gyi ku shu dmar por sun snang skyes te/ 'dod rngam gyi me dpung mig kong las 'phyur zhing /ngoms med kyi 'dre lag gis ga sar brdab gsig gtong ba na/ gangs thig yan gyi sprin bzang las‘‘dus ni mi 'gyur mi rnams 'gyur ba yin’’gsungs byung /slar yang / gnas mjal ba rabs gcig spro sems kyis blo kha phyogs pa'i chab char 'byor/ 'on kyang ngag rgyun khrod kyi chu bo gnyis ldan gyi yul gru —180—

de srid na ma yod/ kho tsho'i mig lam du mngon pa ni/ kha zhing che ba'i gram thang du dka' sdug gis bgrod cing / rdo zegs grangs med la sngon chad chu chen lho ru bzhud skabs kyi brjid nyams rjod kyin pa'i sbrul zhig go/ /

rī dribazangathul ba'i sman ljongs/gangs ljongs gzhon nu gsar ba/—‘‘lnga bzhi’’gzhon nu'i dus chen la/kun thar rgyal/dus tshod kyi gom stabs 'dis spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo'ang sgyur bzhin yod pa dang / de dang bstun nas spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'dod blo dang dgos mkhos kyang rig gnas gsar pa dang len byed pa'i don dngos gzhir bzhag gis rig gnas gsar pa zhes pa'i tha snyad thun mong ba byung / gsar ba ni nam yang gsar pa yin zhes pa'i sdom tshig sus kyang kha tshon gcod mi thub pa'i ltos bcas kyi tha snyad cig tu go dgos pas des blo kha bsgyur cing rig gnas gsar pa dang len/ da dung rig gnas gsar pa'i bkod 'doms kyis 'tsho zhing spyod la rig gnas gsar par phyogs pa'i bod pa tshor gangs ljongs gzhon nu gsar pa(gsham nas gangs ljongs gzhon gsar du 'bod)zer/gangs ljongs gzhon gsar 'byung ba ni lo rgyus kyi chos nyid kyis bskrun pa'i thon dngos yin/ de'i stobs shugs la 'gog rgol dang ma rangs sun 'byin byed pa ni ngal ba'i rgyu las ma 'das/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar yang sang nyin gyi bdag po yin par ma zad rgyal kha'i bum pa 'dzin mkhan kyang yin pa ni mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus la zur lta byas pas rtogs thub/‘‘blang dor’’ces pa'i gzi brjid ngom pa'i tha snyad 'di bkol ba'i bod kyi rgan po kha cig gis rig gnas gsar pa'i dge mtshan dang len bya ma thub —182—

gangs ljongs gzhon nu gsar ba/par de'i skyon gyi rang bzhin cher bskyed kyis rig gnas gsar pa dang len bya bar gegs byed la de dag gi sbrid sman gyi ngogs na bzi ba'i skye bo dag gis rig gnas gsar pa dang bar thag cig bzhag yod la/ bar thag de ma bstung bar du nam yang rig gnas gsar pa'i dang len par 'gyur mi srid/rig gnas gsar pa'i dang len par ma gyur na gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi gras su ji ltar 'tshangs kyang khas len mkhan su yang med do/ /gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi mtshan byang 'di srol rgyun nam rang mos snyan ngag tsam 'bri ba'i rjes su 'gro ldog gis bzhag tu med par rig gnas gsar pa rgyud 'dzin dang 'tshol snyeg lag len bstar thub pa'i snying stobs sogs kyis 'jog pa zhig yin/ zhi bde ma ṇi ltar 'don pa'i shes ldan par rlom pa kha cig gis rdul phran mtshon cha'i 'jigs zil ma bzod par rig gsar gyi 'thus tshab tu gyur pa tshan rig dang bod kyi gzhon rabs pa'i bar du phra ma lta bu 'jug gin yod mod/ zhu rgyu la/ de dag la ma zhed dang nying rdul mtshon cha dang bod mi rigs kyi bar du da dung ha cang ring / nying rdul mtshon cha rig gsar min la/ rig gsar yang rig gsar min/ —rig gnas rnying bas lo rgyus kyi khrod du thon pa'i nus pa lo rgyus yin la rig gnas rnying ba'i gzi dpal yin mod/ rig gnas rnying bas rig gnas gsar pa'i tshab byed du mi btub pa ni lo rgyus chos nyid yin pas‘‘rig gnas rnying ba rgyud 'dzin dang rig gnas gsar pa blang dor’’las‘‘rig gnas rnying ba zur lta dang rig gnas gsar pa 'tshol snyeg’’byas na re ba'i btang ba'i gzhon nu la gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi ru dpung gis lhag bsam dag pas dga' bsu zhu nges/gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyis nam yang brtsi 'jog byed pa ni drang —183—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ bden yin la/ bden don gyi ngogs nas nam yang 'tshol zhib byed pa ni 'phel rgyas dang gsar gtod yin/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyis thog dang por lad mo byed kyang srid/ 'on kyang lad mo'i ched du lad mo byas pa min pas rig gnas gsar pa ni gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi stobs shugs yin la bod mi rigs kyi tshe srog gsar pa'ang yin/ rig gnas gsar rnying gis‘‘nga tsho’’dang‘‘kho tsho’’so sor gyes kyin yod la dgar gyin yang gda'/dgar stangs 'dis khag gnyis su 'gro ba‘‘stobs shugs’’gcig khag gnyis su song bar bgrang srid mod/ khag gnyis su 'gro ba gsar rnying gi 'gal 'du'i chos nyid yin la/ 'gran rtsod kyi do rar yang tshud pa yin pas da gzod rig gnas gsar rnying gi stobs shugs gsal 'ong la rgyal pham yang dbye chogarig gnas rnying ba srog tu gyur pa'i 'ud shod pa kha cig gis deng rabs bzo las kyi gnam gru sogs kyang bka' bstan gyi gzhung na tshul ji ltar bzo ba lhun chags su yod ces u tshugs byed la/ med par smras na ma shes pa'i rtags so zhes brjod pa dag ni rig gnas rnying bar 'khrul ba'i brtsi 'jog par gyur la rnying nag mkhregs 'dzin par gsol 'os so/ /gangs ljongs gzhon gsar ni skyon kun bral ba'i yon tan kun ldan min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar ni snang bzhin stong zhing stong bzhin snang ba'i dbu ma min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar ni ma brtag dpyad pas yod tshad skyabs su mchi mkhan min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyis yang mes kyi tshe srog gis bris pa'i lo rgyus la bsrings thig 'bri thub/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyis phang phung ljan ljin gyi rdzob pa'i khor yug la gtsang 'don bya thub/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyis mi'i rigs spyi mthun la bsam gzhig —184—

gangs ljongs gzhon nu gsar ba/de bas kyang byed thub/gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi mdun du basmu brid kyi me sgor spungs kyang sa rdor rtsi/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar la dgra bo'i mdun nas lcags kyi srog yod/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar la brtse ba'i 'og nas bal gyis byams yod/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi shes rab dang spobs pa/ la rgya dang stobs shugs la sus kyang dper mtshon bya thub med/gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi 'os 'gan ni rig gnas rnying bar brtsi mthong gis rig gnas gsar par dgag rgyag tsho'i kha gtad min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi dmigs yul ni yab mes bla srog gis bskrun pa'i shes rig gi gshed po min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi bya bzhag ni lo bcu'i god chag la bdo ba'i 'gong 'dre yi rjes 'jug min/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi 'os 'gan ni bod kyi don dngos rjes lus kyi ngo gdong bsgyur te rang rigs kyi rdog kha sngon skyod kyi lam du zhugs rgyu de yin/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi dmigs yul ni rig gsar gyi bla bkug nas bsam blo gsar pa'i rmang bting ste gsar gtod kyi snying blu rgyu de yin/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi bya gzhag ni thog ma'i lad mo brgyud nas rig gnas gsar pas 'phel rgyas kyi gdong bsu rgyu de yin/gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi khrod na‘‘mi min pa'i mi’’med/ gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi pha yul sa'i go la yin la gangs ljongs gzhon gsar gyi khyim gzhi gangs ri'i ra ba yin/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/dran/sa dkyil tshe bkra/'char sgo zhig gi sne mo nas/ gtsang bo zhig gi 'gram ngogs su/ngas nam rgyun khyed rang dran zhing khyed rang gleng la/sra srod cig gi snga ltas bzhin/ blos bslangs shig gi go rim khrod/ngas sngar bzhin khyed rang dran zhing khyed rang bos/khyed rang song shul du grib gzugs nag po zhig nga'i lus la 'thims shing / sgra dbyangs gsar pa zhig nga'i sems la zug 'ong / phal cher/de ni/ khyed kyis nga la gnang ba'i mnar dungs kyi sdom rgya zhig gam/ khyed kyis nga la bzhag pa'i 'grul bzhud kyi gom sgra ljid mo zhig kyang yin par nges/lo zla ji ltar rgas pa'i tshul gyis sems pa de ltar 'khyag 'gro la/ nub rlung ji ltar g.yugs pa'i zol gyis nam zla de ltar 'gyur 'gro/dran pa'i rgyang ring nas sems pa 'di khyed kyi dus ston la rol cing /dran pa'i smyug kha nas snyan ngag 'di khyed kyi mna' rten red ang /'ja' tshon dang mtshams sprin/ dgu tshigs dang skar mda'/ yang na/ nam mkha'i pha rol gyi zla ba kher rkyang de 'u gnyis kyis re ltos byed sa'i gces phrug yin la/ rgyang blta byed sa'i sge'u khung yang ma yin nam/dus tshigs kyi kha phyogs shig gis/ bdag sgo 'gram gyi glog sdong —186—

dkar po la khen nas tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun la nyan dus/ rgya srang du phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed pa'i mi tshogs kyi rba rlabs khrod na nga rang khyed kyi brtse dung gi slong mo ba ste/ khyed kyi lang tsho yi nga rgyal lags pas/ khyed rang nga'i tshe srog gi dran pa dang re ltos kyi ljid shugs 'degs pa'i gangs kyi lha mo bzhin/nga'i 'tsho ba'i ltag rgyab kyi sngas gong na 'bar ba'i mchod me'am/ gsang ba'i skra lo yi yang steng na 'phyo ba'i phug ron gyi rnam shes lags/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ me tog gso mkhan gyi rmi lam/pad+ma dbang rgyal/skyed tshal zhig tu rgya se me tog mang po btab yod la/ me tog gso mkhan gyis kyang 'di ltar byas na zla ngo re rer me tog gi mdzes dpal nyams su myong thub par 'dod/ rgya se me tog la rigs ha cang mang / de dag ni phyogs so so na yod pa'i grogs po tshos kho'i dga' phyogs la bstun nas ngo chen brgyud bskur byas pa dag red/ me tog bzhad 'go tshugs thengs re rer dbyibs gcig kyang kha dog mi 'dra ba'i me tog rnams kyis kho'i ldum ra la mdzes cha zhig gi dod du dga' lhang lhang gis mdzes nyams chig rkyang dag ston bzhin rdzig nyams mngon/ khos me tog de dag gso skyong yag po byed ched/sen mgo khrag dang sen gting rnag byas nas nyin sum brgya drug cu'i nangs dgong re rer me tog rnams la chu ldug pa dang lud 'jog pa/ dza re dzo re'i yal ga'am ra lag dag gtub gcod byed ci thub la rem/nyin zhig gi mtshan mor khos rmi lam glo bur ba zhig rmis byung / khos rgya se me tog cig la‘‘gtsang bsher’’byed pa'i skabs su/ me tog mang po zhig skyed tshal la thon yod pa rig byung / phar bltas tshod kyis 'dzam gling gi me tog yod rgu thon yod pa 'dra/ 'gying stobs mi 'dra ri tshogs kyi gtos/kha dog mi 'dra grong khyer gyi glog ring thung mi mnyam nags tshal gyi shing ltar —188—

me tog gso mkhan gyi rmi lam/du me tog tshos gcig las gcig lhag gis kho la mig gis phur tshugs su gzas 'dug de bas kho rang har rgyag gis yar langs te me tog tshor zhib gzigs byas/thog mar kha grag mkhan ni me tog gangs lha red/ khos‘‘spyir rang nyid kyi brtsi mthong che bkur gyi phyir du/ nga khyod kyi ldum ra'i ma bos mgron po byed 'dod med mod/ 'on kyang de ring ming sring spun grogs tshos bdag la 'bod pa btang bar brten 'dir yong ba yin’’zer/der mthud nas bshad mkhan ni chu skyes pad+ma red/ khos‘‘nga rang chu rdzing las so ma gnyid las sad dus ming sring tsho skad chen pos ri lung brgyud nas 'gro ba thos pas kho tsho'i rjes 'brangs nas yong ba yin’’zer/thag 'khyud me tog gis kha cher gdangs nas‘‘nga tsho'i skyes gzugs gtan nas mi mdzes pa e yin nam’’zer/de bzhin me tog ser chen gyis ngo gdong dmar por gyur nas‘‘gtan nas kha ya mi byed pa yang brnyas dmod mthong chung zhig red’’zer/lug mig me tog gis‘‘gal che ba ni gshis rgyud kyi mdzes pa myong rgyu de red’’ces sgam brling gis bshad/a ga ru yis‘‘byams snying dang bstod pa kho nar dga' ba ni de'i rang gshis ha cang nyams chung yin pa'i rtags red/ yin yang / nga tsho la sra brtan spobs gdeng gi bla srog ldan’’zhes thal/ dpyid 'go'i me tog gis‘‘nga yid ches dang dad sems la 'grogs nas yong’’zer/ de ltar me tog tshang mas rang rang gi skad cha bshad tshar rjes mgrin gcig tu/ ‘‘rgyus lon yang bde skyid cig yin’’zhes brjod/—189—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'di'i skabs su rgya se me tog gis kyang kha grags byung / ‘‘drang mor bshad na nga tsho yang ha cang kher hreng red/ gal te ming sring tsho dang mnyam du 'dug thub pa byung na/ nga tshor yang de las lhag pa'i bde skyid cig gang na yod’’zer/de'i rjes su me tog phyi yong rnams kyis‘‘dbang btsan sger sdom gyi dbang gis nga tsho 'di ltar yun ring la lus song / kho tsho las can tshos kyang bshad mi tshar ba'i 'khang sems re brjod bzhin bzhud zin pa red’’ces bshad tshar rjes me tog rnams gar song cha med du gyur/kho rang gnyid las sad pa na/ sems khams bde la ma babs pas rang nyid gcig pu skyed tshal la song nas phar 'gro tshur 'ong byas/ skabs shig tu kho'i yid la 'di 'dra zhig shar byung ste‘‘me tog tshor yang rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes yod la/ lhag par du rang dbang gis bzhad chog pa ni kho tsho'i dbang cha red/ nga ni dga' zhen gyi dbang gis me tog mang po zhig la yid ma rang / de bas da lta rang gis kyang 'jig rten gu je dog nas je dog la 'gro bzhin pa tshor bas/ zhib bsdur byed ran/ gal te zhib bsdur med na/ don spyi gang mang zhig la go ba mi lon/ thung ba yod pas ring ba yod la/ chung ba yod pas che ba yod/ ngan phyogs mthong bas da gzod bzang phyogs rig thub de'i phyir de ring nas bzung ste nga'i skyed tshal kyang sna tshogs me tog bzhad sa'i ldum ra byas nas/ mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad byas na/ nga tsho'i 'tsho ba sngar las je mdzes dang me tog yod tshad la'ang rang rang gi mdzes sgeg ngom pa'i go skabs sbyin pa red’’ces yid la shar ba ngag nas kyang shor song / /—190—

las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa'i le'u/las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa'i le'u/re rkang gling /'dra par las gus nyams btod pa'i mchu sgros shig skyes yong zhing de nyid chags pa skye bya'i mtshon byed cig tu ma 'phos par sngon dang 'dra bar khyod la na zug dang sdug bsngal ster ba'i smra sgo zhig tu gyur song / yin na yang mchu sgros de 'dzum shes pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi dbang gis mig chu'i mtshon don la'ang brtse dung dang / lhag bsam/ re ba bcas kyis bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur ston tshul re yod pas khyod kyi nang sems kyi 'khor skyod la de lta'i nyams rgud byung med par phyi yul gyi khor yug dang 'brel ba'i lus po 'di kho na 'dod sred kyis 'dar zhing 'dar/ 'dod sred kyi kha dog bsles pa'i rmi lam gyi char rgyun yod tshad dag pa'i phyir na khyod kyis nam rgyun bud med cig gi 'khrungs rabs la pha ma dang mngal sgo/ 'chi ba dag gi thob bya gang yang ma brgyud pas grogs po tsho'i khrod du khyod la rlom pa mi 'dug zer mkhan shin tu mang la tha na bu mo tsho'i khrod du yang khyod la brtse ba mi 'dug zer bzhin rang nyid kyi brang gzhung gi skom tshad la sha drod kyi me btsa' mi 'jog pa'i rang rlom can yang mang po zhig byung yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir khyod kyis rus tshigs re re'i bar gseng du thim pa'i bde snang gi myong ba la rol dbyangs kyi kha dog rnyed pa'i smad 'tshong ma skor zhig la rang gi gser dngul gyi gter kha sbas pa'i —191—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sa khra de'i gsang lam bstan cing nor rnams gyar ba'i sdug bsngal gyi sha khams chen po 'di yang grang shur shur gyi mal khri zhig la ngos 'dzin gyin yod/lang tsho'i skyes stobs dang rnam shes kyi mnar gcod mtha' dag khyod kyi dpral ba nas bzhur te mig zung la babs dus mdangs shor ba'i mig 'bras de'i gting rim du zegs pa ni khyod kyi tshe gang la bsags pa'i rgyu nor de'i longs spyod kyi byung ba ma yin par 'chi ba'i don du ngu shes pa'i mig chu dkar yol gang dang de yi skyes stobs la brlan gsher gyi nus pa 'don pa'i rang dbang gi brtse dung de red/ brtse dung de lha sgrung ma yin la dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba zhig dang stes dbang gi snang tshul tsam yang ma yin par rang nyid dang bcas pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rnam shes shig dus ma yin pa'i dmyal ba'i mdun sgo'i phyogs su gtong gin pa'i chags sdang gi las mkhan zhig red 'dugadrang mor bshad na mi rnams kyis byis dus kyi 'tsho ba ni lhad ma 'dres pa'i dwangs gtsang gi rmi lam zhig la ngos 'dzin gyin yod mod/ khyod la mtshon na de nyid ni blun rmongs dang khungs med/ sdug nyes dang rdzun bzo bcas kyis zin pa'i gdon 'dre'i ring lugs shig la go ba sbyor gyin yod/gdon 'dre de'i sdug skad lhang lhang gis khyod la ches mi gtsang ba'i rmi lam zhig bkod sgrig byas pa'i lung bstan nas reb cig la khyod kyi klad pa nas rkang mthil bar gyi sha khrag gi snying bor 'phos pas khyod kyis zhed snang gis 'tshos pa'i slob grwa dag kyang mdog ngan pa'i gcan gzan gyi ra ba zhig las bde snang gi glu tshig 'phab bya'i dag pa'i zhing khams shig la ngos 'dzin ma thub/khyod kyi 'tsho ba ni shākya'i rigs shig gi 'phos tshul ltar nags tshal dang ri dwags/ gtsang bo dang sil tog sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dben gnas shig tu zad yod na'ang sngo mer 'khyil ba'i mi gshis kyi gtsang bo dang grong nger —192—

las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa'i le'u/'gying ba'i kun spyod kyi g.yang gzar dag ma brgal bar khyod nyid gang du 'gro nus/ tshogs lam las kyang rang rgyud la nges 'byung gi bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes pa ni rmi lam gyi gnas skabs rnams su'ang 'khor ba ni dug sbrul gyi tshang ltar mthong nas thar ba'i yon tan la brnyes dgos zer na'ang sems 'di'i phar ngogs su dpyangs pa'i bu mo zhig gi mdzad rnam ste rang lo nyer gsum gyi bde sdug khrod da dung yang khyod kyi phyir du gson yod na nyid kho na ma yin pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig gis kyang gsang ba'i sgo nas khyed kyi re 'dod la 'jab rgol byed cing de las kha ba'i sdug bsngal gyi bro ba gtong gin yod pas khyod nyid gzhan zhig gi ched du sangs rgyas kyi sa ga la ba der gshegs mi rung /khyod kyis snum tshon nam thang ka gang zhig 'bri ba'i dus su'ang bu mo de'i mig zung yid la bcangs yod pas sus bshad na'ang khyod kyi sgyu rtsal la dpal gyis sgeg pa'i skyes stobs shig gnas yod zer/ phyogs ngos gzhan zhig nas bshad na gnyer mas bsles pa'i lang tsho'i lcebs thag de dang shes rab kyi rno dbal las bskrun pa'i sdug gcod kyi ral gri de dag gi byin rlabs la bu mo gzhan zhig gi dug rlangs lta bu'i brlan gsher gyi sha drod gos pas thag pa de ral zhing hrul ba'i tha gu zhig tu gyur la sdug gcod kyi ral gri de yang rtul zhing rmongs pa'i rig pa zhig tu gyur song /de nas bzung ste khyod kyi rmi lam du 'khor ba ni brtse dung gi bden pa kho na yin zhing rang nyid gang la'ang mi 'dzem pa'i mi gsod gshed ma zhig tu khrun thag bcad/ khyod kyi rmi lam de〈lha sa'i zla ba〉las grub rjes gser 'od kyi rlabs ris su 'thim pa'i po ta la'i gzi brjid de rang gi snying stobs su dran zhing me ri gas pa lta bu'i tsha rlabs shig gis khyod nyid lha sar thengs gcig —193—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'byor ba'i bde snang bskrun/lo rgyus de sngar bzhin bzhur ba'i dus mtshungs su khyod kyis nyi zla ri bo'i bla srog tu 'phros pa'i a ce rgya bza' lags kyi dkar mdog gi rang gshis dod pa'i 'jim brnyan la lan gcig bltas myong zhing / mig zung bslus te brtse ba nyos myong ba'i blo gros mkhan zhig gi bla mtsho de mthong yod cing de dang 'brel ba'i lha sgrung nang gi dud khyim khri phrag gi dpa' mdzangs la smon pa skyes yong / de ltar na'ang lo rgyus kyis nam yang khyod kyi skom tshad kyis zin pa'i 'dod sred la bzo bcos byed mi thub cing dngos yod kyis kyang khyod kyi re 'dod de rnam par bskang ba'i mthun rkyen sbyor ma thub/khyod kyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu mi yul la 'tsho gzhes kyi don du bzhag pa ni skyo lhang lhang gi glu skad re yin zhing 'khor ba 'di'i skyo gar la yid sun byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis〈glu skad gnyis pa〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam zhig kyang bris myong / sgrung gtam de la rkyen byas te khyod nyid gsang bar spro bas na slar yang 'dzoms pa'i mi zhig gi rang rtogs su 'jug pa ni gnas ma khel ba zhig yin pas khyod kyis gsol 'debs gang zhig zhu ba'i dus su'ang rang nyid kyi khe phan zhes mi mthong bar rang nyid gzhan te tshar gcod pa'i lag cha zhig gnang rogs zer rgyu de red/ gsol 'debs 'di gangs rin po che'i nye 'dabs nas thengs gcig bton myong la/ yar klung gtsang bo'i 'bab rgyud nas kyang thengs gcig bton myong / 'on kyang lag cha de dngos don du 'gyur ba'i go rim tshang mar skyabs zhu sa nyag gcig yod pa ni jo khang chen mo ma yin la chos rgyal sgrub phug kyang ma yin par gnya' chag gi bab tu lhags pa'i btsan po'i bang so de red/dur khrod kyi sgang 'bur re re khyod kyi byin rlabs brnyes pa'i snyim pa de'i —194—

las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa'i le'u/mchod gong du zegs dus khyod la'ang gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba'i rang rgyal ba zhig gi rtogs pa de bsngos na'ang rgyab phyogs nas mched pa'i bud med kyi ngu skad gnyom dung ba zhig gis slar yang glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos sku la byed pa gdon gyis skul ba'i mya ngan gyi 'khor tshul de phyogs res su 'thor bas khyod kyis snga ma bzhin 'dra par de brang la brlan bzhin rang nyid gzhan de'i dran dbang la gus 'dud mi byed ga med byung /khyod kyi lus gzugs de pha bong chen po zhig dang 'dra bar g.yo med rtag brtan gyis gtsang bor cer sdod pa'i dus su kha ras brgyab pa'i bud med cig gis khyod kyi brang khar sbyar ba'i 'dra par la yun ring bltas rjes‘‘tshe 'das shig gam rus ming bsngo yig la phab rgyu’’zer bzhin thar dmar ba'i shog nye zhig khyod la gtad byung /mtshams 'di la khyod kyis gser rkong mang ba'i mchod stegs su gzi ྅byin gyis 'bar ba'i jo bo rin po che der gus phyag lan gsum btsal rjes lha sa zhes pa'i lhing 'jags kyi grong khyer chen po de la gsang stabs kyis bde mo bzhag cing khyod kyi mkhur tshos su bzhur ba'i mig chu des brang ngos brlan pa bzhin 'gul skyod du brel ba'i smyu gu des kyang shog ngos der khyod kyi rus ming kho nas brlan par byas song /bsil rlung gis sgul ba'i rlabs ris kyi me tog shig shig ldem pa'i lha sa'i skyid chu de khyod kyi rang lus nas bzhur te dwangs gsal gyi gzugs brnyan ngo ma zhig chu gzhung la 'khur dus da gzod khyod kyis rang nyid gzhan de la skyel ma byas shing shul du lus pa'i kher rkyang gi rang nyid la mya ngan gyi mig chu bton pas gser tog dang rgya phibs kyi bar na rngam brjid kyis 'gying ba'i pho brang po ta la de ngo gdong tshos kyis brgyan pa'i dpa' rgod cig gi rang gshis d+ngha195—

las snyems bzhin snyems bzhin khyod kyi mkha' dbyings la nyi zla'i zol du bzhad cing skad mthon pos bde mo byos zer/ ‘‘bde mo byos/ chu gzhung du gyar ba'i bu mo khyod kyi 'dra par dang rang gi rus ming gnyis la'ang’’kha phyir 'khor bzhin khyod kyis rtse po ta lar de skad lan btab/ lha sa de sngar bzhin 'od kyi gong bu zhig gi klong na 'dzum dmul dmul du khyod la gyes phyag gi lag brda ston gyin khyod dang bar thag phye ste mi snang bar gyur/ /

bod pa'i bu phrugabod pa'i bu phrug—rang nyid gleng ba/rang gsal/grang reg dang ston bad skya 'thab pa'i dus tshigs 'dir/ gsar rnying dang bar sdod 'dzing 'dres pa'i bar skabs 'dir/ go la zlum po'i rig gnas gzhi gcig tu 'gril ba'i dus rabs 'dir/ ngas mi lo sum cu'i bod phrug cig gi bsam blo'i rim pa chags tshul la spyi bsdoms thengs gcig mi bya rang dbang ma byung /gdod ma'i rang gtso'i sems pa rmeg med du bcom pa'i gzhan brten skog gyur gyi lam phran de kho bo'i las dbang‘‘bzlog med’’de'i dbu tshugs shing /bla na ma mchis pa'i sems gtso sems 'dul gyi khong gseng nas kho bo'i gsar chags shes pa nar nar bo chag grum gyis 'khrungs/rmo mo'i yig drug gi mgur dbyangs kyis khyim gzhi 'di drod kyis 'tshos shing kho bo'i mgo bo thog ma'ang mgur dbyangs 'dis bkrus pa'i brtsams chos rang byung zhig gi zla ru ngang gis thogs/ rgyun chags 'dis mi lo bdun phrag tsam la kho bo'i mgo bo the ba'i dbang lag gor mo'i rang dbang khad kyis phrogs shing ma ltogs ma grang ma shi tsam gyi bye'u phrug nga'i 'dab gshog gnyom po'i rkyang skum yod tshad gtan du khel/mgo bo skog gyur la bcol ba'i smug long 'di'i khrod nas kho bos‘‘skyo ba’’—197—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ma tshor la‘‘sdug bsngal’’ma shes/ ‘‘dga' bas’’ma myos la‘‘spro bas’’kyang ma brtas shing / dbang phyogs a she ya'i shan shugs stug pos‘‘phal ba'i rten’’kho bor yang 'dzam gling rig gnas nyams su myong ba'i skal ba thob yin na'ang‘‘yig 'bru gcig na sangs rgyas stong sku'i’’bshad rgyun gyis kho bo‘‘bla med’’rig gnas la dad pa sa 'jigs shing gus pas bslabs pa'ang mi lo bcu phrag bar du'o zhes da lta dpyad kyis tshor/lo rgyus kyis snga ma'i mtshar sdug brjod cing nang rig gis rang sems 'dul tshul gleng / tshad ma yis rig pa 'gran tshul rtsod cing grub mtha' yis rang lugs mchog tshul lab pa'i tshe na/ kho bos dge rgan dam pa gzhung lugs kyis phyug pa tshor zhing kha ba'i ljongs 'di rig gnas kyis 'grangs yod snyam pa byung /yud tsam nas kho bos/ rmo mos skad gdangs gnyom pos yang nas bskyar skor du bshad pa'i mi sems 'gul ba'i bu mo lha ris kyi gtam rgyud la bsam gzhig shor cing / dge rgan dam pas rngam brjid tshig gis spros pa'i lha lung dpal rdor gyi mda' mo gcig gi ngo mtshar la nges shes rnyed tsa na/mi lo stong phrag gi 'ching thag ring mo 'dir ngan khag cig mi dkri thu med byung zhing / rkang gnyis la brten pa'i mi rigs gzugs spobs can 'di slar yang ci gsung dang len gyi sug bzhi'i thog sgur ba'i‘‘byang sems snying rje'i’’bdag nyid can du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa'i nyam chung nus med kyi gshis ka 'dir sems khral zhig ngang gis thon la/ mi bu bdag gi khor yug kun na 'di phyi'i bde skyid thams cad sa rdo ri brag la bcol ba'i gnyug ma'i spyod pa shes yon dus rabs su 'drud pa'i rang rigs thams cad la bsam blo mi 'khor ka med byung /—198—

bod pa'i bu phrugamangon gyur rig gnas kyis klan ka 'gyed pa'i 'jig rten 'khor mo yug 'di'i gru zur nas/ kho bo dang kho bo lta bu'i mi bu dag 'tshang kha rgyag cing gcig las gcig lhag gis bde phyogs su bsnyegs pa na/ 'das zin la phyi mig gtong ba'i kho bo'i sems pa 'jags thabs bral/ mi lo bcu phrag gsum gyi bshul lam steng na bkag rdo tshad med yod pa ma tshor bas mi tshad/‘‘u tshugs’’dang‘‘rang tshugs’’med/ ‘‘phugs bsam’’dang‘‘rang dbang’’shor ba'ang ma rtogs la/ da dung ma yin yin mdog gi ngang la mgo bo thogs yod kyi bsam pas bla mar mjal cing pha mar bkur/ kha yis dam chos 'don zhing lag gis gzhan don sgrub pa'i‘‘ya rabs’’kyi brtul zhugs bzung nas shes med tshor med ngang dus rabs 'dir gtugs pa na/ da gabrod khong 'dar zhig gi 'jig rten 'di'i ma 'ongs pa yangs shing che na'ang kho bo'i mdun lam gu dog pa tshor/ yab mes kyi gsung sgros thams cad mtha' gcig tu tshad mar 'dzin pa'i khor yug 'di'i nang nas kho bo'i lus ngag yid gsum sgrog gis bcings shing / ‘‘shing dpar gcig’’gi nang rol nas dus nam yang‘‘mi gcig’’pa dang‘‘mi mthun’’pa bsgrub pa'i go skabs phra rkyen/ gzhung bzang gi lta mkhan khri phrag gi mthong lam nas kho bos snyigs ros bkang ba'i 'khrab tshig cig mi 'dod bzhin du mid dgos byung la/ snga ma kho bo la sogs pas brtson pa gang thub bgyis pa'i lam bu'i steng bsam bzhin rdog brdzis gtong mkhan sgal tshigs kyis stong ba rnams la gros 'debs pa'i gzhi mthun ye med pa gzhi nas shes/de lta na'ang mi tshe gcig gi dkyil 'di nas bzung ste kho bos rang lus mtho gang bor gtsang sbra byed la rang sems rma med la rang dbang sprod/ dam —199—

bca' 'di kho bo'i srog ma 'gag bla ma ma 'thor/ dbugs ma chad gong du tshe srog gis srung la sa sgang ril mo 'di'i steng gi rigs gzhan ltar 'grengs nas 'gro ba mi bu'i gral la e tshud brtson len bya ba las/ mgo sgur byol song gi las nas ring du gyes rgyu yin stabs kho bo lta bu'i na mnyam dag la rtogs sad pa'i gras su tshud shog ces skul ma byas pa yin no kye/ /

nang ma khang dang slob grwa chen mo pa/ nang ma khang dang slob grwa chen mo pa/me lce/ cigana' mkhar zi ling grong khyer du2001lor bod kyi nang ma khang thog ma byung ba nas lo ngo gnyis lhag gi ring la snga phyir nang ma khang brgyad btsugs pa dang / nang ma khang ni zi ling du sdod pa'i bod mi dang zi ling brgyud de 'gro ba'i bod mi rnams kyi rtsed mo rtse sa'am spro gseng gtong sa gtso bo zhig tu gyur 'dug bod rang gi srol rgyun gyi khyad chos dang deng rabs kyi rgyan gyis spras pa'i nang ma khang du rgan gzhon pho mo med par 'gro zhing / de'i nang du las byed pa dang tshong pa yod la/ rig gnas pa dang slob ma'ang yod/ de du sgor mo yod med gnyis ka 'gro bar 'dod cing / sems khams skyid min gnyis ka 'gro bar spro/ nang ma khang du na gzhon rtsom dga' rnams kyis rang gi gsar rtsom dang phugs bsam gang 'dod gleng chog la/ ltad mor phebs pa'i sku mgron rnams kyis gar stegs steng gi glu gar gyi 'khrab ston ci dgar longs su spyad chog gzhan yang brtse dung gi rgya mtshor lhung ba'i pho mo zung gis phan tshun gyi snying gtam sba gsang med par brjod chog la/ pho hreng mo rkyang du lus pa'i gang zag dag gis phan tshun la mig gi zur mda' yang yang 'phen chog de lta bu'i khor yug ni grong khyer du 'tsho ba rol ba'i mi zhig la mtshon na ji 'dra'i yid smon 'chor sa zhig dang rol rtsed kyi gnas legs shos —201—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/shig ci la min/ nye char〈sbrang char〉du kha byang gcig pa'i brtsams sgrung〈grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba〉zhes pa spel dang spel mus su mchis pas/ gal te brtsams sgrung de dag la mnyam 'jog mkhan zhig dang zi ling grong khyer gyi nang ma khang du song myong mkhan zhig yin tshe/ 〈grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba〉zhes pa'i kha byang mthong ma thag nang ma khang de dran srid/zi ling du nang ma khang thog mar dar ba'i skabs su gnas de ni rol rtsed byed sa dpal yon dang ldan pa zhig tu mthong ba dang gza' mjug ngal gso sa'i‘‘gnas mchog’’cig kyang yin snyam/ yin na'ang da lta zi ling gi nang ma khang de phan tshun 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i g.yul sa zhig tu gyur yod(klog po lags/ khyed kyis 'dir rtswa sa rtsod gleng byed kyin 'dug snyam mam/ de ma yin te bud med rtsod kyin yod pa red)pa dang / bod kyi slob chen pa rnams kyis mtshan mo'i rang sbyong byed sa'i‘‘slob khang’’du gyur yod/ spyi tshogs thog las ka ci yang med par nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed pa'i mi dag la mtshon na nang ma khang du dus 'da' bar song chog kyang / slob chen pas thos pa 'tshol zhing mkhas pa slob pa'i gser las dkon pa'i dus tshod de nang ma khang du 'da' bar byed pa ni ji 'dra'i yid skyo ba zhig red ang / skabs 'dir slob ma de dag gi khyim bdag dang dge rgan rnams kyi snyan lam du‘‘byis pa skyob rogs’’zhes pa'i lu'u zhun lags kyi 'bod skul de slar yang gtong dgos byung /deng sang slob chen du 'gro dgos tshe slob yon mang po sprod dgos pa dang shes yon rin gyis nyo ba'i dus yin pas/ yul gyi pha mas sen mgo khrag dang sen rting rnag byas te bsags pa'i sgor mo rnams grong khyer gyi gru zur re re'i nang ma khang dang chang khang gi khra chil dgu chil gyi glog 'od 'og tu rlung la spur ba yin na/ 'u cag gi pha ma de dag kyang snying re rje la/ rang re'i bu phrug —202—

nang ma khang dang slob grwa chen mo pa/rnams kyi sems pa yang gor mo rdo las mkhregs/ ‘‘pha sems bu thog dang bu sems rdo thog’’ces pa 'di deng gi spyi tshogs la sbyar na shin tu 'phrod pa'i gtam dpe gson po zhig red/ nang ma khang gi sbyin bdag cig gis nga la bshad rgyur/ dbyar dgun gnang gi skabs su slob ma rnams pha yul du log tshe nang ma khang gi tshong ltos bcas kyis mi bzang la/ slob 'go brtsams ma thag nas bzung tshong shin tu bzang / gza' mjug tu slebs tshe cog tse phal cher slob ma rnams kyis gang 'gro/ la shas shig la gza' mjug dang slob khrid kyi dus tshod gnyis kyi dbye ba med par dus rgyun yong gin 'dug phal cher lo nyi shu yas mas kyi na gzhon pho mo dag red zer/ slob ma'i las ka slob gnyer mi byed par rnam g.yeng byed pa dang / slob ma 'gro sa dpe mdzod khang du mi 'gro bar nang ma khang du 'gro ba/ slob mas nyo rgyu dpe cha mi nyo bar sbi rag nyo bar byed pa ni deng gi slob chen pa rnams kyi rang gzugs red/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'dzugs skrun gyi 'gan 'khri rlabs po che phrag tu khur ba'i na gzhon slob chen pa rnams kyi bya spyod 'di dag mthong thengs rer/ nga tsho'i re bzhag gi me tog sad kyis bcom zhing hur brtson gyi sems pa rmang nas nyil ba dang mnyam du/ srin bu mtsho dkyil du lhung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung dang 'byung mus su mchis/thengs shig grogs po zhig dang mnyam du‘‘dbyangs can ma’’nang ma khang du song ba yin/ de du sbi rag gi bzi stobs dang glu gar gyi rtsed mo yis mgron po rnams snang ba ha cang skyid po ru gyur 'dug yin na'ang 'khrab ston gyi le tshan gnyis kyis nga rang sems khams dwangs shing snang ba skyid thabs ye nas mi 'dug par bsam gzhig gi mtsho mor 'jug dgos byung / gcig ni na gzhon glu pa zhig gis blangs pa'i glu dbyangs〈chang 'dren pa'i klu〉zhes —203—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/par 'di 'dra'i glu tshig cig 'byung ste/ ‘‘chang bzhes la/ chang bzhes la/nga tsho tshang mas chang bzhes la’’zhes pa'o/ / ci ma bden/ lha sa'i dbyar kha'i gling kha gtong ba nas mdo smad kyi drug pa'i glu rol sogs dus chen re re la 'u cag gis nam rgyun chang phor sna tshogs phar 'gyog tshur 'gyog gis chang bzhes te 'ongs pa red la/ bod kyi las khungs so so dang slob chen dag na'ang las byed pa glang gnya' tshil rkyal rnams dang / slob chen pa mgo stong bag yangs su rgyu ba rnams kyis chang bzhes te dus 'da' bar byed bzhin yod/sos dal bag phebs dang sbrid tshor sgyid lug gis nyi ma gtong thabs byed pa ni 'u cag bod mi rnams kyi thun mong gi sems khams khyad chos shig red/cig shos ni pho gsar gsum gyis deng rabs rol chas kyi gdangs dbyangs dang bsdongs te ma ṇi yig drug glu ru len zhor gar stegs su rkyang phyag gsum 'tshal ba'i le tshan de red/ le tshan 'di ni dgod bro zhing ngu shor ba'i le tshan zhig red la/ bod mi'i kun spyod nyams dmas su 'gro bzhin pa dang /bsam gzhig byed stangs ya ma brla yin pa'i mngon stangs shig kyang red/nye sngon grogs po rtsom sgrig pa zhig dang lab gleng byed skabs kho rang nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig sde khag gi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’dhisu zhugs pa'i mthong thos shig nga la brjod byung / bod kyi dge rgan chen mo gzhon pa zhig gis slob ma rnams la‘‘brjed mi nyan pa gsum’’gyi blang bya bton pa dang / ‘‘brjed mi nyan pa gsum’’ni rang nyid bod rigs yin pa brjed mi nyan pa dang za ma rtsam pa yin pa brjed mi nyan pa/ kha ton ma ṇi yin pa brjed mi nyan pa bcas yin zhes smra bzhin yod skad/ bltas tshod la blang bya 'di mi rigs la sems khong nas dga' zhen che ba'i legs bshad lta bur snang yang / don du glen bshad 'ba' zhig red/ 'di ni slob grwa chen mo'i dge —204—

nang ma khang dang slob grwa chen mo pa/rgan zhig gis slob chen pa la 'don rgyu'i blang bya ma yin par/ pha yul gyi lo lon rgan rgon gyis byis pa rnams la 'don rgyu'i blang bya zhig red/ yang gcig bshad na blang bya 'di'i shugs bstan du rig gnas gzhan dag dang dpal yon gzhan dag phyir 'bud byed pa'i rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba zhig kyang mngon yong gi 'dug gal te‘‘brjed mi nyan pa gsum’’gyi blang bya 'don mkhan gyi dge rgan kho rang bod rigs kyi bzo rtsal dang bod rigs kyi mdzes chos kyis spras pa'i nang ma khang du yong ste/ ma ṇi yig drug glu dbyangs su len bzhin pa'i 'khrab ston la gzigs/ kho bo ni khams pa dang khyod rang ni bod pa red zer ba'i dregs nyams de mthong / chang kha nas mi rigs kyi la rgya bshad de khu tshar bsgrengs/ am gtsigs bsdams/ bzi dwangs rjes mi rigs kyi dungs zhen nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal cing bya ltar 'phur ba'i rnam pa 'di dag mthong tshe khong gi dran pa'i me long ngos su ci zhig 'char ram/de bas ngas bltas na mi rigs la dga' zhen yod med de phyi'i rnam pa'i goms srol dang zas rigs kyi khyad chos/ zhal 'don cho ga tsam gyi steng nas dbye rgyu min par gtso bor kun gzhi(bag chags)yi steng la 'jog rgyu zhig red/ kha skad kyis bshad na mi rigs zhes pa de rus pa'i gting la zug dgos pa dang rtsa'i sbubs lam nas rgyu dgos pa zhig yin par 'dod/ rang re'i slob grwa chen mo'i slob gso yi nor 'dzol yang 'di na 'dug ste/ dge rgan chen mo rnams kyis rnam grangs can gyi‘‘gdams ngag’’dang‘‘legs bshad’’kyi shes bya rkyang pa stsol ba las/ bsam gzhig gi sgo mo phye nas bsam blo'i mkha' dbyings su rang dbang gis lding skor rgyag pa'i nus pa dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi dpal yon gyi nying bcud dam gsung rtsom grags chen dag la mjal ba'i skal pa sbyin gyi med pas na/ 'u cag gi mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dag tu —205—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/shes yon can dang 'jon thang can shin tu 'byon dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di la thug yod par snyam/ kwa ye/ slob chen pa rnams lags/ khyed cag gis dge rgan chen mo rnams kyi‘‘mtshang’’rtogs rjes slob yon 'bor chen sprad par phangs sems skye mi yong ngam/ de yang ku re yin mod/ 'on kyang ku re de'i rgyab na dngos yod kyi gnad don zhig gleng ba dang bden pa'i lam zhig 'tshol gyin yod pas na/ bsam gzhig la goms pa'i klog pa po rnams kyis slob chen gyi slob gso'i 'jigs nyen thad la mno bsam gtong bar 'tshal mchan/()‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’ni nub byang mi rigs slob chen bod yig sde khag gi slob ma rnams kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i rig gnas bsam blo bgro kyaing byed panā smrungastugasdu shig yin pa dang phyi gling gi‘‘k+ṣe 4kyilhasgru/ lku’’dang cha 'dra ba yad/ bgra glang ga nga bo ni rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam yin pas slob ma rnams kyi bsam blo'i rang dbang thad la nus pa bla med bton dang 'don bzhin yod/—206—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/a bu/dang po/ don rkyen/na ning gi dbyar gzhung du/ gsar 'grogs shig nga'i sdod shag tu 'byor te gtam rgyud mtshar bo zhig gleng song / gtam rgyud de'i khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo ni kho rang nyid yin la/ byung rim mdor tsam ni 'di lta ste/ kho ni rong khul gyi sde ba zhig gi slob chung dge rgan zhig red/ nyin zhig sde ba de'i skyes pho mo med par ma ṇi khang du tshogs te lha gsol klu dga'i cho ga bstar bzhin pa'i sgang la/ kho'ang der phyin te kun gyi mdun sar bsang khri bshig song / khos skabs der chang nyung tsam 'thung yod tshod 'dugaslob chung gi dge rgan che ge mos grong sde ga ge mo'i bsang khri bshig ces re zhig rlung ltar khyab/ don ngo mar yang / bsang khri bshig pa ni rang gar shig pa'am 'jig pa gang rung dang mi 'dra phyir/ dad ldan pa tshos rgya yan du gtong mi srid mod/ 'on kyang skabs thog tu bar mi langs nas bshol ba ci yang btab mthar/ phan tshun bar du 'khon 'dzing ma byung zhing /ci don dag de yag pa yon tan gyi sgo nas thag gcod thabs su bsang khri bshig mkhan khos bsang khri bzhengs mkhan tsho'i spyi rgya gzhung la sgor mo sum brgya'i chad pa sprod rgyu byas/—207—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gsar 'grogs des kho rang nyid kyi gtam rgyud gleng zhor du gdong la yid tshims pa'i mdangs shig ngom zhing / don rkyen de'i rjes su khos‘‘bod kyi dad pa sgor mo sum brgyas khugs ki’’zhes bsgrags myong zer/gnyis pa/ thog ma'i myong chor/gsar 'grogs kyi mi de log rjes/ nga'i myong tshor la/ sos dal sgyid lug gi ngang nas nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed pa dang / dad pa 'khral 'khrul gyi khrod rang mgo rang g.yogs kyis 'tsho ba skyel ba'i mi dag la mtshon na/bsang khri bshig phod pa'i‘‘'dre srin’’skor zhig yod dgos la/ yod chog chog kyang red ang / de ltar bsams mur/ ngas gzhan gyis lab myong ba'i skad cha zhig kyang dran byung ste/ bod 'di ni na zug med pa dang dran pa bor ba'i mi rigs shig red/ don rkyen de las sdom tshig sla mo zhig rnyed thub pa ni/ rabs 'di'i na gzhon rnams kyi sems khong du na zug brjod du med pa zhig yod pa mtshon thub/skyes bu zhig la na zug yod na 'khun sgra 'don pa ni sdar ma'i ngang tshul tsam min la de ni drang mo drang rkyang gi rang tshugs thub pa 'i rtags red/ 'on kyang mi rigs shig la na zug yod bzhin du da dung yang lkugs pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ste mal sa dron mo zhig nas bde bde skyid skyid ngang la sdod pa 'di ci zhig yin ang /gsum pa/ holar+ghagadon rkyen de la 'brel nas grogs po kha shas dang nyams myong brjes shing /der yang rang nyid kyi bsam gzhig gtong stangs brgyud de sreg bcad byas —208—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/mthar/ ngas bsang khri bshig pa de ni hol rgyug thengs shig red mi zer ka med byung zhing / de las phan 'bras ci yang med pa'i gdeng tshod kyang rnyed/dad pa'i rtsa ba sgor mo sum brgyar thug pa zhig min la/ ma gzhi nas gser srang khri stong gi blus pa yin tshe/ tshong lad de 'dra sus rgyag phod dam/lhag par du lo rgyus dang khor yug sogs kyis bskyed pa'i bdag cag gi dad pa de ni bsang khri bshig pa tsam gyis 'jig 'gro ba'i chos shig kyang ga la yin/dad pa de la dge chos khong yang phangs sems 'di 'dra shor myong ste/ sa skya'i sgom du lha khang la phebs te gna' dper rdul dkrug pa tsam byed dus/ der chos sems can 'ga' zhig gis dpe 'khrug pa nyar na bkra mi shis pa yong zer nas 'og khang phyags dar khrod du 'phangs pas thams cad chud zos/ ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i dpe rnying shog ldeb re tsam rgya gar du yang ches shin tu rnyed dka' ba lags pas/ gces nor la brtsi thang de tsam du ya cha/ de bzhin dad pa can 'ga' zhig gis gzhung cha tshang re re nas shog gu re tsam brkus te mgul srung byed pa dang / dpe ldeb kyi shog bu sen mo tsam du bkog ste byin rlabs zhes za ba dang / sku brnyan dang mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhug tu phul te nam yang mthong rgyu med pa sogs bstan pa'i rgyun la gnod pa dag byas nas gzhan la da dung ngoms par byed (〈gser thang〉217—18)ces pa'o/ / de yang 'u cag gi sha gseng rus gting du a 'thas su phyin pa'i dad pa de'i rigs ni ma ṇi khang gi bsang khri bshig pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa zhig yin na da bar du‘‘'thab rtsod’’rab dang rim pa byed pa'i dgos pa ma mchis/ nga tshos glen 'dang kho nas rjes dpag tsam byas na'ang /bod mi'i khyim re rer bsang khri re yod pas spyi bsdoms byas na ga tshod yod srid dam/ gal srid bshig 'dun che ba can zhig dang / de'i khar rgyu —209—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'byor ba'ang ldan pa zhig gis mi rer sgor mi sum brgya sprad de sbyor ba dngos su brtsams na ni ci 'dras dgod bro ba la ang /'das song gi nyams myong la gzhi bcol na/ btsan po'i ring la jo khang brtsigs pa nang bzhin/ mtshan mo 'dre yis bshig kyang nyin mo lha yis phyir gsos par ma zad/ gzhar yang bde 'jags kyi ched du sngar bas brjid chags sra brtan du mi gtong ba'i nges pa ga la yod/ des na nga tshos bsang khri bshig pa'ang ngal ba 'bras med ma yin nam/ de'i phyir/ ji srid‘‘sems kyi bsang khri’’ma bshig ma 'jig bar du de srid ma ṇi khang gi bsang khri'ang chu la wu ba bzhin yang nas yang du 'phyo nges red/bzhi pa/ nyen kha/nye ba'i mi rabs du ma'i ring la mu nas brgyud de nga tsho'i khrag rgyun du 'khol ba'i bsam blo gsar pa 'di ni sa 'og na rgyu ba'i me ri ste/ da lta rdo dang g.ya' ma'i srubs nas 'phyur bzhin pa'i rdul dang rlangs pa ni de'i snga ltas yin/ skabs bab 'di tsam la/ rdul rlangs 'phyur 'phyur thams cad de'i snga ltas su 'dod mi rung ste/ khyi zug pa dang gzhan la rmugs pa gnyis ni khyad che zhing snga ma las skor zhig ni gnam gyi skar ma ya mtshar du bzung ba'ang yod/sgam dkyel che la na zug yod pa/ dpa' ngar ldan la blo bkod gsar pa dag ni de dang mi 'dra ste/ khong tshos gang bshig shul du ci zhig slong dgos pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa yin na/ de'i sta gon yod pa'ang rang shugs kyis grub/ 'on kyang‘‘hol rgyug pa’’rnams ni skad cig gi spro snang gis brtas pa'am yang na rang nyid sngon thon pa yin par sgrub ched kho na red/ de ge210—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/ la/ jag rkun rang bzhin gyi gtor brlag dang bran g.yog rang bzhin gyi gtor brlag de'i rigs ni nyam chung zhing dmigs yul ni phu med pa red/de ni gtor bshig tsam la kha g.yar te gtor bshig gi ched du gtor bshig gtong ba dang rgyu rdzas mtha' dag bdag gir bzhes 'dod pa red ces kyang gsungs so(〈ñtsāblu4༈ tsoneṣ+pe7〉29)mdor na/ bsam med gyi hol rgyug gang rung ni nyen kha zhig las nyen kha gzhan zhig gi 'obs dong du 'khrid pa'i nyen kha ste/ kho tsho'i sems khong du‘‘phugs bsam gyi 'od snang’’bral bas red/lnga pa/ rgyu mtshan/nga tshos lo rabs brgyad cu pa nang bzhin gnyen sgrig rang dbang ma red ces pa ni phyi'i snang tshul tsam la kha gtad pa las/ bza' dpon gtsor byas kyi spyi tshogs sgrig srol te‘‘bu mo'i las dbang pha mas thag gcod pa'i’’shugs kyi don la khab gtsags 'big gtsags kyi byed nus thon med na/ rmongs dad dam rjes lus red zer ba bzhin bsang khri bshig pa'ang de'i rang bzhin dang /'dre rgan phug ces pa'i dpe ltar nga tsho'i rang rgyud du mkhregs 'dzin du gyur pa'i‘‘bsang khri’’der ser ka tsam yang 'phud thabs med/nye rabs lo rgyus steng / rgya nag pas phyi phyogs btsan 'dzul pa'i brnyas bcos myangs mthar/ stobs ldan du gyur tshe gzhan gyi rdung rdeg 'khur mi dgos snyam pa'i blo har gyis bskyed de/ thog mar nub phyogs pa'i lag rtsal la slob sbyong byed ci thub kyis bzo grwa gang mang btsugs mod/ shing rta lo'i krung ri'i dmag 'khrus/ gi pham nyes byung rjes/ nub phyogs pa'i lam lugs la slob sbyong byas par ma zad/ mthar lcags phag lo'i gsar brje —211—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ byung nas lam lugs rnying pa bsgyur mod/ 'on kyang de nas bzung stobs ldan du gyur tam zhe na ma yin te/ mtha' mar yang‘‘gnam gyis bskos pa'i’’nyams myong dmar po yod pa red/ shes ldan pa dag gis dka' ba ma spyad pa ni ma yin mod/ yin rgyu ni‘‘sems kyi bsang khri’’ste mi mang gi blo bkod rnying pa de'i rigs ma bsgyur pas red snyam/lu'u zhun gyis 'jar pan nas sman ma bslabs par rtsom rig gi lam du zhugs pa la don snying che ste/ ‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’de sngar bas cung mthil du phyin zhes lo rgyus pa rnams kyis smra ba'ang gnad de la thug yod/rang rigs la'ang de 'dra'i nyams myong med pa ni ma yin/ nye rabs lo rgyus steng / bod mi blo rno ba bzhi dang bcas dbyin jir slob sbyong du mngags te gzhan gyi lag rtsal bslabs/ phyir thon te bzo grwa sogs btsugs/ lung shar lta bu'i sngon thon pa'ang byung mod/ mjug 'bras ni rang gi ye shes kyi spyan yang sa la brdabs/ de bzhin dge chos kyis‘‘sprang po'i mi tshe’’dang lcags smyug lhan du zad pa'i skyo nyams dang / dpal don grub rgyal gyis‘‘nyam chung ba'i tshe srog’’shor pa'i phangs sems sogs kyang gnad gang la thug gam/ khong tsho'i dmangs gtso dang dogs slong / gsar gtod kyi snying stobs sogs bod kyi yul gru kun tu ma 'thor par kha mal de nas gzhom gzhig gtang don yang / nga tsho'i‘‘sems kyi bsang khri’’de brjid chags sra brtan du yod pas red/kho bo'i dran tshul zhig la/ da lta'i bar du nga tsho'i go ba len stangs nor 'khrul can zhig ni/ skor zhig gis‘‘bsang khri’’bshig ched du/ mi thang dang 'dra mnyam/ dmangs gtso dang tshan rig sogs tha snyad gyong po 'ga'(don du ni phun sum tshogs pa zhig)thogs te nam yang‘‘bsang khri’’dang kha —212—
