bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/gtad du langs ci thub byed cing / tha snyad de dag gis bsang khri bshig thub kyis re smon 'chang bzhin pa de red/ nga tshos 'dra mnyam dang tshan rig sogs thogs reg bkag gsum gyi chos can yin pa'i bye brag gi lag cha zhig tu bsgoms te/ do dgong nub ja 'thung dus rjes lus yin pa la/ sang zhogs skya rengs ma bkyags gong la stobs 'byor ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur nges kyi rmi lam rmis yod/ 'dra mnyam zer nas pha gral mgor dbang na rang nyid kyang sdod chog chog gi gnas lugs kyis gral mgor 'tshang ba tsam dang /tshan rig zer nas gzhan gyis gnam gru bzo shes na rang gis kyang ngo snyam ste byas pa tsam gyis a ri dang 'gran bzod pa zhig tu 'gyur thub tshe/ ‘‘bsang khri’’nges par du bshig dgos pa'i bden lugs su la'ang med/ ma gzhi ni‘‘bsang khri’’des mi mngon pa'i 'ching thag gi tshul gyis nga tsho dgu bsgril du btang yod pa red ang /spyir tshan rig zer ba sogs ni mi rigs shig gi rig gnas khor yug dang des bskyed pa 'ba' zhig yin phyir/ nga tshos kyang lag cha zhig tu mi brtsi bar snying stobs shig gi dod du bgrangs nas tshur len dang slob sbyong byed pa yin na rab tu mthong / 'o na tshan rig de snying stobs shig yin pa'i cha nas ga 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos zer na/ tshan rig gi ngos zin mtha' dag lag len las byung ba dang / lag len kho nas tshan rig gi bden lugs la brdar sha gcod pa zhig yin/ des tshan rig la yul dus kyis bkag rgya med par smra la/ tshan rig gi blo sna ci rigs sdud par spro ba'i rgya mtsho las kha nang du gcun par byed pa'i sgrom bu min/ tshan rig gis mthar thug gi bden lugs zhes pa khas mi len zhing / rang dbang 'tshol rtog gi snying stobs gces su 'dzin/ tshan rig gis bden lugs kyi mdun thad nas 'dra —213—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/mnyam yin par smra la/ lta ba mi mthun par brjod pa dag la dkyel yangs kyi rnam 'gyur ston/ tshan rig gis dbang dang grags pa'i rjes su mi 'brang zhing / dogs slong dang / dgag rgyag mu nas mu ru gsar gtod kyi lam du zhugs pa'i blang bya 'don pa'o/ (〈ṣ+kar+ṣa〉22110)mi rigs so sor rang rang gi‘‘bsang khri’’bshig pa'i nyams myongayod la/bdag cag gis mig dper 'dzin rung ba yang mang / spyi lo1789lo'i zla7pa'i tshes14nyin h+pha ran se'i mang tshogs kyis pa hri ti btson khang bdag bzung byas pa ni de'i gras kyi gcig ste/ ma ṇi khang gi bsang khri bshig pa dang ye nas mi 'dra/ de ni lo ngo brgya phrag gi ring la snga phyi go rim bzhi(〈ṭ+wā⑫hūṃṇ+ḍaṃgloko7skru lam̐ 4 wo 〉218)tsam brgyud cing / chab srid rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa/ kun spyod rig pa/ slob gso rig pa dang rtsom rig bcas kun thad nas mun nag spyi tshogs la 'gran bslangs shing / shes yon can dag gi blo gros kyi mig chu rabs nas rabs su bstims pa'i 'bras bu yin/lo rgyus la sbyong ba ni bye brag gi lo tshigs rtsod rgyu dang bye brag gi byung rim tsam blor skyor ba ma yin te/ gtso bo 'das zin gyi nyams myong len rgyu yin tsang / nyams myong de tsam las kyang shes thub pa ni/ nga tshos kyang‘‘sems kyi bsang khri’’bshig par brtson dgos pa'o/ /drug pa/ ‘‘bsang khri/’’bsang khri ni tshang mas mthong yod de/ ngas ji ltar zhib 'bri byas kyang khyod kyis dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i bden snang sbyin mi thub/ tha snyad kyi tshad bkag kyang 'di la thug yod/ —214—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/nam rgyun bsang khri las du ba sngo lhog lhog 'phyur te yul lha gzhi bdag dgyes byed kyi gsol ston bshams thengs rer/ nga'i dran shes su thog mar 'khor ba ni gdang la'i ri rgyud dam byang thang skya mo gang zhig na rtsam skya 'gem bzhin pa'i ru ba dag yin/ 'di ni ngas rtog 'char byed pa'am yang na rtsom rig la gzhol che ba'i 'bri thabs tsam red/ don du ngas brjod 'dod pa ni zhed snang las bskyed pa'i rang rigs kyi skyabs bcol gyi 'du shes yin/zhed snang de ni gdod ma nas byung ba zhig dang / skyabs bcol gyi 'du shes de ni dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bdag cag gi rgyud la bsrings nas yod pa zhig red/de'i dus su/ gnam sa ri gshong gi grub tshul/ char rlung thog glog gi byung ba/ nyi zla skar gsum gyi 'char nub/ dpyid dbyar ston dgun gyi 'gyur ldog bya dang ri dwags/ nya dang 'bu srin gyi 'gul skyod sogs la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'grel bshad rgyag mi thub pas/ de ni rang byung las brgal ba'i stobs shugs shig ste/ lhas tshod 'dzin byed kyin yod par bsam zhing / mi'i rigs kyi bde sdug legs nyes kun lha la rag par bsam/de nas lha la dad pa dang zhed pa'i blo skyes shing / mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs byas te/ nyer 'tshe kun sel nas bde legs su sbyor ba'i skyabs bcol(〈bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus skal bzang mig sgron〉215—16)ba'i 'du shes bskyed pa red/ nga tshos da lta〈srid pa chags glu〉dang〈srid pas ba chung bshas glu〉sogs klog dus/ rang rigs kyang 'char yan gyi gshog rtsal rgyas pa zhig tu khas ma blangs sa mi 'gro na'ang / shugs su mes po tshor rang byung khams la 'jigs 'jigs ngang sdod pa'i zhed snang de tshor thub/ zhed snang de las lha gsol klu mchod kyi gar stegs bsang khri zhes pa 'di byung zhing /—215—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/de las kyang nga tsho'i sems kyi gting la sra 'thas su song ba'i‘‘bsang khri’’de brtsigs pa red/zhed snang de yang rang byung khams kho nas bstsal pa zhig min/ lo rgyus yig char/ bod mi ri dang brag ste mtho sa dang btsan sar gnas 'cha' ba ni rgya gar nag sogs shing la sbrul ltar 'khri ba dang lug la spyang ltar 'jab pas‘‘phyogs kyi dgra ma thul bar’’'gog rgol gyi ched du btsan sa bzung bar bshad(lde'u jo sras kyi〈lde'u chos 'byung〉ldeb98par gsal)/ de bzhin phyis kyi pho brang sogs kyang rdzong btsan par grags shing / rgyu rkyen ni phyi rkun dang dgra jag la mi 'jigs pa/ chu dgra khogs pa/ brjid chags par yong ched du red/ bzo bkod de dag la sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang yod du chugs kyang shugs las rtogs pa ni mi rigs 'di'i zhed snang tsha bo de red/ zhib tu bsams na de ni mi rigs shig da dung nar ma son pa'i rtags te/ dper na byis pa lo chung mtshan mo'i dus su gcin thog tu 'gro mi thub par pha mar skyabs su re ba lta bu red/skyabs su re ba rkyang rkyang byed pa'i mi dag gis gnas lugs dpyod dka' ste/ kho tsho'i mig zung ling tog gis bsgribs shing / rang tshugs thub pa zhig med/ mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas kyi go rim la gsum du phyes yod pa las/ dang po skyabs su re ba'am gzhan rten can zhig dang bar du rang tshugs thub pa zhig mtha' mar rang gshis kyi 'ching rgya 'grol ba zhig yin zhes kyang gsungs(〈tshen+de rmyalam̐k+ṣe4ṣ+kalko77rgyu〉245)te/ de lta na nga tsho dus tsam gyi cha nas dus rabs nyer gcig par 'tsho zhing gzhes mod/mi rang steng gi 'phel rgyas thad nas bshad na da dung gdod ma'i khyad chos gsal ba'i mi rigs shig red/—216—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/mtshams 'dir kho bo'i sems su po ta la glo bur du 'khor byung / rang rigs tshos gzi brjid du rtsi ba'i pho brang der nga thengs gnyis la mjal myong ste/po ta la'i sge'u khung dog mo las phyir lta thengs rer mi rigs shig gi sems rgya dog mo de las gzhan dran rgyu mi 'dug(gzhan du na dkyel yangs sam sgam dkyel zhes kyang 'bri)/ des na 'dir sems rgya zhes pa de rang gi nyams myong dang sbrags te cung bshad de/ kho bos de snga sgrung gtam thung gras shig la dpyad pa phran tsam spel te/ zhor du deng dus sgrung gtam gsar rtsom gyi snang tshul 'ga' sba gsang med par brjod pa la/ der yang dgag lan shog ngos bco lnga lhag bris yong 'dug 'di ltar ngas rang nyid kyi phyogs slong ngam tha mal ba'i phrag dog tsam brjod par 'dod na gong gi bris bris thams cad skyag rdzun du brtsis chog spyir rma khar gtsags na na zug gam 'khun sgra 'don pa ni ma shi ba'i rtags dang da dung gson re che ba yin mod/ mi rigs shig gi sems rgya'i thad nas bshad na cung pham par 'dugabastod pa ni bod yig rtsom rig gi khyad chos shig ste rtsom stangs tsam du ma zad/ deng rabs bod yig rtsom stegs su khyab che ba'i snang tshul thun min zhig kyang red/ nga tsho sor skyes shig la mtshon na dam pa dag dang mi 'dra phyir/ bstod pa tsam gyis yar skyed dang skul slong gi nus pa 'don thub mod/thag ring bor bsam blo 'khor na khyod bde nga skyid tsam gyis spyi chus mi yong bar 'dug snyam/ de yang rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi thad nas kyang tshang ma bstod pa byed pa rkyang rkyang yin la/ gcig bstod gnyis bstod dang rim bzhin kun gyis bstod de‘‘lha’’ru btang rjes/ sus kyang mdzub mo ker mi chog pa ni rang re'i lugs srol red/ lar la shas ni bstod 'os su 'dug mod/ mang mang ni bzang sa dang bzang sa'i bar/ dge rgan dang slob —217—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ma'i bar/ nye mi dang nye mi'i bar phan tshun bstod res kyis khyod bzang nga yag gi rnam thar bskyangs nas 'dug grogs po zhig gis de la gson nyams ldan pa'i sdom tshig cig bkod pa ni/ bod yig rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni lo gsar skabs kyi‘‘kon thig’’red zer ba ste/ ngas khyed tshang la gcig 'khyer na phyir nged tshang la'ang gcig ces pa'i dpe red/‘‘bstod dpyad’’kho nas bskyangs pa'i bod yig rtsom rig gi byis pa 'di/da ni ngan lang dgu lang du phyin pas/ kha khog med pa'i skyon brjod byas na cis kyang bzod thabs med pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin mchis/ ston mi chog zer ba ni min te/ lang shor gyi byis pa tshos da dung yang phyir 'khor te kha pho che ba la ang / spobs pa 'dzoms pa la ang zhes pa'i‘‘gong rim’’gyi bshad sgros su 'khyer te sgrob nyams ston pa dang / ‘‘gnas lugs ni de ltar ma yin 'di ltar yin’’zhes pa'i‘‘rgan po'i’’ngag la lad mo byas te lta ba gzhan rnams byis pa mdzong khug nas gsod rtsis kyis brtul zhugs kho na dang du len nges/ de ni lta ba gcig gcod kyi‘‘bsang khri’’min na gzhan ci zhig red/nga tshos dkyel yangs de tsam yang gtong mi shes sam/ spyir rtsom rig gi bya ba de yul rkyang ba'i steng la gzhol nus pa'i‘‘tshan rig’’gi bya ba ltar yul can gyi blo'i shan mi thebs pa'i rig gnas shig ma yin par/ yul can gyi rtog pa ches cher spyod dgos pa can zhig yin na(〈bod rtsom gsar ba bdams bkod dang de dag gi bshad pa〉25/ da dung yang gnas lugs ni‘‘'di ltar’’du thag gcod pa ni dgod bro mod/ de la khag med de/ khong tsho ni rgan po red/nga tsho ni lo nyung red/ lo nyung tshos rgan pa dag gi kha bkod la nyan rgyu yang‘‘gnas lugs’’dang mthun pa ma red dam/ bu pha la do na gnam gyis mi khebs zer ba ma red dam/ des na/ nga tshos sngar bzhin du/ rang nyid —218—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/kyi lta ba ci rigs brjod du med par a phas byin pa'i ka ra bzhin khug mar sdud rkyang rkyang byed pa las phyir 'don mi chog gam/ des na/ nga tshos sngar bzhin du/ mang po zhig la mgu ba bskyed pa'i slad du khungs med kyi gtam rgyud ches mtshar mtshar ba dag bri ba dang / gzhan gyi ngo bo srung drags te gtam bden pa yang smra ba'i spobs pa med par rang gi rtsam khug bsrung ba'i ched du yin min gyi dbye gsal thams cad btang snyoms su bzhag nas jo bzang gi ming la re ba(〈gser thang〉25)byed dgos sam/ kho bos kyang ni de ltar mi nus te/ bden par smra ba'i lce 'di pha mas byin tshar la kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi zer ba sogs gnas lugs‘‘skyag rdzun’’dag gis rang nyid skugs par mi byed do/ /bris nas mtshams 'dir thon rung / khyod kyis‘‘bsang khri’’zhes pa bris mi 'dug snyam mod/ mnyam re bzhag nas 'dang re brgyab yod tshe/gong bris thams cad de yin/ don du‘‘bsang khri’’zer ba'i rdza bum lta bu zhig ston rgyu med la/ yod tshe skad cig gis bcags te 'jig par bya chog pa las/nga tshos mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 'di ltar sdug myangs don ga la yod/ de ni phyi nang khor yug gis bsgos shing rang cag gi 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug dang gtam spyod sogs bye brag pa'i go rim khrod ducisastuciglo tshad ltar mi mngon pa'i tshul du gab cing sbas nas yod la/ shes bzhin gyis ma brtag na rang gis kyang ngo mi zin/ nye char grogs po zhig gi sar song ste/ rtsom yig rnams phyogs su bsdus te dpe cha zhig bskrun thub min gyi kha brda byed skabs/ngas sgorno mo med tshul gyi skyid sdug bton pa ma zad/ gzhan la slong 'dod yod tshul lab mod/ grogs pos nga la gsal 'debs tsha bo zhig byas song /ngo ma/ mnyam re ma bzhag na rang gis kyang ngos zin dka' ba la ang /—219—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/slong mo slong mo/ drang mor bshad na/ kho bos sngar yod kyi dran tshul 'di'i rigs dngos su shog ngos su phab pa'i sgul shugs kyang grogs po'i gsal 'debs byas pa des bstsal ba yin la/ de las kyang ngas‘‘bsang khri’’zhes pa ni gzhung lugs skam po zhig min pa'i tshor ba skyes/ nga tshos spro skyid gtong sa'i btsan po nang ma khang nas skags la gri ring dpyangs te rtswa sa rtsod gleng du 'gro mkhan e yin snyam pa dag mthong tshe de dag ni gzhan min te/rang nyid yin la/ nga tshos rgyal sa pe cin mkhar du sbyin bdag 'tshol du 'gro ba'i bla sprul tsho mthong dus de dag kyang gzhan min/ rang nyid kho na'o/ /'di ltar bshad na/ ‘‘bsang khri’’zhes pa'i mi mngon pa'i 'ching thag de khyod kyi blo ngor shar e byung / red de/ ‘‘bsang khri’’ni rang nyid yin la/ rang nyid ni‘‘bsang khri'i’’khol po red/ rgyu mtshan ni rang nyid de dang mnyam du nar son pas so/ / 'dir kho bos rtsom pa po grags can por ha'i tshi'i gsungs shig dran te/ khong gis gsungs don/ ngas rtsom yig gang bris kyang rung sa cha gang du phyin yang rung nam yang rang nyid ni la ting me gling gi yin zhes nan du bstan mod/ ma gzhi rang nyid de'i yin pa brjed 'dug ces pa'o/ /u ru su'i gsar brje'i lo rgyus la bltas na/ skabs der kha spu bzhar pa ni don snying gal chen zhig tu brtsis 'dug cing / nye ba'i char bshad na/na ning a ris u h+phu han rgyal khab kyi thā li pan srid gzhung sogs bslogs pa'i rjes su yul mi rnams kyis skra bzhar khang gi nang du 'tshang kha brgyab te kha spu bzhar par gral bsgrigs pa dag brnyan 'phrin las mthong tshe ‘‘bsang khri’’ni kha spu'i bu ga re re'i nang du zug 'dug la/ gal srid‘‘bsang khri’’ma bshig na rang lus 'ching byed kyi‘‘kha spu’’de'ang bzhar pa'i go skabs bral ba la —220—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/ang snyam la/ u ru su'i lo rgyus pa rnams kyis ji ltar kha spu bzhar pa de'ang don snying gal chen zhig tu smra bar nges shes cung tsam 'drongs/‘‘bsang khri’’brtsigs pa'i go rim de 'dra ring bo zhig yin bzhin du/de bshig pa'i go rim yang skad cig tu 'grub pa zhig min/ don grub rgyal gyi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉la da lta mang shos kyis‘‘gyer 'don snyan ngag’’zer nas snang chung gi nyams 'don mod/ ‘‘bsang khri’’bshig pa'i go rim gyi khrod du bzhag nas bltas na/ snyan ngag de'i rin thang ma gzhi nas rtsom rig rang steng las brgal 'dug ste/ phyi'i rnam pa tsam gyi bcings 'grol de yang lo rabs brgyad cu par byung ba'i don snying can gyi bya ba zhig ci la min/bdun pa/ mjug sdud pa'am yang na nyen kha gzhan zhigang tsho ni lo rgyus kyi khur bo lci ba'i mi rigs shig ste/ 'das song gi mtshar sdug kho nas yid tshims shing sdod/ lhag par du mkhas pa tsho de 'dra tsam du zad/ khong tshos rang gi go gnas dang 'tsho ba'i mchod bkur la mgo gtan nas mi nyog mig snga'i bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi kha'ang 'das zin gyi lo rgyus rig gnas sngog 'don la gtad/ nam yin yang lo rgyus kyi gter kha nas 'das zin rig gnas kyi gser blangs nas rlabs chen yin khul byed pa des bod kyi go gnas mthor 'degs byed 'dod pa ni ji 'dras yid phang ang(〈bod kyi slob gso'i rnam bshad〉2110)/ kho tsho'i khyad chod ni sger sems che zhing gzhan la ngom thub thub byed pa las khyim phug gi mdzod stongs par song ba nam yang mi rtogs/ rtogs 'dod kyang ye nas med/kho bo'i bsam pa zhig la/ rig gnas zer ba'ang tshong las dang gcig pa'i khyad chos ni/ phar tsong tshur nyo mi byed par btsong rkyang rkyang byed —221—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/tshe snyoms por chags pa zhig cis kyang mi yong / da lta bod brgyud nang bstan zer ba 'di'ang dang po rgya gar du dar che ba la/ de ring blo ldan su zhig nang chos sbyong du 'gro zhes rgya gar phyogs su gser bye bre gang re bsnams nas chibs bsgyur ram/ yang lo brgya phrag du ma'i gzhug nas su zhig gis nang chos sbyong du 'gro zer te a rir mi bskyod pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ de 'dra'i 'jigs nyen da snga nas yod 'dug mi shes khul ma byed/ rig gnas 'di yul dus dang bstun mkhas pa zhig byed dgos/ de'i nang don gtso bo zhig ni nga tshos gong nas gleng ba'i gzhan gyi rig gnas kyi nying bcud de tshan rig sogs kyi snying stobs la slob sbyong dang nang 'dren byed dgos/ nang 'dren byed sgang la thob shor gyi dogs pa 'chang ba ni glen rtags tsam las ma 'das te/rig gnas shig la mtshon na rang steng nas phan tshun bsres sbyor gyi nus pa ldan pa red/ nga tshos khi li btung ba yin na ma lobs pa zhig la pho bar gnod pa'i skyon yang yod mod/ sku zhabs sān(byakhu1 'usmokhukhu)lags kyis bstsal ba'i khe phan 'thob 'dod na/ sku zhabs khong gis mtshams mtshams su khros 'khrug gi rnam 'gyur ston pa'ang dang du len dgos pa zhig yin dgos zhes pa'o/ / (〈ṭ+wā⑫r+sā7ko7skrulkero7〉221)de lta'i snying stobs dang ldan pa'i mi rabs ni rgan po dag yin mi srid de/kho pa rnams ni 'gul rgyu med pa'i rdzing bu de'i nang du byung tshar pas red/de lta'i snying stobs dang ldan pa'i mi rabs nga tsho yin srid la min yang srid/gang ltar kho bos nam yang re ba byed pa ni da lta nar son pa'i mi rabs gsar ba dag ste lhag par du 'bring rim slob grwar yod pa'i slob ma rnams red/yin na'ang / blo pham chen po zhig skyes pa ni rang gi spun chung dang kha brda thengs gcig byas pa des glo bur du mun nag gi 'jig rten zhig la bskyur ba'i —222—

bsang khri bshig pa'i nyen kha/'jigs skrag cig sbyin 'ongs/khos nga la 'dri tshig 'di 'dra zhig dris myong ste/ deng dus kyi mkhas pa mi gsum su su red ces pa'o/ / thog mar ngas rnams grangs de 'dra bzo mkhan gyi dge rgan tshor‘‘dad pa’’skyes shing / rang nyid sbyangs pa dman zhing go thos nyung bar yid chad cig skyes ma thag de'i dus shig la rgya yig gi tshags par zhig las mthong ba'i gnas tshul zhig gi dran pa rab rib tsam sos byung / hrang he nas rgya'i rtsom pa po grags can 'gas tshod lta'i tshul du mtho rim slob grwar rgyugs sprod pa'i rgya yig gi rgyugs rar zhugs te mthar skar grangs longs pa gcig kyang mi 'dug zer/nga tshos rnam grangs dang rnam grangs bzos te slob ma tshor‘‘bum pa gang byo'i’’tshul du khrid rjes/ slob ma tshos kyang de las 'da' ba med par rgyugs shog steng ji bzhin du 'bri dgos pa des byis pa'i blo rig nang du gcun pas mi tshad/ gsar gtod kyi 'dod 'dun ci rigs kyang smreg med du gzhom par gdon mi za/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho'i mdun du nam yang tshon dmar po'i smyu gu thogs pa'i‘‘bsang khri’’gcig las gcig mtho ba dag yod de/ yul tsho las rdzong mtho zhing rdzong las kyang zi ling mtho ba'i mchod rten gyi bang rim lta bu zhig chags nas yod do/ /lu'u zhun gyis byis pa skyob rogs zhes pa'i gtam yang bskyar 'dir brjod de da ni rtsom 'di'i mjug sdud la ran zhing / mjug ma bsdus gong du/don dag cig yod pa ni deng dus kyi mkhas pa mi gsum su yin zhes pa'i lan te(spun chung gis nga la 'di ltar bshad)/ tshe tan zhabs drung dang dmu dge bsam gtan/ dung dkar tshang bcas gsum mo/ /—223—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'gro ba mi'i rigs ni che srog gi gshed ma yin nam/zhogs dung /tshe srog ni sdug bsngal lo zhes na ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi gna' bo'i shes rig gang rung gi lta ba las ma 'das/ tshe srog ni bde ba'o zhes na ni tshe srog la nyams myong med pa'i bshad stangs shig red/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gnas shing bde ba'i ngo bo dang yang ldan pa ni da gzod tshe srog ces pa de red/ tshe srog gi bye brag cig yin pa'i cha nas 'gro ba mi rnams kyang rang bzhin de 'dra red/ yin na'ang / chos lugs pa'i bshad tshul ltar sdug bsngal skyed mkhan zhig yod la/ gzhan dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal skyed mkhan zhig yod na ni tag tag 'gro ba mi rang nyid yin pa las gzhan gang yang ma red/ ngas 'di nas thos shing mthong ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi nag nyes sam gdug tsub che ba'i gtam rgyud che chung 'ga' drangs nas klog po khyed nyid kyi bag chags kyi ches gting rim du yod pa'i skyo snang dang / yid mug skyug mer/ sdug bsngal sogs yid la 'khor mi 'dod pa'i sems byung skor zhig la dran gsos te gang zhig gsal 'debs 'dod pa yin/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su/ ni tsi'i gcig —224—

'gro ba mi'i rigs ni tshe srog gi gshed ma yin nam/bsdus btson ra na ma smad gnyis kyang nyes med du btson la bcug yod/ bu mo der mo'i a ma ma gtogs nye mi gcig kyang med/ gshin rje'i gshed ma dang 'grogs pa'i dus yun nang / bu mo'i lhad med kyi rnam 'gyur dang dgod sgras mi rnams la tshe srog gi mdzes sdug bstan cing skyo bas sangs su bcug 'on kyang / ring po ma lon par kho mo'i a ma ni me mda' bcangs pa'i gshed mas khrid de phyir log med par gyur/‘‘a ma9a ma gang la songalha’’don dag ci byung gi ha gtan nas go yi med pa'i bu mo'i snying rje rje'i skad kyi dri ba re re thos tshe mi rnams dbang med mig chu shor/ ‘‘a ma ni a pha btsal du phyin song / kho mo phyir log gi red’’ces pa na bu mo'i ngu mtshams chod 'gromajug mthar/ yo rob 'thab ra nas rgyal kha'i rnga bo che rdung zhing na tsi'i sdig spyod dbang sgyur la rdzogs tshig 'bri sgang du/ gshed ma rnams kyis sngar bzhin gson dur gyis dong chen po zhig brkos yod/ mi rnams kyis 'chi ba zlog mi thub pa shes na'ang zhed snang dang ngu 'bod gang yang med par nag phug ger yod pa'i mda' khung gi gral lam nas sa dong du gshar/ na tsi'i dmag mi zhig gi bu mo chung chung de pang nas gson dur du 'phen grabs su/ kho mos lhad med rnam dag gis mgo bo btegs shing snying du sdug pa'i mig zung ches cher gdangs nas/ ‘‘a khu lags/ khyed kyis nga sa yi gtingad gting la ma bcug na e chog gi a ma phyir yong dus nga btsal nas ma rnyed na mo rang sems sdug gi red’’ces gdong la zhi ba'i 'dzum dang bcas de ltar bshad/bshan pa'i lag zung thong ga nas rengs/ bzod dka'i bred sha thon pa'i bshas ra'i gtam rgyud 'dis dmar —225—

dri bzangathulaba'ismanaljongs/ — gsod kyi gtam rgyud gzhan zhig kyang ngang ngam shugs kyis dran du 'jug ste/gangs dkar ti se'i bsti gnas dang / bod gna' bo'i shes rig gam zhang zhung shes rig gi 'byung khungasad stod mnga' ris kyi sa cha ga ge mo na/gtsod khyu zhig zhed 'drog gis srog la bsdos te rgyug cing byer/ de dag gi rjes 'ded kyi gshed ma ni 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi lcags kyi gcan gzan gtum po zhig dang kho tshor drang thad du kha gtad pa'i mda' khung nag phug ge ba dag red/'bros lam du/ snying rje zhing drod khol ma yal ba'i gtsod phrug dag ga sar g.yas 'gyel g.yon 'gyel du yod cing mig lcibs nyem nyem ngang mde'u shul las bzhur ba'i rang lus kyi zungs khrag dmar po srung ste sdod/ glo bur du/ dmyal ba'i dkan gzar lta bu'i ngam grog ring mo zhig gis ral gri'i nags tshal g.yo 'dra'i rwa tshogs de'i rgyug lam 'phred kyis bcad cing gtubs/ 'tshang kha shig shig gi g.yo 'gul chen po yis‘‘nags tshal’’de char rlung drag tu rgyas pa'i rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin 'phyo/ dus de nyid du/ gtsod dpon rgan pos gdan sa gshag pa lta bu'i ngu rgyangs ring po zhig bos pa na/ shi gson gyi bas mthar 'greng ba'i gtsod khyu'i tshogs skad cig nyid la gshar phreng gnyis su chad/ gshar phreng cig shos ni dpa' ngar brtan pa'i rgan gras rnams red/ skabs der rlabs che zhing gzi brjid ldan pa'i tshe srog gi ngo mtshar rang gshis bar snang du gzugs ris su phab byung ste/ gtsod rgan zhig dkan gzar gyi mtha' kha nas ngam grogs la rbad kyis lding song / de'i mdzes sdug gi gzugs pos bar snang la gzhu ris shig bris te mchong na'ang / ngam grog che drags pas gtsod rgan phar phyin ma song / don dam du/ gtsod rgan de pha mthar slebs 'dod pa —226—

'gro ba mi'i rigs ni tshe srog gi gshed ma yin nam/gtan nas ma red/ gtsod gzhon zhig ngar mchong gcig gis gtsod rgan grog shur la drang 'phyang du lhung song la gtsod gzhon de nye zho ci yang med par ngam grog gi pha mthar son/de ltar/ gtsod rgan dang gtsod gzhon khag gnyis kyis glo snying 'dar ba'i rnam pa de yang dang yang du bskyar ba na lcags las grub pa'i gcan gzan dang rdo las byas pa'i rjes 'ded kyi sems pa rnams kyang ha las shing hrig ger lus/gtsod khyu lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du byer/ tshe srog gi gzi nyams dang mdzes sdug gi ri mo bar snang la phab pa'i gtsod rgan rnams grog zhabs su phyi srog chad de nang srog la thug cing / rwa yi rtse mo sog sog sa sgang 'di'i ches mtho la ches sngo ba'i mkha' dbyings su gtad cing 'bigs snyam byed do/ /gshed ma'i lag gi me mda' rang bzhin gyis sa la lhung / tshe srog de dag 'chi bdag dang gdong thug brgyab kyang gtol med du ma gyur/ tshe srog de mtshar sdug bkrag mdangs bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon ri mo 'bri dus kyang kho tshor de 'dra'i bab brling zhum pa med cing dpa' ngar spobs pa ldan ang / gson pa'i nga rgyal dang mi'i rang bzhin gyi byams brtse'i gzi dpal dag kho tsho'i lus steng du lhun gyis grub cing yongs su rdzogs pas/skar ma'i tshogs rnams kyang mi sems skyi g.ya' ba'i dga' ba chen po 'di la spyan chab mi gtor rang dbang e yod dam/brjid nyams che zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshe srog gi gzi stobs 'di mthong tshe/ gshin rje rgyal po yin kyang gnya' chags mdangs shor du mi 'gro ba'i nges pa ci la yod/de ni/ tshe srog gi ches bla na med pa'i 'tsho gzhes kyi don snying dang rin —227—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/thang red la/de ni/ tshe srog gi ches mtha' mjug gi mnyam sgrog rol dbyangs chen mo'ang red/rnam dag lhad pa med pa'i byams brtse chen po 'di dag gi mdun du/gtum drag brlang spyod la mos pa'i gshed ma'i tshogs kyis rang nyid kyi ngan nyes sdig las dang skyug mer tha shal gyi rang bzhin yongs su mthong zhing /dmar po khrag gi las mkhan rnams ni rlabs chen gyi stobs shugs de yis kun nas ya nga bar byas song / rgyu mtshan ni/ tshe srog 'dzem med du dmar gsod byas pa'i dus mtshungs su/ kho tshos rang nyid kyi sdug 'bras kyang mngon sum myong dgos byung ngo / /‘‘yod pa thams cad lugs mthun yin pas khyab’’ces pa ni nub phyogs kyi mtshan nyid mkhan zhig gi tshad ma'i gsung red/ yin na'ang / mi rnams kyi lugs ldog gi ham pa tshad med kyis mtshan nyid mkhan gyi skad cha'ang nam rgyun chos lugs pa'i skad cha ltar‘‘bka' lung’’zhig tu bsgyur 'gro ba red/khyad par du lag dmar rnams kyi sems ngan 'bar ba'i 'jig rten du/lugs mthun de'ang lugs min du bsgyur 'gro ba 'di lta ste/2001lo'i zla9ba'i tshes11nyin/ 'dzam gling hril bo 'jigs yer ba'i don rkyen ya nga ba zhig byung / nyin der/ o rgyan yul du ldom gzhis chags pa'i pin la tin zer ba gtsos pa'i ngan jus las/ 'jigs skul pa skor zhig gis a ri'i 'grul skyel gnam gru bzhi btsan khrid kyis so so nas wa zhin ton dang nyig yor sa cha'i khang brtsegs mthon po la gdong gtug brgyab pa'i don rkyen bzos/ don rkyen de'i khrod du mi yi tshe srog5000lhag shi rmas thebs shing / dngos dang brgyud de 'dzam gling dpal 'byor la khyong gun —228—

'gro ba mi'i rigs ni tshe srog gi gshed ma yin nam/bgrang gis mi lang ba dang gnod pa blo yis mi dpog pa bzos song /‘‘mdza' mo lags/ nga khyod la dga'’’zhes pa ni 'dzam gling nyo tshong thog khang chen mor gdong gtug brgyab pa'i gnam gru las skyes pa zhig gis kha par brda 'phrin brgyud de bskur ba'i ches mtha' mjug gi 'chi kha'i kha chems red/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs mang che shos ni 'di ltar dga' ba dang brtse ba chen pos 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho gzhes gnang gi yod na'ang / mi la shas shig gis mi yi tshe srog lag cha byas nas mi yi tshe srog gzhan dag tshar gcod dang dmar gsod gtong ba'i las la 'bad kyin yod/tshe srog ni 'gro ba mi'i rtsed chas e red/mi lo mang po'i sngon la/ rma chu'i lho rgyud kyi grong sde zhig tu dmar gsod kyi lo rgyus skyi g.ya' ba zhig byung / pha bu gnyis skabs de'i dbang sgyur pa dang ma mthun pas ri la bros/ dbang sgyur pas kho gnyis jag pa red zer nas 'dzin bzung byas/ blo yul las 'das pa'i gcar rdung skor gsum gyi mjug la kho gnyis kyi gson ske bregs/ lag dmar rnams gson ske bregs pas yid ma tshim par shi bo gnyis kyi mgo bor a long brgyab nas mna' sgyug gnyis kyi 'gul la btags/ khrom du khrid/ thams cad la bstan/mna' sgyug gnyis kyis rang rang gi skyes pa'i mgo bo khur nas khrom lam du gom pa ljid tig gis 'gro/ (thos byung)tshe srog ni 'gro ba mi'i rtsed chas e red/kye ma yi hud—mi'i rang bzhin rtsa ba nas yal cing tshe srog gi rang gshis la rgol ba'i dmar gsod kyi lo rgyus de ni tshe srog rtsed chas byas pa'i dpe gson po zhig ma yin nam/—229—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gong gi gtam rgyud de dag la bltas pas klog pa po khyed kyi sems pa ga 'dra 'dug rang gshis na snying rje dang dga' ba'i sa bon til 'bru tsam yod na gtam rgyud 'di 'dra mthong bas sems khong gzer gyis mi khengs sam/lag dmar rnams la tshe srog rtsed chas su spyod pa'i rgyu mtshan bstar phreng du 'dren rgyu yod kyang srid mod/ rgyu mtshan yod pa tsam gyis ni tshe srog rtsed chas su spyod pa'i gnas lugs su ci la 'gyur/gna' bo'i ke ri se'i mtshan nyid mkhan phi la tho yis khong gis brtsams pa'i〈rdzogs ldan rgyal khab〉tu/ phyi rabs rnams kyi phyir du 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis rang gi skad cha'i khrod kyi‘‘bar do’’dang / ‘‘dmyal ba’’/ ‘‘shi bo’’/ ‘‘mi ro’’zhes pa'i ming tshig 'jigs rung rnams med par bzo rgyu'i re ba bton yod/ yin na'ang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi dngos don 'tsho ba'i khrod byung ba'i dmar gsod kyi lo rgyus re re yis khong gi bsam blo rnams smon 'dun lta bu zhig tu byas song ba ma yin nam/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis rang nyid kyi lo rgyus brjed ga la rung / khyad par du phan tshun sreg gsod 'phrog bcom byas pa'i lo rgyus brjed mi rung ste/ lo rgyus mi brjed pa'i phan yon ni skyo gar bskyar zlos mi byed pa'i ched du red/tshe srog gi skyo gar chen po las tshe srog gi bla med dang gzi brjid rtogs nus la/ tshe srog gi skyo gar chen po las tshe srog gi dka' sdug dang thu med kyang mthong yong /skyo gar gyi gtam rgyud chung chung 'di dag gi zur las kyang nga tshos tshe srog gi rlabs chen hril bo yongs su mthong zhing 'tsho gnas kyi rin thang lhag lus med par rtogs/ gong gi skyo gar gyi gtam rgyud dag las la shas shig chab srid dang 'brel yod cing / la shas shig chos lugs dang 'brel yod/—230—

'gro ba mi'i rigs ni tshe srog gi gshed ma yin nam/yang la shas shig dpal 'byor ram rgyu nor dang 'brel yod pa ltar du/ 'gro ba mi rnams ni srid 'byor rig gsum gang rung nas de dag gi gzhan dbang dang bran du gyur tshe/ skyo gar gyi lo rgyus yang dang bskyar du ston pa la the tshom med pa ltar 'dug gang yang de dag gi phugs su langs yod pa ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi sems na yongs khyab tu yod pa'i ham sems dang / chags sred/ dbang zhen/ bdag 'dzin sogs red/ sems byung de dag ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs thams cad la mnyam por yod cing / spyi sdog nas rang nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur na'ang / der nges shes yang dag ma rnyed tshe/ ral gri so gnyis ma ji bzhin khe yi zhor la nyen yang 'byung ba de lta red/spyir na go la sngo ril 'di'i sgang ni gzhi nas gson shugs rgyas shing skye stobs 'bar ba can dang / bye brag 'gro ba mi'i rigs ni nam yang mdun skyod can dang 'phel rgyas can red pas/ kho tshos nam zhig rang nyid the ba'i 'jig rten 'di'i yod pa thams cad la nges shes yang dag rnyed nas tshe srog gi rin thang dang / tshe srog gi don snying / tshe srog gi rlabs chen yongs su rtogs pa'i rjes la/ phan tshun mdza' zhing zhi ba/ dud khyim gcig gi mi nang ltar gnas pa'i dus shig gzhi nas 'byung nges red/ /(gsal bshad/ rtsom thung 'di ni rgya yig gi tshags par chung chung zhig tu kha yig la〈mdza' mo lags/ nga khyod la dga'〉zhes pa'i rtsom thung legs po zhig yod pa gzhi byas nas bris pa yin)

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag mdangs/dge gnyen/lugs gsar gyi zla10ba'i tshes9nas15bar/ rgyal yongs bod yig tshags par sgrig spyi'i gros tshogs yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul sems kyi nyi zla rdzong nas 'tshogs shing / bsod nams ldan pa'i yul sde de nas dpal yon 'phel ba'i grub 'bras mang tsam thob pa ma zad/sngon chad deb ther ram rtsom yig dag nas de ga'i 'das dang da lta'i byung ba spyi khog tsam las blo ngor mi yong ba'i tshul de/ rdog pa dngos bcag brgyud nas gsang mthil mi nyung ba rnyed thog bye brag zhib cha'i thad nas sngon bas spro ba langs byung / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi‘‘dpal yon rnam gsum’’spel bar mkho ba dang rtsom thung 'di'i shong tshod bcas la gzhig nas/ yul sde de'i rig gnas kyi yang snying ci zhig yin pa'i thad 'di nas dod tsam brjod na 'os snyam/yid smon 'chor sa'i zhing khams de ga na yod srid/1933lor dbyin ji'i rtsom rig mkhan grags chen te/ krang mu si zhir tun gyis brtsams pa'i sgrung gtam ring mo ste〈'dzin ma'i kha mtshams mi snang bar yal ba〉(gter ma tshe ring chos 'phel lags kyi bod 'gyur kha yig ni don sgyur tshul du〈mi yul gyi dag pa'i zhing khams〉zhes bkod yod)zhes pa —232—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/par skrun 'grem spel byas pa dang / skabs de'i 'dzam gling yongs su ches brin pa'i dpe deb cig tu gyur cing / klog pa po rnams la 'dzam gling dmag 'khrug chen po thengs dang po mjug rdzogs nas ma 'gyangs pa tsam dang /dmag 'khrug chen po thengs gnyis pa de ni rkyen tsam thebs na langs par 'gyur ba'i zang zing che ba'i skabs su/ dbyin ji'i don skyong khang gi phyi 'brel dpon po zhig dang kho'i grogs po gsum zing 'khrug langs pa'i pa si khu grong khyer nas bshol 'bral ched du gnam grur bsdad nas pha ka'e si than(bod skad kyi‘‘spar te’’zur chags pa yin la si than ni dbyin skad kyi yul gru'am sa cha'i don yin)gyi pa'e hra war skyod pa'i mkha' lam du/ khong rnams bsdad yod pa'i gnam gru de jag pas bcun shor zhing / sngon du gtan khel byas yod pa'i mkha' lam dang bral pa dang / hi ma la ya rdza rgyud snyeg nas nub nas shar phyogs su dkyog mur byang phyogs su 'phur ba na/ u tshugs dbang du mtha' kun gangs ris bskor zhing rdza rgyud dang gcong rong 'phred gzhung du chags pa'i gsang ba gnyen po'i nyams dang ldan pa'i bod mi 'tsho ba'i sa cha zhig ste‘‘zheng ki li la’’zer sa de la babs/ sgrung las yul sde de ni lha yul zhing khams dang mi yul zhing khams kyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu med par/bde zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i rang dbang dang ldan sa zhig yin tshul sogs bkod yod/ de nas bzung ste zing 'khrug gis rab tu sun pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ sa ming 'di ni ji srid du rtag pa dang bde ba ldan pa dang zhi dul lhing 'jags bcas kyi go don du 'dra bar bsdus pa'i don du chags/skabs de dus dbang drag ldan pa'i〈pu le ten rtsom rig tshig mdzod〉nang /brtsams chos de'i byas rjes las gcig ni dbyin ji'i skad cha nang la‘‘zing bral dga' tshal’’zhes bya ba'i don 'di nges pa'i ming zhig btod byung zer/—233—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ ho le wa'u glog brnyan bzo dpar kung zis dpe deb 'di'i par dbang nyos nas brnyan yol steng du 'char bcug pas/ de ma thag tu 'dzam gling yongs la spel cing khyab pas sngar las rgyun 'byams su gyur pa ma zad/ 'gro ba mis ring du re snyeg byas shing phugs 'dun du snang ba'i zhing khams gang de'i 'dra bsdus tshul du ngos 'dzin byung /krung go'i bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed las don rim bzhin gting zab par phyin pa na/ gangs can mdo khams su yod pa'i bde chen yul gru'i sgo glegs kyang gzhi nas phye ba red/ de dus nas bzung rgyal khab tha dad pa dang sha mdog mi gcig pa'i gnas skor pa dang ma rtsa 'debs pa'i tshong pa sogs gcig la gcig 'brang tshul du kha ba ri bo'i mdo gru 'di la 'tshang kha brgyab yong / kho tsho shel las bzhengs shing dngul gyis shan 'dra'i gangs ri dang /khod yangs shing mar khu'i snum mdangs 'dzin pa'i na gzhung / sman btsun khra chung mig las dwangs shing zhi dul lhing 'jags kyi mtshe'u/ mu mtha' dang bral bar 'khrul ba'i me tog gi rlabs mo/ gsang gnyan gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i chos sde/ mtshar zhing lta na sdug pa'i gcong rong / lhun chags la gshis 'jam pa'i bod dmangs/ bkrag mdangs rnam par 'tsher ba'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas bcas kyis yid dang tshor byed yongs su drangs par brten/ mthong yangs pa'i seng ge phur sogs rgyal khab nas smon par yong ba'i gnas skor pa dag gis yid kyi dungs pa mtshon pa'i gtam 'dra min shor ba las/ 'di ga tan tan dus rabs shig gi ring la mi rnams kyis g.yel med du btsal ba'i‘‘zheng ki li la’’ma yin nam/ 'di ma yin na gzhan zhig yod srid dam/ 'di dang 'di lta bu'i gtam gyi dri bzang rlung du khyer zhing khyab/ ma 'gyangs par‘‘zheng ki li lar’’smon zhing phyogs pa'i yo lang rgyal —234—

yosems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/khab phyi nang kun nas ngang gis langs pa dang / yul sde de ni rgyal khab khag gi gsar 'gyur las rigs dang gnas skor las rigs kyi spro ba che nas che bar 'phel ba'i gleng bya zhig tu gyur song /ji skad du gzhan gyis bstan na rang yang sad 'gyur ba'i dpe ltar/gong gleng gnas tshul la gzhig nas blo ldan dag gis‘‘ming grags thon tshad kyang thon skyed nus shugs kyi char gtogs pa’’shes shing / bod dmangs ngag rgyun gyi do shal las mu tig re 'ga'i nom nyams la'ang rna ba skyor mos pas/'dzam gling du khyab yod pa'i ming der brten na/ bde chen sa cha'i 'phel rgyas ni mkha' ldang rlung dang bstun nas dgung la bstad pa tshul du 'gyur bar rtogs tshun/ yun nan zhing chen srid gzhung srid jus zhib 'jug khang gis mgo drangs thog zhing chen srid gzhung gzhung las thin dang zhing chen gnas skor cus dang bde chen khul gyi tang srid mgo khrid las khungs dang 'brel bcas zhing chen gyi las khungs gzhan dag the ba'i‘‘yun nan zhing chen bde chen khongs zheng ki li la 'byed spel las gzhi'i zhib 'jug tshan chung’’btsugs pa dang / mkhas pa bcu phrag 'ga' shas gdan zhu byas nas rtsom rig dang mi rigs rig pa dang chos lugs rig pa dang skad brda rig pa dang sa gshis sa rgyus rig pa dang bod kyi shes rig sogs rig khag 'dzoms tshod nas zhib 'jug mdzad cing / lo phyed lhag gi yun la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas mthar/ grub 'bras kyi snyan zhu'ang mkhas pas dpyad bsher brgyud nas chog gnang thob/bde ba chen po ldan pa'i gnas mchog de ngos 'dzin rgyu yod srid/1 ‘‘zheng ki li la’’zhes pa'i sa ming 'di bde chen khul bod kyi yul skad —235—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/du‘‘sems kyi nyi zla’’zer ba'i sgra'i zur du chags pa yin la/ bde chen bod mi'i sems su yul 'di ni bde 'gro mi dang lha chen po spyi la dbang zhing /'gro ba mi dang rang byung khams bar mthun par 'tsho ba'i phugs 'dun mngon sum du rtogs thub pa'i zhing khams su go ba 'jags yod de/ rgya rigs kyi‘‘thar ldan kham bu 'byung tshal’’dang nub phyogs rgyal khams kyi‘‘yid bsten dga' tshal’’sogs dang mtshungs chos ldan pa red/2 krang mu si'i sgrung gtam du khod yod pa'i‘‘zheng ki li la’’yi khor yug dang bde chen yul gru'i khor yug ste snod du rung ba yongs su mthun te/'phred rgyug rdza rgyud kyi lto bar gnas pa dang / gangs ri ni brjid chags pa/gcong rong ni zab drags pa/ spang 'dam ni bcud ldan pa/ 'bri chu rdza chu rngul chu sogs gtsang bo chen po gsum ga gshib par 'bab cing gser ldan yul zhes gna' nas bstod pa yin la/ 'di dang 'di bzhin rtags su rung ba'i rigs kun nas ra 'phrod pa red/3 bde chen yul gru 'di ma gtogs‘‘zheng ki li la’’dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i spyi tshogs khor yug gzhan la mdzub mo 'dzugs dka'/ nan zhu dgos pa'i gnas te/ yul sde 'di ni 'dam(yun nan gyi bsdus ming)dang khron(si khron)dang bod(bod ljongs)gsum gyi sbrel mdud a long lta bu dang tshong zong 'du 'grem thon sa gal che ba zhig yin pa'i sbrags su/ mi rigs tha dad bar phan tshun 'gro 'ong dang gzhis spo mtsher bsnol yang yang byung ba'i lam kha lta bu yin pas/ bod kyi rig gnas gtso ba'i mnyam du rgya dang 'jang dang li su'u rigs dang phod mi rigs(phu'u smi zhes pa ma dag pa'i skyon mchis)'be rigs(pa'e rigs zhes pa ma dag pa'i skyon mchis)dang hos rigs bcas mi rigs kyi yul srol can du chad pa'i rig gnas lhan gcig tu —236—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/gnas pa 'di 'dra byung zhing / nang sgos gna' bo'i dus su de las gtsigs chen du 'dzin pa phal cher med pa'i chos lugs rig gnas sna tshogs pa ni 'ja' tshon ji bzhin mdangs mtshar ba de 'dra bod mi 'tsho yul gzhan gyis 'gran zla mi yong / de'i khongs su bod brgyud thub bstan dang ru'u bstan dang gto bstan dang gshen bstan dang ston pa'i bstan pa(ston pa zer sa gshen rab la go zhing 'jang rigs kyi cha lugs su gyur pa'i gshen bstan la ngos 'dzin)dang dbyi si lan sogs 'dus yod/ de yang bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs nang gses su'ang dge lugs dang rnying ma dang bka' rgyud sogs ri bo tha dad pa du ma 'dus yod/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i ngos nas mi rigs mang po dang bstan pa sna mang mthun par gnas shing cha shas 'ga'i thad nas phan tshun 'dres kyang yod pa'i spyi tshogs shig yin pa 'di la'ang bod mi 'tsho yul las 'gran ya gzhan pa yod pa min/4 'grul bzhud kyi thad nas brtags na/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs30bar du bde chen ni zheng ki li la dang 'dra bar/ rta drel dang rkang thang la brten nas phyi logs dang 'brel gtug byed pa yin la/ phyi gling pa'i bde chen du lus pa'i shul rjes mang tsam yod pa'ang sgrung gtam du bkod pa dang mthun/ 5 sgrung gtam du bkod pa'i bod brgyud sangs rgyas pa'i dgon sde'i dpe gzhi de'ang bde chen du mngon par gsal ba red/ bde chen khongs su gnas pa'i nags kar dgon pa dang don 'grub gling dgon pa dag sgrung gtam gyis ngos bzung ba'i dus rabs de'i snga phyir gzhi khyon che la gsog nom mang ba dang / grwa pa dang jo mo dgon pa gcig tu lhan bzhugs kyi srol yod pa dang / tshags zhib mos btab pa'i me tog skyed tshal dang bkod yag cing —237—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/khu sim pa'i lhas ra sogs zheng ki li la'i chos sde dang kha 'grig so 'grig red/6 nub phyogs pas a she ya gling gtsos pa'i yul gru chen po 'di la shar phyogs zer la/ shar phyogs yul gru'i mkhas pas brtsams chos su bkod pa'i bde chen yul sde de krang mu si zhir tun gyis rtsom du bkod pa dang yang ha cang mtshungs/ chin gong ma kong zha'u'i skabs kyi sa dam khongs gtogs can khron pa yang li kro yis brtsams pa'i〈so nam spyis gnyer sde ba'i zin bris〉su/ yul sde de‘‘mnga' khongs(skabs de'i chin rgyal rabs kyi dbang du ngos bzung ba yin)phyi na gnas shing / dmangs gshis bab chags pa dang /g.yo rdzu la mi phyogs pas/ wa'u lin rdza 'dabs kyi kham bu 'byung tshal dang mtshungs par snang’’zhes pa dang / 1933lor shar phyogs pa'i mkhas ma le'u man chin gyis〈khams dbus su 'khor los bskyod pa'i zin bris kyi mthud cha〉nang bkod pa ste/ ‘‘sa dam nas nub phyogs su skyod par nyin gsum phyin rjes/ thol gyis bde thang mtha' yas pa zhig snang ba dang / rlung kha 'jam la zla zhal dwangs/ spang thang gnam gyi kha mtshams bar brkyangs shing /steng du me tog ser po brgyan pa dang / nor khyu lug khyus bkang ba/ nags kyis phyogs bzhir yol ba btegs pa zhig snang zhing / yang phyin pa na/rdzong mkhar bkod legs shing / khyim thab kyi du ba snang tsam ste/ wa'u lin nya ba kham bu 'byung ba'i drang srong gnas su ma bsam par tshud pa dang 'khu ba zhig tu snang /’’7 lugs gsar ltar brtsis na/ dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil char tho bod btsan po'i dmag sdes rgyal thang sogs bzung ba na/ yul gyi chags dbyibs mdzes la sa gshin po yin par gzhig ste/ de ni bde mchog chen po'i gdan sar 'dod cing / phyi rabs rdzong mkhar chags sa'i lho nas byang —238—

phasems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/la bltas pa'i dkyil thig steng nas‘‘nyin yul ba’’'am‘‘nyi pang rdzong’’dang /(sngon gyi rgya 'gyur du‘‘ri ka'ung khrin’’te‘‘nyi 'od rdzong’’zhes pa'i don yin)byang gi rus sbal sgang du‘‘byang dkar ba’’'am‘‘rdo khog rdzong’’ste(brag dkar po yin pas zla ba'i 'dra bsdus su btang nas rgya 'gyur du‘‘yo ka'ung khrin’’te‘‘zla 'od rdzong’’gi don yin)bskrun pa red/ de ni tan tan grags che ba'i nyi zla rdzong gi 'byung khungs yin nges/ ta min hung kri(hung kri zhes pa rgyas par bskyangs pa la go)khri lo bcu gnyis par(1499)'jang sa dam mu gza' rgyal pos rgyal thang bzung tshun gyi dus yun nges can nang rdzong de gnyis slar gso yang mdzad myong / nyi zla la dad 'dun ldan pa ni gna' rabs bod mi'i rang byung dngos por dad pa'i srol zhig yin la/ chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa'i brgyud rim du/ mgur dang glu dang mchid(gtam)dang gzhas dang srid pa 'ded pa sogs su nyi zla'i dad 'dun yang dang yang du ngag gi me tog tu sgron pa'i dpe ni bgrang las 'das pa yod/ des na rdzong la ltos nas byang dkar ba'am rdo khog rdzong de zla ba'i dod du sbyarartecing / gna' gzhas su rang gi yul sde de’’sems kyi nyi zla ’’la bstod pa'i go don dang ni rgyal thang gi gna' bo'i yul skad kyi sgra ji bzhin mtshungs pa red /dngos srid yul sde zhig dang rtog snang gi zhing khams shig ngo bo gcig tu sbyar ba de'i sgyu stsal gyi grul tshul la dpyad na/ krang mu si'i nyams myong du thebs pa'i bde ba chen po ldan zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i yul sde des khong nyid kyi yid drangs pa dang gcig bod ma'i chos sde dang dmangs khrod sogs su byang phyogs sham bha la'i chos sgrung de khyab yod pa dang / chos sgrung nang brjod pa'i zhing khams de bod brgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bde ldan 'dun pa dang bod dmangs kyi bde ldan 'dun pa gcig gyur byung ba'i 'dra bsdus shig —239—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/yin pa rtogs sla ba dang / de phyir krang mu si la myong rtogs gnyis nas shan bzos pas/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi snang khams nas gcig gyur btang yod/sham bha la'i shan thebs 'dug pa de brjod bya'i thad nas mngon gsal thon yod par ma zad/ gnam gru gang de jag pas bcun shor zhing nub phyogs nas shar phyogs dang shar phyogs nas yang byang du 'phur ba'i mkha' lam thad nas kyang gsal bshad byung yod pa dang gnyis/ krang mu si lta bu'i phyi gling pa'i snang ngor bod mis bde ldan du 'dod pa'i byang phyogs sham bha la dang bde chen yul mis rang gis pha sa pha yul de sems kyi nyi zla la bstod pa 'di kun nas gcig 'dra ma yin nam/ 'dzam gling dmag 'khrug chen po snga mur phyi langs 'byung nye ba dang / don dam du ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas byung nas bzo las rgyu cha 'phrog rtsod dang btsong sa'i tshong khrom rgya bskyed dgos pa'i dbang du gyur cing / phyi nyams su rgyal khab bam mi rigs bar gyi 'thab rtsod dang rig gnas sam chos lugs grub mtha' bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyis sun pa bskur ba'i mi rnams la mtshon na/ ye shu chos sgrung du brjod pa'i‘‘yid bsten dga' tshal’’ni rtog snang gi sgrung tsam las/ 'jig rten 'di na srid pa ni sems kyi nyi zla 'di yin la/ 'di ni sham bha la ste mi rigs mang yang mthun pa dang / grub mtha' mang yang 'dum par 'tsho ba'i cha nas yid du 'ongs pa zhig ci la min/ gzhi 'di nas yul de'i bod mi'i 'tsho stangs dang 'dun pa/sgrung gtam pa kho nyid kyi legs nyes gnyi ga'i nyams myong dang 'dun pa/spyir 'dzam gling yongs kyi sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i mi rnams kyi tshor snang dang 'dun pa/ 'di dag gcig la gcig ltos dang phan tshun 'grig por btang nas sgyu stsal snang khams de bkod pa red/ gal te mi rigs tha dad dang grub mtha' tha dad bar mthun par 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa 'di 'dra zhig —240—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/brjod 'dod kyang / 'tsho ba dngos nas don snying 'di 'dra ldan pa'i rten sa zhig ma rnyed na/ sgrung gtam de 'dra zhig sgom mi thub pa red/ gal te bod mi'i ngag rgyun gyi byang phyogs sham bha la'i chos sgrung nang bzhin bde ldan zhing khams kyi rtog snang yid 'gug pa de ni brjod 'dod kyang / dngos srid 'tsho ba las 'dun pa de'i bla srog bcol sa'i‘‘bla gnas’’nyams dang ldan pa zhig ma rnyed na/ chos sgrung la nges pa'i mag mog gi rang gshis de zhib cha'am 'tsho ba'i bro ba dang ldan par brjod mi nus/ des na 'tsho ba dngos kyi ma gzhi'i rnam pa de 'dra zhig bde chen nas ma gtogs myong snang du 'gyur thabs mi yong ba red/9 bde chen khongs kyi gnas chen kha ba dkar po'i ngag rgyun dang sbyar nas go ba len rgyu yod pa red/ gangs ri de nyid bde mchog chen po'i gnas gal chen du ngos 'dzin pa dang / rang byon lha chen po'i dkyil 'khor du ngos 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs sras dang yul gru de'i ches gtsigs che ba'i phyogs skyong bcas la'ang ngos 'dzin pa yin/ tshul 'di mi nyung shas shig gi 'dod pa dang dus yun thung ngu zhig gi dmangs sems min tshod de/ deng sang yang mtha' 'khor gyi spun zla mi rigs so so dang / yul gru gzhan nas yong ba'i 'grul bzhud pa dang / tha na rgyal khab gzhan dang rig gnas dar srol gzhan pa can nam bstan pa'i dad rlom rtsa ba nas mi gcig pa'i mgron po rnams kyis kyang mthong ba tsam gyis yid drangs mi 'gro ba phal cher med pa red/ 1992lo'i〈bzo pa'i nyin re'i tshags par〉gyi gsar 'god pa ste hi cin wu dang yun ring tshags par gyi rtsom sgrig las 'gan khur ba'i bza' zla hong tig mis rnam gnyis bde chen la yong thengs bzhi ba'i skabs der/ kha ba dkar po'i ri rtse nas nyi zla brtsegs ma'i 'od khyim mtshar —241—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/po mthong ba de 'dra par du blangs pa dang / phyis su bod mi 'tsho yul gyi mchod rten rtse dang dgon pa'i rtsig ngos dang grong mi'i gzhis ka sogs su de 'dra'i ri mo dang bzhengs bkod gang mang mthong ba ma zad/ khong khyo shug gangs ri'i 'dabs kyi gnas chen te chu shel gnasartsokyi logs su yod pa'i bod khyim zhig gi nyis thog gi mchod khang du mi rabs mang por brgyud pa'i nyi zla brtsegs ma'i gzugs dbyibs kyi mchod chas shig la mjal zhing / lo tsā byed mi'i yag po mi 'khyongs pas na/ mchod chas de'i ming dang go don gyi skor gsal cha ma thob kyang / lha pas lha 'bab pa'i cho ga'i skabs su mchod chas de mgo thog tu sgron rgyu yin tshul tsam go brda 'phrod yod/ gzhi 'di nas khong khyo shug gnyis nas blos dpags tshul gyis 'dod pa ste/ kha ba dkar po'i rtse mo nas nyi zla brtsegs ma'i 'od khyim shar ba de 'dra mthong dkon yang /gna' bo'i dus su las dbang can la lar mthong skal ldan yod shas che ba red/bde chen rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa sprul sku'am dge bshes nyi ma lags kyis gsungs pa ste/ ngo mtshar che ba'i snang brnyan 'di lta bu khong gis kyang mthong myong tshul dang / de ni skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs 'tshogs pa'i snga lo der mthong ba dang / 'dra par steng du blangs pa 'di 'dra gsal bo zhig min pas na/ kho bo'i mig 'phrul yin nam snyam nas gzhan la ma 'ur zer/ skabs der bde chen khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang thub bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso bzhes pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin chos 'phel lags na re/ gsang bsngags kyi dgongs pa ltar na/ kha ba dkar po'i rab 'phags snang brnyan 'di dang 'di lta bu ni lo ngo stong phrag re'i nang lan re gnyis tsam las mngon sum du snang ba min tshul dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis kha ba dkar po'i gnas su gter —242—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/ma 'dra min gnang yod cing / las dbang can la rten 'brel 'grig srid pa yin tshul gsungs pa las/ phyogs skyong 'di nyid kyis bskyangs yod pa'i yul gru 'di'i bsod nams kyi che ba dang khyad chos kyi zur tsam rtogs thub pa red/ gong gleng rgyu mtshan de dag dbang du los yin te/ lugs gsar gyi1996lo'i zla12par yun nan zhing chen srid gzhung gis‘‘zheng ki li la’’bya bar phyogs mang po nas dpyad pa na/ yun nan khongs de'i rgyal thang dkyil snying du bzung rung ba'i bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul yin pa thag chod pa dang / 1997lo'i zla9pa'i tshes14nyin yun nan zhing chen srid gzhung gis bde chen khul du gsar 'gyur khyab spel tshogs 'du bsdus shing / 'dzam gling yongs la dus rabs phyed lhag ring mi rnams kyis btsal ba'i‘‘sems kyi nyi zla’’zer sa de bde chen du nges 'dug tshul bsgrags/ de'i mur2001lo'i zla10bar rgyal thang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rgyal khab dmangs srid pu'u dang mnga' ras dpog 'god cus la rgyal thang rdzong gi rdzong ming sems kyi nyi zla la bsgyur rgyu skor snyan 'bul byas pa dang / 2001lo'i zla ba12pa'i tshes17nyin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rgyal thang rdzong gi ming de sems kyi nyi zlar sgyur rgyu'i chog gnang bkod pa dang / 2002lo'i zla5ba'i tshes5—10bar rdzong ming brje ba'i mdzad sgo rgya chen po spel/‘‘sems kyi nyi zla’’bya ba'i yul gru de'i bkrag mdangs kyi ngo bo bzung zhing khyab gdal du btang nas sngon las mang ba'i mi la bde ldan bskal ba bskrun rgyu ni rang re'i 'os 'gan du gyur yod/ sems kyi nyi zla'i rig gnas la khyad 'phags don snying yod srid de/ mi'i spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo de rig gnas kyi steng du nges pa yin la/ rig gnas ni mi'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung snod bcud bar gyi 'brel ba dang / mi sger dang mi'i sde tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba/ mi'i —243—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sde tshogs dang sde tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba/ mi rnams dang mi'i blo yul du gyur ba'i chos can gyi 'brel ba'i dbang du ngos 'dzin pa'i deng srol ltar na/ltos bcas kyis 'bur du thon pa'i sems kyi nyi zla'i rig gnas kyi khyad chos de ni chos lugs grub mtha' sna mang 'cham mthun ngang gnas pa dang / mi rigs mang po 'cham mthun ngang gnas pa/ mi'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi skye rgu 'cham mthun ngang gnas pa de lags/ de yang / sems kyi nyi zla'i rig gnas dang gna' bo'i rgya yig tu khod pa'i wa'u lin rdza 'dabs kyi‘‘thar ldan kham bu 'byung tshal’’bar phan tshun 'dra ba'i chos yod kyang / sgrung de dag ni rtog snang gi zhing khams tsam du zad/ bod kyi chos sgrung du brjod pa'i byang phyogs sham bha la dang krang mu su'i snang ngor gyur ba'i sems kyi nyi zla bar na'ang mthun sa mang ba'i dbang du〈'dzin ma'i kha mtshams mi snang bar yal ba〉nang du ngo bo gcig tu btang yod kyang / bsam bzhin du gral rim ldan pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod dang ni g.yol thabs tshul du btang yod/don dam du sems kyi nyi zla ni 'jig rten du srid cing phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba'i don dang ldan pa'i yul sde zhig yin pas/ gral rim ldan la g.yo sgyu dang 'thab rtsod ldan pa'i spyi tshogs kyi bden pa ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i dbang du nyid kyi rig gnas don snying ngos gzung dgos pa red/dang po/ spyi tshogs dang rang byung snod bcud bar phan tshun mthun pa'i rig gnas khrad chos 'jin 'dug sems kyi nyi zla'i mnga' khongs de 'phred rgyug rdza rgyud kyi gnas te/ ri bo mang la ri tshogs khrod du gter mang ba dang / chu bo mang la chu rgyun dag tu gser bzhur ba/ mnga' ras kyi93lkori klung du gtogs pa dang / ches mtho sa mtsho ngos las mus5545yin la ches dma' sa mus1503yin/ nub —244—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/byang mtho la shar lho dma'/ spyir sa mtho yang sa'i go la'i spun thig thebs sa dma' ba dang / gnam gshis ni sa babs je mthor song bar bstun/rim pa bzhin gcong rong tsha gsham khul dang ri sa drod 'jam khul dang ri sa 'jam pa'i khul dang ri sa grang 'jam khul dang ri sa grang gsham khul dang ri sa grang ngar khul te/ gnam gshis chags rgyud drug tu dbye rgyu yod/gnam gshis chags rgyud kyi spyi'i rnam pa ni zheng du yangs la yug tu dog pas na/ ‘‘ri bo gcig nas dus bzhi snang 'gyur la/ le dbar re rer nam zla mi gcig pa/’’zhes bya rung la bzhengs dbyibs kyi gnam gshis mngon par gsal/ de yang / rdza ri gzar la gcong rong zab pa dang / nags klong mthug la spang thang yangs pa'i yul khod du/ rtsi shing dang srog chags kyi khyab tshul ni rnam pa mang la 'khrug cha ldan pa yin/ de 'dra'i dbang du mi rnams ni yul gru de ga nas mkho ba len yang spyod mkhas pa/ dka' tshegs che yang brtson pa mi lhod pa/ 'jigs dngangs tshor yang dpa' ngar mi zhum pa/dgos pa thob kyang drin lan gzo shes pa bcas kyi tshul du 'tsho zhing / 'di ni rang bzhin du grub pa'i las dbang lta bu zhig tu gyur yod/ gzhi de nas byung ba'i rig gnas ni rang byung khams la brtsi 'jog dang re 'dun bcol ba dang 'dzems par bya ba bcas kyi bsam blo byung shin tu snga la deng sang yang rgyun bskyangs yod pa zhig tu snang / de 'dra'i rig gnas nang du lha 'dre klu btsan lta bu'i gdod ma'i rig gnas su gtogs pa yod cing / 'khor ba mi rtag pas na len mkhas chog shes sam gzhan phan bsam pa lta bu'i bar bskal gyi rig gnas yang 'dus yod/ de ma tshad 'gro ba mi la yod pa sa'i go la 'di gcig pu ste/ mi ni ji srid du rang byung khams la ma brten na bde ba mi 'thob phyir/ rang byung ci rigs la brtsi 'jog byed pa de rdon dam du mi'i —245—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'byung 'gyur la brtsi 'jog byas par nges pa dang / mi'i rigs kyang 'gro ba'am srog chags yin pa'i cha nas gzhan dang 'dra mnyam du gnas dgos kyi/rang gi gnas skal las thal che na/ 'gro ba mis rang nyid min log tu bskrad pa yin pas/ spyi tshogs dang rang byung snod bcud bar 'cham mthun ngang 'tsho ba ni mi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i 'os 'gan yin pa lta bu deng rabs rig gnas kyi srog kyang ldan pa red/ rig gnas 'di 'dra ba la mi rnams so sor thob pa'i go rtogs tshad mnyam pa zhig ma yin yang / gang zhig gdod ma'i rmongs dad du nges pas rjes lus su ngos bzung nas dgag par bya ba ma yin gyi/ rang re'i rig gnas kyi bskal ba nges can zhig gi shul bskyur yin pa dang / khungs bcol sa'i dad rlom gyi gzhi ma gcig pa tsam las mi la da lta yin yang rang 'doms kyi rin thang dang rig gnas kyi rin thang dang gnas skor dpal 'byor gyi rin thang bcas ldan zhing / dgos pa mi nyung ba yod pas gces 'dzin gyi 'du shes ldan pa red/ gang zhig chos lugs su nges pas bag 'khums kyi gshis dang ldan par 'dod pa dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi rkyen ngan du ngos bzung nas dgag par bya ba ma yin gyi/ shes rig bskal bar byung ba'i chos lugs nyid gnas shing 'phel ba'i rgyu rkyen bzhi ste/ rang byung khams kyi gsang mthil ma brtol ba dang / spyi tshogs sdug bsngal gyi gsang mthil ma brtol ba/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi 'phel tshad da rung dma' ba/ sems can la med thabs mi yong ba'i re 'dun bcol sa dgos pa sogs mi'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi brgyud rim dang yun ring 'grogs srid pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas par/ rin thang rtogs shing gces 'dzin gyi 'du shes ldan 'dug pa red/ spyir rig gnas grub tshul gyi che khag cig mi'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung —246—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/khams kyi 'brel ba'i dbang du mi rnams kyi blo ngor gyur ba ngos bzung ba zhig yin la/ dus rabs so so'i rig gnas khor yug mi gcig pa'i dbang du ngos bzung tshul la 'phel rim gyi khyad par yod pa tsam lags/ des na rig gnas 'phel rim gyi che khag dbang du gang zhig skabs bab kyi srog don du nges pa dang / gang zhig skabs bab dgos mkhor bstun nas 'os shing 'tsham par bed spyod pa ni rig gnas 'phel rgyas brgyud rim gyi g.yol thabs med pa'i las 'gan zhig yin la nor 'khrul yang 'byung sla ba'i gnas yin pas/sems kyi nyi zla yul gru'i rig gnas su 'di'i thad nas nyams myong thob pa la'ang rin thang mi dman pa red/gnyis pa/ gu yangs kyi blo 'dun dang nang du sems phyogs pa'i blo 'dun ldan pa'i rig gnas khyad chos 'dzin 'dugasems kyi nyi zla yul gru'i mi rigs dang mi rigs bar/ mi sger dang sde tshogs bar/ sde tshogs dang sde tshogs bar/ nang la sems phyogs shing chig sgril yong bar do snang byed pa'i kun spyod rgyun bskyangs yod pa yin/ 'di 'dra yong ba la tshugs zab pa'i lo rgyus rting gzhi zhig yod cing / de gar 'tsho ba'i bod dang 'jang dang li su'u dang phod mi dang 'ape dang dbyis sogs mi rigs dag ni rgya bod skad rgyud khongs kyi bod 'bar skad tshogs su gtogs pa dang / yig srol btod snga ba'i rgya yig tu deng nas yar ded pa'i mi lo bzhi stong nas nyis stong bar mi rigs de dag gna' bo'i lde cha'ang(sgra tsam)tsho khag gi tshogs sgril nas gyes yong ba yin tshul brjod pa dang / mi rigs de dag rang rang gi gna' sgrung las kyang 'byung khungs rus khungs gcig nas ji ltar gyes tshul mang du brjod kyi yod/ lo rgyus steng du bod dang 'jang gnyis deng gi 'dam(yun nan)dang khron(si khron)dang bod(bod ljongs)bcas kyi —247—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sa mtshams logs phyi nang nas tshwa mtsho brtsad nas dmag 'khrug lan mang po byas tshul deb ther dang ge sar mgur sgrung lta bu na rgyas bsdus 'dra min 'byung ba las/ dmag 'thab skabs kyang phar 'gro tshur 'ong rgyun ma chad pa dang /dgra zla la'ang snying thag pa nas de'i che ba khas len pa dang / zing 'khrug rdzogs rjes sngon bas kyang nye du'i 'brel ba je dam du song tshul sogs nas shes gsal bzhin/ deng sang bar du rigs rus dang rig gnas thad khyed khongs nga dang nga'i khongs khyed kyi tshul du gnas/ srol rgyun de 'dra'i rmang gzhi steng bde chen yul sde ni gna' bo'i lo ngo chig stong yan nas bzung ste shar gyi ja lam mam deng sang gna' bo'i ja rta tshong lam zer ba'i lam kha yin pa dang / rgya bod rig gnas sam nang logs sa khul gyi mi rigs khag gi rig dpal dang bod mi 'tsho ba'i gzhongs mthon po'i rig dpal de gar 'dres pa yin srid/ lo rgyus su bde chen yul sde ni mi rigs mang tsam dang rgyal rabs mang tsam gyi khongs gtogs su gyur myong bas/ rig gnas 'phel rgyun du gna' rgyun ma shor ba dang gsar ba spel thub pa'i khor yug cha rkyen zhig ldan 'dug nye rabs su yo rob gling dang a she ya lho ma'i bstan pa spel mi'i rgyud pa'ang lus yod pas/ rigs rus dang rig gnas gnyis nas bshad kyang / sngon bas rgyal spyi can du 'gyur bar rmang gzhi bting 'dug spyir chos lugs rig gnas la gzhan pa 'phud skrod kyi gshis ka ldan pa dang / pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes zab pa zhig yin srid/ 'on te sa rgya che rgyu med pa'i bde chen yul gru der/ rang sa nas 'phel yong ba'i chos lugs rig gnas yod thog krung go'i nang logs sa khul nas spel yong ba dang / tha na rgyal khab phyi nas spel yod pa'i chos lugs rig gnas sna tshogs 'dus yod pa ma zad/ tsho drug gi ye shu lha khang du dad ldan gcig d+ngha248—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/gis ye shu'i bstan pa dang bod rgyud thub bstan sbrags mar bsten pa'i mtshar 'os gnas tshul yod pa dang / khri 'bum dgon pa nang du thub bstan dang gto bstan dang gzhi bdag la dad pa dang rmu rdo'i dad pa lhan 'dus byung ba'i gnas tshul yod la/ gzhan da rung grwa pa dang jo mo dgon pa gcig tu sgrub sbyong byed pa'i gnasu tshul yang yod pa red/ yul mi rnams kyis phan tshun gu yangs byed cing 'grig mthun yong bar do snang byed pa'i blo 'dun de'i rten gzhi ci zhe na/ rang sa'i mi rigs gzhan dag dang bsdur na/ bod kyi rig gnas dang bod rgyud thub bstan ni gzhan pa las drag pa'i go gnas zin yod/phyi'i yong mi rigs dang bsdur na/ mi 'bor thad nas bod mi ltos bcas kyis mang ba dang / thon skyed byed stangs sam 'tsho ba rol stangs thad nas bod srol drag pas gtso bo'i go sa zin yod/ rgyu mtshan bsnyegs na/ bod kyi thon skyed byed stangs dang 'tsho ba rol stangs thad nas snga mo zhig nas gzhan gyi lag cha bsdu len byas nas rgyun 'dzin dang dar bar spel thub song ba dang gcig rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyang tshong lam gyi lam kha yin pa'i cha nas yul sde gzhan gyi rig gnas sdud len thub song ba dang gnyis/ gzhi de nas bskal ba ya thog gi grub 'bras kyang ma dor bar nyar tshags rgyun bskyangs thub song phyir/ phun sum tshogs par snang la kun gyis yid smon srid pa dang gsum/ dper na rdza chas dang shing chas kyi bzo rtsal dang srol rgyun gyi dkar chu'i g.yos sbyor la sogs srol bzang ma nyams la thabs gsar ba'ang yang yang spyad pas na/ bed spyod par ran la gnas skor thad nas kyang rgyan zhig tu gyur yod/ de yang / gtso bos phal bar brtsi 'jog dang phan tshun brtsis pas/ phan tshun rang mir 'jog pa dang bzhi/ rig gnas sam chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs tsam du ma bltas par/ bed spyod ji 'dra yong bar —249—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gtsigs che bas/ mi rnams kyi sems kyang rang shugs kyis nang la phyogs pa dang lnga lags/ gzhi de nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur brgyud nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs su zhugs tshun/ chab srid rig gnas kyi bla srog ni mar khe si ring lugs kyis bzung zhing / mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba sngon bsu 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril dang rogs res kyi phyogs su 'phel/'on te1958lo'i tshun gyi dus yun nges can nang / nang sgos lo bcu'i‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po’’brgyud / g.yon lhung thal che ba'i spyi tshogs khor yug tu mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas spyi dang skad yig slob sbyong sogs thad nas ma rung ba'i chag sgo che tsam byung bas/ log lam du shor ba deng sang yang ngan mtha' rnyed srid/ yin na'ang dpal 'byor thad kyi 'dzugs skrun lte bar bzung ba dang bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi srid jus lag bstar byas tshun/dpal 'byor gong spel dang rig gnas gong spel la sngon med du brtson pa skyed pa'i skabs su bab pas/ lo rgyus las chags byung zhing rgyun kyang ma chad pa'i srol rgyun yag po la rjes dpags kyi ngos zin thob par brten/ sngon pas go rtogs ldan zhing ma skul rang 'gul gyis dar rgyas su gtong bzhin yod/gsum pa/ mi rigs kyi nges pa dang rnam mang gi nges pa ldan pa'i rig gnas khrad chos 'dzin 'dugabade chen yul gru'i da yod rig gnas kyi ngo bo ci zhe na/ srid du gzhig na/ bod rigs gtsos pa'i nye du mi rigs kyi tshogs sgril zhig gi rig gnas srol rgyun nang / bran g.yog spyi tshogs dang de'i yan gyi gdod ma'i bskal bar chags pa'i rig gnas kyi lhag 'phro dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs lam lugs su chags pa'i rig gnas kyi phyi rabs la 'phrod pa'i cha dang /spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs lam lugs su chags pa'i rig gnas bcas —250—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/'dus yod cing / lo rgyus 'phel rim las srol rgyun du gyur pa'i mi rigs kyi nges pa dang / nye du mi rigs kyi khyad par dang 'phel bskal gyi khyad par dbang du gyur pa'i rnam mang gi nges pa mthun sbyor thon yod/ zheng du gzhig na/ bod rigs gtsos pa'i nye du mi rigs kyi tshogs sgril dang / rgya rigs kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig dang gto bstan dang bzo rtsal 'ga' las grub pa'i rig gnas dang / hos rigs kyi dbyi si lan bstan pa dang tshong gnyer goms srol sogs kyi rig gnas dang / phyi gling pa'i ye shu'i bstan pa dang tshong gnyer goms srol bcas so sor mi rigs kyi nges pa ldan la/ de dag 'dus gyur nas rnam mang gi nges pa can gyi khyad chos grub cing 'cham mthun thon yod/ 'di ltar phyogs gnyis nas mi rigs kyi nges pa dang rnam mang gi nges pa grub thog bcos bsgrur sgo 'byed kyi rgyal jus chen lag po bstar byas tshun/ mi rigs so sos rang rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i gos rgyan dang g.yos sbyor dang bzhengs brtsigs dang zhabs bro dang glu gar dang bkur srol sogs la sngon bas gtsigs 'dzin byed kyin yod pa ma zad/ yul gru gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khab gzhan gyi sngon thon shes bya dang lag rtsal yo byad sna tshogs dang 'tsho ba rol stangs gces shos sogs yul sde rang gi dgos mkho ltar bsdu len bed spyod byed pa'i mu la/ sngon bas gzhi khyon che la phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang mthun sbyor byed bzhin mchis/ dper na/ bod kyi cha lugs mngon par thon la sgrig chas sogs deng rabs kyi tshan rtsal spyad pa'i skar rtags yan gyi khyim tshang gis gnyer ba'i mgron khang rigs rdzong thog tsam du sum cu lhag yod pa dang / chu tshan gyi chu mig mang ba dang de dag nas khrus rgyag pa'i goms srol yod pa'i gzhi nas/ chu tshan gyi rkyal rdzing bzos pa dang brag khung bed spyad nas rang byung rlangs khrus gnyer pa lta bu deng rabs kyi sgrig —251—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/chas ldan pa'i chu tshan khrus rdzang du ma 'byed spel byas yod/ spyir mi rigs kyi nges pa dang rnam mang gi nges pa de lo rgyus las rang bzhin gyis chags yong ba la rjes dpags kyi go rtogs ldan pas na/ bsam bzhin du bed spyod dang sngon bas rkyen bzang mang po 'dus bcug nas sngon thon can dang khyad chos mngon gsal dod por gtong bzhin 'dugasems kyi nyi zla'i rig gnas la 'phel rgyas mdun lam rgya che ba yod srid de/srol rgyun ring la mngon par gsal ba'i‘‘rang mdog’’rgyun skyong gong spel dang 'di la 'tsham pa'i‘‘gzhan mdog’’bsdu len bed spyod byed pa'i mnyam du/srol rgyun gyi nges pa dang gsar gtod kyi nges pa 'cham mthun yong bar brtson pa'i tshul 'di la gzhig na/ sems kyi nyi zla yul sder yid du 'ong ba'i 'phel rgyas mdun lam yod pa shes thub pa yin/ rang byung snod bcud dang yul gyi chags dbyibs dbang du dpyad na/ sems kyi nyi zla ni 'bri chu rdza chu rngul chu gsum gyi gnyer srub ma lag ces pa'i nar mo yug tu snang ba'i sa dbyibs su gnas pas/ gter du grub pa'i cha rkyen shin tu bzang / shes zin pa la gser dang dngul dang zangs dang lcags dang zha nye dang chu shel dang rdo bal dang ka ma ru dang sol smug dang 'dam sol sogs gter sna25yod pa dang /gter kha dang gter du gyur yod sa120longs shing / de'i nang du bsher nas gsal cha byung ba'i gter mal che shos1dang 'bring gras5dang chung gras15yod pa red/ mnga' khongs su 'bri chu ma the na'ang chu rgyun che chung244yod cing / yongs su 'bri chu'i ma lag tu gtogs pa red/ lo mang po'i ring brtags pa ltar na/ ma mnyam 'bab tshad mus dpang bzhi grig ma3 7nas4 37(skar cha can gyi chu rgyun rim pa dang po'i gras su tshud pa la13yod cing / spyi'i ring tshad spyi le545yod pa dang / 'bab yul gyi rgya —252—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma80065 9yod pa yin/ mnga' khongs su mtsho mo'am mtshe'u298yod cing / rgya khyon mus bcu yan longs pa la30lhag yod pa dang / mngon par che la grags kyang che ba la nags mtsho dang bas mtha' mtsho dang zho stod mtsho sogs yod pa yin/ sa khar thon tshad mus dpang bzhi grig ma0 5(skar cha yan gyi chu grang chu mgo9yod pa dang / chu tshan chu mgo che chung14yod pa yin/ 'byed spel chog pa'i chu'i nus stobs chan wa khri116 2yod cing / 2 001lor son sngon rdzong khungs su chu glog sa tshigs38bskrun zin pa dang / 'phrul 'khor bsgrigs tshad chan wa khri12 75longs yod pa dang / chu bed kyi bzo 'god rnam grangs511grub yod/ 1988lor rgyal yongs kyi zhing sde glog chas can du 'gyur ba'i rdzong10yi gras su tshud pa dang /da lta phal cher grong ba so sor glog 'phrod yod pa yin/ lo 'khor re'i nang du zla6pa nas10ba'i bar du nub lho'i 'jam rlan mkha' rlung gi shan thebs nas char chu mod cing / lo re'i 'bab tshad kyi80phrozin pas rlan shos dus tshigs chags pa dang / zla11pa nas phyi lo'i zla5pa bar du 'jam skam gyi gshis dang ldan pa'i lho phyogs kyi yan lag nub rlung drag po'i shan thebs nas char chu nyung la lo re'i char chu 'bab tshad kyi20skotsam zin zhing / dwangs nyin mang ba dang nyi 'od kyis longs pas skam shos dus tshigs chags pa yin/sa gshis dang gnam gshis kyi cha rkyen de 'dra'i dbang gis yul du sngo ljang bklubs tshad mtho zhing skye dngos kyi rnam pa mang / nags klong gi khebs tshad mnga' khongs spyi'i38lkolongs pa dang / nags tshal gyi khebs tshad dang shing cha bsags yod tshad yun nan khongs kyi rdzong127nang gi rtse mor gyur yod/shing char rung ba'i ljon pa rigs43yod pa dang / shing tog rigs20lhag yod pa dang / rgyal khab kyi srung rim gnyis par gtogs pa'i ljon pa rigs—253—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/6dang srung rim gsum par gtogs pa rigs7yod cing / nags sa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i yul thon zas sman sogs rtsa chen rigs8yod/ phyugs 'tsho chog sa'i rgya khyon mu'u khri tsho1310 94yod cing sa khyon spyi'i75 26skolongs pa dang / rang byung rtswa sa mu'u khri tsho416 50yod cing rang byung 'brog sa'i82 66lkolongs pa dang / spyod bde ba'i rtswa sa mu'u khri tsho316 40yod cing 'brog sa spyi'i go chod rgya khyon gyi84 74lkolongs pa red/ zog rtswa la rigs742dang gzan rtswa bzang shos rigs220yod pa red/ de ma zad zas dang sman du rung ba'i sha mo'am mog rigs92yod pa dang / 'bras bu thogs pa'i rtsi shing rigs3278yod/ 'di lta bu'i khor yug tu nu sos rigs kyi srog chags97yod pa dang / bya rigs170yod / nya rigs75yod/ lto 'gro'i rigs18yod/ skam gsher nyis 'tsho rigs5yod pa red/ de'i nang du rgyal khab kyi gnad du bzung nas srung skyong byed bzhin pa'i rigs38yod cing / nang gses su srung rim dang po'i rigs11dang srung rim gnyis pa'i rigs12yod pa red/ 'di bzhin du yul gru de dngos gnas gna' bo'i 'khyags klung dang deng rabs 'khyags klung gi bsham ston rten gnas dang / mtsho dang mtshe'u yi bsham ston rten gnas/ rtsi shing gi bang mdzod/ srog chags kyi dag zhing du bstod pa la nongs mi dgos pa zhig yin/2003lo'i zla7pa'i tshes2nyin/ h+pha ran se nas 'tshogs pa'i mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi skabs27pa'i 'dzam gling bskyur nor thad kyi lo tshogs steng gtsang bo rnam gsum gshib par 'bab yul de〈'dzam gling rang byung bskyur nor gyi ming tho〉la khod pa dang / da lta rgyal khab kyis de gar skye dngos rgyud rgyu'i bang mdzod 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin yod/ bzo las che ba ma spel na'ang / de na rang byung thon khungs sbyor bzo thad kyi bzo las sna mang spel —254—

‘‘sems kyi nyi zla'i’’bkrag dmangs/ba'i cha rkyen yod pa red/rig gnas nyar tshags dang spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs dbang du dpyad na/ sems kyi nyi zla yul sde'i rig gnas nyar tshags dang spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs skor gong du rig gnas khyad chos gleng ba'i skabs su chog tshod tsam zhus yod pas/ 'dir mdor bsdus tsam zhu rgyu yod pa ni spyi tshogs 'du shes kyi bla srog ste mi chos kyi snying bo ngos gzung bar bya/ sems kyi nyi zla yul sde'i rig gnas de mi'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi 'brel ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi grub cha tha dad bar gyi 'brel ba legs 'dum byung zhing / srol rgyun skyong shes dang gzhan bzang sdud mkhas kyi gzhi nas grub pa red/ rang byung khams kyi skye dngos rnam mang can dang spyi tshogs kyi rig gnas rnam mang can srung skyong thub la bed chod pa'i rgyu mtshan dpyad na/ spyi tshogs kun spyod dam mi chos kyi lta ba 'dzin stangs kyi thad 'di do snang bya 'tshal/ de'i spyi mtshan du rung ba'i gnad de/ rang byung khams spyi dang de gar gnas pa'i dngos po ci rigs la rang rang gi gnas skal yod pas brtsi 'jog byed pa'i 'bras bur rang gi che ba'ang ngang ngam shugs kyis 'thob pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bya yul la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i 'bras bu rang gi ma 'ongs pa la'ang tshogs bsags pa dang / 'gro ba mi la bkur sa 'dzems sa yod pa ni rang la che ba dang la rgya bskyur ba yin pa'i 'du shes ldan pa red/ gzhan la mthun rkyen bzos na rang la'ang mthun rkyen 'byor yong ba dang / gzhan de mthon por bzhengs pa las rang yang pha rol pas bzhengs 'gyur ba dang /gzhan de sgrol ba'i brgyud rim du rang yang ya rabs su bslebs 'gro ba red/gzhan la gu yangs byed pa las rang la'ang zhi bde 'thob pa dang / gzhan la byams brtse gnang ba las rang la'ang gces skyong 'thob pa red/ 'di dag —255—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ las kyang gnad ni bdag 'dzin med pa las che ba ldan pa'i bdag cig 'grub yong ba dang / bdag 'dzin med pa'i khrod nas ltag phugs can gyi bdag cig 'grub yong ba 'di lags/ 'di lta bu'i mi chos kyi 'du shes nyid rig gnas gsar pa 'ba' zhig nas thob pa min gyi/ gsar rnying rang gzhan te rig gnas rnam mang can gyi gshib bsdur las nying bcud bsdus byung ba red/de'i phyir tshong srol dar yang g.yo sgyu med pa/ brtson sems che yang rnab sems med pa/ kha rgyab kyi dgos mkhor lta yang 'chal thabs la 'dzem pa zhig tu gyur yod/gong gleng ltar 'di 'dra'i rang byung khor yug dang spyi tshogs khor yug ldan pa'i yul sde zhig la mtshon na/ bde ba chen po ni nges par 'byung ba zhig yin la/ mdun lam yang rgya chen po zhig med thabs mi yong ba red/ /

sems kyi khrus gsol/sems kyi khrus gsol/klu 'bum tshe ring /gshog 'dab la skyon gyis nyes pa'i 'dab chags rmas ma zhig tshang du 'khor ba bzhin/ skyo dub cig gis nga rang khang ba'i nang du brdzangs/sems khams su smug pa langs dus lang tsho'i bkrag mdangs kyang nyams/zungs zad kyi nad pa nga 'dam du byings pas/ dus yun ring bor nyab nyob dang / ldab ldib/ ban bun gyi ngang la had de lus/ phyi rol na byis pa skor zhig bda' 'ded sogs kyi rtsed 'jor rol bzhin thang stong de 'ur zing gis khengs/ smyug kha bskor yang 'u thug ste u tshugs byas skabs byis pa tsho'i gsal lhang lhang gi dgod sgra de phreng thag chad pa'i mu tig rdog po bzhin 'od chil ler nga'i sge'u khung gi kha ru 'thor yong / byis pa'i dgod sgra dang lhan du bye'u chung zhig kyang 'phur yong ste sge'u khung gi kha ru babs shing / dra glegs la mchu to bsnun bzhin kyur sgra lan 'ga' 'byin rjes yang bskyar 'phur song / de ni gnyer mdud rgyag pa'i smyug thogs pa nga la 'phya bzhad dang kyal ka slong ba 'dra bas/ nga'i rig par glo bur skar khung zhig btod pa ltar gsal ler gyur/ de mur sems kyi smug pa yang rang sar yal 'go brtsams/ nga la mu mthud du nad med gcong skad 'byin pa'i snyan ngag de 'bri 'dod med pas smyug shog bskyur te sgo ru bud/—257—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'jig rten 'di ni bkod 'doms kyi tshod 'dzin dang dus yun gyi bkag rgya med pa ni byis pa tsho'i rtsed dga' min nam/ na chung tshos bag yangs pa'i ngang nang sems kyi mdud pa lhug grol byung na chog go /a sngon dang sprin dkar kho tsho'i yin la/ sa gzhi dang me tog kyang kho tshor dbang / lhad med kyi sems khong nas da gzod zol med kyi 'dzum chung rgod/ byis pa tshos rtsed 'jor g.yeng ba'i kho bos rang gi phyi nang kun la zhib lta zhig byas pa dang rang sems la khrus gsol thengs shig bgyis/da bar du skyo dub kyis mnar mnar ba ni 'dod sred zhabs med kyi dong du 'phag 'tshag brgyab pa'i rkyen du nges la/ da bar du bris bris pa gang zhig gzhan gyis bkur bar mos pa'i khyed kyis gsog gsob dang bcos mas ma bsgrib bam/ rdul gyis ma zin pa ci tsam yod/ byis pa tsho'i mdun du nga rang ngo gnongs shing zhe mer ba byung / da lta'i bsam med kyi byis pa 'di tsho nam zhig gi tshe na 'tshar longs byung ste 'ur 'ur lang long gi mi tshogs su 'gro dgos pas/ skabs der kho tshos kyang bdag dang 'dra bar nad med gcong skad 'don pa'i snyan ngag re 'bri srid dam/ ngas de ltar bsam pa'i mod la sems pa ljid tig ger gyur/ /—258—

sems khral rigs shigasems khral rigs shigaljang bu/khyod lags tenam yang sems khral bya dgos pa'i kher rkyang du 'phrin yig 'bri bar mos pa'i mikhyod lags terjes su'ang mjal thabs med pa'ilus po dang lag zung cha med mchu sgros grang mokho bo'i lcero myong byed kyi dbang bome lce sngon pos sa gzhir bldags khyod la bldagasanags tshal gyis chu phran btungami tshogs sgo 'gram du rub nas ci zhig smra'on kyang—259—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bdag gis sngar ltar khyed rang dranadus rabs kyi sgrog gu bkrol ba'i kher rkyang gi mi'on kyang mi tshogs sngar ltar rubabadag gi rigs rgyud la rim bzhin goms pa'iskad cha gsar ba zhig ya mtshan zhig smra bzhin 'dugabadag / smra ba je nyung du phyin sems khraladzi —260—

nor bu/)nor bu/ljang bu/gtsang po ni bzhur lam tsam las mi snang na yangagru shan rta mgo ma de mdun phyogs su nur gyin 'dugartog btags kyi bar thag de smug pa'i khrod na g.yo 'gul byedang tsho dmigs sa ru slobs kyin yod pa 'dra nor bus rtsi dmar po khyon pa'i rdo khang gi thog kha rudar lcog rnying hrul kha shas kyis g.yab g.yug rgyagargyab ljongs ni sprin pa kher rgyu zhig dang nam mkha' stong pa zhig yinang tsho gzhi nas sos dal ngang mnyam 'dzoms 'byung la nye'adas pa dang ma 'ongs pa de rgya cog gru bzhi'i mtha' lad lta ba'i ngo bor thim cog tse'i steng lagrub kyin pa'i rgun chang bum pa gang dang gleng mol gyi dga' tshor 'khyilalag pa tshur srings shig nga'i brang khar sbyor cig nor bukhrag thigs dang gad snyigs g.ya' chu dang me son 'dres pa'ibarlan gsher bum pa gang po 'di la dkrug dkrug ma gtong rogasa'adi g.yo skyom ma byed rogs thams cad ga ler gting du thim dusadwangs gtsang dang zhi lhod kyi rang mdangs de mngon thub pa'i ched du—261—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bud med tshos 'jig rten 'di thog ma nas rtog bzo byas tshar 'dug snyam gyinabartse dung gis 'gro lam dang dmigs sa sngar nas jus 'god byas tshar snyam gyinang tshos bslu brid ldan la don snying ldan pa'ibarjod bya gsar pa gang zhig gleng 'dodagang zhig gleng rin ldan nor bung tshos shing tog cig las sdug bsngal gyi pags pa thengs shig bshusanor 'khrul gyi pags pa thengs shig bshusabade zug kyang thengs shig bshusasil sha de la gsung mgur gyi phab rtsi brgyabasil sha de kho na bdud rtsi ru gyur songatshi gu de kho na bden pa nyid dang kha thag nye bar 'gyur gyin 'dugargun chang bum pa gang debyed med las tshig cig dang mnyam dugs chag tu 'gro bzhin 'dugadus la ma slebs par skye bzhin pa'ibu phrug cig gi lce rtser 'khyil songatshor ba'i gting la 'khyil songabartse dung gi bro ba ci 'dra redang la gsung rogs—262—

nor bu/nor bumig chu kha shas thog ma nas bzhur sa mi 'dugasnod bca' kha shas nam yang mig chus khengs 'dugatshe srog 'di ma gzhi nas char thigs rdog po zhig dang 'dra b.radus tshod kyi kha nang la zhu bzhin 'duganor ba snying gi nor ba mngar kha las phyir thon shogarami ra༄ las kyi dbang gis gnas mi 'dra ba so so nas lam la chas teng tsho dpung ba mnyam gshib ngang don dam gyi khrod nas mjal 'ongadagun kha ma slebs sngon lang tsho srab nas srab tu 'gro mus lagangs thang du bzhag pa'i rkang rjes kyi mgur ma'angalhags rlung dmar po'i kha gtad kyi rkyen gyis mog por 'grotshangs dbyangs kyi nor burgya mtsho yi nor bunor bu nga tsho ji ltar ci tsam bzhur na'ang rang nyid las thon ma thub pa 'di yang ci—263—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/lham chung dmar po/'brong /khyod kyi lham chung dmar po dpyid kyime tog bzhin rtswa ljang gi mnyen sha'i stenga.a dkar gyi dri ngad 'thul dwangs gtsang giyid 'ong mkhur tshos kyi gzhon sha srab moralam lam du nyi 'od dang bcas pa'i'adzum chung gi drod rlabs 'khyil gsal lhang ngeralham chung dmar po'i bkrag mdangs kyi steng nachung chung gi khyod rang ngas mthong ba'i dus 'di la'aphyor sgeg dang dri bsung phye leb kyis 'phyonga'i sems khong gi dung ba zab mos ljid tig gerakhyod rang nar son gyi mdzes sdug gibargyud rim yod tshad 'tsho bzhin dam bca' 'jogang nam yang rgas mi srid gnam sa'i bar du—264—

rje mi la ras pa/rje mi la ras pa/gangs 'tsho/rje mi la 'jigs rngam rngam gyi sprin rum lasaser ba rum gang khyer nas phebs 'ongs larje mi la gdams ngag gi lcag tshan dbu la skor bzhinalha rta dkar po zhig bcibs te bzhud songarje mi la ras pasarmi lam lta bu'i rmi lam ring mo zhig brgyud mtharadagra bo ngo ma de rang gi rus gseb nas rnyedade nas bzung ti se'i spo ru 'gying ba'i gangs g.yag bzhinabu yug gi sbyang tshogs rgod pa'i kha lam du bzhugs nasashel sgong lta bu'i rang nyid de 'tshol slada.a mas gnang ba'i gser gyi skam pa desarnam rtog gi dug tsher re re drungs nas phyungaslong bzed na nas 'bru bdun las mi brgal lasku rgyab na sgom thag tsam las med pasardo gor mo la yang mig chu shor song

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rje mi la ras pasamadzes se yi sha drod dang pe ta yi sdug skad 'khor ba 'di'i zhags pa yod tshad bcad nas phebs dusanyams rtogs kyi gzi byin shig shigagasung byon pa tsam gyisabar snang gi sprin dkar lug khyu bzhin 'dus shingazhabs brkyangs pa tsam gyisam pham g.yu mtsho de chu mig bzhin du bskyur songarje mi la bar snang du 'phur dusaspyan zung kem kem gyis su la gzigs yodamada' bor ba'i rngon pa la gzigs pa yin namaganyid lci ba'i byis pa tshor gzigs pa yinango ma nga khong dang bar thag ring song bsangs ci yang ma mthong ngas ci yang ma shesarje mi la 'jigs rngam rngam gyi sprin rum lasaser ba rum gang khyer nas phebs myong zerarje mi la gdams ngag gi lcag tshan dbu la skor bzhinalha rta dkar po zhig la bcibs te bzhud song zer—266—

gsar du rnyed pa'i rgyal khams/gsar du rnyed pa'i rgyal khams/—sgyu rtsal mkhan po dbyang li phen gyi zhabs bro'i ltad mor rol ba'i tshor snang /'ju skal bzeng /na bun sngon po zhig yun gyis bkram pa'i khrod nadri ma med pa'i sgro phran dkar po zhigasteng 'og sgyur bzhinayang bar skyod cing mnyen por ldem zhen gdung drag po'i kha rlung gis 'dar ba'imachu 'dab kyi pags pa yi chad dang ngang sgug gi bar naskom gdung gis had pa'i mig zungabazhin rasazungs khrag shor ba'i zla ba stend tshugs kyi mdzes nyams shigadar zab kyi sbug lam nas gyen la 'gyu ba'igayu 'brug sngon mo'i 'khyog 'grosadri bzhon gyis phar tshur res su skyod pa'i—267—
