dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/dar ling dkar po'i rlabs gnyerasbrul zhags sa la 'khyagasachab rom gyi ri zom la srubs ka dod pa las chu thigs nyil nyil 'ong stong khams chen por bris pa'i 'gyur khugs desadabang rtsa'i yan lag lhug lcug g.yo'adi na 'tshe ba meda'atshol snyeg dang re ltos kyang medasems pa dang sems pa lhan du g.yo'adi ni khyed kyis bskrun pa'i 'jig rten zhigayang na bdag gis bzhengs pa'i rgyal khams shigagang ltaraganas 'dir de sngon su yang slebs ma myong d+ngha268—

snyanangagapa'irgyalakhams /snyan ngag pa'i rgyal khams/'ju skal bzang /snyan ngag pa'i rgyal khams nitshon mdangs sna tshogs 'dres pa'i khra shig ge ba zhig min lade na rtog btags kyi sbrang chang dang mdzes ma'ang medasnyan ngag pa'i rgyal khams nalung tshig dang rnam bzhag de tsho yod ma myongasnyan ngag pa'i bsam gzhig detshags ma ru chu blugs pa bzhinathol gyis thon zhing shar gyis 'gro bsazhag mal ye mi gtongatshor ba sna tshogs kyang gtsang chen rags las shor ba bzhinagang shar la 'dor len thengs gcig gisathams cad lam gzhung gcig tu sdud cing 'grosnyan ngag pa'i rgyal khams ni—269—
dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/stong ba 'ba' zhig lags testong ba kho naraganam sa shong thub —270—

rlung ldang ba'i snga rol/rlung ldang ba'i snga rol/gcan me stagarlung ldang ba'i snga rol turdo ba'i tshogs sngar gnas su gnyidalhing 'jags kyi gtsang bo su zhig gimig mdangs ji bzhin 'jam larlung ldang ba'i snga rol tunyi 'od dang 'ja' sprin bar snang mtho shos su 'khyilanags tshal gyi pha mtha' 'grims pa'i mi tshogasarlung ma ldang ba'i yar sngon du'ajam mnyen gyi ri 'dabs dang mtsho khugs su gnas mal 'cha' zhingamachod bstod kyi rol dbyangs khrod nasakha khu sim pa'i rmi lam la zhugasarmi lam gyi dus tshigs

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/de ni rlung ldang ba'i snga rol gyi dus tshigs yinagaser gyi ljon shing g.yu yi lo mdung gi ngang ngurd dung lha mo tsho'i gar stabs ldem ldemarlung ma ldang ba'i yar sngon dudus tshigs yod tshad kyi kha dog gcig yinaglu sgra gcig yin gar stabs gcig yinadagod sgra dang ngu ngagasmon 'dun dang yid ches gcig yin larlung ldang ba'i snga rol tung tsho'i tshe srog gcig yina'adod blo'ang gcig yin—brtse dung gi byin rlabs khrod naskyes ma tsho'i gya gyu med la skyes chen dag girdzig nyams kyang rnyed thabs bralachar thigs re re'i khrod nang tsho'i mdzes sdug gi gnas tshang yodadwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbugs khrod nang tsho'i 'tsho bcud dang shes rig yodalo legs dang lang tsho yod—272—
n+d+rang sridro ba'isngarol sdoshā ༵ṭ+wāṃtrī r+ghaṃ sbyi ljadā lda py-id phrag gong na 'phur

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/snyan ngag — gcan me stagabazi 'thom pa de las yang bskyar sad dusadus tshigs yod tshad kyi kha dog brjes zin ladran pa yod tshad kyi kha phyogs kyang sngar nas 'gyur zinasnyan ngag 'di dag larmi lam gyi dreg pa chags shingargas gnyer gyi dra bas g.yogs zin 'dugapha yul gyi rkang lam steng na gzhas gdangs med cinga'ajig rten gyi khrom tshogs dbus su skad sgra mi 'dugawu dkar lta bu'i 'gyur khugs de'i khongs nasame tog lta bu'i sgeg nyams de'i rgyab nasang la rang gi na zug skyong sa'i dus skabs kyang mi 'dug angashog bu ther gang la bshad mi tshar ba'i sems don brjod cingasmyu gu rdog gcig la bris mi tshar ba'i skyo snang bcol na'angakher rkyang gi las 'bras 'di—274—

snyanangag — —lus rgyab khur ba'i grib ma bzhinagar phyin sa ru sun snang dang skyo yus med par 'brangs 'ongs tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mi tshe gcig la 'khyams shingami la ras pa mi tshe gcig la sprang ste mthar thug gi bden pa rnyedango mtshar ba'i rgyab ljongs ji ltar brtsams na'angarlabs chen gyi bden pa de thengs gcig las mi 'dugagal te nam mkha' 'dir da dung nam mkha' gzhan zhig shong naglu sgra yod tshad kyi dbyangs 'gros gcig mi srid cingabagrod lam 'dir bgrod lam gzhan zhig kyang bsnan chog nablos btang ba yod tshad kyi skyo ngalasmre sngags dang dogs yus ga la yinaltos dang srid gsum gyi rig pa sbrum pa'i brtsams chos phon po dgaphyi rabs pa'i dpe sgrom logs na rdul gyis g.yogs dusanub phyogs kyi mtshams sprin dmar po'i ngogs na'adas po'i 'gyod gdung gi gzugs brnyaname ltar 'bar

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ lam gyas rgyu/ gzhas tha ma thor/sgo smreng bu/lam de'i dbang gisangs tshal 'chos kyi phyi gos re gyon nasa'i ༄'ispesrad pa' ma ra la 'khyam 'khyam byasakho bo dang kho mo tshorgyus med pa'i ngo gdong wal wol rlom dka' ba'i lab gleng than thun kha sang gi snying gi grogs pode ring gi sgyu ma'i mgron pomathar thug na lam ha cang dog drags de tsho chos nyid cig yin pa shes srid pa'i lam 'gro bgating zab sa zhig na nyam chung gisagashog klu zhig la pha gzhis g.yaralam de'i dbang gisangs bsams na 'jig rten ha cang rgas dragasagazhon sha dod po'i kho rang gang la 'grolha —276—

lam gya ma gyu/ gzhas tha ma thor/sa srod la char ba 'babanangs zhogs su kha ba ldangarlung bu nam g.yug la nges pa medargas pa'i 'gyod snang gisa'ajig rten 'ur la brjesabaden no kho gcig purgas pa'i khrom ra na kho gcig pu'agyod snang med nga rgyal medayin na yang nam rgyun log thengs rerakho la rang gi lam bu zhig yod zeralam de'i dbang gisangs las 'phro'i g.yu sbrang la skad cig btang‘‘nam mkha' zhig yod na rmi lam zhig yodamang po zhig rgyab tu bskyur bzod nagling phran g.yu lo can de nga tsho'i yin’’yod pa dang med pa'i mtshams nasalam de bdams gsar ba dang rnying ba'i bar nasagazhas de bkugs lam de'i dbang gisagazhas kyang de'i dbang du song

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rkyang thang /klu tshang smyug rtsen/thang chen po skyo ngal gyi glu chung zhig sterkyang khyu kho na pi wang gi rgyud skud na 'dararlung bu 'khyag bsil bsil gyi rlung buyud tsam yud tsam sterlung yin pas rlung ltar bud 'grosnyan ngag pas rkyang thang brgyud dusasprin pa zhig ga ler lho phyogs su rgyu zhingapha bong kha shas kyi rgas nyams mthong bsasmyug rtse yang rlung la brdar ma nusayul ljongs mi tshos rkyang thang du glong ba'i yul ljongasaphan tshun 'ded par rtsen pa'i rkyang khyu da dungargod la shor ba'i ri dwags kha shasarlung bu bzhin kher rkyang gi mdzes sdug la 'khor yong—278—

pha yul la btang ba'i gzhas/pha yul la btang ba'i gzhas/klu tshang smyug rtsen/pha yul nga ngo ma dbul zhing phongs dbul phongs pa ngas khyod la ci zhig sbyin 'osalag pa stong bzung 'di'i nang na ci yang med pasangs khyod la ci zhig sbyin ang —pha yul sngon chad zhig la nga tsho phyug rab zera'abyor phyug de da lta gang la song keng rus lta bu'i nga tshoran zug dang tshor ba med para'adi ltar rgud de rgas 'gro ba ji 'dra'i skyo ang pha yul ngas khyod la 'khang ra byas pa min modang tsho'i mtsher shul na bya bye'u tshorargun 'bu'ang 'thu rgyu meda'agram lcag thengs shig gis rdzu bag shor 'dra'ire chad kyi‘‘gdong ris’’'di dag mthong natshod tshod la ngu rgyu zhig yong

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/rdzi glu/ bdag gi skom pa sel ba'i rdzi glu/skyabs chen bde grol/rdzi glu dus ltar bzhur byungarta mchog gi rmig bzhi g.yang gzar ngos kyi chu mig bzhinamagyogs la 'gyur khugs kyis phyug ri rtse'i nyi zer gyis ri rtse'i spyang ki sbed phyirarngon pa tshor ha cang dro ba'i de'u 'bur re ngo sprod byasardzi glu mtshams med par bzhur byungardzi glus 'dar ba'i me tog gi gam dubyis pa tshos lha bsang gi bsung ngad kyang 'gamakhal ma tsho'i sgal bar na zug dang bcas pa'i rdzi glu babasasbra 'dabs kyi rgan mo des lhod chags kyi gtam rgyud dran zhoralhod chags pa'i 'ja' tshon la sgug rdzi glu sprin dkar gyi grib bsil yang yinardzu glu'i gseb tu na chung ma'i mig gis—280—

dzi glu/ bdag gi skom pa sel ba'i dzi glu/nam mkha' yongs su bzung zhingargod po'i gshog rtser a tshags kyis 'thams pa'i ni ra༅ rlung bu mthongardzi glus grong khyer gyi 'ur zing la'ang g.yo 'gul thebasardzi glus tshan rig gi dus rabs la'ang ngo tsha sbyina.o rdzi glu bdag gi skom pa sel ba'i rdzi glu —281—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ na zug 'jags thub pa'i phyir du khrod la bos pa/skyabs chen bde grol/ cholo rgyus kyi dpe deb de'i steng du khrag dang sa rdul las ci yodanam mkha'i ngos su nyi zla cha gcig gis 'gro 'ongs byedasems 'di me tog gis bzos shing bsam blo'i ze'u 'bru yisa'ajig rten gyi phye ma leb rnams re re bzhin 'gug pa bden nabadag gi gu ge'i mkhar shul du khyod rang ji ltar 'grim bzhin yodabadag gi snying khar re re bzhin lhung ba'i sdug bsngal dngashes rig gi mchi ma da dung 'brong dang rin po che'i gter khasakhyod rang 'tshams por yod med kyi gnas tshul 'dri ngesalung stong du glo bur 'khor ba'i rgod po'i gshog sgra desems rten gyi gangs ri thag ring nas nyil ba'i mtshon byed yin namabadag gi brang kha'i me glo snying gi bsang khri'i steng na drag tu 'bara'agro 'ongs byed kyin pa'i nyi zlas khyod nyid 'jig rten du yod tshul glengabadag gi po ta las kha rog ger mun nag 'thung laskar mda' kha shas kyi phyogs su mchi ma phran tsam gtonga.e rlung 'tshub khrod yal gyin pa'i gangs ri—282ge

na zug 'jags thub pa'i phyir du khyod la bos pa/dbyangs gsal gyi sa zhing du yur ma yur bzhin pa'idapa' mdzangs dang brtse dungs kyi bdag nyidatha snyad khrod gzhi mi tshugs pa'i rol dbyangs kyi bdag nyidagadong 'bag las 'bro bar rtsom pa'i rnam shes kyi bdag nyidakhyod kyis rang sems su zug pa'i tsher shing lta bu'i bdag nyid srung rogs —283—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/khrod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dus/ri sngon bla ma thar/khyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dusabadag gi brang khog la snga mo nas gzhan su zhig 'dzul tebazod glags bral ba'i na zug 'ga' bstud mar ster zhorasnying nye nye yi skad cha re re brjod bzhin gda'akhyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dusabadag dgod bro ba'i brtse dung gi rol rtsed kha shas la rlom drags nasarang nyid kyi kha dog yod tshad ji ltar 'gyur ba ma rtogs shingatha na cha rgyus tsam yod pa'i ngo gdong de yang gang zhig la yal gyin pa tshor myong medakhyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dusabadag gis bzhud zin pa'i lam phran gyi sne mo glo bur ngang brjed cingadus tshod dang rab rib kyi mkha' dbugs khrodagru kha 'dir 'greng nas nar son gyin pa'i gom sgra zhig la yun ring sgug—284—

khyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dus/khyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dusabadag tshor ba med pa'i mig 'bras dang yan lag de tshor g.yol phyiragayo sgyu dang rnying zhen la goms pa'i 'jig rten 'dir rgyab gtad degazhan su zhig gi mig mdun du rang rlom ngang skyod kyin yodakhyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig yin dusabacos ma'i gdong 'bag mthug po desakhyod dang bdag gi bar thag rim gyis je ring du btang zhingashi zin pa'i 'dzum mdangs kyis lo rgyus sam dus skabs shig mtshon pa 'dra yangam 'ongs pa'i nam mkha' dang sprin dkar la dung ba'i dbang gisagang ltar bdag gi snang ngor khyod rang shing leb dang sdong skam lta bu zhig tu gyur

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gi/ —dgon chung zhig dang de'i 'dabs kyi slob chung /'brog bsam gtan/'du khang khra mo gzi byin lam lam/ /gser tog ser po bkrag mdangs krig krig/btsun chung gzhon nu'i 'du 'god lang long / /dad ldan mjal ba'i gsol 'debs shab shub/ /slob grwa'i ra skor gyang hral nyal nyil/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen grogs med rkyang rkyang / /mi kha gnyan po me stag mched mched/ /khyim bdag btsan po stag mo mchong mchong / /zhal 'debs dkar thigs 'o ma 'phyur 'phyur/ /bsang dud sngon mo g.yu 'brug 'khyug 'khyugatshe 'bar mar me skar ma 'char 'char/ /mjal dar kha btags khangs skya 'bab 'bab /gsar zhugs 'dzin grwa dmag khral bsdu bsdu/ /dpe rin sgor 'ga' bu lon 'ded 'ded/ /slob ma kha shas shor ma 'bro 'bro/ /pha mar thug na bag ma ngu ngu / /—286—

sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gi/chos sgor zhugs na mthe bong ker ker/ /grwa gzhon zhugs na brang kha ldir ldir/ /skya sar babs na dmod mo 'ur 'ur/ /yul mi gnyen nye mgo bo dud dud/ /slob ma'i ma lo mig chu sham sham/ /stag lo ba zhig mtsho la 'phen 'phen/ /'os 'gan slob gso 'u lag rgyug rgyug/gnang ba byin dus btson nas thon thon/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris chu khol gdu gdu/ /mdza' bshes mthun sgril dar ba dkrog dkrog/lung yig rdzun ma brda yig 'grem 'grem/ /dmangs kyi sems pa lu gu rtsed rtsed/ /sman bcos mang shas phyag nas than thun/ /re ba phal cher 'tsho ba tag tag/ grol dus bsu ba'i yul mi rub rub/ /dus ltar skyel ba'i khyim mi kha kher/ /'chad pa'i phyogs su kha lce digadig/rtsod pa'i thad la smra brjod ldab ldib/ /rtsom pa'i tshe na shes tham thom/ /blun po skor zhig glang thug 'gying 'gying / / zhi khro'i lha tshogs gser tshon kyug kyug/slob khang sgo sam skya mdog thal thal /rnga sbubs chos dung sang sang snyan snyan/ /—287—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/phru gu'i sbyor klog chad chad mthud mthud / /lha khang grub ston zing zing lang long / / dge rgan dus chen kha khu sum sum/ /pha ma'i dmigs bya rgyu nor rdog rdog/phru gu'i sbyangs 'bras bya sgong log log/sku rim cho ga me tog bkad bkad/ / slob byol slob ma sbrang ma 'phur 'phur/ /gnas skor mjal ba sha khyu zhogs zhogs/ /gseng na slob phrug she'u chung sding lding / /dpe cha sna ring gces nor nyar nyar/ /mchod sgam nang na spos dri thul thul/ /slob khrid sbyang deb pags pa mnyed mnyed/ /mi gtsang phyags dar khrod na hral hrul/ / a lags mthon po'i khri na rdzig rdzig/ sgor mo skyu ru leb mo brtseg brtseg/slob dpon mi mang mtha' na zhum zhum/ /slob gso'i dom yig bu yug 'tshub/ /ri gsum rtse na dar lcog lhab lhub/ /nyag gsum mdo yi khang rnying thar thor/ /bca' sdod slob grwa yin pa skyo skyo/ / stod na chos skad snyan mo lhang lhang / /smad na rnga skad brel mo tong tong / /bar na lcags chag rdo bas thag thag/—288—

sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gi/slob khrid 'tshogs brda yin pa sdug sdug/dgon na chos khrims dar skud 'then 'then/ /grong na sde khrims gru gu sgril sgril/ /nam yang mi grim bal thig lhod lhod/ /slob gso'i sgrig khrims yin pa mtshar mtshar/ / —289—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ rgya rkyen mang po mi dgos /zhi bde nyi ma/khyod da rung cung tsam yang mi ngal lamari de 'dra zhig gi phar rgyab nas yong ba su la mi gsalangal thang chad pa'i dus shig med pa dengo mtshar ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig redakhyod da dung 'di ltar rgyu rkyen gang mang bgrang bzhinamu mthud du ngal dub med pa'i ngang mdun du skyod pa sus mi rtogasakhyod kyis ngal gso phran bu zhig byosanga'i chu hub gang 'thung rjes mig hrig hrig ngang nga la ltosardo ba bsgrigs pa'i mkhas mdzangs dengs rbad de gtor zind ni ngas khyod la ro bcud can gyi glu zhig lenade la rgyu rkyen gang yang mi dgos —290—

rgyu rkyen mang po mi dgos/lo zla gang mang zhig gi pha rol nasakhyod ga ler yongalo zla gang mang zhig gi pha rol nas nga ga ler yongame phung de'i ched du gzhas ga 'dra zhig btang bsha za mkhan kha shas kyis khyod la ra sprod byed ngesargyu rkyen mang po mi dgos snying nyerang gi rnam shes gshag rgyu de las sla mo zhig ga la yinardo 'phen tshe chu bo dgos lachu med sa ru 'grul bzhud pa mang po medathos byung ngam rdo 'phen tshe chu bo dgos lachu med sa ru ku co dang 'phag 'tshag medasems dang ngo gdong lu gu dag la'ang yodargyu rkyen mang po kho tshor yod ma myongag ler rtswa za ba'i go rim de rgyu rkyen zhig e yinag ler mig chu 'don pa'ang rgyu rkyen zhig e yinardo ba dag la ci yang mkho mi srid sku drin can gyi mes po tsho nishin tu rdzob pa'i lam chen po zhig redargyu rkyen mang po mi dgosartswa za zhing chu 'thung ba'i go rim de ji 'dras stong—291—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gli tho chu mo dgu mdud/—sbrum ma'i zin bris/bde skyid sgrol ma/gcig zla/zla yi mtshan ma'i me tog ma bzhad nyin zhag du ma'i dus yol tshe/ /sbrul chen 'khyug 'gro'i stangs stabs gcig gis brla rkang g.yas par thim pa rmis/ /'byung ba'i gnod skyon gang yang ma thebs khu khrag sems gsum 'dres pa las/ /rgyu zhabs snod du sngar med bde ba'i tshor ba skyid po nur nur chags/ /da ni lhums khang gor mo'i dbus na gsar byung khye'u'i sa bon zhig/pad+ma'i sbubs kyi ze'u 'bru nang bzhin dal gyis 'bus par brtsam pa na/ /byed las rlung gis g.yo zhing bdun phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad du/ /kho mo'i zas bcud dwangs ma'i rgyun gyis skye 'phel gso skyong mthun rkyen mkho/ /gnyis bla/gar 'gro lus ni cung zad dub cing sha tshil zas la skyug mer langs/ /bza' 'dod zas rigs gcig tu ma nges pho ba'i yi ga ye nas 'gags / /nyi 'od me drod ring nas spong 'dod tsha gdung drag po cher rgyas pas/ /—292—

zla tho chu mo dgu mdud/da ni bdun phrag brgyad dgu'i dus yun nya yi gnas skabs yin par nges/ /sngar med sems chung gom pa yang mos lam du bgrod par byed pa dang / /yan lag 'gul skyod gnyom zhing dal la bsam bzhin ngal rtsol smyung ba sogs/ /nyin mtshan dus drug skad cig nyid dang 'tsho ba'i nang gses so so ru/ /rang gi spyod lam nyes min la brtag mngal gyi tshang mal 'thor bar dogs/ / gsumazla/zla ba gsum pa bdun phrag bcu tsam son pa'i dus kyi nyin zhag la/ /byang khog smad du lag pas rnyab bzhin reg bya 'jam pos byil byas na/ /sra mkhregs rdzas shig spar mos 'dzin nus spro 'dzum dbang med 'chor srid de/ /yan lag la sogs 'phel tshul 'tsho gnas rus sbal gnas skabs gdon mi za/ /btsong sgog blo rlangs lhang lhang 'phyud ba'i bza' btung g.yos sbyor thab 'gram nas/ /skad cig tsam yang sdod par ma tshugs sna mchu lag pas 'geb bzhin 'bro/ /dwangs gtsang mkha' dbugs 'byin rngub la re skom gdung mnar gcod bar med pas/ /rgyang ring ri rtse'i gangs dkar mthong na 'gam 'dod ham pa kun nas ldang / / —293—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/bzhizla/nyin nas nyin du lus zungs rid gyur sems khams 'gyur bag che na yang / /dus min skyug langs don lnga snod drug mgo mjug ldog pa'i sdug bsngal de/ /da nas cung zad bde ru gyur la lhog lhog 'gul skyod rtsed mo yis/ /nga yi lus la srog ldan gsar pa'i gson shugs 'bar ba gzhi nas tshor/ /yin yang skabs 'gar lus khams yongs su rang bde'i gzi mdangs mi 'char la/ /ltas ngan phung 'dre'i g.yo 'og tu tshud mi zhim dbyen gyis 'dun pa'am/ /yang na nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi cig car lto ru bsdus pa gang / /the tshom yid sems kun nas dkrugs gyur mi bzod 'gyod pa'i smre ngag bton/ /lnga zla/je cher sbos pa'i lto ba zlum po gos kyi thu bas mi khebs shing / /gom kha ljid mos spo tshul des kyang sbrum ma'i gsang ba 'chor nyen che/ /pad nang bung ba 'khor ba nang bzhin dkar 'jam gzhon sha'i ngo gdong la/ /nag nog grib mas mnol thur gyis khengs phag gi gnas skabs slebs nas zin/ /mngal gnas lus can chung ngu zhig gis gsang ba'i mun klong yangs pa ru/ /'di ltar lang long gar stabs bsgyur bzhin ro drug bza' btung bcud bzang dag/ci dgar rol nus gsal la mi gsal lteg nyig snying gi lding sgra bcas/ /dbugs kyi 'byin rngub rgyun ldan gyis 'tsho bsam zhing bsam na ya re mtshan/ /—294—

zla tho chu mo dgu mdud/srog ldan 'di ni bu'am bu mo bzhin sdopy-i // 'dra'i 'dri tshig gis/ /dus nam kun tu bdag yid bzung ste btsa' ba'i dus la re bsgug cing / /nyin re'i 'gul grangs rtsis su gnyer ba re zhig 'thus shor byung ba'i tshe/ /snying rlung stod 'tshang sems khral chen pos lto bar yang yang reg dgos byung / /drin can ma sogs skyes ma gzhan las bu btsa'i gtam rgyud btu byas te/ /go rim ma nor mngal bsrung 'dzem bya shin tu zhib mos nyar ba la/ /ma gzhi sbrum ma'i lus khams 'di yang ha cang gting dpog dka' ba ste/ /shes bya'i don snying rab rib 'tshang ba'i phun tshogs 'jig rten chen po zhig/bdun zla/gsus pa'i bongs tshad shin tu che ste 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug mi bde zhing / /pre tshag rtsed mos phyogs dang phyogs nas nga la rgol ba drag che mod/ /khyo bo'i phyag gis byil cing reg tshe ha cang bde zhing tshim gyur te/ /bza' btung yi ga gting nas phye byung ltogs pa'i 'du shes yang yang 'byung / /btsa' ran nyin mor nye zhing nye zhing dpa' rang snying rtsal je chung ste/ /'jigs snang ngan ngon sems su 'dzin bzhin phru gu'i ca lag sta gon bgyis/ /bal 'phyang leb mos mdzong khug bzos la bal thig bsles ma'i ska rags dang / /'jam ldan gos kyi stod lwa 'ga' yang khab skud brtse bas bzos nas grub/ /—295—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/brgyadazla/kha sang las kyang de ring ljid pa'i lus po 'degs par ma nus sam/ /phru ma'i snod na bag yangs gnyid pa'i bu phrug dkrogs par skrag pa gang / /rked nyag lto 'bur rkang gnyis sa la yun ring 'greng bar mi nus te/ /'gul skyod rtsa rgyus glo bur 'then 'gyur ma 'gal so ru 'chang dgos byung / /skabs shig lus khams skrangs thag chod de rkang gnyis spo bar mi thub par/ /mdzub mos shugs kyis gnon tsam byas 'phral dong gi ri mo shar shur 'bab/ /gon pa'i lham yang chung drags su snang skyi pags dbugs kyis bkang 'dra 'dis/ /de snga'i a gsar yongs su zhum ste skyo ba'i mig chu dbang med shor/ /dgu zla/lto ba ri rab gtos dang mnyam ste g.yas 'khyil dung gi dbyibs 'dra bar/ /dgye sgur ngal bas dbugs kyi rgyu ba nyem nyem len pa'i skabs de la/ / srog ldan ljid mo'i gnon shugs kyis ni re 'chang ngang ba'i 'gros stangs ngoms/ /da ni ha cang 'gor 'gor byung bas lus kyi lcogs tshad 'degs nus nyams/ /brang gi myos bum ches cher rgyas las nu zho nyung tsam 'dzag byed cing / /ya khog gyen gyi 'phel kha mar phyogs khyo bo'i reg bya ches tsub la/ /zla dgu'i byed las yongs su rdzogs zin mngal kha yangs lhod chu khrag 'dzar/ /tshang rked drag gzer lan ldang 'di ni sbrum ma'i bstan bcos rdzogs tshig yin/ /—296—

mtshan ma mang po zhig la/mtshan mo mang po zhig la/ge sar/mtshan mo mang po zhig langs thag ring thag ring gi glu skad cig sems kyis yun ring 'tshosalam lam 'tsher ba'i skar ma re gnyisarang gi lam rgyags dang rang gi 'dod 'dun gyi phyir du sgrug cingaslar yang mi tshe'i lam tshigs kyi dkyog lam re la bkalamatshan mo mang po zhig langs 'jig rten 'di'i pha rol pha rol gyi gom sgra zhig la yun ring bsgugasamano bsam gting mthug po de'i phyir dungs rang nyid las gzhan su zhig la'ang rgyab 'gal bya mi 'dodagyang ldebs mthug po zhig la rna ba gtod bzhin bsdad pasarang sems 'di mtha' med zhabs med kyi brag rdong zhig dang 'dra byungamatshan mo mang po zhig langs phyi rol na khyi'i zug skad re gnyis dang rlung gi ngo bo—297—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sa srod kyi rol dbyangs dang bsdongs nas mched bzhin pa blos bslangs mdzadad dung brtse ldan gyi phu bo nyid dang lab gleng gi mdza' dungazhing grong 'di'i dwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbugs khrod sim nas yod tshul dranadran dran pa'i mtha' marang la rgas 'khogs kyi sems pa 'di dngasems pa 'di brten byed kyi bem po 'di las ci yang med song—298—

chung ma dran pa/chung ma dran pa/kher skyes/dran pa 'di rlung ltar rgyang ring du skyod ma thub na'angakher rkyang khrod rang nyid kyi grib ma 'gem pa'i bzo ltas kyangamatsho mo dang nags tshal mang po zhig gi mtshan mo'i gnyid kyang dkrogs lazhogs par me tog gi mig chu grang mo sa ru shag shag thorakhyed ni rlung dang me yi lo zla'i khrod kyi ljon lo chung chung zhig yin teng rang khyed kyi gru chung la bsdad nas thag ring thag ring zhig la bskyod ma thub na'angagatsang bo 'di'i zam 'gram na khyed la sgug mkhan nga kho na yin pasangs skad gseng mthon pos rang nyid kyi dran pa glu ru blangs nasakhyed kyi 'jig rten gyi 'gram ngogs nas nga yi nyin mtshan gyi pho brang bzhengs ngesagatsang bo'i phar ngogs na su la yang rang nyid kyi gru kha chung chung zhig yod srid la—299—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/gru kha na drod ma yal ba'i mal khang zhig kyang yod nges pasade ni 'jig rten 'di'i rang nyid kyi yod tshad 'go rtsom sa dang mjug bsdu sa 'ang yin khyed rang rgyang ring rgyang ring la ma song gongangs rang nyid ni bde skyid kyi glu gzhas rkyang rkyang len mkhan yin 'dodangs rang nyid kyi 'jig rten na 'od snang kho na las med 'dodad ni khyod kyi drod lhog lhog gi rus ming tsam gyis kyangamatha' med pa'i mtshan mo yang mdzes sdug gi rmi lam ring mo zhig tu 'gyur srid lakhyod la 'od lam lam gyi snyan ngag tshig kaung gcig bris na yangade ni nga'i 'tsho ba la 'od snang stsol ba'i nyin byed dbang po yinakhyod kho na'i phyir du nga thag ring thag ring zhig la 'gro ba'i spobs pa gtan nas skye ma myong lathag ring na nga la 'di lta bu'i nyi 'od rkyang rkyang gi 'jig rten zhig yod mi sridanga'i dga' skyo dang glu gzhas rgyu nor dang shes pa yod tshad nikhyed kyi nu zung las babs pa'i 'o ma'i dwangs ma yin lade ni cis kyang brgal mi thub pa'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig steng ni mtsho ngos su g.yeng ba'i ske shing la sgug pa'i rus sbal long ba de yinakhyed kyi mig zung gi 'byed 'dzum tsam gyis kyang nga rang me ru sbar thub la—300—

chung ma dran pa/khyed kyi nu zung gi bar stong na nga yi khyim gzhis dad dur khrod yod denga'i shi gson gnyis ka khyed kyi bar snang las brgal mi sridangs khyed kyi 'jig rten la mdzesu sdug gi pho brang bzhengs ma thub na'anga'u gnyis la sems kyi khyim gzhis dron mo zhig yod nges la'adang brtse dang yid ches kyi nyin mtshan yang yod pasa'u gnyis la gang gis kyangal ma stongs pa'i bde skyid kyi rgyal khab cig yodad ni khang mig chung chung zhig gi gru kha nargyang ring du nga rang dran bzhin pa'i khyed rang dran bzhina'akhyag zin pa'i ja lhag de yang me ltar tsha lamag mog gi glog bzhu de yang nyi 'od bzhin gsalakhyed kyi brang sha mnyen mo dang skra lo zhim po dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'jam pod dung mang po zhig khyed kyi yod tshad yod tshad kyi yod tshadazhag gang bo'i nga'i rmi lam dang dran pa yin song—301—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'grul bzhud ring mo/ (snyan tshom)‘‘gal te ngas mun nag gi khrod nas dar cha dkar po zhig mthon por bsgrengs tshe/de ni su zhig la mgo bo sgur ba ma yin par ngas rang nyid rnam dag cig yin pa ra sprod pa'i ched du yin’’khri sems dpa'/1 rmas pa'i lo zla/dus tshod sdog phyogs su bzhur nam mkha' dang sa gzhi rgyang du ded cinga'aphar sbyang gi ngud mos 'jig rten la na zug gi rol dbyangs dkrol dus ning tsho'i sems khong nas yun ring lus pa'i mag mog gi lo zla stedran zhing dran na dmag rta khri phrag gi gom pa thang chen du 'gyel ba'i dus tshigs degatam rgyud kyi gshog zung rlung ngogs nas 'dar ba'i sems kyi byang thang yinadran snang gi rtsig ldebs ngos su sprin nag gi grib gzugs 'khor zhinga'od zer gyi nyag ma re re sa nag gi bzhin la 'thim thengs rerarta pho'i bang rtsal rlung gis khur cing lu gu'i 'ba' sgra brag cas bcomade lta na'ang mu ru 'then pa'i bgrod lam gyi dkyogs mtshams re re nasakhyod tshos ri tshogs ma bdas gtsang bo ma bkag—302—

'grul bzhud ring mo/dpa' zhum pa'i mi a rang nyid kyi mig zung sgyid lug gis bsgribs nas ga tsam 'gor songadus kyi 'khor mo nyi zla'i 'gro 'ong dang bsdongs nas rgyang la gshar shul dugadung sems dang 'tshab 'tshub skrag snang skyo shas kyi tha snyad re resems kyi mtha' nas bsdus te rang nyid kyi rdzongs par 'o dod lhang lhang bosawa ye khyod kyis rang nyid brjed chog lo zla brjed chogadapa' spobs kyis bslangs pa'i rdo ring gi yig phreng gseb nakhyod kyi ming byang rang nyid kyi 'gros dal ba'i gom khas bsubs shingarigs rgyud kyi lang tsho yid pham pa'i dbugs dbyung gis yang yang bcoms chen gyi gzhi la ser ga gas shing khu byug de tsho rlung nang nas gshegs shul dudran pa shor ba'i khyod tsho mun nag gi kha gtad du 'tshub ma 'khor 'khoramig chu thigs phreng re res rang nyid kyi ngo gdong yang yang bkrus na'angadran pa'i dran par nag nog gi grib ris bskyar du babasade'i rkyen pas ngas da dung yang phyi mig gi zhen chags khrod nasabartse dung gis khyod tsho'i ming nas bos shingaskyo snang gis khyod tshor sdig mdzub kera.a a dpa' zhum pa'i mi sgyid lug gi mi angakha phyogs yod tshad tshad ma'i bsam blo dang gtan du gyes pa nasakhyod tsho gna' bo'i rdo mkhar gyi nang rol tu 'khum zhingaha cang 'khyag snang gis ‘‘drod khol—drod khol’’zer bzhin—303—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/nyi 'od lta bu'i rmi lam zhig kyang rmi ma thub bar snang gi rgod po khri phrag khyod tsho'i 'chi skar gyi gsol ston la babs pasamatha' mjug gi gdung yus drag po brag them la bskyur kyangadapal 'bar ba'i stobs shugs mkha' dbyings su gshegs songadapa' zhum pa'i mi a khyod tshos phugs bsam gyi bzhur rgyun rang sems nas nyams dmas su btang tshar bsang tshos 'od snang gi kha gtad du rang nyid kyi mig zung skyo snang gis zum dgos shing nga tshos mun nag gi mtha' nas 'jig rten gyi dkar ngogs rang nyid la gleng dgosad dung zhogs par 'jo ba'i nyi 'od kyi thigs phreng 'jam po nga tsho'i sems khral dngas srod du 'thibs pa'i smug long gi dud zhags gya gyu nga tsho'i sems rten yin song2 bgrod lam/nga tshos ri chu dang thang chen nags tshal la 'o brgyal ma bzosang tshor thog ma nas rngul khrag gis brtson len myangs pa'i bgrod lam yodadus rabs kyi ngo gdong glog zhags ltar shes rab kyi shel gong ngos nas 'khyug dus greng tshos mdun skyod kyi gom sgra sgrog tu tshud par mno bsam gtong ran—304—

'grul bzhud ring mo/bgrod lam gyi sne mo nga tsho'i sems khong du bsrings yod pasang tshos rang nyid kyi dran pa bslangs nas mes po tsho'i dpa' ngar bed spyod byed dgosamatshan lam ring mo ni nga tsho sbyong brdar la zhugs pa'i dza drag gi g.yul sa yin nadaka' tshegs thung thung skyo gdung thar thor sems ngal rab ribabagrod lam de'i don du nga tshos bar chad kyi bslu brid me ru sbar cingamig zung 'khor ba'i skad cig gi mdzes ljongs smreg med du btang zhingarang nyid kyi g.yang rong las phyi ru mchong ste/ phyi rol gyi g.yo 'gul lagazigs dngabagrod lam gyi phar sne na phu nu tshos khyod la snying stobs kyi dar cha bsgrengs zinabagrod lam de mu nas mu ru bsrings yod 'tshol snyeg gi lam dukyag kyog gi zur ngos kha shas kyang khyod kyi kha gtad du krong nger 'greng sridabagrod lam de pham nyes kyis bskyar du bskrun pa'i bde thang gi lam chen zhigad nas bzung khyod la 'jig nyen gyi tshor ba sdug mo sdug mo de yod mi 'os lad nas bzung khyod la brtson 'grus kyi skul ba'i rdog par yid ches yod dgosad dung khyod kyi skyo gdung gis zin pa'i sems par gtsang dag byas nasarang nyid kyi sems khong du nam yang rgas rgyu med pa'i lang tsho'i dpal 'bar—305—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sgron dgosabagrod lam mi'i rigs kyi bgrod lam ma gzhi nas bar thag cig yinakhug kyog mang sa ni khyod nyid ngal gso ba'i rang dbang gi stegs bu dngabagrod lam ni ched du khyod kyi sdug rus la zhugs pa'i kha dog sna lnga yinabagrod lam gyi khyod la nam yang yi mug pa'i nyams zhib byed srid kyangabagrod lam ni nam yang khyod kyis bkur bar 'os pa'i tshe srog gi bzhurargyun lagasagom zung gi 'degs 'jog re res ri tshogs kyi dbu 'phang dma' nas dma' ru btang zin na'angamakha' dbyings kyi sprin lam gshag pa'i spobs sems nga tsho su la yod myong angazhe sdang gi me lce tsha mos brtse sems kyi nags tshal gtan nas bsregs mi thub pasakhyod la nam yang song mi tshar ba'i rang nyid kyi bgrod lam yodagom pa spos zin na rgyab phyogs ni g.yang gzar dang mun dong yin pas phyimig ma ltabagrod lam gyis nam yang khyod la mi srid pa'i re ba 'don mi sridade bas dkyogs mtshams re re ni khyod kyi skyes stobs ngom sa'i gar stegs yinakhyod kyis bgrod lam gyi ched du bgrod lam mi 'tshol b.rakhyod rang nyid kyi ched du bgrod lam du zhugs rogs3 smon pa'i yul/de ni rmi lam du lan mang 'khor myong ba'i mdzes sdug gi yul ljongs shig—306—

'grul bzhud ring mo/yul ljongs der me tog gi gang bu 'dzum zhing g.yu sbrang gi gshog sgra 'jebasagasar du bzhengs pa'i pho brang gi rtsig ldebs ngos su 'ja' tshon gyi 'od gurabakra zhingastes dbang gis bsrings pa'i lam gyi sne mo re re na'ang me tog gi bsu ma modad dung dbyar ljongs shig la yod 'os pa'i bkrag mdangs yod tshad kyang de na gsal bsaskyes chen tsho'i snga mo nas rang nyid kyi sems khong nas smon pa'i lam chen rebaskrun zin la mig zung gi sgo mo yang thog ma nas 'od snang gi rtsol bar brten nas de la gtad yoda.o 'di ni shes rab kyis gsal ba'i rtog ljongs dang dran snang khrod kyismon pa'i yulakhyod kyi dbang gis gnam 'og gi rkang thang pa tshos nyin zhag gi phreng ba'i bar nasalo zla'i zur kha grangs med rang nyid kyi brtson par brdarakhyod kyi rkyen pas khom long gi rgyal sras tshos kyang rmi lam gyi klong chen khrodadangangs skrag dang mi sdug pa'i tshor ba kha shas sems kyis regakhyod ni mi yul gyi ches mtha' ma'i dwangs gtsang gi gnas mal teng tsho'i dpa' ngar gyis khyod kyi lhing 'jags bsrung thub bamang tsho'i re bzhag gis khyod kyi bar snang gsal nus sam

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/nga tsho lam gyi zur ngogs kha shas nas 'di ltar 'tshab 'tshub ngang thon pa nasakhyod dran pa'i gdung yus dang khyod 'tshol ba'i sems ngalalus po 'dis theg tshod cig khur nas khyod ded cing khyod snyeg nas 'ongad dung sems dang sems pa'i bar du brtson 'grus kyi gser zam re 'phangs terang nyid kyi ngal bar rgyab rogs dang mthun rkyen gyi lam yig sbyar zinanga'i dran rtog gi yol gor ngos su mag mog gis 'gul ba'i grib ris sngon po anang sems kyi mtha' na khyod rang 'od du 'tsher ramaphugs bsam gyi sne na khyod rang rang dbang gis g.yod ni ngas rang nyid kyi byas nyes yod tshad la 'gyod bshags kyi glu tshig brisayod pasargyang ring ni nga la mtshon na snga mo nas goms shing 'dris pa'i lam chen de lagasamathar thug gi smon 'dun dang brtse sems yod tshad gom zung skul ba'i rnga chen du sgom bzhinasems yan dang smreng skyo mtha' dag mi kha'i rlung nag khrod bskur srid lasdug rus dang dka' spyad gang mchis kyang sems kyi rta phor bskyon nges pasalag pa bsrings pa tsam gyis khyod kyi 'jam mnyen tshor thub cingarna gshog brkyangs pa tsam gyis khyod kyi grag 'gul thos thub par smon—308—

grong sde chen po/grong sde chen po/ ( snyan tshom)mtsho bu dga' bde/btson grol btang rjes/nam mkha' sngar bzhin nam mkha' redanyi 'od sngar bzhin nyi 'od redamun nag las 'od zer mthong 'dod skyes med nang slar yang sngar gyi nam mkha' dang nyi 'od du 'dzul nges de yang grogs po lan pas redanyin rgyun g.yo 'gul byed bzhin pa'i rtswa thang de dran nasargyun ldan gyi thabs shes yod tshad gzhan la gnang bas redanyin gung zhig la slong mor chas tshul/de ni nga la stobs 'byor dang mnga' thang med pas ma yinade ni nga la bu rabs tsha rgyud med pas ma yinade ni nga la khrel gzhung dang kun spyod med pas yinade ni nga la lhing 'jags dang kher rkyang med pas yin—309—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/grong sde chen po/do dgong yang nga rang 'di nas zhag sdod byasaphal cher su zhig gis bkod sgrig byas pa yin shas chelan rer khang ba'i gru zur zhig tu'o sbyor byed kyin pa'i dbugs rgyun thos thub laphrag pa'i steng nas mar bzhur gyin pa'i zla 'od kyang mthong thubalhag par du grong sde chen po 'gul med ngang btsog par bsdad nasasu zhig gi gtor bshig la re sgug byed kyin mchis pasangs gzhan dbang gis ma bslad pa'i kher rkyang gi snying bo zhig rnyed zin

dus skabs de tsho/dus skabs de cho/ (snyan tshom/)gnya' gong lha ste/chang gis bzi dus/kha ba dang 'bug bzhin dultag rgyab nas 'ongs te khyod rang rmas pa nang ni 'dzem bag med par chang gis bzichang gis bzi dusasems pa'i bye thang ngos su rlung bu ldanga'ajag ma'i shugs glu snyan ngag yina'adang rgyag med par chang gis bzi dusa'adug sa‘‘mgron khang yin’’kyang chogami de nags tshal du chas dus/mi de dngos med kyi gtam rgyud kyis bkugs nasabasdad bsdad de da ni dus tshod kyi dbang gisami 'gro thabs med byung

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ha cang rdzong stug po'i nags tshal dumi der gra sgrig med nyams myong med 'char sgo yang medang tsho dang rgyang thag gis chod pa'i nags tshal ning tshor mtshon na cha rgyus med pa'i mun nag gi gling yinami de rang dbang med par 'gro dgos skabasang rang tshur rol gyi spang ljongs steng nas kyangablo bde bag phebs kyis 'dug kyang dka'aphal cher nga rang mi de yin pa 'dra layang mi de nga rang min pa'i nges pa'ang bralayin na'ang khos 'jig rten 'dir rang nyid rnyed song snyamami rkyang tshor 'phrad dus/mi rkyang tshor 'phrad dusami rkyang tsho tsha lam lam mi rkyang tsho grang shur shurami rkyang tshor 'phrad dusangs rang sems nas bor 'dod pa zhig bor songangs rang sems nas rnyed 'dod pa zhig rnyed song—312—

dus skabs de tsho/nyin mtshan gyi dbye bar 'tham pa'i mi rkyang tshosmon lam brgya dang brgyad kyi sa bon gtor nasangs kyang 'u cag la sa zhing zhig slog na 'dodardo ba'i gtsang bo mthong dus/gna' bo'i gtsang chu bzhur shul nasanga'i rdo ba'i gtsang bo mthong byungardo ba tsho bzhur srol med kyangagatsang bo yin pas dus kyis dedardo ba tsho'i rang gshis gyong bsaphan tshun la sag sag brdaraphan tshun la ser ga dang chag grum btangardo ba'i rang gshis de sgyur bar dka'ardo ba'i las dbang la zad mtha' bralardo ba'i gtsang bodus tshod kyi chos nyid tsam gyis sgul ba lasa'agul 'dod kyang med la rgyang ring du 'gro'ang mi phodardo ba tshor rkang ba med rdo ba tshor klad pa medardo ba tsho tha na 'dug kyang mi shesardo ba'i gtsang bo rang 'khor rgyag bzhin 'dug—313—
dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'di ltar rdo ba'i gtsang bo mthong dusang yang rdo ba bzhin yid la ci yang dran rgyu med par gyur—314—

kha ba dang po/kha ba dang po/—'phrul snang gi le tshan zhigabasgral rdo/dang po/zla 'od 'og tu kha ba ni dkar sob be khu sim merargyang ring du bgrod pa'i skya mi de rmi lam dang 'drarmi lam de gru zur zhig tungs slar yang kho dang 'phrad pa'i kha ba'i mtshan mo de dran byungakho ni cis kyang phyir mi log pa'i lam 'gro ba zhig stelas dbang dang khur bo dang dam tshig gsum khur nasaganam mthar 'gro dgos zerado nub kyi kha ba'i khrod nas kher rkyang dung rang kho dang thengs du mar 'phradakhos zer rgyur‘‘ngas bod yul la gles phyag zhu dusajo mo glang ma snga mo nas ngu bzhin 'dug laganyan chen thang lhas mig chu yang yang 'byina'on kyang nga rang lam la chas dgosalas dbang gis nga la bsgugs 'dug’’

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/do nub kho rang gang na yod dmagangs ri'i pha rol gyi zla ba 'di me long zhig yin nang tshos su yang mthong thub pa red angakha ba'i khrod du nga rang 'di ltarakha sang gi tshes bco lnga dang mnyam dupha yul gyi ri grong zhig tu kher rkyang du lusang tshor lhan 'dzoms shig 'byung srid pasang tshor rang gi pha gzhis shig yod pas ngas kho rang dran byungaganyis pa/dus rgyun gyi tshes bco lnga'i zla 'od 'og tu kher rkyang ngangad lta nga rang zla ba la kha skyengs shingarang nyid kyi dam tshig la yid ches par gyur modakhyod da rung phyir ma logayang na de ni nga'i mi tshe 'di'i stong 'dun reda.oṃ ma ṇi pad+ma hūṃ oṃ ma ṇi pad+ma hūṃtshes bco lnga'i dus chen ga ler phebasakha ba snga mo nas babs byung phyogs mtshams so soragasum pa/tshon mdog gi chang dang de rukhos rang nyid bzi ba'ang ma tshoramig mdun gyi na gzhon de brel ba dang bcas —316—

ha cang mthug pa'i kha ba'i khrod yal rjesad gzod khos kher rkyang du lha sa ru bzi ba'i rang nyid kyi pha yul dranakha ba la grang ngar med par 'jam sob sobakha ba'i khrod du khos pha yul du lus pa'i bu mo de dran lakho mo dang 'dzoms pa'i rmi lam lha la bcolaha cang khu sim pa'i ri grong zhig nas

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/zur bkod/sgal chigs/zhogs dung /(mig chu/ ngu skad/ mgrin pa brnangs nas dus tshod skar ma gnyis lhag gi yun 'gor)da lta nga yid sems ha cang skyo/ ngas mig chu 'di zlog thabs med/'dir bzhugs rnam pa/ dgongs pa ma tshom/gal te/ 'u tshor gces nor zhig yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ sku zhabs khong nyid ni 'u tsho'i gces nor yin/ 'u tshor khong nyid lta bu'i gces nor mang po mi 'dugayin na'ang / da lta 'u tshor dbang ma song / gces nor 'di 'dra brdabs chag byung dus/ nga'i sems kyi sdug bsngal 'di la bzod glags bral/ khong nyid 'tsho bzhugs kyi skabs su/ 'di 'dra'i skad cha zhig bshad myong zer/ de ni paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa sku gshegs dus red/‘‘lkokhu’māṃ4/ka7lko4khya〉 1’’zhes rgya skad kyi skad cha de 'dra zhig bshad rabs yod/ skad cha de las 'phros te/ de ring ngas bshad 'dod pa ni/da ni 'u tsho'i mgo bo dma' ba tsam ma yin/ 'u tsho'i sgal tshigs je snyir song —318—

sgal tshigs/ba red ces pa de yin/ rgyu mtshan ni/ sku zhabs khong nyid lta bu ni 'u tsho'i sgal tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ ci'i phyir 'u tsho'i sgal tshigs yin zer na/ sku zhabs khong nyid kyi bsam phod pa dang / bshad phod pa/ sgrub kyang phod pa'i snying stobs de ni 'u tsho'i sgal tshigs yin/ sgal tshigs kyang je mkhregs su yong nges/ yin na'ang / 'u tsho 'gyel mi srid/khong gi rtsom gyi cha nas bltas na/ khong gis bris pa'i rtsom yod tshad tshad ni snyan ngag tsam ma red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni snyan ngag rang steng gi mdzes sdug dang / mi tshe la bstod glu phul ba'i mdzes sdug tshe srog la klu dbyangs blangs pa'i mdzes sdug de las sogs pa'i mdzes sdug tsam ma yin par/ des gnas lugs shig dang / bden don zhig rang gshis shig ston gyi 'dug pas/ ji 'dra'i dkyel yangs la sgam brling dang ldan pa zhig red ang /ltos dang / ‘‘bdag gi snying dbus te lhun por bag la nyal ba'i gangs seng dkar mos gnam sa g.yo ba'i g.yu ral gsig’’'di 'dra'i snying stobs shig 'di 'dra'i spobs pa zhig su la ldan ang / de ni tag tag snyan ngag mkhan khong rang la ldan/snyan ngag mkhan khong nyid ni 'u tsho'i dar cha yin zhes da sngon sku zhabs sman bla skyabs kyis bklags pa'i mya ngan zhu tshig tu gsungs thal/ ngo ma bden pa red/ khong ni 'u tsho'i dar cha red/ ci zhig gi dar cha red zer na/mdzes sdug gi dar cha red/ mi gzhi'i dar cha red/ mi gshis kyi dar cha red/ bden don gyi dar cha red/ khong gis 'u tshor bzhag pa'i gces nor 'di dag nga tshos nam yang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du brjed mi srid/—319—

mchan/2004 10 27nyin nub mi rigs slob chen nas snyan ngag mkhan sku zhabs yi dam tshe ring sku gshegs par bsdus pa'i mya ngan tshogs 'du steng gi gtam bshad kyi sgra phab dngos bshus pa/ kha byang ni sgra phab rjes btags/

phebs skyel smre sngags sum sgril/phebs skyel smre sngags sum sgril/—sku zhabs yi dam tshe ring gi dgongs rdzogs la bris/ljang bu/yi gar 'ong ba'i a ma'i sems ris yi ge'i 'phrul gyis mkha' nas mtho ru bsgrengs pa yi /dam tshig brtan pa a pha'i rang gshis dam nyams skye bo ngo tsha nyo rin e byed dam/ /tshe thog 'di la a thang ma chad tshe gcig lus gcig dmigs pa'i las la phul ba'i tshe/ /ring du phebs kyang a 'thang khyed ni ring na gnas pa bdag gi snying la bzhugs yun ring / /—321—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/mi bu/'bar rde'u/khyod kyi rus rkang de lcags nag gi gling bu zhig yin nam/khyod kyi glu skad kyis mes po'i rnam shes khur yod dam/khyod kyi zungs khrag de me tog gi chu bo zhig yin nam/khyod kyi ngu skad kyis bu tsha'i mig zung phyes yod dam/khyod ni nyi zer gyon pa'i brag ri zhig yin nam/brag gi ldebs la bu yig rang byon zhig yod dam/khyod ni gre ba 'gags pa'i bye'u chung zhig yin nam/'dab gshog phra mo kha char bu yug gis bkrus sam/khyod ni mngon sum mig gi gangs seng dkar mo zhig yin nam/khyod ni mi yi khrod na mi bu rang nyid de yin nam/khyod ni byis pa mang po'i nang gi bgres po zhig yin nam/khyod ni rgan po mang po'i nang gi byis pa zhig yin nam/khyod ni rnyed par sla ba'i dan rtags shig yin nam/khyod ni besleb par dka' ba'i lam bu zhig yin nam/—322—

tshig rkang bdun ma'i snyan ngag gi zhu gsol/chig rkang bdun ma'i snyan ngag gi zhu gsol/—snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring lags la rjes dran du/'brong /chig rkang bdun ma dang po/seng ge de ches brjid pa'i ri rtser nga rgyal gyis 'gyings nasagazengs mtho ba'i gad rgyangs yid tshim pa zhig byas rjesarang gi 'khor tshogs rnams la 'bod pa sna tshogs gtong bzhina.a mas thog mar byin pa'i nu zho'i mngar kha de yang yang myangasaseng ge des myangs pa'i nu zho ni gangs ri'i rtsi bcud kho na yin pasakho'i g.yu ral de nam yang sogs sgang na shugs kyis 'phyo zhing ldem lakho'i gad rgyangs de nam yang mgrin par drag tu sgrog cing mchedachig rkang bdun ma gnyis pa/go thos la thog mar khyod kyis zhabs bro 'khrab myong zerangs khyod kyis zhabs bro 'khrab pa'i sgeg nyams mthong ma myongayin na yang de dus gar stegs hril bo khyod kyi yin nges larkang lag gi 'gul stangs re re dang mig gi nyams 'gyur re re nashed dang shugs kyis gdus pa'i brtse gdung gi skad sgra sgrog cingarlung dang kha bas sbyangs pa'i blo spobs kyi stangs stabs mngon pa—323—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ngas khyod kyi snyan ngag gi tshig 'bru re las kyang da dung yang mthong thubachig rkang bdun ma gsum pa/dgun gzhung 'dir kha ba yod tshad sngar bzhin 'bab kyin yod lasde mi tshos gon pa ngan pa re gyon nas ma ṇi sngar ltar zlo bzhin yodakha ba'i khrod rdog sgra thrig thrig gi mgron po zhig rgyang nas bslebs byungamagron po des nga khyod tsho'i bu phrug yin zer zhor ki co gang mang brgyab rjesazhogs pa'i dus su khos phyi mig yang yang lta bzhin rgyang la bud songakho song shul du sde mi tshos zhi lhod ngang nangs ja 'thung bzhin 'dug modanga'i sems pa rmang nas dkrugs shing smra lce gzhi nas bcad tshar song —324—

snyan ngag pa nam yang bzhud mi srid/snyan ngag pa nam yang bzhud mi brad/—snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring sku gshegs pa thos mur/byang skar/snyan ngag pa bzhud songasbrang dkar rtsam pa lta bu'i snyan ngag de dran nasa.a ma'i nu zho lta bu'i snyan ngag de dran nasang tsho 'di ru 'dzomasadri ma med pa'i byis blo de dran nasarnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam de dran nasamatshungs pa med pa'i mi gzhi de dran nas nga tsho 'di ru 'dzomasa'adi du 'dzoms te khong la mya ngan zhusnyan ngag pa bzhud medasnyan ngag pa'i rnam shes pho brang po ta la'i dbu rtse na 'phyosnyan ngag pa'i bzhin ras lo rgyus kyi brag ngor rang byon du bzhugasasnyan ngag pa'i snying stobs bod pa pho mo kun gyi khrag lam na rgyu—325—
dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/snyan ngag pa bzhud mi sridanam yang bzhud :se srid

phul byung ba/ phul byung ba/—snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring la/dpal ldan rgya mtsho/nyi ma zla bar ches cher nye ba'i gangs ljongs ma ma'i lhums de ru/ /gangs kyi bu lo dbyangs kyi mnga' 'byor shes rab 'phrul gyi dbu lo can/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams thod du blangs pa'i mig rgyang kun gsal yangs pa'i mtha'/ /rigs mthun snying gi bde sdug rum pa'i snyan ngag glu chung rang gis len/ /gangs chab sngon mo'i chu thigs 'phos las srog gi lang tsho'i kha dog rgyas/ /yangs pa'i rtswa thang mtho ba'i ri sgang sems pa'i dpang gi rten du chags/ /dri med bsam pa'i 'du shes chu mo dus rabs gsar ba'i sngun na 'phyur/ /mi rabs gcig gi dpa' bo'i snyan pa sprin chung bu mos mkha' la khur/ /tsong la ring mo'i bzhur rgyun ltebs su brtson pa'i gser mig 'khyug gis bgrod/ /ri mtho chu gtsang gang nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul 'di'i a ma'i zhal gyi 'dzum/ /mdzes pa'i me tog dwangs pa'i chu mo pir rtser 'khyug pa'i snyan rtsom ma/ /bsung ngag dri bzhon rlung gis khur te go la'i rtse mor ngang gis 'gro/ /'tsho gzhes dug rlung shur shur g.yug pa'i yul gru dog mo'i bar snang las/ /dran pa'i sems kyi snyan ngag bu mo lhug lhug ngus pa lto rgyab min/ /—327d+ngha

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'tshol dpyod bden don lam bur bsnyeṭa pa'i lam thag stong gi pha mtha' nas/ /ngal ba'i mgo bo 'phred du ma bor dpyod shes g.yu ral dgung du gsig/dga' skyo zung 'jug 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i me tog zung gi snang tshul te/ /rtsed mtshar 'ja' ris mi sems 'gugs pa'i lcags kyi a long ring mo nyid/ /ya mtshar dgod sgra'i rlung bu'i rjes na phan pa'i bsam gzhig lci mor 'khyil/ /tsag dang rlung gi nam mkha'i ngogs su 'phur ba'i rgod po khyed nyid tsam/ /lang tsho'i zil shugs dus kyi khram pas dal bar brkus pa'i la mgo na/ /mi gzhi'i dar cha ring du btsugs pas lhab lhub g.yo ba kha ba'i mdangs/ /snying gi 'phar rtsa khrag gi bzhur rgyun 'jags med lhog lhog 'phyur ba'i 'od/ /gang de khyed kyi rigs rgyud phyi mas ri rgyud bsnyegs pa'i rten 'brel mtho/ /kha ba dkar po lhod kyis babs pas khyed kyi mthong lam yangs por phye/ /sbrang char zil ma ngang gis thor bas tshor snang dron mos khyed nyid brlan/ /ri chu grangs med pha mthar brgal ba'i sems kyi dpa' bo phul byung ba/ /brgal ba'i ri chu grangs med mngal las lo rgyus dran shing 'di ru btsugs/ /—328bhe

snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring sems khong du gnas nges/mi rigs kyi la rgya snying rtse na 'bar ba'i snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring dus gtan du nga tsho'i sems khong du gnas nges/kha sgang bkra shis tshe ring /nga tsho'i dus rabs 'dir snyan ngag gi dar cha bsgreng bar mthu stobs brtas shing yod tshad 'bul bar dpa' ba'i snyan ngag mkhan chen yi dam tshe ring sku gshegs pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung / khong nyid kyi brtse ba'i zhal ras gsal ba'i gzugs brnyan yid la 'khor ba dang / tshogs 'du dang gsol jar rol ba'i dus dang / yang na gsol chang bzhes pa'i dus kyi gtam gleng mang po zhig kyang thos 'dzin rna ba'i lam du sgrog bzhin pa'i nyams snang de dag la sems rnel du phab nas bsams tshe/ khong gis mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse sems des nga tshor shugs rkyen drag po thebs shing rang gi sems ngor don de rtag tu 'char/ khong gi snyan ngag las‘‘deng 'dir nga yis snyan ngag gyer dus yul khams gang du gnas kyang rung / / kha pho drag po'i ngang tshul 'di ni gangs ri'i ljongs kyi ngar skad yin/ / ’’ces dang‘‘sku nyid chu rkyal tsam la 'ud shod stong sgra ma ldir cig/ bdag gi mes po'i mgul rgyan rin chen rgya mtsho'i gting gi byu ru yin/ / ’’zhes pa sogs rtag tu gyer bar dga' ba'i rnam pa des mi rigs shig la med du mi rung ba'i la rgya'i dar shing mthon —329—

por bslangs/ khong ni mi rigs kyi la rgya snying rtse na 'bar zhing / snyan ngag gi me lces mun pa'i mkha' dbyings bsregs pa'i gdengs ka can/ 'od snang 'jig rten mi yul du sbyin par nus pa'i bu phrug bzang po zhig yin pas/khong nyid kyi gangs dkar lta bu'i bsam blo dang ri rab bzhin nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i gshis ka de dus gtan du nga tsho'i sems la gnas nges yin/ /

nub bzhud kyi gangs seng /nub bzhud kyi gangs seng /—bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan grags can sku zhabs yi dam tshe ring sku gshegs par mya ngan du bris pa/me lce/zhogs pa der bdag gi las grogs shig gis gzhung las khang du nga la snyan ngag mkhan khong sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i gtam mi snyan pa de brjod byung / rna bar gzan la yid mi ches pa lta bu'i gtam de thos ma thag nga'i kha nas rang dbang med par‘‘ya—da ma 'grig ma 'grig’’ces shor ba'i mod la/ sems pa de sdug tshor lci mo zhig gis mnan zhing yid sems skyo ba'i na bun stug po zhig gis yongs su btums/ de ni spyi lo2004lo'i zla10pa'i tshes24nyin red/ nyin de'i zhogs pa'i chu tshod3dang skar ma50steng snyan ngag mkhan khong 'u cag dang zhal gyes te bzhud song ba red/gangs dkar ti se'i steng 'gying ba'i gangs seng zhig gis g.yu ral gsig bzhin bzhud song / jo mo glang mar nyal ba'i gangs seng zhig gis ngar skad sgrog bzhin bzhud song / snyan ngag gi pho brang na gser khrir mnga' gsol ba'i snyan ngag gi rgyal sras khong 'di ltar bzhud 'gro ba yid la ma shar/mi yul gyi zhing khams na tshe srog la bstod glu phul ba'i drang bden gyi glu gzhas de 'di ltar chad 'gro ba sems la ma dran/ nga la mtshon na/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi la rgya'i me dpung dgung du mched skabs glo bur char zhod btsan gyis —331—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/babs pas lus kyi brang khog tshal bar gshags/ / snyan ngag mkhan gyi gsung gi legs bshad chil chil 'bab dus glo bur ma rung 'khyags pas bsdams pas mig nas skyo ba'i mchi ma thon/ / snyan ngag mkhan gyi kher tshugs mi gzhi brtan nir brjid dus mi 'dod sa 'gul yom yom g.yo bas sems la drag po'i na zug bskyed/ / snyan ngag mkhan gyi bden pa'i 'od zer lham mer 'phro skabs ma rig mun pas glo bur g.yogs pas glo snying mchin pa'i mgo rting bslogs/ /mjug tu brjod 'dod pa ni/ snyan ngag mkhan khong gi mi rigs kyi brtse dung gis byur bur gtams pa'i snyan ngag dang / 'chad khrid skabs kyi lhog lhog tu 'phyur pa'i kho la sems/ nag nog gi dri mas ma gos pa'i byis blo(sgyu rtsal mkhan zhig la mtshon na byis blo ni sgyu rtsal gyi tshe srog lta bu yin)ser po gser gyi mi gzhi sogs ni 'u cag gi‘‘dkon nor’’yin la/ de ni snyan ngag mkhan khong nyid bod mi'i sems khong du gtan du gnas pa'i rgyu rkyen 'ba' zhig go /'u cag gis snyan ngag mkhan khong la skyo gdung tshad med ngang mya ngan zhu ba'i dus mtshungs su/ ‘‘dkon nor’’dag la gces spras legs po byed par rigs so/ /

phangs pa'i skyel ma zhu/phangs pa'i skyel ma zhu/sgrol dkar skyid/ dus rabs kyi rlung kha na sku ngal gyis 'tsho ba'isnyan ngag pakhyed kyi bab brling gom sgra de gtan du 'jags pa de bden namasnyan ngag panam mkha'i rgod po bzhin 'phyo ba'ikhyed kyi mngon snang gi mdzad rjes re re labasam gyin bsam gyinabartse ba'i ma ma bzhin 'dzum pa'ikhyed kyi dung snang gi phyag bris re re la bltas kyin bltas kyinade ring gi dran gdung 'bum gyi mchod yon dang lhan dungs kyang snyan ngag pa khyed laphangs pa'i skyes ma zhu/‘‘a khu lags/ ga ler phebs’’

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sems mdangs ri mor bris pa'i snyan chig—snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring la rjes dran du/rta nag zla ba gzhon nu/gdong lnga'i go sa dbyings su 'phags pa yis/ /gri rtser snying la btab 'dra'i mu cor thon/ / mi bzod mya ngan thog zhags rgod po yis/ /sems kyi sa chen mgo bo rmongs par byas/ /skyo snang kha ba lhod kyis 'khor ba gang / / skra lo'i gseb tu thor ba ci yis lan/ /dran snang lci mo'i dngan pa stod la 'tshangs/ /mig chu'i khrod nas sgam po'i zhal ngo mjal/ /khyod la mos pa'i snying chung 'phar lding gis/ /ya chung lcags kyi sgo mo brtol la nye/ /khyod kyi kha mdog 'gyur ba'i dus mtha' la/ /khor yug kun gyi kha mdog rim bzhin 'gyur/ /bdag gi skar chen smag gis zos pa'i rjes/ /gling bzhi gsal ba'i gtam rgyud ci yang gleng / /sa srod mun pa nag po'i thu 'og las/ /nyid kyi 'tsher 'od slar yang thengs gcig dran/ /—334—

sems mdangs ri mor bris pa'i snyan tshigagangs seng rgyang la bzhud pa'i ngang tshul la/ / blo gnyis the tshom rna ba cor cor gyis/ /gad rgyangs 'ja' ru yal ba'i gtam rgyud 'dis/ /bdag gi sdug snang skyur mo'i rma kha lci/ /gangs ri'i mos mthun bral ba'i zhogs pa nas/ /dran pa'i gdung ba snying du sim pa dang / /'jig rten sgyu ma'i rmi lam rol ba yis/ /stong snang yid kyi bu chung skyo bas gzir / /tshor 'du'i rlabs rgyun 'phyo ba'i klong rim las/ /bsam blos phyug pa'i ngag gi rgyal po la/ /sems dmangs ri mor bris pa'i snyan tshig 'di/ /mi mngon dbyings su 'phur ba'i skyel mar phul/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring /—khong gi 'das skar la bris pa/mtsho bu dga' bde/gcig zhogs pa der nga rang rgyun ldan ltar glog klad kyi kha gtad du 'greng nas rtsom rig dpyad mol gyi dra ba re rer 'jug gin yod la/ zhor du rgya yig gi lam nas rtsom yig 'bri bzhin pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa gnyis dang gleng mol byed kyin yod/ kho rang gnyis las gcig ni lan kra'u dang cig shos lha sa'i red/ phal cher lo ngo gcig gi snga rol nas nga tshos phan tshun ngo shes shing rgyun du bod kyi rtsom rig skor gyi gleng mol byed kyin yod/ mtshams shig la yul lan kra'u nas yin pa des nged gnyis la skad cha mi snyan pa zhig brjod byung / ‘‘a khu yi dam tshe ring lags sku gshegs song /’’nged gnyis kyis kyang ma gros gcig mthun gyis‘‘ci zhig byung song’’zer zhor du sems la sdug bsngal theg dka' ba zhig byung / de ni grang rlung gis ser thig lhung ba'i lo ma bdas kyin ston pa'i kha zhig red/gnyis/‘‘'di ngo ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir nga la mig chu mi 'dug’’—336—

snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring /gsum/spyi lo1998lor nga rang gtsos bod rigs slob 'bring gi slob ma zhig yin la/ skabs der snyan ngag pa khong nyid lo na bgres kyang sku ngal la ma 'dzems par nga tsho'i slob grwar phebs bzhugs gnang nas gtam gal chen mang po zhig brjod byung / kho'i bsam blo dang mi gzhi dang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung sogs ni nga tshos nam yang brjed thabs med la/khos bod pa'i rtsom rig bya gzhag thad bzhag pa'i byas rjes ni chu bzhi sgang drug khongs su shong thabs bral/‘‘khyod kyi snyan ngag la mi dmangs kyi yid ches thob par ngas re sgug byed/’’ 'di ni phyi dro der sku zhabs kho rang phyir 'gro khar nga'i snyan ngag 'bri deb steng bris pa'i skad cha red/ ngas da dung nyar tshags byas yod/bzhi/‘‘snyan ngag pa rang bud song / mjug mtha'i lo zla yi chags sems dor nas bud song/’’kho'i glo bur ba'i 'grul bzhud rtswa/sa nga tsho la dang len byed dka' ba'i don dngos shig gsal bshad byas na'ang / nga tshos zlog thabs bral ba'i chos nyid 'di lta bu zhig la ji ltar rgol par bya/ 'on te da dung chos nyid cig yod pa'ang zlog thabs med pa sha stag ste/ sku zhabs ljang bu'i snyan ngag cig gis khyed la skyel ma byed cing / 'dis mi gang zhig gi 'dun pa'ang mtshon nges red/—337—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/snga phyi/da gshegs zin pa'i dam pa zhig la phul ba/gsar gtod pa zhig gi rjes 'brangs nasabashul lam ring bo zhig dal gyis bgrodalam de'i pha rol gyi sne mo rudaben zhing 'jags pa'i gnas shig nagangs ri dang mnyam pa'i bang so dkar po zhigadur byang steng du 'khod pa'i kha chems ni‘‘khyod kyis 'go brtsams pa debadag gis mjug bsdu'o’’zhes sodus der bdag thang chen de'i dkyil nas chas shinga'adas po'i bya gzhag gi rgyun bsrings te—338—

sems kyi mya ngan/sems kyi mya ngan/dbang drag rgyal/mthong smon lang tsho'i 'dab brgya dus kyis zin/ /ngag rig dri bsung mngar mo'i shis pa rdzogs/ /mtha' dag snying gi thig le pad ma'i ljon/ /khyed med chu mtsho'i phang ba stong pas 'khums/ /dam pa gang gi legs byas zla ba'i 'dzum/ /kha ba ri ba'i mdangs la mchog byin dngos/ /'di na mi brjed bskal pa'i dran shing la/ /bsnyes pa'i ngud mo stong gis mchi ma blags/ /nga tsho'i yul la mkho ba gcig pu'i grogs/ /dran pa'i sems na gsal ba'i snang brnyan las/ /mi mthong gtan du gles pa'i phyi phyag 'dis/ /skyo ba'i snying kha dmar po nad kyis thebs/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/ sems pa'i ri rab nyil song /—snyan ngag mkhan po yi dam tshe ring rjes su dran pa/khyung thar rgyal/‘‘a khu yi dam sku gshegs song ba khyod kyis thos sam/’’skad cha 'di ni nga rirang gzhung don zhig gi ched du zi ling la thon rjes grogs po snyan ngag pa 'brong gis bshad pa yin/ skad cha de ni sbrid sman zhig dang 'dra bar nga'i rtsa lam yongs su khyab song / rgyu mtshan ni snyan ngag mkhan po gang nyid g.yu ral gsig pa'i gangs seng lta bu zhig yin pa'i ngos nas nga'i sems pa'i ri rab 'jig song ba dang gnyis su med/ngas sku zhabs gang nyid ngo shes pa'i lo ni spyi lo1994lo'i zla lnga pa ste/gnas ni〈sbrang char〉rtsom sgrig khang yin/ de dus ngas sku zhabs khong ni tshor ba rno zhing lus phung bde thang yin pa las gzhan ku re dang bzhad gad la mkhas pa'i mi khog yangs shig yin pa'ang gzhi nas shes/ yin na'ang /thug 'phrad thengs der ngas khong la 'tshams 'dri tsam las skad cha gzhan pa ci yang bshad ma spobs/de'i phyi nyin/ zi ling gi srang lam zhig nas nga rang sku zhabs khong la slar yang stabs legs kyis 'phrad pa dang phan tshun lab gleng byas pa'i dus tshod kyang thung rgyu med/ yin na'ang / sku zhabs khong gi la rgya dang ku re 'dres pa'i bzhad gtam dang dri ba de dag la ngas sngar bzhin dris lan gang —340—

sems pa'i ri rab nyil song /yang 'debs ma nus/ phyi dro nub ja btung rjes nged gnyis kyis mnyam du brnyan 'phrin la bltas/ brnyan 'phrin ni ched sgrig le tshan zhig ste 'grul bzhud khug ma chen po khur ba'i dmag mi zhig gangs ri chen po zhig gi mdun du langs nas‘‘a/ gangs ri lags/ nga'i yum chen/ ’’zhes kha nas ci zhig brjod pa'i skabs/ snyan ngag pa khong myur stabs kyis yar langs te brnyan 'phrin ngos su mdzub mos btsugs nas/ ‘‘a tsi/ khyod su zhig yin/ngas mthong yang ma myong / ’’zhes brjod par nga la ya mtshan dang mnyam du skrag snang zhig kyang skyes/ nga'i sems lhod la babs rjes khong gis da gzod gangs ri'i tshab tu skad cha bshad bzhin pa shes/ 'di ni ngas snyan ngag pa khong thog mar ngo shes pa'i brgyud rim tsam yin/ nga 'gro khar khong gis snyan deb〈gangs ljongs gces bsdus〉kyi ngos su phyag bris gnang nas dran rten du gnang ba de da lta dus gtan gyi dran rten du gyur pa ji 'dra'i skyo ang / de nas bzung ngang rang khong la ma thug par yun ring 'gor zhing / rgyal khab phyi nang na snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar ba'i khong la mtshon na/ grogs po dang bzang sa mang par ma zad/ ngo shes mi shes kyi klog pa po'ang ha cang mang bas phran chung nga lta bu mi brjed pa'i nges pa'ang ga la yod snyam/yin na'ang / khong gi mi gshis ni ngas tshod dpag byas pa de 'dra zhig gtan nas yin tshod mi 'dug snyan ngag mkhan po khong gis lha rgyal tshe ring gi snyan deb〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉yi mgo brjod bris pa'i nang du‘‘lha rgyal tshe ring dang phal cher lo tshod mnyam pa'i mgo log gi 'ju skal bzang dang / lho kha'i mkhas grub/ dkar mdzes kyi brag 'go2 nyi ma/ rtse khog gi khyung thar rgyal/ mgo log gi mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs mchis ’’zhes brjod par gzhigs na/ nga rang brjed med par ma zad da dung gdeng —341—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/'jog mthon po byas 'dugad lo'i zla bdun par nga rang grong khyer lan kra'u nas bsdus pa'i‘‘ge sar stong lo'i’’rjes dran tshogs chen la zhugs skabs khong gi gser zhal slar yang mjal ba'i skal pa thob par ma zad/ gsol ston tshogs chen du 'di ltar snyan ngag gyer/ ‘‘ya ma zhon gyi gtsang bo'i ngogs su yun tis an gyi gna' klu'i brjid nyams 'phyo bar bdag gis bstod cing bsngags/ / ni ro gtsang bo'i ngogs su mnal ba'i〈zhag gcig mtshan stong〉skar 'od 'bar bar bdag ni de bas nyams snang dga'/ / 'on kyang bdag gi skyed yum mchog la gang byung rdzun gyi tshig rnams bsgrigs te dma' 'beb byed pa 'di ci zhig/ rma 'bri gtsang pos snga mo zhig nas〈ge sar sgrung〉gi mtshar sdug 'od stong 'dzam gling chen por spros min nam/ / mi rigs so so'i rig gnas tshang mar dka' ba spyad pa'i brtson 'grus med par dgung sngon mthon pos gnang ba min/ / gzhan nas blangs pa'i rgyan chas rgyus med yum zhig mdzes par brgyan pa'i 'gan de bdag la babs pa min/ / ma yum mchog gi nu zho mngar mos lo rgyus snyan tshig shar mar 'bri ba bdag gi blo gros dam pa'o/ /’’'di ni bdag gis thengs dang por khong gis snyan ngag gyer 'don byed pa thos pa yin la/ ches mtha' mjug ma'ang yin/ yin na'ang / snyan ngag pa khong nyid nam yang nga tsho'i sems su gnas pa ma zad/ ‘‘blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas’’khong gi snying stobs dang khong gi snyan ngag gi rgyun bsrings nges/ ci /—342—

kha ba'i mi/kha ba'i mi/—yang na kha ba'i khrod kyi gangs seng dkar mor/mdo smad he ru kakha ba'i mi/ kha ba las skyes shing rnyog 'dzing gi go rim shes rab kyis dkrugs nas slar yang kha ba'i khrod 'thims pa'i mi de yin/kha ba'i mi/ phyi gsal nang gsal gyi dri med dwangs gtsang gi ngo bor grub pa'i 'od kyi bu yang yin/ ri mtho chu gtsang gi yul gru 'di/ nyi zla dang ches cher nye na'ang / dpangs mtho ba'i gangs ri dang rdzobs mthug pa'i nags ri sogs kyi gru kha re rer da dung 'od kyis ma zin cing / mun stug dang grang 'khyag gi bshu gzhog khur ba'i btson ra'ang yod na/ nga tshos smon sems tig tig gi kha phyogs gang la 'dzugs/ dus de nas bzung / kha ba'i mis 'gyur med rtag brtan gyi dam bca' khur te kha ba mthug sa dang nags ri rdzobs sar chod sems kyi zhabs rjes re res bcags pa las da gzod kha ba'i ljongs kyi ngos gzhan zhig mthong zhing / zhu la nye ba'i kha ba'i bu phrug mang po zhig bskyabs yod skad/kha ba'i mi/ mi dkar rta dkar bzhon pa'i pho rgod cig yin/kha ba'i mi/ mi bzang don bzang sgrub pa'i rgan 'khogs shig yin/kha ba'i mi da lta 'jig rten du yod tshod min yang / kho'i gtam rgyud kyi 'dab ma re re kha ba'i khrod 'dzum pa'i gangs lha me tog gi mdzes sdug re re —343—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/yin/ kha ba lhab lhub 'bab pa'i nangs mo zhig la/ rlung bu shur shur g.yug pa'i zhogs pa zhig la/ kha ba'i mi kha ba'i ngo bor 'thims song / 'od zer khri 'bum bzhin 'thims song / 'ja' tshon sna lnga bzhin 'thims song /nyi nub kyi mkha' mtha' na 'tshang kha rgyag bzhin pa'i mi rabs shig gi bde sdug khur nas bud song / dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyis bud song / yod tshad kha ba'i khrod ri mor phabs te bud song / kha ba'i mi song shul du/ 'jigs yer ba'i mi tshogs kyi ngos nas/ kha ba zhu ba'i mig chu gtsang bo bzhin lhung lhung gis brugs pas/ lhung lhung gi bzhur sgra ni dus tshod kyi thag sgra bzhin/mi rabs 'di khu sim mer khyur mid gtong la nye bsam na/ ngas yang bskyar kha ba'i mi de dran yong ste/kha ba'i mi/ rnam shes gangs dkar ti se yin/ba ba'i mi/ khrag rgyun yar klung gtsang bo yin/kha ba'i mi/ mig rgyang nyi zla cha 'dzoms yin/zla 'od kyi lhing 'jags khu sim mer 'khyil ba'i gangs 'khyag gi khrod du/kha ba'i khye'u dkar po zhig babs yong / tag tag kha ba'i khye'u zhig yin pas/kho bo khye'u de'i 'gul stangs la cer zhing / kho bos khye'u de'i gsung gleng thub min la re/ re sgug gi mig zung kem kem g.yo ba'i dus tshod kyi hrag bar nas/ gyang ngos su bkal ba'i chu tshod kyi cong sgras kho bo yang bskyar bslangs pas/ yod tshad stong 'dang brgyab pa tsam red/ stong 'dang gi khrod du kha ba'i khye'u zhig yod bsam na/ nga'i sems pa yar klung shel brag yin/nga'i phugs 'dun nyi zla rang shar yin/kha ba'i mi/ g.ya' spang dang gangs ri'i mtho sar gshegs pa'i lo —344—
rgyus kyi dar cha de yin/kha ba'i mi/ bden lugs dang dpa' mdzangs kyi g.yu ral gsig pa'i nges don gyi glu ba de yin/ /

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/mjug byang /〈dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs〉zhes pa'i deb 'di ni〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉spel 'go tshugs nas lo ngo55 'khor ba'i skyes skar du phul ba yin/deng rabs rtsom rig las sgrung gtam gsar ba'i thog mar bgrang rung ba'i don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i〈pad mtsho〉dang 〈'brug mtsho〉sogs brtsams chos skor zhig tshags par 'di'i steng nas lang tsho'i 'dab lag rgyas pa yin la/ de min rang re'i bod kyi rtsom stegs steng bag chags cung zab mo bzhag yod pa'i rtsom pa po gang mang zhig gi gsar rtsom gyi 'bras bu yang 'di nas smin pa yin pas/ 'di las nga tshos tshags par 'di'i las gnyer pa rnams kyi blo khog yangs tshul dang mig dbal rno tshul gyi cha re cis kyang mthong thub pa yin/deng gi dus rabs 'di ni‘‘mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang / me tog mnyam bzhad’’kyi dus rabs shig yin pa dang / nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i ring ni bod kyi shes rig gi yo lang drag tu rgyas pa'i bskal ba bzang por 'khel 'dug par ma zad/ sgos su rtsom rig gi myu gu phyogs kun nas char phyi'i sha mo bzhin brdol 'go brtsams/ phal cher lo ngo nyi shu tsam gyi dus yun thung ngu 'di'i nang sngon dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i 'phel rgyas byung yod pa mig mthong lag zin yin la/ de bzhin du kun gyis kyang gdeng 'jog dang —346—

mjug byang /bstod bsngags kyi me tog gtor bzhin mchis/deb 'di'i nang1996lo'i tshun du rang re'i tshags par gyi〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉 steng bkod pa'i sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag bcas las nang don dang rnam pa phyogs gang thad nas legs shos dang 'thus tshab tu rung ba bdams yod pa dang / lhag par du deng rabs rtsom rig gi thad ltos bcas kyis grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod pa'i rtsom pa po skor zhig gi brtsams chos bsdus thog rtsom 'bri'i phyogs la brtson pa che zhing blo rig bzang la snying stobs dang ldan pa'i gzhon skyes dag gi brtsams chos las kyang khyad chos 'bur du thon pa skor zhig bsdus yod de/ bsdoms pas rtsom74'dus shing / rigs su bkar na sgrung gtam11 dang lhug rtsom27 dang snyan ngag23 longs la/ gzhan yang snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring sku gshegs par spel ba'i rjes dran rtsom yig14 zur bkod kyi tshul du bkod yod/'dir gsal bshad byed dgos pa zhig ni/ bod yig gi rtsom rig bang mdzod nang nas lhug rtsom gyi shing rta'i srol lam dog pa dang brtsams chos kyi 'bor chung ba'i zhan cha la gzhig nas/ sngon gyi lhug rtsom la go ba len stangs te ri chu la bstod pa dang pha ma dang dge rgan sogs la bstod pa sogs goms srol tu gyur pa de tsam las 'da' ste/ bsam blo'i bskyed yangs pa dang skabs bab kyi don bya brjod pa sogs brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom yig bsdus yod pas/ lhug rtsom gyi go khyab rgya je cher btang yod cing sna mang sne 'dzing can du 'gyur bar 'bad khul byas yod la/ rtsom yig gi sgrig stangs thad rang re'i tshags par steng bkod pa'i zla tshes kyi snga gzhug ltar du yin/ gzhan deb 'di bsgrigs pa'i go rim khrod du phul byung brtsams chos la la zhig gdam thub med pa'i gnas tshul yang mchis srid mod/ de ni rtsom —347—

dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs/sgrig pa'i las kar 'thus shor byung ba yin gyi/ gzhan gang la'ang khag dkri sa med pas 'dir ched du bzod gsol zhus pa lags/mjug tu〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉la rgyab skyor gnang ba'i rtsom pa po dang klog pa po/ gzhan yang thugs khur gyi a long ma lhod pa'i mgo khrid dang grogs po yongs la thugs rje che zhu ba dang chabs cig deng phyin yang tshags par 'di'i las lam la 'gro ched mu mthud du gzigs skyong gnang ba'i re 'dun zhus pa yin/ /zhes deb 'di'i sgrig pa po che ring bkra shis nas sbyi lugs kyi2006lo'i zla3pa'i ches7nyin zi ling nas phul/ / —348—
